description: It’s a film about a conversation that happens between mother and son regarding his sexual preference.

title: The Christmas Crumb
description: Discover the magical tale of Pip, who finds unexpected joy when a family of giants drops a yule log crumb. Witness how little things can have a big impact in this heartwarming holiday adventure!

title: The Christmas Ride
description: On Christmas Day, Georgia experiences the true ups and downs of the holiday season. Through empathy and active listening, she does her best to understand the situations surrounding her to help make the season brighter.

title: The Christmas Tapes
description: In this Christmas-Horror Anthology, a family's movie night on Christmas Eve is interrupted by a stranger, insistent on making the next Christmas 'classic' film himself.

title: The Climate According to AI Al Gore
description: Al Gore became the godfather of today's worldwide climate change movement. Director Joel Gilbert interviews Gore using AI technology, and exposes the climate scare as a political tool used to undermine free-market capitalism.

title: The Closet
description: Hiding in a closet with his life on the line, a priest reflects on his darkest secret while calling for help.

title: The Cobalt Rush: The Future of Going Green
description: Cobalt, vital for batteries, is mined in Congo at great environmental and human cost. This film investigates child labor, pollution, corruption, and the geopolitics behind this strategic mineral.

title: The Coca-Cola Case
description: Coca-Cola Uncovered: Lawyers fight for accountability, invoking the Alien Tort Claims Act to challenge the practices of US multinationals. A gripping tale of justice and activism.

title: The Cohasset Snuff Film
description: In 2009, Cohasset faced tragedy when Collin Mason murdered three classmates, capturing it on video. The Cohasset Snuff Film's infamous impact endures.

title: The Cokeville Miracle
description: Children who were held hostage in their elementary school tell stories of miraculous things, but many adults are skeptical that the Cokeville Miracle ever truly happened.

title: The Collector's Code
description: Collector's Code is a captivating documentary that explores the complex and often obsessive world of collecting. From vinyl records and vintage games to action figures and antiques, this film offers a unique look at what drives people from all walks of life and generations to collect.

title: The Colonel's Playbook
description: In 1969, Fort Worth Country Day School enlisted Lt. Colonel R.C. Rosacker to transform athletics. His high standards sparked a championship dynasty, leaving a lasting legacy of inspiration for generations to come.

title: The Colour of Darkness
description: All the colour, depth and mystery of India's complex and riotous cultural heritage is brought to light in a single action which changes two countries forever.

title: The Companion
description: What happened in the flat? Why did somebody have to die? Who is the enigmatic man who pays that visit in the middle of the storm?

title: The Company We Keep
description: Before Carter can finally enjoy life as a free man, he needs to: move out of his abusive mom's house, help his detective friends catch a possible serial killer and figure out what to do with the girl staying in his room now that her pictures are all over the missing posters in town.

title: The Company You Keep
description: Tells the story of con-man Charlie and undercover C.I.A. officer Emma. A night of passion ignites love between the pair, who are on a collision course professionally.

title: The Concertmaster
description: When the concertmaster of a symphony orchestra gets injured, a florist who is a brilliant violinist replaces her only to encounter his musical disability and traumatic past that challenges him to succeed

title: The Conscientious Objector
description: Witness the remarkable true story of Desmond Doss, a conscientious objector, and US Army medic who defied the odds to receive the Medal of Honor.

title: The Corner
description: Tired of waiting, Veronika tries to give her girlfriend direction over the phone, but Susan gets more and more confused with every word. The Corner is a 5-minute-long, one-shot-film, and it’s a story about communication and the sense (or non-sense) of direction.

title: The Corrupted
description: A lakeside cabin retreat turns chilling for twenty-somethings as bizarre events derail their weekend. Prepare for a suspenseful ride.

title: The Cottage
description: Five friends on holiday at a remote cottage unwittingly summon a paranormal evil.

title: The Cowboy Hat Movie
description: One cowboy embarks on a quest to find the ultimate cowboy hat while exploring the origin, evolution, quintessential stylings, and solidification of this iconic American West expression.

title: The Credible Messenger
description: The Credible Messenger is a story that captivates all audiences. It’s an underdog story in which the underdog wins through self-reflection, honesty, and hard work. Anyone from any social or economic background can relate and walk away wanting to help make a change.

title: The Crossroads of Angel Sanz Briz
description: Can save 200 visas 5,500 Jews in the extermination camp of Auschwitz-Birkenau? In 1944 the Spanish diplomat Angel Sanz Briz avoided these deportations in Nazi-occupied Budapest. His family, survivors and Spanish specialists, Hungarians and Israelis, as did reveal.

title: The Crumbs
description: Dr. Benjamin Crumb and his family run a Bed and Breakfast in the woods where the family conducts procedures on some of their unsuspecting guests.

title: The Cuddler
description: Samantha is a single woman with commitment issues and very specific rules on dating. Those get challenged by super-hunk David, who doesn't want to leave Samantha's bed after a night of mind-blowing, first-date sex. So Samantha must resort to bringing out 'The Secret Weapon'.

title: The Cure That Will Arrive
description: Three people with differents trajectories and lifes, however joined for a same purpose: finding the cure for close people that got sick. The time is short, 14 days. Three axis of seeking, the music, the chemical alchemy and the witchcraft. Somehow will end the seeking of the cure that will arrive? The society is sick, consequently you are as well.

title: The Curve
description: An investigative documentary examining America's response to the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: The Custodian
description: Josh Francis is a man who hasn't found his niche in life. Good at many things, nothing has provided meaning. While lost in the woods, Josh stumbles upon the physical entrance to heaven and discovers he's trapped with souls unable to cross-over.

title: The Damned
description: College student Tom uncovers a vampire clan next door. As they realize he knows, survival becomes his priority. Joined by horror fan and skeptic roommates, plus an experienced investigator, they unite against the bloodsuckers.

title: The Dark Web
description: Beyond the positive surface of social media & communication apps lies a darker reality. Criminals exploit these platforms for illicit and dangerous activities.

title: The Darkness Outside
description: 8 year old Briana vanishes from her bedroom without a trace one night. Her aunt Madeline and others involved in the ensuing search fall into harm's way as the mysterious forces behind Briana's disappearance are revealed.

title: The Daughters of Tutankhamun
description: Dr. Sahar Saleem reveals her CT scans of the tragic children of King Tut with unprecedented techniques to discover their secrets. Using these new techniques, we can unveil the faces of Tutankhamun's children, for the first time.

title: The Day After Stonewall Died
description: After their dog's death, Boots urges his son Oscar to bury his grief. On July 4th, unexpected encounters disrupt their healing process.

title: The Day of the Dead
description: Based on true facts, a gang of suburban kids is sport-killing home-less people just for fun in the streets of Chicago. One day, they decide to try a new excitement, by murdering a young Mexican working girl, assuming there would be no consequences since she was illegal. They were wrong.

title: The Dead Guy
description: Louisiana Mediumistic Communicator and FBI Agent Justice Brown is burdened with the task of solving the cases of three different female vocal apparitions, who allege that they were killed and buried in Bar Harbor, Maine by a local park ranger named Auggie Doggett. And now Agent Brown must bring the killer to justice.

title: The Dead Matter
description: Discover the tale of a grief-stricken young woman who possesses a vampire relic with occult powers, driven to extreme lengths to communicate with her deceased brother.

title: The Dead Next Door
description: An ambitious horror feature pitting an elite team of Zombie Squad soldiers against hoards of the undead and the secretive religious cult hell-bent on protecting them. Newly-restored from a 2K scan of the original film elements!

title: The Dead Sleep Easy
description: A Mexican wrestler entangled with the mob seeks revenge after a group of Mexican migrants are massacred in a human smuggling ring.

title: The Deal
description: A Hollywood producer begins with a script on Disraeli, but ends up filming in Cape Town with a black action star. Will the movie be made? Will he win over Deidre/Meg Ryan's heart?

title: The Debt of Maximillian
description: Max's secret addiction strains relationships as he begs for money to cover debts. With his family unaware, desperate measures unfold, and luck takes a sinister turn. Will one last bet save him?

title: The Definites
description: On the eve of buying a house with her longtime boyfriend, Anna Wolkoff spirals into a moment of reckoning. When the deal is done, she walks away from the life she’s built and escapes to Miami. Immersed in a world of friends, art, desire, and excess, Anna confronts the self she’s been suppressing and the uncertain, dangerous freedom of becoming someone new.

title: The Devil at Your Heels
description: Devil at Your Heels follows stuntman Ken Carter's daring quest for a death-defying aerial car jump. Going beyond the ordinary, he aims to leap from Canada to the USA.

title: The Devil Told Me What to Do
description: A young man with severe mental problems kidnaps a doctor who specializes in the sale of medical insurance so that the doctor confesses what the coven considers to be his unforgivable sins.

title: The Devil's Woods
description: Struggling friends reunite for a camping trip to a music festival. Unexpectedly, their detour to a rural Irish town uncovers a dark history of mysterious occurrences.

title: The Dilemma
description: Two men walk agitatedly on a dirt road, between underbrush and large trees. One follows the other: both inspect the place. After a while, they stop in the middle of the foliage.

title: The Dinner Party
description: A budding playwright and his wife attend a dinner party hosted by wealthy, cultural elites, who have promised to bankroll the writer's latest play to Broadway, but, in fact, have darker designs in mind for the couple.

title: The Disappearance
description: Witness Amadeo, the last Taushiro speaker in Peru's Amazon, as he communicates with nature, exposing the destruction of the forest and fading indigenous cultures.

title: The Disparition
description: In northern Peru, deep in the Amazonian jungle, Amadeo is the last man to speak Taushiro. He is old, his body is tired, he knows he will die soon. We follow him in his solitude and his rituals.

title: The Divide
description: A migrant ranch hand contacts an aging rancher's estranged daughter when it becomes apparent that the rancher is suffering from the onset of dementia.

title: The Divided Island
description: The 20th of July marks the 50th anniversary of the partition of Cyprus. The Divided Island brings the 'Cyprus problem' back into focus, revealing untold stories and unraveling the intricate history that still reverberates today.

title: The Divine Mediator
description: A study on the apparitions of the Virgin Mary. Unique documentaries about the stories and revelation of secrets.

title: The Dogmatics: A Dogumentary
description: The Dogmatics might very well be the most emblematic Boston band of this half-century, that too-few people know about. This outlier status has more to do with the untimely death of their bandmate than with their catalog of kick-ass garage rock. The Dogmatics were established in 1981. They gained notoriety with a loyal following in the Boston music scene, and beyond. The quartet was no different than any other talentless, self-deprecating, beer-swilling, girl-chasing lunkheads with guitars. It wa

title: The Dollmaker
description: Rick and Jenna, grieving the loss of their child, seek solace from The Dollmaker. But as their desires come true, they find themselves trapped in an unsettling game of consequences.

title: The Downfall of the German Dictatorship
description: From obscure Austrian childhood to tyrannical dictator, Hitler's path traces through failed art, political manipulation, power seizure, and war, ending in a Berlin bunker as his regime crumbles.

title: The Drowning Goat
description: Luca's visit to his dad's new family in Sweden takes an unexpected turn, unraveling tensions in a stressful incident. Experience this captivating story of familial dynamics.

title: The Dunes
description: A renowned journalist from the LA Times returns to his hometown of The Dunes. While he's there, a mysterious figure from his past arises and threatens his entire existence.

title: The Early Inauguration
description: What happens when a newly elected US President takes office? 'Hope and Change' meet challenges as conflicting powers influence his vision. Explore President Liebman's journey in this thought-provoking film.

title: The Earth Calling Ana
description: Ana and Juan's tale of love and home.

title: The Earthing Movie
description: The Earthing Movie is a documentary that reveals the scientific phenomenon of how we can heal our bodies by doing the simplest thing that a person can do - standing barefoot on the earth.

title: The Edge of Adventure with Adam Asher: Nicaragua
description: Join Adam Asher for this cinematically brilliant journey to one of the most remote corners of Central America. Extreme beauty meets devastating needs as Adam takes you overland, upriver, and beyond the status quo to discover what really matters.

title: The Edge of Paradise
description: Howard Taylor, brother of actress Elizabeth, bails out a rag-tag band of young Mainlanders jailed for vagrancy and invites them to live on his oceanfront land. Soon, waves of hippies, surfers, and troubled Vietnam vets find their way to this clothing-optional, pot-friendly, tree house village at the end of the road on Kauai's North Shore-the ultimate hippie fantasy perched in a pristine forest along a beach in paradise, until the locals decide it's time for them to go.

title: The Edge of Success
description: Two high school suicide clusters in six years rocks the affluent town of Palo Alto, California. Emotions run high and while no one has a silver bullet solution to this crisis, students rise up to make sure their voices are heard.

title: The End of the Day
description: On the day of the Mayan apocalypse, Quillagua village faces its own crisis. Join them in "The Last Day of Quillagua" as they confront environmental contamination caused by mining companies.

title: The Enemy Within
description: In a harrowing home invasion, a battle-hardened father faces a destructive dilemma. When guns speak, everyone becomes the enemy in this gripping thriller.

title: The Equation Of Life
description: Heartbreaking and impactful, Nathan's transformation from a sweet child to a violent bully due to abuse unfolds. A tragic event prompts reflection on kindness, safety, and the lasting impact on future generations.

title: The Evangelist
description: In Provincetown, MA, theater director Danny adopts Gideon, a religious fanatic. As Gideon's radical ideas stir up trouble, Danny faces a challenging dilemma. A thought-provoking story of faith and community.

title: The Evangelist
description: A Bible-quoting hitman and his wise-cracking sidekick relish in their work and offer their victims the opportunity to repent of their sins before terminating their life.

title: The Evil Down the Street
description: Unaware of the demonic presence, the Ryan Family moves into their dream home, inspired by true events. Prepare for a chilling tale.

title: The Evil Inside Her
description: Four friends' tranquil weekend transforms into a harrowing battle for survival amidst the North Carolina wilderness.

title: The Evils Surrounding Elvis
description: Elvis Presley was one of the most talented and prolific musicians of all time. But all the good fortune that may come with that, also brings evil. Elvis was loving and caring to the people around him, which lead to loyalty...but other times manipulation.

title: The Exhibitionists
description: Enter Walter Todd's dark journey, exploiting friends and family during a New Year's bash. The Exhibitionists blurs the line between documentary and pornography, unearthing secrets. Gripping, provocative.

title: The Exploding Boy
description: Alex dreams of becoming the next Jim Henson. Unfortunately, his life is no happy puppet show. His dad is overbearing, school is oppressive, and even the neighbors seem out to get him. But everything changes when a charismatic transfer student enters his life.

title: The Extendables
description: A disgraced Hollywood icon gets a shot at mega stardom, starring and directing an action movie in Uzbekistan. Can he redeem his career? Exciting journey!

title: The Fabled Stables: Trouble with Tattle-Tails
description: A new creature haunts Rainbow's End, terrorizing citizens! Join Auggie and friends on their quest to capture the loose Tattle-Tails!

title: The Falconer Sport of Kings
description: Experience martial arts champion Eddie Brochin's quest to master falconry in Mongolia. Learn from Genghis Khan's descendants as he soars with eagles.

title: The Falls
description: The Falls is a feature film about two missionaries that fall in love while on their mission.

title: The Falls: Covenant of Grace
description: This third and final film of the Falls trilogy revisits former Mormon missionaries Chris and RJ, six years after they first fell in love and were disciplined for it, as they formulate a plan to be together at long last.

title: The Falls: Testament of Love
description: Chris and RJ reunite five years after coming out to their families and their church as gay men, where the factors that led to their separation are revealed as they mourn the death of their mutual friend Rodney.

title: The Fans
description: In Moscow, two skinheads kill homosexual men while being in a sexual relationship with one another. Based on a true story, the film inquires about masculinity, identity, and a sense of belonging in contemporary Russia. The film’s brutal aesthetic conveys anger, fear, and frustration of those confused by crony capitalism and government-sponsored propaganda.

title: The Farm
description: "The Farm" beckons you to join the farm-to-table food revolution sweeping America. Roll up your sleeves and be a part of this transformative journey.

title: The Fastest Motocross Bike in the World
description: Two speed junkies build and test what they claim is the fastest motocross bike in the world. Then they set out for the premier, land speed racing event at the Bonneville, Salt Flats; where they overcome environmental, technical, and personal challenges.

title: The Father, the Son, and the Gun
description: A disturbed retrograde father goes to extremes to keep his teenage son from moving out of their home in rural southern America to the “big city”.

title: The Fear Engine
description: THE FEAR ENGINE is a documentary film which mixes Interview and poetic documentary styles to explore questions that focus on how we might make the world a better place. A cross section of people from artists, scholars, innovators, everyday people and children are all asked the same sequence of 10 disarmingly simple but thought provoking questions on the nature of human behavior and the values that we live by.

title: The Fight for Life
description: This is the story of life before, during and after a coma. Mariano Big Dawg Mendoza was an MMA Fighter, an Actor and a Husband. This is Mariano Mendoza. This is his Fight For Life.

title: The Final Blade
description: The Chicken cup is a treasure passed by the Emperor of Ming, and Jin's guards were the imperial guards of the Ming Dynasty who got the mission to protect the Chicken Cup. And after hundreds of Years, the Chicken Cup still exists also the only surviving Jin guard He Xingyun. So the treasure hunters are willing to kill him and get the Chicken Cup. He Xingyun then passes on his mission to the young boy Li Moxun, and the battle goes on again.

title: The First Wedding
description: The First Wedding is a story about love. Bhumi and Akash fall In love and decide to get married, an unheard union in a world of otherwise only same sex couples. We see snippets of their life through self- recorded camcorder footage, and an interview discussing their decision to fight the system, and simply follow their hearts.

title: The Flapping of the Hummingbird
description: Fran is granted a second chance to reshape his past after a life-altering car accident. A captivating tale of redemption and self-discovery unfolds.

title: The Floating Koto
description: The fate of Japan rests in the hands of a mysterious musician and a tyrannical shogun. Blinded at birth, a musician's unique musical gift grants her an audience with a military tyrant.

title: The Fly Room
description: When a wide-eyed 10-year-old girl visits her fathers insect laboratory, she receives an unorthodox education in genetics.

title: The Foodie
description: Embark on a delectable journey with "The Foodie" as host Liz Bramwell, a chef, oyster farmer, and Emmy Award Winner, explores the New England food industry. Join her in meeting farmers, fishermen, and talented chefs.

title: The Foreigner
description: In New York City, secret agent Max Menace awaits his assignment, encountering eccentric characters and puzzling situations. As he becomes entangled, the purpose of his presence remains elusive.

title: The Formula
description: In "The Formula," engineering students Quinn & Graham find a formula for dating success. But love has its own plans, teaching them valuable lessons.

title: The Foundling
description: An old woman seeks water, but the apartment owners find a missing piano. Join Natasha and her friends in a series of captivating adventures.

title: The French Teacher
description: A French teacher has her personal life transformed after she begins an affair with a student half her age. The present collides with the past, as long-buried family issues are unearthed in this complex, intergenerational drama.

title: The Friend from Tel Aviv
description: Noam, a trans artist and immigrant living in New York, gets a surprise visit from an old friend and flame.

title: The Frightened President
description: In a fictional nation, the president and first lady's love is challenged by supernatural forces. Witness their test of love in this captivating tale.

title: The Frosty Ground
description: Follow Eun-bae's journey as he falls in love with Seo-ri, a simple-minded woman, bridging the gap between their different worlds. A heartfelt story of love and connection.

title: The Fruit Hunters
description: "The Fruit Hunters" by Yung Chang: Adventurers, fruit fanatics, and Bill Pullman embark on a captivating journey through nature and commerce. This film redefines our relationship with food and what it means to be human.

title: The Fucking Lack of Love
description: Emma, head of a film production company, and her daughter Luna navigate love and identity in Vienna's cultural society. Blanka's arrival sparks change and connection, challenging their dynamics.

title: The Full Moon Fathers
description: The year is 1979. Hiding in the woods to escape the law, a fearless biker gang must come face to face with a terror from their past.

title: The Future
description: A young man meets his date at a nightclub through an online dating app. They soon find themselves lost in a moment of passion on the dance floor. As they wander into the street, they come across a fortune-teller who kindly offers them a free reading of their future …This brief encounter soon leads the young man on an unexpected path revealing his innermost desire…

title: The Future is Bright
description: In 1979, a local newscaster prepares to cover an anti-KKK protest in Greensboro, NC, and realizes that she may never be ready for the events to come.

title: The Game of the Clock
description: A teenage girl visits a friend late at night, but an empty house turns into a deadly game where she must survive five minutes without looking at a lurking monster.

title: The Gas Station
description: An unhappy gas station attendant encounters a confrontational party girl seeking retribution.

title: The Gatecrasher
description: The story revolves around a late-night party of some young boys and girls which turns into a disaster after a transgender person joins them.

title: The General
description: Unaware of his vital civilian role, an engineer faces adversity as he reclaims his cherished locomotive seized by Union spies. A daring mission ensues to bring it back through enemy lines.

title: The Get Rich Quick Scheme
description: Three students make a bet with their evil principal to succeed in business. Will they become entrepreneurs or will they fail trying? Find out what is in store for you in Samuel Pierces new film, the get rich quick scheme!

title: The Ghost on the Bridge
description: Some paranormal activities lead a writer to uncover the mystery of his wife's disappearance on the bridge.

title: The Giant Killer
description: The true story of the smallest Green Beret soldier who became a war hero-only to be killed homeless and alone, whose life and death are shrouded in mystery.

title: The Gift
description: On his eleventh birthday, a young boy joyfully picks his present, unaware of the profound impact his selection is about to have on the world.

title: The Gift of Love: A Christmas Story
description: After experiencing several stressful situations within a short time - including the failure of the family business and the loss of her mother - Janet Broderick (Lee Remick) becomes ill. Falling into a deep sleep, she dreams of returning to her hometown, taking her children with her to meet her deceased loved ones. Perhaps, during a Christmas reunion with her beloved family, she will find the answer to coping with her troubles.

title: The Girl Behind the Door
description: In a room behind a door, a young woman named Sylvie adventures through the depths of her heart. She builds a world that can keep her safe from all of the "what if's" she fears most, never daring to venture beyond the threshold of her door.

title: The Girl in the Cornfield
description: Three young women on a dark country road cross paths with a mysterious girl in a white dress, revealing a hidden truth beyond their expectations.

title: The Girl Who Left Home
description: A musical dramedy about a Filpino-American female who must put her dreams aside to keep her family restaurant from eviction.

title: The Glass Window
description: A young man struggles with balancing success and relationships until he travels to a mysterious island in the Bahamas and discovers the secret of The Glass Window.

title: The God Who Speaks
description: A documentary that traces the evidence for biblical authority and reliability.

title: The Godfathers of Hardcore
description: Discover the journey of Agnostic Front's revered members, Roger Miret and Vinnie Stigma, in the world of underground music.

title: The Gods
description: A modern day Romeo and Juliet, where Mikey James, a street hustler raised on the streets with his two brothers, goes to work for the Fasano family, as he desperately tries to find a way out of his hustling life style.

title: The Gods 2
description: Following 'The Gods', Mikey James comes back from hiding to pay old debts, only to be fighting for survival against his old enemy Anthony Fasano, awaiting his return.

title: The Golden Age
description: After a string of controversial remarks gets him dropped from his music label, pop star Maya O'Malley sets out on a spiritual pilgrimage throughout India in an attempt to resolve his troubled past.

title: The Golden Apron
description: A mockumentary crew follows the 5 main contestants of The Golden Apron contest, a competition in search of "the greatest home chef in America", being held by a nefarious food manufacturing company with their own corporate agenda.

title: The Goldfish Memory
description: Armando and Gualtiero are two elderly homosexuals who have been living together for fifteen years now. One day, though, the unthinkable happens: Armando, suffering from Alzheimer's, no longer recognizes his partner and, as if that weren't enough, he believes he is married to Paloma, their South American caregiver. Gualtiero's attempts to win back Armando turn out to be holes in the water, but where the man fails, the goldfish arrives, Elton John, who keeps a secret in his aquarium.

title: The Good Exorcist
description: After a ranch in Texas is befallen to a mysterious, demonic presence, it is up to an eccentric, wandering priest to find answers and dispel the darkness. As he digs deeper he soon finds that he may be in over his head and out of time.

title: The Good People of Orphan Ridge
description: When an indie rock band sneaks into a haunted house to record their final album, they are met with more than they bargained for: fairies, banshees, and the ominous Innkeeper.

title: The Grave
description: The Grave is a story of a gravedigger who has been digging graves for more than thirty years. His ancestors believed that if anyone could dig 100 graves, they would go to heaven. But...

title: The Great Route
description: Stand Up Paddler, adventurer, and environmental activist Michael Walther sets off with filmmaker Maximilian Stolarow and photographer Daniell Bohnhof to find the hidden beauty of Greenland´s remote west coast.

title: The Great Rupert
description: Join a charming little squirrel as it unwittingly aids two struggling families in overcoming their obstacles. Witness the heartwarming magic unfold.

title: The Greatest Adventure: Book of Dragons
description: Embark on an extraordinary adventure with Finn and Haldor as they explore classic bedtime fairytale stories, including the incredible tale of "The Book of Dragons."

title: The Greatest Adventure: King Arthur
description: Embark on a magical adventure with Finn and his dragon, Haldor, as they soar through the skies and encounter timeless bedtime fairytales.

title: The Grey Zones
description: At the age of 21, Nicolás decides to get his first HIV test. The uncertainty about the disease will affect the relationship with his family and his sexual life during the weekend he awaits the results.

title: The Grump Who Stole Christmas
description: Larry the Reindeer thinks he can fill Santas shoes but he is about to get more than he bargained for. When a wicked Grump, accompanied by his robot sidekick Clank, casts a spell that allows Larry to switch places with Santa, the future of Christmas rests in one simple minded reindeers hooves.

title: The Half Wall
description: A gay couple’s lunch break does not go as planned when they engage in a discussion about how they can renovate their cabin bathroom. They suddenly find themselves in a heated argument which leads to a series of misunderstandings. Based on a conversation the director had with her wife, «The Half Wall» tells a true story about the difficulties of communication, and how it sometimes leads to stupid and (later) laughable misunderstandings.

title: The Ham or the Pig
description: A film crew paints a portrait of a werepig. Through his relatives and scenes of daily life, we come across the life of a man who periodically turns into a pig.

title: The Handout
description: Lonely and wealthy Laura auditions for "The Handout," a TV show where three beggars compete for public compassion, collecting live donations from home.

title: The Handover
description: Amidst moving apartments, a couple races against time to organize everything before the landlord's crucial final inspection. Chaos ensues.

title: The Happiness
description: An oppressive heat and economic crisis in the most important coastal city in Argentina. "Mikei" begins working for Oscar, a self-proclaimed inventor of "Happy Trains". Once on the train, he will meet a princess and find love.

title: The Hard Ride
description: Amidst the Vietnam War, a GI fulfills his promise to care for his fallen comrade's motorcycle, "Baby". Back home, he encounters trouble with rival bikers opposed to his possession of the bike and the girl.

title: The Hardwood
description: The Hardwood is a fascinating drama about the turbulent life of Lee Rhodes, a star collegiate basketball player who is lured into the perilous world of clandestine organ trafficking by one of his college professors.

title: The Harvest
description: Docu-musical merges Punjabi dance and documentary, unveiling worker exploitation by gang-masters. Intertwined stories span dawn-to-dusk toil and evening prayer, revealing distant harvest amidst permit renewals and fake paychecks.

title: The Haunting of Alexis King
description: Alexis King is a budding college student with a bright future in front of her. But when she inherits her deceased mother's estate, Alexis' dark past gives rise to dangerous paranormal activity and threatens the lives of everyone she loves.

title: The Haunting of La Llorona
description: The screams of children echo in the night, as La Llorona, a vengeful force, seeks the blood of the innocent. The chilling legend comes alive in this haunting tale.

title: The Head & The Hand
description: Explore the intertwined lives of two disabled women on a remote Portuguese island in this meditative documentary.

title: The Heart
description: Arash and Rasta, those who love each other, on their wedding day, Rasta disappears and the wedding breaks up. Rasta does not talk about the reason for her disappearance and no longer intends to marry Arash. The lives of both of them are destroyed.

title: The Heart of the Volcano
description: In a desperate act, Gregorio strikes a deal with a warlock to save his daughter's soul. As his strength fades and crops wither, Nextli embarks on a journey to free her father's soul and reclaim their land at the volcano's summit.

title: The History Begins Starting From Us
description: Mixing images of trips in Europe during the 1970s, “The history begins starting from us” visually reconstructs the experience of the exiled Brazilian women during the military dictatorship. The short film attempts to retrace the steps of the Brazilian diasporic communities created in Europe and invites the spectator into the world of an anonymous “we”.

title: The History of Magic: Ensueño
description: In the isolated border town of West Texas, teenager Ester Bolaños navigates life with curiosity and a wild imagination. 'Ensueño' explores how her vivid fantasies infiltrate even the simplest of daily routines.

title: The Holiday Shuffle
description: When a holiday gift exchange goes hilariously wrong, a group of coworkers must navigate misunderstandings and rediscover the spirit of teamwork.

title: The Holy Path
description: Young couple Hunter and Olive navigate their relationship with Evelyn, Olive’s disapproving and obsessively religious mother. When a mysterious hole appears in the floor of their new home, things start to heat up…

title: The Horse, the Human, the Truth
description: Human domestic violence parallels horse training. By highlighting subtle abuses like coercive control, it resonates with viewers’ experiences and engages those interested in social issues and animal training.

title: THE HUNT
description: Mats, 23, lives a restless, wild youth, searching for acceptance, while his father, Sebastian, 55, lives a static hermit life in the woods, mourning his wife and creating fleeting environmental art. After a hunting trip goes awry, Mats flees into the forest and reunites with his father.

title: The Hunter Legacy
description: A million species are threatened with extinction due to humans. Nowhere is this reality more pronounced than in Kenya, a nation the size of Texas with twice the number of people. The result is humans and wildlife in competition for resources.

title: The Hunting of the Snark
description: Join a peculiar group as they set sail on a quest to capture 'The Snark' in this enigmatic voyage.

title: The Idea of Manhood
description: Two old friends unexpectedly spend one day together and end up debating each other's shortcomings. The conversation and day go places neither of them predicted.

title: The Illegal
description: A gritty realistic story about a young film school student from middle-class India who's forced to drop out to support his family while staying in the United States as an undocumented worker.

title: The Immensity
description: La Inmensidad is an Argentine fiction feature film inspired in some ideas and texts of the Italian poet Giacomo Leopardi. Paolina and Antonio, brothers, accompany their terminally ill friend Giacomo in his last days of life. Wishes, dreams and reality are blend in an atmosphere that fights against the worse enemy, time.

title: The Inevitable Death of the Crab
description: When businessman Carlos Barba and his son Santiago receive an extort call from a professional, they dismiss it as the work of a scam artist. But a series of unfortunate events force them to discover who is who in a political system hijacked by corruption.

title: The Infected
description: Revolves around Marcos, a thirty something year old man largely unremarkable but for the fact that he managed to escape an epidemic of the undead sweeping through Mexico City - and, indeed, the world - by taking flight and surviving as best he can in the remote hill country. It is there that he meets and takes up with the oafish Renato, young mother Claudia and her young daughter Zoe. The rules to survive are simple. Leave no trace, make no sound and leave no odors behind. The undead, you see, h

title: The Inflight Food Trip
description: Join Nik Loukas, the airline food guru, on a global journey discovering what goes into the meals served at 35,000ft. Explore behind-the-scenes and unique airline food stories.

title: The Inside
description: A group of girls face violent vagrants and a terrifying supernatural evil that threatens their lives in this gripping horror tale.

title: The Interpreter
description: Inspired by true events, The Interpreter follows a fledgling love triangle between Jacob an American man seeking to date a Japanese woman, Hiromi, and Kaito, their Japanese-American interpreter in Tokyo, Japan. As Kaito tries his best to maintain his polite and professional boundaries as a hired third party, his genuine chemistry with Hiromi becomes harder for him to ignore.

title: The Intruder
description: A young, paranoid man begins to believe someone is breaking into his house every night.

title: The Investors
description: The morality shakedown continues in Hollywood as new-age producers challenge aspiring artists to ignore abhorrent behavior in exchange for a career bump.

title: The Issue with Elvis
description: First feature film by Charlotte Wincott about a botanist who meets a runaway boy in the mountains of West Virginia.

title: The Jakes Are Missing
description: Janice and Donald Jakes fall out of love and into Police Protection. In a journey filled with unexpected events, they rediscover the true meaning of love.

title: The Jazz Singer
description: The son of a Jewish Cantor must defy the traditions of his religious father in order to pursue his dream of becoming a jazz singer.

title: The Job
description: A bank heist takes an unexpected turn when one of the robbers plays a dangerous double game. Watch as the plot thickens in this gripping thriller.

title: The Journey: Mère Océan
description: Leina and Jean-Marie embark on a wild ocean journey during pregnancy, exploring the universal question of welcoming a child. A philosophical adventure awaits.

title: The Judge's Shadow
description: When the blood flows, no one will be able to hide the trail of a lie.

title: The Jungle Book
description: Witness the extraordinary journey of a boy raised by wild animals as he navigates the challenges of adapting to village life.

title: The Keys of the Kingdom
description: A Michael Chin film.

title: The Killing of Jacob Marr
description: After a haunting past, a disturbed man returns to find his childhood home occupied by vacationers. His sinister intentions unravel in this chilling tale.

title: The King of Arcades
description: Follow the rise and fall of the King of Arcades as one man pursues his dream against all odds.

title: The King's Highway
description: A film about the highway that connected the American colonies. The discovery and preservation of historic places in Philadelphia. The true origin story of America.

title: The Kinsey Sicks: I Wanna Be a Republican
description: From the gals that broke the Kinsey Scale comes a live show that you wont want to watch with your parents. This political acapella group dons their biggest wigs and American flags in this musical live show where they decide to leave their morals behind in exchange for all of the greed and corruption of the Good Old Party.

title: The Knight in the Tiger's Skin
description: Prince Tariel is in the quest for his captured love, Nestan, but he fails. All attempts are in vain. He retires to a cave to live in the wilderness. Since then, he dresses in tiger skin, a reminder of his love. Help comes unexpectedly.

title: The Knowledge of the Forever Time Part 3: The UFO Stargate Agenda
description: A new novel perspective about the Extraterrestrial presence now engaging the planet Earth, as well as our place in the Universe. This film reveals an amazing connection between the UFO's and our world which will completely change the way we see our past.

title: The Knowledge of the Forever Time Part 4: The Prometheus Stones
description: Ancient rocks have been carrying a secret, and now we can finally read them. Each rock is a Prometheus Stone, and within each stone is the knowledge of immortality.

title: The Knowledge of the Forever Time Part 5: The Stargate Found
description: From the sacred knowledge of pyramidal structures around the world to the unmasking of the origins of extraterrestrial aliens, this program reveals one of the greatest mysteries of all time, the location of the Stargate.

title: The Knowledge of the Forever Time Part 6: The Black Knight Satellite
description: This documentary opens a dark and hotly debated chapter in our human history. The Black Knight Satellite. It is the definitive understanding and the final word on this wayfaring instrument of our demise.

title: The Kybalion
description: This film is an adaptation of the 1908 occult manuscript, The Kybalion - and explores the 7 principles of Hermetics. It is a surreal documentation of the supernatural world around us.

title: The Lady and the Highwayman
description: A thrilling story of love, treachery, rivalry, crime, and political scheming unfolds in the 1660s, amid the Restoration of King Charles II to the English throne.

title: The Lake Girl
description: Legend has it that on July 7, each 100 years in "enchanted lake", a mysterious girl will test her charms to help the people of good heart and punish people corrupt.

title: The Lake of Scars
description: In a corner of Victoria exists a place of astounding beauty and rare archaeological and environmental significance. On the verge of being lost forever, an unlikely partnership could see it saved.

title: The Landing
description: An investigation into the tragic end of Apollo 18, the last US mission to the moon in 1973. In interviews conducted in 1998, on the 25th anniversary of the incident, witnesses and participants peel back the layers of mystery surrounding the events that nearly destroyed an American institution.

title: The Last Breath of War
description: From empire to ashes-Japan's rise, war, and reckoning. A gripping journey through ambition, conflict, and the cost of a nation's destiny.

title: The Last Christmas Party
description: Three college couples spend one final night having a Christmas party before they go off for winter break.

title: The Last Days of Emma Blank
description: A woman living in a large country home drives her servants to mutiny with her outrageous demands as she waits for death to come for her.

title: The Last Days of Patton
description: July 1945. The war in Europe is over and General George S Patton is now military governor of Bavaria. True to form he doesn't always see eye-to-eye with his superiors and is prone to making comments that they don't approve of.

title: The Last Descent
description: In 2009, John Jones explored an unmapped section of the famous Nutty Putty Cave. After becoming stuck in a hole 18 inches wide and 150 feet underground, rescue crews worked frantically and heroically to free him to get him home to his loving wife, Emily. This is the story inspired by not only the incident at Nutty Putty, but by the way John lived his entire life.

title: The Last Earth Girl
description: Facing the impending apocalypse, a young woman reevaluates her priorities and sacrifices on the path to her dreams. A thought-provoking journey unfolds.

title: The Last Fiction
description: The Last Fiction" is the first animated feature film made entirely in Iran. This contemporary looking crowd-favorite film played in countless film festivals and received multiple awards. Based on classic Persian literature.

title: The Last Floor
description: Within an intensely claustrophobic setting, this chilling horror film follows Alma, a timid girl trapped with Eduardo in an elevator.

title: The Last Letter
description: A 70-year-old Gay Mohan still in the closet, living in a heterosexual marriage in Mumbai, starts to see things differently after revisiting the reality from which he escaped years Ago.

title: The Last Mogul
description: An innkeeper bikes 700km to Rome, bringing Pope Francis local eco-friendly products, inspired by the "Laudato si'" encyclical on environmental care while reconnecting with communities along the way.

title: The Last Morning of the World
description: A young man prostitutes himself on the streets of Paris on Christmas Eve. He is going to meet his guardian angel.

title: The Last One
description: Near future. Madam Victoria is the last inhabitant of the city. After a sequence of events, humanity began a new era on the New Earth. One of the few remaining cities on Earth that are still standing, is for sale. With the arrival of the mysterious Adam, Madam Victoria visits familiar places, now covered with dust. Will they manage to find understanding and is Adam a suitable buyer?

title: The Last Opportunity
description: Vanesa, a young woman, decides to give herself the last chance to find love in each of her peculiar dates that her friends organize for her or that she finds on social networks. What Vanesa doesn't know is that you find love where you least expect it.

title: The Last Passenger
description: An old hotel is at the center of legends told by Eduardo Gamba. But when contradicting accounts surface about the legitimacy of the hotel's title deed, Gamba turns out to be a skilled storyteller and a clever interpreter of the truth.

title: The Last Post Office
description: On the edge of Bangladesh, between mountains and water, stands a post-office, the only sign of civilization. It has a notorious reputation: its employees disappear. Two men, in love with each other, work there.

title: The Last Request
description: Two brothers wake up in a strange house and must play a deadly game in order to get their child back.

title: The Last Schnitzel
description: In a future where Earth is uninhabitable, the President of The Grand Turkish Republic craves a chicken schnitzel, but chickens are extinct. Kamil, the Chief Presidential Assistant, faces a daunting challenge to save their nation.

title: The Last Supper
description: The story of two warring generals (Liu Bang and Xiang Yu) fighting for control of China at the end of the Qin Dynasty.

title: The Last Supper: A Sopranos Session
description: An intimate and hugely entertaining dinner with key members of the cast of The Sopranos, as they reminisce about the show, filmed in the Little Italy restaurant, IL Cortile, that cast members would go to for a commiseration dinner after their character had been killed off in the show.

title: The Last Surviving Cheetahs
description: Centered around the Asiatic Cheetah, an endangered species, which was believed to have been extinct before 1996. “The Last Surviving Cheetahs” is a retracing of the director’s journey to discover the Asiatic cheetahs in remote regions of Iran.

title: The Last White Knight
description: In 1965, 21-year-old Torontonian, Paul Saltzman drove to Mississippi, volunteering as a civil rights worker with the Student Non-Violent Coordinating Committee. He was arrested, spending 10 days in jail. He smuggled letters out of jail to the Toronto Star. Canadian Foreign Affairs requested his release but Saltzman declined.

title: The Laughing Mask
description: If you're guilty, beware The Laughing Mask. Jake Johnson lost his wife and child to a psychotic killer known as Laughing Mask and goes to extreme measures to achieve his revenge.

title: The Legend of Bob Leonard
description: In the forest, Norman soldiers face ruthless thugs. A minstrel trades his life for a song, promising immortality. Legends are born, truth whispers.

title: The Legs of Saint-Pierre
description: Pierre Molinier, painter and photographer, was found dead on March 3, 1976, shot in the head, in his room at 7 rue des Faussets in Bordeaux. The documentary Les Jambes de Saint Pierre highlights the life of this enigmatic and sulphurous character whose unity results from an astonishing fusion where his work, his life, his death, merge.

title: The Lessons My Mother Taught Me
description: Benji tells us the story of the beginning and the tragic ending of his friendship with Nino. The contrast between what is narrated and what is seen questions the memories of important events in our lives. Benji’s first sexual experience brings out his latent sadistic nature to which he never admits he has. He justifies the murder of his best and only friend through the lessons his mother taught him.

title: The Letter Writer
description: When a teenager receives a mysterious letter in the mail, she sets out to find the author. It's a journey that will change her life forever.

title: The Life of Jesus
description: Jesus Christ is simply the most famous and influential man who ever lived, so this documentary gives a complete and precise account of his life, from his birth to his baptism, to his teachings, to his execution, to his resurrection.

title: The Light of the Moon
description: After her world is irrevocably changed, a successful New York City architect struggles to regain intimacy and control in her life.

title: The Light Touch
description: Sexy puckish pickpocket Becky, a Bugs Bunny of a girl, is teasing a wallet out of a purse on a crowded Athens metro when she notices Miranda, falls in love, and the chase is on. Oops, Becky picks the pocket of a policeman on vacation, her Elmer Fudd, and he's obsessed with catching her.

title: The Line
description: In this gripping criminal thriller set on the Ukrainian border, explore a world of traffickers and smugglers. Experience life on the edge of borders in this captivating feature film.

title: The Lion
description: A fresh faced video director sees an opportunity to prove himself in a voice-over recording session for a company brand film.But with a script that reads like corporate nonsense, clients holding the creative process hostage and voice over talent refusing to cooperate, preventing a train wreck is looking rather unlikely.

title: The Lioness Within
description: Meet Graciela Casillas, a pioneering, undefeated world champion in martial arts mentored by Dan Inosanto. Her story unfolds—a hidden champion breaking barriers for women, embodying resilience, and embracing empowerment. A celebration of martial arts and a transformative teacher-student dynamic.

title: The Little Shop of Horrors
description: A clumsy young man's plant grows carnivorous, compelling him to commit murder in order to satisfy its insatiable appetite.

title: The Little Vampire
description: 13-year-old vampire Rudolph befriends Tony, a mortal boy with a fascination for castles and vampires. Together, they confront a vampire hunter and save Rudolph's family, forging an unbreakable friendship.

title: The Lonely Italian
description: The journey of a young Italian man looking for love online in America.

title: The Long Rider
description: When Filipe Leite leaves his adoptive home of Canada, the aspiring journalist sets out on an epic quest to ride from Calgary to his family's home in Brazil - and later beyond - entirely on horseback.

title: The Long Shadow
description: When filmmaker and investigative journalist Frances Causey, a daughter of the South, set out to explore the continuing racial divisions in the US, what she discovered was that the politics of slavery didn't end with the Civil War. In an astonishingly candid look at the United States' original sin, The Long Shadow traces slavery's history from America's founding up through its insidious ties to racism today.

title: The Long Way Home
description: Joel's world turns upside down when he discovers his wife's ailing dog, Elvis. Locked out of home, he embarks on a desperate journey to reclaim his shelter.

title: The Longest Line
description: The longest line between two tarmac roads in the UK was detailed by Ordnance Survey in 2019, follow Jenny and Calum as they walk the line from start to finish, crossing the rugged and remote Cairngorms National Park.

title: The Longest Month
description: No narrator. No script. These are the gripping true stories, told by the U.S. Army aviators, ground crews, and ground troops, who took part in the most consequential military operation of the Iraq War: "The Surge." Four intense stories of courage and sacrifice.

title: The Longest Run
description: Two rival getaway drivers settle the score on the open road.

title: The Looking Glass
description: Enter a surreal thriller as Paul's life takes a dark turn when his girlfriend's sinister mother arrives. Fear, secrets, and a malevolent influence collide in this gripping tale of destiny.

title: The Lost City
description: In 1982 Peter Brosnan heard a story about an ancient Egyptian City buried in California. For thirty years he has been fighting to dig it up.

title: The Lost Elf on Christmas
description: Kuttie Pie, a little elf, gets lost in a blizzard while looking for Santa before Christmas. Jax decorates for Christmas and realizes Kuttie Pie is missing. HayleeCookie comes across Kuttie Pie and helps him find Santa. They meet some of Santa's helpers. Finally, Kuttie Pie finds Santa and safely returns home.

title: The Lost Mail Adventurer
description: Lola Lokidor is an intergalactic adventurer who fears nothing. Her last job ? Postwoman for the G’lactic confederation.

title: The Lost Mantle of Elijah
description: The spirit of a murdered king gives Kai the cloak of Miracles to raise him from the dead. Kai discovers that working miracles is not as easy as he imagines.

title: The Love and Beheading of Anne Boleyn
description: Henry VIII and Anne Boleyn's story is one of passion, ambition, and tragedy that altered the course of history. Their romance challenged the Catholic Church and led to the creation of the Church of England. But as Anne rose from lady in-waiting to queen, her life was marked by political intrigue and betrayal. Henry's once-devoted love turned to bitter mistrust, leading to Anne's shocking trial and execution. This documentary explores their turbulent relationship, its impact on England, and Anne'

title: The Love Section
description: Ali, is a struggling real estate agent and ladies man who has never desired to commit to anyone or anything. One night while out with his buddy Chris, Ali meets and falls for Sandrine, a single mother who works hard and is looking for love.

title: The Maid
description: An American teenager forms a deep emotional bond with his father's foreign maid during a visit to England. A tale of cross-cultural connection and love.

title: The Maladjusted
description: Drunken parties and chasing after good times turn an innocent beach trip into a wild life-changing adventure while three friends struggle to maintain their hedonistic lifestyle as they approach 30.

title: The Man in Room 6
description: Carrie (Jackie Kelly) is a socially-troubled young woman trying to mend a strained relationship with her mother. After her grandfather dies in a nursing home, Carrie finds herself attracted to William (Bill Oberst Jr.), an elderly man in a neighboring room. William's doctor offers Carrie a part-time position with the nursing home to keep tabs on the old man. William shares a series of tall tales from his life as a younger man. He claims to be immortal, cursed to never die, but to grow old and si

title: The Man in the Living Room
description: Peter insists on a mysterious man's presence in the living room, while Rebecca remains unconvinced.

title: The Man in the Trunk
description: A late night knock at the door from an absent friend brings the question - "I need you to come with me, but I can't tell you where we're going or what we're going to do." How far would you go to help those you care about?

title: The Many Faces of Beth Jones
description: After a TV success, Beth's agent lines up new roles, but they may not match her expectations. Excitement turns to uncertainty in this comedic tale.

title: The Marriage Fixer
description: A marriage counselor grapples with the task of remedying his neighbor's relationship woes. What will be the outcome of his professional services?

title: The Marvelous Mrs. Shenkman
description: The Marvelous Mrs. Shenkman is a comedy special starring a real-life Mrs. Maisel. April Hava Shenkman is flocked out of her mind, pregnant and turning 40 - what's she going to do? Throw herself a baby shower with puppets.

title: The Mason Brothers
description: Outlaws seek justice, betrayed during a bank heist. They confront their brother's killer in a rival gang. Action-packed quest for vengeance unfolds.

title: The Medallion of La Llorona
description: A Texas family moves into a house which is terrorized by the spirit of the infamous Mexican Weeping Woman. She is attracted by a cursed amulet, the Medallion.

title: The Meeting
description: José falls in love at first sight with Clara, later discovering that she could be carrying the transplanted heart of Amanda, his former wife who died 3 years ago.

title: The Memory of You
description: Adam is going to dinner with his wife, when he is disrupted by something from his past. A story about a love that never was, shot in one single take.

title: The Merry World of Leopold Z
description: Amidst urgent snow removal duties, a worker strives to buy last-minute gifts on Christmas Eve, navigating chaos without abandoning their job.

title: The Method
description: In Madrid, Dekia Corporation conducts interviews amidst protests. The Grönholm method unveils mind games as applicants search for the HR mole, testing ethics and loyalty.

title: The Milkman: Vengeance
description: After witnessing the murder of his beloved Grandfather, during his childhood, a Special Operations veteran with a tick, returns to his city to enacts his own retributive justice against the bad element of the city and those in power who turn a blind eye to protect his family.

title: The Milky Way
description: Embark on a transformative pilgrimage as two drifters journey from France to Santiago de Compostela in Spain. They confront dogmas, heresies, and the challenges of survival while hitchhiking and seeking sustenance along the way.

title: The Miracle
description: Camila, a 16-year-old teenager, and her Sister Pía, 11, after the tragic death of their parents, roam the streets of a small town in the Ecuadorian highlands, they will have to search for anything to eat.

title: The Mirror
description: A young woman's life changes when she discovers evidence of an eighty-year old, unsolved murder mystery that took place in the very house in which she now lives. The mystery deepens as she realizes that the silent movie star that once lived here had a hidden dark side. Playing amateur detective can be fun - until she finds that prying into other people's secrets uncover hidden motives of the people around her - like her parents and their sordid double-life.

title: The Mirror Game
description: Two childhood friends find themselves in Vegas on the same weekend, and one night together-with one life-altering favor-will change everything for them both.

title: The Misguided
description: After planning to leave the city with his girlfriend, a young man must first betray her in order to save his brother from a deadly situation.

title: The Misty Green Sky
description: A young girl in another solar system asks an innocent question that sets off a chain reaction of adventure, destruction and tragedy.

title: The Monopoly on Violence
description: Academics opposing the rule of the Government and the ability to make laws and tax. Trying to use a rationale perspective to offer anarchy as acceptable.

title: The Mountain
description: The Mountain: A gripping true story of Amy, a girl battling PTSD. Corruption and neglect plague the Neuro-Rehab Center. In chaos, Amy finds solace in Charity, a staff member turned love interest.

title: The Mountaineer
description: Victoria Stokes, a young daughter of a wealthy businessman, runs away to escape an arranged marriage with an evil coal tycoon businessman Langley Prescott so she can instead be with the man she truly loves, Joshua Forbes.

title: The Moviemakers: Tarantino
description: Since the early 1990s, Quentin Tarantino has been on a cinematic rollercoaster ride, that's never looked like slowing down, that has cemented himself as one of the worlds most influential filmmakers. Through his unique style, Tarantino carved out a place in Hollywood just for him, and even when others have tried to emulate him, his films stand-out amongst the crowd. And with one movie left before he supposedly retires, we take a look back at the ups and downs of his incredible life on film.

title: The Moving on Phase
description: Piper, a young adult, faces a life-altering change when her boyfriend ends their relationship and evicts her from their shared home.

title: The Mundo King
description: If you dream it, they will come. This cosmic exploration paints the portrait of artist Rolf Schulz's pursuit to make his dreams come true through his endless toil to complete the majestic Mundo King Castle on a hill in the Dominican Republic.

title: The Musical Adventures of Afro Banzai
description: A group of culturally diverse teens who each receive an invitation to a mystical music school where they take on various challenges to help unlock their hidden musical potential.

title: The Mystery of Mr. E
description: Twin brothers John and George Danes are visited by a stranger who knows where they are heading, announces himself as 'the murderer' then disappears. On arrival it isn't long before a guest is found dead in mysterious circumstances.

title: The Nail Shop
description: The Nail Shop is an Asian and Black comedy that combines the best of both worlds. Quarter and Ray Ray leave their individual nail shops to start a super shop and where comedy erupts as the two cultures collide.

title: The Nero's Trip
description: El Ñero, an unscrupulous Mexican homeless, travels to Australia looking for the soccer boots of his dreams. On his way, he meets a series of bizarre characters who discriminate and stop him to achieve a love at first sight romantic commitment with a voluptuous lady.

title: The Networker
description: THE NETWORKER is a comedy-drama with heart, an entertaining indie about family and redemption.

title: The New Roommate
description: After Maggie caught her fiancé cheating on her, she moves out. Her new roommate Heather seems very nice at first, but soon Maggie begins to suspect Heather has a darker side to her.

title: The Night
description: The cheap white sport socks of the man in front of me on the cue to Aldi’s cashier, reminded me of you.

title: The Night Belongs to Lovers
description: A meeting. Somewhere. At night. In a week, he's getting married. For years, she no longer believes in pleasure. They meet. They play. They talk. They desire each other. As a gift - unconditionally. Like a dance - on the edge of emptiness. For one night. Only one night. Their one night.

title: The Night Is Ours
description: Tomboy Morgan is haunted by her best friend Olivia's sudden death. At Olivia's wake, she inexplicably returns to life, leading them on a wild road trip blurring the lines of friendship and venturing into an uncertain future.

title: The Night of the Harvest
description: Aubrey and her friends go geocaching in the woods behind an old cornfield where they are trapped and hunted by a masked woman in white.

title: The Night That Holds You
description: A young woman is obsessed by memories of her vanished lover.

title: The Night Watchmen
description: In a fight for survival, three bumbling night watchmen, a rookie, and a journalist battle hungry vampires unleashed by a warehouse mishap. Can they save themselves and Baltimore?

title: The Nomad
description: When the traveling never stops, the whole world is your home. There's beauty around every corner and fascinating people to teach you, you just have to seek them out.

title: The Notebooks
description: THE NOTEBOOKS is an inspiring film about friendship, love, and hope. When Preston Walker suddenly finds himself forgetting his memories, he puts a game plan in place to help him remember all of his life's greatest events. This film deals with severe short term memory loss and a man who is going to do whatever he can to not loose his memories.

title: The Notorious Guys
description: Join Steven, a special needs student, on an adventurous trip to Portugal in "The Notorious Guys." When they're mistaken for counterfeiters, Steven's friend Guy-Désiré steps up to save the day.

title: The O'Briens
description: Two years after the death of his wife, an Irish Father summons home his two Sons & Daughter, causing all to fear the worst, but he is not the only one with a secret...

title: The October Flowers
description: When Danielle inherits a house from her grandmother, she uncovers something sinister and dangerous. There is an unsettling darkness from the past hidden behind these walls.

title: The One
description: Four months ago, in the skies all over the world appeared the One, an unidentified flying object that oversees and conditions everyone's life from above. Including that of Marta and Tommaso, who organize a New Year's party in which her best friend participates with his latest conquest, a French girl he met the night before. The four are joined by Cecilia, the sister of the landlady, three months pregnant, accompanied by a friend - Shut up in a room, without contact with the outside world, relati

title: The Ones We Choose
description: “The ones we choose” is a documentary about my chosen family. The ones I decided to walk through life alongside with. First taking the form of a family video ; this documentary takes us from the intimate to the collective, from the intimate to the political.

title: The Opera Game
description: 1850's New Orleans chess prodigy, Paul Morphy's tortured life is examined.

title: The Orator
description: Saili, an unassuming villager & taro farmer, lives happily with his beautiful wife Vaaiga and her teenage daughter Litia. Their existence, whilst happy and peaceful; is unconventional. Vaiga has been banished from her ancestral village for many years. Saili faces serious threats to his plantation as well as his family & has been denied his fathers chiefly title.

title: The Origami Code
description: Unveil nature's folding secrets in "Folding Nature." Join researchers in robotics, medicine, and nanotechnologies as they embrace the "origami philosophy" to unlock its principles.

title: The Origin of the End of the World
description: A little girl and poachers cross the landscapes of a wild nature, native cradle of the painter Gustave Courbet. They attend the origin of the end of the world.

title: The Other Side
description: Days before his 18th birthday, Abel (Ethan Herisse, When They See Us) finds himself about to graduate his orphanage and leave his younger brother, Kiya, behind. But when a prospective adopting couple threatens to break their relationship apart, the brothers wrestle with waiting for a dream that may never be fulfilled.

title: The Other Side of Dooman River
description: Experience a poignant North Korean family's journey as they cross the Dooman River. Witness their inspiring story of defection.

title: The Owl
description: The mood in a teacher’s lounge changes when the reason behind one teachers nickname is brought to light. A group has lost its balance and will do anything to regain stability. The Owl is a slow cataclysmic journey into the dark core of humans trying to have a good time together.

title: The Oyster Shucker
description: In the world of competitive oyster shucking, Honor Allen is among the planet's best. Following this four-time US Champion over several years, we explore this unique subculture, meeting competitors from around the globe.

title: The Pale Man
description: In a small town plagued by a mysterious illness, a teachers assistant and a Pale Man team up to solve a local missing persons case.

title: The Palms of Early Morning
description: Jade and Marcus live off petty theft and hang out in the Parisian underworld. A major event forces them to question their dubious habits. This unhealthy, seductive world of bandits is beginning to catch the eye of a young, isolated artist. Brigands rub shoulders, hoodlums clash and the City of Light shines brightly.

title: The Panther of the Border
description: A young woman who works as a secretary is raped, and unjustly accused of drug trafficking, a corrupt system finds her guilty and makes her pay a long prison sentence.The Panther of the Border seeks revenge against a ruthless drug cartel.

title: The Paradise Inn
description: An enigmatic bartender, two friends convinced they're heading in the same direction, a man stuck because of a train strike, just one day before his wedding, dubious employees... This is the story of 13 characters, each as different as the next.

title: The Paraseekers
description: Join the team investigating Corrados farm's haunted hay ride, exploring its rich history and apparitions in the most haunted place in New Jersey.

title: The Park Bench
description: Emily, a future librarian, tutors Mateo in American Lit. At odds initially, their talk evolves into life-changing confessions. A transformative connection.

title: The Partisan with the Leica Camera
description: An old photo helps uncover a family secret: Mundek the photographer and Hannah his wife were resistance leaders. During World War 2, they commanded a Polish assassination squad--proof preserved in haunting photos shot on Mundek's camera. A shocking true story of courage, blood, and buried truth.

title: The Passengers
description: Two young men represent their final abandoned community of Ethiopian Jews on a fateful trip to America as representatives in an advocacy campaign, with the ultimate goal to enter Israel as citizens.

title: The Past Hunters
description: The team explores the UK's paranormal hotspots, blending psychic mediumship and investigation tools to uncover proof of the spirit realm's existence.

title: The Pastry Chef
description: Achille Franzi's passion for pastry becomes a recipe for adventure when he stumbles upon a crime. Watch his life take a thrilling twist!

title: The Pathan Project
description: An unexplored range in a remote valley of Pakistan, an unclimbed big wall, and a solid team of Belgian, French, and Argentinian climbers ready to combine exploration, music, and humor. Nicolas Favresse, Jean-Louis Wertz, Mathieu Maynadier, and Carlitos Molina embark on a new adventure full of surprises, French fries, and unexpected twists!

title: The Peacekeepers
description: "The Peacekeepers" grants rare access to United Nations Department Peacekeeping, capturing their desperate struggle to save a "failed state." Witness their gripping efforts to prevent a Rwandan-like disaster in the DRC.

title: The Penitent Man
description: The Penitent Man follows Dr. Jason Pyatt's transformative journey as a psychologist torn between his work and family. A mysterious client leads him on a mission to alter his future and the world.

title: The Pentagon UFO Tapes
description: For decades, the U.S. military denied the truth. Now, declassified footage reveals an unidentified, craft-defying explanation. This film uncovers America's UFO secrets from Roswell to the latest Pentagon leaks.

title: The People Smuggler
description: Bahar decided to leave Iran illegally along with her boyfriend. They asked an unknown old man to transfer them. During the way, the old man showed a special attention toward Bahar.

title: The People's Girls
description: Explore Egypt's sexual harassment crisis in The People's Girls documentary. Unveiling its roots and women's resistance, it sparks global discussions on women's rights violations.

title: The Perfect Brew
description: Anya du Plessis returns to Philadelphia, South Africa from New York to repair the fractious relationship with her father Marius and help with the struggling farm. She finds that her father's crutch for dealing with her mother's death is an obsession with his beer-brewing hobby; he believes it will answer their financial woes. When she left New York, Anya left behind Jacob, her boyfriend and work colleague, and the last thing she expects is to fall for a suave, charming stranger. Ruan is on a mis

title: The Phenomenon
description: This documentary examines unidentified aerial phenomenon. With testimony from high-ranking government officials, and NASA Astronauts, Senator Harry Reid says it "makes the incredible credible."

title: The Pick Up
description: A sullen teen, resentful of her divorcing parents, doesn’t like their controlling ways. So when her mom picks her up late from swim practice, gets a flat tire along the way, she sulks. That is until a mysterious and intriguing stranger comes to help.

title: The Pigeon People
description: It takes you deep into Arizona's underground pigeon racing scene as racing rivals prepare for and compete in the Grand Canyon Classic - a 350-mile pigeon race from Utah to Arizona that crosses over the Grand Canyon.

title: The Pink Bike
description: Gabriel found a very nice bike. Unfortunately, there is a little detail that bothers him: it's pink.

title: The Pink Chateau
description: A young woman follows a beautiful stranger into the countryside. What unfolds is a series of sensual and intimate tales, set to the music of In The Valley Below.
