description: The thrilling story of an elite group of Cuban spies sent undercover to the US in the 1990s. From their recruitment, training and eventual capture on US soil; this film peers into a secret world of false identities, love affairs and betrayal.

title: Casualty 24/7
description: The doors of Barnsley Casualty Department are open 24/7. In this exclusive series, we see for the first time what’s really going on in the hearts and minds of the medical emergency team.

title: Cat Daddies
description: A heartwarming collective portrait of eight unique men whose lives have been changed by their love for cats. Some of these men will navigate the unprecedented challenges of 2020 with the help of these feline friends.

title: Cat Nation
description: Follow British YouTube personality Chris Broad, as he treks across the land of the rising sun to document numerous unusual cat-centric activities such as cat-themed cafes, bars, temples, and even entire cat islands!

title: Cat's Eye
description: The three Kisugi sisters: Rui, Hitomi and Ai, rob art galleries as the thief "Cat's Eye" in hopes that his works can give them clues to discover the whereabouts of their father, Michael Heintz.

title: Cat's Eye en español
description: Las tres hermanas Kisugi: Rui, Hitomi y Ai, roban galerías de arte con el alias "Ojo de Gato", esperando conseguir pistas para descubrir el paradero de su padre,  Michael Heintz.

title: Catacombs
description: Horror unfolds when a naïve American makes her first trip to Paris and is invited to an underground rave party in the city's catacombs.

title: Catalyst
description: Seven strangers wake up surrounded by an electrical grid and collars on their necks. What truths must they reveal to survive the nightmare?

title: Catch 21
description: Players add cards by answering pop trivia questions and try to build the closest hand to 21 without "busting" in this fast-action game of knowledge and strategy.

title: Catch 44
description: Three friends (Akerman, Woll, Reed) sent by their boss to stop a drug deal get caught in a standoff with a psychopath (Whitaker), a truck driver, a line cook, and head crime boss (Willis).

title: Catch Hell
description: Former Hollywood star Reagan Pearce is kidnapped by two men connected to his past while on location in Louisiana.

title: Catch Me If You Can
description: From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!

title: Catch-22
description: The tale of a small group of flyers in the Mediterranean in 1944. Separately and together, they are nervous, frightened, often profane and sometimes pathetic. Almost all are a little crazy. Catch-22 is an anti-war satire of epic proportions.

title: Catching Air
description: Competitive air guitar, often mocked, is showcased in the documentary "Catching Air." It follows diverse participants who channel creativity through air guitar, aiming to inspire hidden talents and defy stereotypes.

title: Catching Bullets
description: In a city plagued by an epidemic of violence, a former drug dealer pledges to protect his late friend's son from the dangers of the streets.

title: Catching Hearts
description: What happens when a bestselling atheist author loses his faith in atheism? This intense drama asks tough questions and explores why there is no such thing as coincidence.

title: Category 7: The End of the World
description: The effects of global warming reach terrifying proportions as a superstorm descends upon the planet.

title: Catfight
description: Sandra Oh and Anne Heche star as two women from opposite walks of life whose violent fight at a party sets off an epic feud that lasts a lifetime.

title: Catfish Christmas
description: A heart-broken young woman home for the holidays feels the family pressure to date again. Her sister sets up an online date with her dream man, a pro athlete. But things are not always as they seem, and true love may be closer to home.

title: Cathedrals of the Game
description: Provides the history as well as background footage of legendary baseball stadiums and other famous baseball sites.

title: Catherine Celebrates Christmas 2020
description: Catherine Fulvio, shows us how to make a selection of delicious, seasonal treats in this episode celebrating the culinary traditions of Christmas.

title: Catherine Celebrates Christmas 2021
description: Catherine Fulvio, shows us how to make a selection of delicious, seasonal treats in this episode celebrating the culinary traditions of Christmas.

title: Catherine Cookson's The Cinder Path
description: In this classic miniseries starring Catherine Zeta-Jones and Lloyd Owen, a farmer's son seeking redemption joins the fight in WWI, facing not only the enemy but also his inner demons.

title: Catherine Cookson's The Dwelling Place
description: A young girl must care for her five younger siblings following her parents' death, facing new challenges when an aristocratic family takes an unwelcome interest. Based on Catherine Cookson's novel.

title: Catherine Cookson's The Fifteen Streets
description: In this romantic drama starring Sean Bean, Owen Teale and Clare Holman, a rugged laborer and the daughter of a wealthy shipbuilder struggle to find love across class divides in northern England at the turn of the 20th century.

title: Catherine Cookson's The Gambling Man
description: A rent collector (Robson Green) dissatisfied with his life decides to use his talents as a card player to improve his situation, but his success is built on a tangle of lies and deceit.

title: Catherine Cookson's The Girl
description: In this classic miniseries based on Catherine Cookson's novel, a dying woman entrusts her daughter to the home of her wealthy former lover, inciting resentment from his wife.

title: Catherine Cookson's The Glass Virgin
description: In 1870s England, a wealthy woman (Emily Mortimer) uncovers a dark secret, prompting her to join her family's former groom (Brendan Coyle) on his caravan journey across Northumbria.

title: Catherine Cookson's The Man Who Cried
description: This classic miniseries follows Abel Mason (Academy Award nominee Ciarán Hinds) as he endures a tormenting marriage until tragedy strikes, prompting him to embark on a journey for freedom and love.

title: Catherine Cookson's The Moth
description: In early 1900s England, a young man joins his uncle's carpentry business in the countryside, sparking unexpected changes in his life. Based on Catherine Cookson's novel.

title: Catherine Cookson's The Rag Nymph
description: In 1854 Newcastle, a rag-and-bone lady takes in young Millie Forrester, abandoned on the cold streets after her mother dies in a brothel. Based on Catherine Cookson's novel.

title: Catherine Cookson's The Tide of Life
description: The lively and unconventional young Emily Kennedy navigates relationships with three very different men, learning valuable lessons about life and love. Based on Catherine Cookson's novel.

title: Catherine Cookson's The Wingless Bird
description: In the shadow of WWI, Agnes supports her sister Jessie's ambitious marriage while grappling with her own conflicts between love and societal expectations.

title: Catnip Nation
description: Would you risk arrest for a cat? The heroes of Catnip Nation have. Ultimately, Catnip Nation is a tool for activists to unite and come forward to demand laws and/or policy on Trap Neuter Return, a decade's-old form of population control for feral cats.

title: Cats
description: Blanket is an indoor cat who is too afraid to leave his apartment. But when his adventurous son, Cape, sets out to find a legendary cat paradise, Blanket must overcome his own fears and embark on the wildest ride of his life.

title: Cats of Malta
description: Experience the colorful cats of Malta as you journey through cat colonies, meeting locals and artists who embrace and look after the huge population of stray cats in this Mediterranean Island.

title: Catskill Park
description: A normal camping trip turns into a nightmare when four friends are confronted with shrieking alien sounds outside their tent.

title: Cattle Annie And Little Britches
description: Two young aspiring outlaws (Amanda Plummer and Diane Lane) manage to join what’s left of the Doolin-Dalton gang, led by the aging Bill Doolin (Burt Lancaster). The gang’s heyday may be far behind them, but there’s still plenty of adventure left!

title: Cattle Stampede
description: Buster Crabbe stars as Billy the Kid, and Billy's playin' it high wide and handsome as he shoots it out with some mesa toughs! But not even the baddest men in in Arizona can stop this trigger-quick legend of the trail!

title: Catwalk: Tales from the Cat Show Circuit
description: Catwalk: Tales From the Cat Show Circuit follows a competitive season in the lives of two top cat fanciers, Shirley and Kim, and their prize-winning felines: Oh La La, the regal Red Persian, and Bobby, the rambunctious white Turkish Angora.

title: Caught in a Landslide
description: Jay's resident ghost appears nightly, conjuring up visions of a lost summer romance; taunting him with the opportunity to speak words previously unspoken that slowly begin to heal his broken heart and release him from darkness.

title: Caught in a Trapp
description: Following the death of his parents, a teen boy is forced into a dangerous life on the streets.

title: Caught In the Crossfire
description: Two detectives investigating a gang-related crime find themselves targeted by both gang members and crooked cops. (2010)

title: Caught Up
description: After being released from prison a man finds himself caught up in a love triangle.

title: Cause of Death
description: DA Taylor Lewis (Patrick Bergin) finds himself falling for his chief suspect (Joan Severance) during a high profile murder investigation.

title: Cautiva
description: Basada en una historia real milagrosa sobre el poder de la fe, Cautiva es un drama inspirador sobre una madre viuda recientemente que es tomada como rehén en su propio hogar. Temiendo por su vida, recurre a La vida con propósito de Rick Warren en busca de guía espiritual.

title: Caveman
description: Leader of a rag-tag group of cavemen, Atouk has his work cut out for him when he sets his sights on the voluptuous cavewoman Lana (Barbara Bach). Trouble is…Lana belongs to Tonda (John Matuszak) the leader of a clan of “superior” cavemen.

title: Cavemen
description: Inspired by his best friend Tess, LA playboy Dean seeks true love, but navigating relationships proves harder than expected.

title: Caza Terrorista
description: Nicolas Cage enciende un barril de pólvora de acción mientras un veterano agente de la CIA va a la caza de su némesis, un terrorista mortal.

title: Cazador de cocodrilos
description: Para salvar a un cocodrilo de un ranchero cuyo ganado estaba siendo depredado, Steve Irwin y su esposa Terri se dispusieron a atraparlo y reubicarlo. ¡Pero el cocodrilo se tragó un faro satelital y los transformó en objetivos de la CIA! ¡Cielos!

title: Cazador de demonios
description: Un maldito pistolero (Wesley Snipes) cuyas víctimas regresan de entre los muertos, recluta a un joven guerrero para ayudar en la lucha contra una banda de zombies.

title: Cazador de recompensas
description: Paul es un asesor fiscal que escapa de un ataque a toda su oficina. Ahora, Paul investiga los vínculos de su empresa con el crimen local y se une a su hermano rastreador de recompensas.

title: Cazadora
description: En un futuro distópico, una madre y su hijo adolescente van de caza a las montañas. El encuentro con un extraño pondrá en juego los roles entre los tres.

title: Cazadores de Brujas Americanos
description: Dos investigadores intentan detener un aquelarre de brujas que se han apoderado de un pequeño pueblo de Nueva Inglaterra.

title: Cazadores de hombres
description: Narra el trabajo de una unidad policial de élite especializada en la localización y captura de fugitivos especialmente peligrosos y, en ocasiones, reclamados internacionalmente.

title: Cazadores de ovnis II: cuentos del universo
description: Los ufólogos italianos exploran la evidencia alienígena en la historia y el folclore. ¿Hemos sido observados desde la antigüedad?

title: Cazadores de ovnis: los ufólogos Italianos
description: Investigadores italianos exploran avistamientos masivos de ovnis, clipeología y testimonios reales, profundizando en la historia y los métodos de investigación de la ufología.

title: Cazadores de pitones
description: Un escuadrón de cazadores de serpientes de élite patrulla uno de los entornos más bellos y mortales del planeta. Con misiones llenas de acción y de adrenalina, observa al equipo en sus intentos por salvar.

title: Cazar para matar
description: Jim Rhodes, agente divorciado, está pasando por momentos difíciles: intenta educar solo a su hija rebelde. Cuando unos fugitivos secuestran a Rhodes y a su hija, el objetivo es cazarlos para matarlos.

title: CBD Nation
description: CBD Nation examines the highest levels of research and evidence behind the safest known, therapeutically active medicine humanity has: cannabis

title: Cbeebies Christmas Show 2019: Hansel & Gretel
description: Inspired by the classic Brothers Grimm tale, this exciting adventure follows brother and sister Hansel and Gretel as they journey deep into the magical woods to rescue their lost parents.

title: Cbeebies Christmas Show: The Night Before Christmas
description: Audiences will follow the adventures of Holly and her brother, Jack on Christmas Eve, as they send their wishes to Father Christmas.

title: Cbeebies Christmas Show: Thumbelina
description: Inspired by the tale from Hans Christian Andersen, this magical adventure follows Thumbelina, a thumb-sized girl in an oversized world of plants and animals who goes on a journey to find out who and what she is.

title: CBGB
description: Alan Rickman stars as legendary NYC club owner Hilly Kristal, who during the 1970s, wanted to create a venue for country, bluegrass and blues music (thus the name CBGB).

title: CBS News Specials
description: President Biden delivered his farewell address to the nation on Wednesday, five days before President-elect Donald Trump's inauguration as the 47th president of the United States. Watch Mr. Biden's fifth and final formal address from the Oval Office.

title: CBS Sunday Morning
description: A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, there are segments from architecture to pop culture to politics.

title: Cease Fire
description: Tim Murphy is a Vietnam Vet. When he loses his job he starts to relive all the pain and horror of his time in Vietnam.

title: Cecil
description: Cecil Stevens' name reveals his lisp so he changes it to "Michael Jordan." His whole school learns a lesson about acceptance after he and his friends start a business with the corrupt principal that sells celebrity names to kids.

title: Cedar Cove
description: When Olivia Lockhart (Andie MacDowell) is given the opportunity for a federal judgeship, she must face the challenging decision, and while tempting, she risks losing her new romance and leaving the town and people she loves most.

title: Celebrating Carol Burnett: The Gift Of Laughter
description: Join Carol Burnett as she shares her favorite moments of her storied career and incredible life - spanning 90 years of love and laughter.

title: Celebrity
description: The life of writer Lee is at a standstill. He divorces his bashful wife and dives into a new job as an entertainment journalist. While fun at first, as he jumps from one lavish party to another, he starts to doubt the worth of his work.

title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
description: Two celebrities hit the road in classic cars for a tour through Great Britain. With antiques experts by their sides, they search the local stores for treasures, competing to see who can make the most at auction.

title: Celebrity Ghost Stories
description: Famous personalities share their real-life personal encounters with the paranormal.

title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics)
description: Famous personalities share their real-life personal encounters with the paranormal.

title: Celebrity Homes Unlocked
description: Welcome to the all-access pass to your favorite celebrities’ lives at home. It’s a house tour like you’ve never seen and this time, the stars are getting involved.

title: Celebrity House Sitting
description: Atlanta stylist to the stars Leah Taylor is a trusted friend to some of the city's top celebrities… which is why they trust her to house-sit while they're out of town. But when celebrities are away, that's Leah's time to play.

title: Celebrity Interviews
description: Ed Sullivan is known for bringing the biggest and brightest talents together in his show. Follow along as he provides us a more intimate view into the lives of these stars with this collection of outstanding celebrity interviews.

title: Celebrity Paranormal Project
description: A team of five celebrities are left all alone overnight in a haunted location to investigate for ghosts.

title: Celebrity Sex Tape
description: A group of college nerds secretly record a washed up celebrity having sex and post the tape on the internet. When the publicity revives the actress's career, every B-list celebrity in Hollywood wants to star in the guys next "production."

title: Cellar Dweller
description: Thirty years have passed since the grisly death of a comic book artist. When an ardent devotee of the artist's work moves into his house she is unaware that her imagination has revived the grotesque murderer and that she might be the next victim.

title: Celluloid Bloodbath: More Prevues from Hell
description: "Celluloid Bloodbath: More Prevues from Hell" is the long-awaited sequel to 1987's horror cult classic, "Mad Ron's Prevues from Hell."

title: Celtic Soul
description: Celtic Soul follows actor and comedian Jay Baruchel on an epic road trip through Canada, Ireland, and Scotland with his new friend, well-known Irish soccer journalist Eoin O'Callaghan.

title: Celts: The Untold Story
description: The Celts. A society that thrived over 2000 years ago and continues to fascinate us today. In this series, we uncover their untold story.

title: Cementerio maldito
description: Basada en la aterradora novela de Stephen King. Después de que la familia Creed se muda a la zona rural de Maine, se topan con un antiguo cementerio con poderes siniestros.

title: Cemetery Man
description: When a cemetery watchman tasked with dispatching the recently deceased falls in love with a widow, will his lust for life eclipse his bond with death?

title: Censor
description: Film censor Enid (Niamh Algar, Wrath of Man) is assigned to review a disturbing film that recalls her childhood memories. She begins to unravel how this eerie work might be tied to the long-ago disappearance of her sister.

title: Cerca de la libertad
description: En un tiempo político del gobierno australiano donde entrenan a las niñas aborígenes como trabajadoras domésticas, tres niñas escapan de su campo de internamiento y emprenden en una aventura peligrosa de regreso a sus casas.

title: Cerca de tu casa
description: Una madre desalojada, un banquero con consciencia y un policía que debe hacer su trabajo pase lo que pase cantan y bailan en este drama musical brechtiano sobre la crisis económica, la lucha de la gente para vivir día a día, la solidaridad y la esperanza.

title: Cercano a la Navidad
description: La organizadora Hayley planea una Navidad tranquila en la montaña, pero la presencia del entrometido Paul enciende chispas inesperadas y un nuevo romance.

title: Certain Fury
description: In this remake of The Defiant Ones, sex worker Scarlet (Tatum O'Neal, Paper Moon) and petty criminal Tracy (Irene Cara, Fame) escape incarceration, fleeing both cops and drug dealers in the process. Featuring Peter Fonda.

title: Certain Prey
description: Minneapolis Deputy Police Chief, Lucas Davenport, has to face off against a duo unlike any he's ever encountered - a lethal hit woman and a ferociously cunning killer determined to hunt him down.

title: Certain Women
description: Michelle Williams, Kristen Stewart, and Laura Dern lead a remarkable ensemble cast in this stunning portrait of three powerful and flawed women forging their own paths.

title: Certifiably Jonathan (2011)
description: A famous comedian (Jonathan Winters) and artist wants to display his work at an art museum. Just when he thinks he's lost his touch, a series of famous comedians drop by to help him rekindle his artistic and comedic spark.

title: Cesium Fallout
description: A deadly fire triggers a radiation leak in Hong Kong, forcing scientist Simon Fan and Acting Chief Executive Cecilia to lead a high-stakes mission to save seven million lives.

title: Chabelo y Pepito detectives
description: Un comandante amigo de Chabelo y Pepito les pide que lo ayuden a descubrir una banda que secuestra niños. Ellos aceptan y se infiltran en la banda para descubrir que los villanos son seres de otro planeta.

title: Chabelo y Pepito en la lámpara maravillosa
description: Pepito descubre que el objeto que compró es una lámpara maravillosa, y pide toda clase de deseos. Pero ahora que su padrastro lo sabe y la quiere usar para hacer el mal, deberá evitar que caiga en sus manos.

title: Chabelo y Pepito vs los monstruos
description: Chabelo y Pepito van de excursión con un grupo de exploradores y se enfrentan al peligro en una cueva maldita. La aventura comienza cuando encuentran a varios monstruos y deciden destruirlos.

title: Chad Daniels: Mixed Reviews
description: Chad Daniels hilariously toes the line of comedy in a variety of topics, including his son's “accident”, nuclear fallout, gross bowling balls and his recent airplane meet-cute.

title: Chain of Command
description: An edge-of-your-seat military action film starring the iconic Steve Austin and Michael Jai White!

title: Chalet Girl
description: Brooke Shields & Ed Westwick star in this enchanting comedy about a pretty girl (Felicity Jones) who discovers love and snowboarding at an exclusive winter resort.

title: Chalk It Up
description: When a super girly-girl is dumped by her boyfriend; she decides to do everything she can to get him back by building a college gymnastics team, quickly learning that she is capable of a lot more than just getting an MRS degree.

title: Challenging Churchill
description: Churchill, a name typically associated with braveness and altruism. Recently found evidence from Soviet and British sources however brings up questions about Churchill's doings in the conferences of Tehran, Yalta and Potsdam.

title: Chameleon Street
description: William Douglas Street is bored with his life. Working for his father is getting to him, his wife wants more money, and he's had enough. His solution is to re-invent himself. He becomes a chameleon, taking on whatever role suits the situation.

title: Champion
description: A former arm-wrestling champion raised in the US returns to South Korea for a tournament that could return him to glory, but finds his life complicated by the appearance of the biological family he never knew.

title: Chance
description: A talented young baseball player's bright future is undone by the silent pressures of teen romance.

title: Chance in the World, A
description: Based on the award-winning book, A Chance in the World is the inspirational true story of a gifted boy who must escape his abusive foster parents to fulfill his incredible destiny.

title: Chancer
description: Stephen Crane (Clive Owen, "Children of Men"), a schemer who looks for opportunity and seizes it through manipulation, is called in to save a crumbling firm owned by the decadent Douglas family.

title: Chandler Christmas Getaway
description: The Chandlers pack up and head to a cabin for maximum holiday fun. With old feuds, new feuds, and a heap of holiday stress, the Chandler family must pull together to make this the best Christmas ever.

title: Chanel No 5
description: The revolutionary fragrance Channel N°5 is a true and unique symbol of elegance around the world. Go behind the scenes into the creation of this iconic scent.

title: Change in the Air
description: After a mysterious young woman moves to a small town, a peaceful community is brought face to face with its own secrets and identity. Starring Rachel Brosnahan (The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel).

title: Change with Ed Mylett
description: Everyday people will have the chance to sit down with Ed Mylett to go through the process of breaking through major challenges in their lives to create real change for a better future.

title: Changeland
description: Directed by and starring Seth Green, the film follows two estranged best friends on a life-changing adventure in Thailand.

title: Changing Rooms Australia
description: After 18 months in their soulless house, Adam and Renee have buyer's remorse but can't afford to renovate. They want to change their front room, which currently works as a dining, living and play area for their two children.

title: Chaos
description: Dos policías, un novato (Phillippe) y un veterano de cabellos grises (Statham), persiguen a un hábil ladrón de bancos (Snipes).

title: Chaos
description: A brilliant thief has masterminded a series of high-stake bank heists, and for two detectives, the only hope for survival is finding an order to the chaos.

title: Chaos
description: Two cops, a rookie and a grizzled vet, pursue an accomplished bank robber.

title: Chaos On The Bridge
description: Acting legend William Shatner takes viewers inside the creation of Star Trek: The Next Generation, the bold attempt in 1986 to recreate the success of the original television series, in which Shatner played Captain James T. Kirk.

title: Chaplin
description: Directed by Sir Richard Attenborough and starring Robert Downey, Jr. and an extraordinary cast, CHAPLIN is a loving, grand scale portrait of the Little Tramp’s amazing life and times.

title: Chaplin
description: Chaplin es un encantador retrato a gran escala de la vida y época del vagabundo. Su infancia marcada por la pobreza en Inglaterra cobra vida, junto con su amistades, sus esposas y romances escandalosos, y la implacable persecución de J. Edgar Hoover.

title: Charade
description: Romance and suspense ensue in Paris as a woman is pursued by several men who want a fortune her murdered husband had stolen. Whom can she trust?

title: Charge
description: Extreme-action story of the first-ever international race for zero-emissions motorcycles. It came on June 12th 2009, the race took place on the Isle of Man TT course, the most demanding and deadly circuit on the planet.

title: Charged: The Eduardo Garcia Story
description: Chef Eduardo Garcia went for a hike in Montana and was shocked with 2400 Volts of electricity when he touched a dead bear. He lost an arm, ribs, muscle mass, and nearly his life, but more important than what he lost is what he found.

title: Chariot
description: John Malkovich stars as Dr. Karn, an eccentric specialist who must guide his patient with mysterious recurring dreams through the reincarnation transition before his future is permanently derailed.

title: Chariots Of The Gods: 50th Anniversary
description: Based on Erich von Daniken's international best seller. Did travelers from outer space visit Earth in our ancient past?

title: Charles Dickens' A Christmas Carol
description: Charles Dickens’ classic tale of the stingy Ebenezer Scrooge in a full-length animated musical.

title: Charles Dickens: The Man That Asked for More
description: Ask people, the world over, to name a great English novelist and chances are the name at the top of the list will be Charles Dickens, the author responsible for creating such all-time classics as "Oliver Twist", "Nicholas Nickleby", "Great Expectations...

title: Charlie And Lola
description: Lola is not sleepy, and she will not go to bed. It falls to Charlie, her older brother, to persuade her. Lola is also convinced that she is absolutely far too small to go to school.

title: Charlie Bartlett
description: Wealthy teenager Charlie Bartlett (Anton Yelchin) is failing miserably at fitting in at a new public high school run by the world-weary Principal Gardner (Robert Downey, Jr.).

title: Charm City
description: As a step toward a brighter future, Jay, Rodney, and Sean now own a popular nightclub in Baltimore, Maryland. When the city threatens to put them out of business, the long-time friends revert back to their old ways.

title: Charmed
description: Witches can't run away from their legacy, at least not the Halliwell sisters -- Prue (Shannen Doherty), Piper (Holly Marie Combs) and Phoebe (Alyssa Milano).

title: Charming the Hearts of Men
description: In the early 60s, a sophisticated woman returns to her southern home town and finds her options are limited. With the help of a Congressional ally, she inspires historic legislation which allows opportunities never before afforded to women.

title: Charms for the Easy Life
description: In the 1940s, a southern midwife is given a lucky charm. Soon, her husband skips town, leaving her happily in charge of the family. Starring Gena Rowlands and Mimi Rogers.

title: Charms for the Easy Life
description: The story of three women who live in a North Carolina town and defy the traditional roles set for them by society. Starring Gina Rowlands, Mimi Rogers and Susan May Pratt.

title: Chasin' The Sun
description: A fishing and lifestyle series highlighting the amazing diversity in and around the emerald gulf waters of Panama City Beach, FL

title: Chasing 3000
description: Mickey (Ray Liotta) recounts the cross-country journey of his 15-year-old self (Trevor Morgan) and his young brother, Roger (Rory Culkin), who suffers from muscular dystrophy, to see baseball player Roberto Clemente's 3,000th hit.

title: Chasing Addictions
description: The next level in modern surfing seen spreading its infectious influences across the California coast and beyond. Chasing Addictions is the latest release from surf filmmaker David Parsa (LIVE: a music and surfing experience, Absolute Mexico).

title: Chasing After You
description: Chasing After You takes a twist on modern romance after a young male pursues a single mother with no interest in a relationship; other than her one with God.

title: Chasing Bigfoot
description: Chasing Bigfoot

title: Chasing Bonnie & Clyde
description: Don't build prisons, they cost too much! In this era of Great Recession, the conservative and tough-on-crime State of Texas takes an unprecedented path by becoming a social justice leader with programs that rehabilitate offenders.

title: Chasing Evil
description: True-crime stories are explored in this documentary series.

title: Chasing Ghosts
description: Lucas Simons, an 11-year-old filmmaker, is obsessed with death after the loss of his brother. When Lucas accidentally captures a mysterious presence in one of his films, he becomes a YouTube phenomenon and must learn to live life in the spotlight.

title: Chasing History
description: All-access series documenting the NBA Playoffs and Finals. 20 teams, all chasing the same dream: hoisting the Larry O'Brien Trophy in June.

title: Chasing Hope
description: Soon after Hope Howard is mysteriously fired, her former boss, a desperate scientist, discovers she holds the secret to his fatal illness, but she has disappeared.

title: Chasing Molly
description: Molly, a paranormal con artist, accidentally rips off a Drug Kingpin. Now she must scramble to save her kidnapped partner and herself while battling through the under belly of Los Angeles.

title: Chasing Monsters
description: Hosted by extreme angler and adventurer Cyril Chauquet, this high-stakes series explores the elusive monster fish living in the hidden depths of the oceans, lakes, and rivers.

title: Chasing Normality
description: Three hot ladies take their bachelorette party to Sin City, and find out was happens in Las Vegas is all good! So good, that after one wild night, the bride-to-be wakes up the next morning married to her last fling.

title: Chasing Secrets
description: A young white girl abused by her grandfather finds happiness when she's taken under the wing of an older black couple. The girl's mother struggles to overcome the family's problems.

title: Chasing Shadows

description: A hilarious look back at some of the most legendary comedic performances that graced The Ed Sullivan Show from the years 1948 through 1971.

title: Comedy Warriors
description: Take 4 top comedians (The Coaches: Zach Galifianakis, Bob Saget, B.J. Novak, Lewis Black), and 5 wounded veterans (Stephen Rice, Darisse Smith, Rob Jones, Bobby Henline, Joe Kashw) and the result… laughter and the healing power of humor.

title: Comes a Horseman
description: Set in the American West of the 1940s, a pair of little-guy ranchers join forces against the depredations of a ruthless land baron determined to expand his empire at whatever cost. Starring Jane Fonda, James Caan, and Jason Robards.

title: Cometieron dos errores
description: Clint Eastwood protagoniza esta historia sobre una banda de justicieros que cometen dos errores: ahorcar al hombre equivocado y no terminar el trabajo. Inger Stevens, Pat Hingle, Bruce Dern y Dennis Hopper coprotagonizan este western de acción.

title: Comfort Eating
description: Comedian Nick Helm is hosting a new show all about food and what it means to him. But when his girlfriend dumps him at the start of the series, Nick must come to terms with his newfound single status. Nick travels all around Europe, eating through it all.

title: Comfort Food
description: Ignacio Barrios, Chef de Cocina Urbana y pionero en Perú con clases de cocina interactivas, viene a consolarnos con deliciosas recetas. Olvidémonos de la dieta por un tiempo y alimentemos el alma.

title: Comic Book Men
description: AMC's new unscripted series Comic Book Men follows the antics in and around master fanboy Kevin Smith's New Jersey comic shop where staff and customers geek out over pop culture artifacts and the legends behind them.

title: Comic Relief: The Greatest (2008)
description: This collection plays host to the best 20 years of Comic Relief. Join Billy, Whoopi, Robin and the rest of the greatest comedians on Earth as they throw their best stuff at a national disaster.

title: Comic Relief: The Latest (2008)
description: This collection includes uncensored performances from COMIC RELIEF 2006, which helped raise funds for Hurricane Katrina victims and animal rescue operations. Join Billy, Whoopi, Robin and the rest of the greatest comedians on Earth.

title: Comida, licor y tatuajes
description: Food, Booze & Tattoos sigue a Brett Rogers mientras viaja por Sudáfrica para rastrear los establecimientos de comida más deliciosos, las cervecerías más geniales y los salones de tatuajes más vanguardistas.

title: Comin' At Ya!
description: Tragedy strikes as two ruthless brothers kidnap a bride during her wedding. Hurt and angry, H.H. Hart (Tony Anthony) begins his quest to find the love he lost, and take vengeance upon the wicked. Presented in 2D.

title: Comin' Round the Mountain
description: Gene Autry is a Pony Express rider in the old west who befriends the lovely Dolores Moreno, whose ranch is about to be sold due to non-payment of taxes.

title: Coming Home for Christmas (Apple Tree)
description: After their parents separate, two estranged sisters who haven't been on speaking terms reunite in hopes that having a family Christmas all together for the first time in years will bring their Mom and Dad close again.

title: Coming Home For Christmas (Maverick)
description: Coming from mixed backgrounds, the Higher-Mills family try to reunite their changing family for Christmas.

title: Coming Home in the Dark
description: A teacher is forced to confront a secret from his past when a pair of ruthless drifters take his family on a nightmare road-trip.

title: Coming of Age in Cherry Grove
description: Founded in 1869, Cherry Grove, Fire Island, NY, is considered by most to be the first openly LGBTQ community in the United States.

title: Coming Soon
description: Three girlfriends discover that one of them has never had a genuine orgasm, so the others quickly decide that they are going to make sure she has one.

title: Coming Through the Rye
description: In 1969, the Holden Caulfield-obsessed Jamie Schwartz runs away from boarding school to find the reclusive author J.D. Salinger. Inspired by actual events, Jamie's search becomes a journey of sexual awakening, love and loss.

title: Coming to My Senses
description: Up until a near-fatal crash in 1999, Aaron Baker soared 40-feet in the air on a roaring motocross bike. Now all he wants to do is walk.

title: Comix Beyond the Comic Book Pages
description: An exciting new documentary about the world of comic books told through interviews of the creators, artists, writers, collectors, store owners, indie publishers, and the passionate fans who have made it the phenomenon that it is today.

title: Command Performance
description: When the Russian Premier is taken hostage at a rock concert in Moscow, it's up to ex-biker-turned-rock drummer (Dolf Lundgren, "Rocky IV") to save him.

title: Commando Chaplains
description: The six Royal Navy chaplains are deployed in the toughest war zones in Afghanistan – in Helmand Province.

title: Commitment
description: The son of a North Korean spy decides to follow in his father's footsteps to protect his little sister.

title: Committed (2016)
description: For the past 14 years, Actor/Comedian Howie Mandel has honestly and openly documented the everyday struggles of Vic Cohen: a man desperately seeking to make it in this "Business Of Show".

title: Community Cup: The Documentary
description: Community Cup The Documentary captures the vision, creation, and execution of the first ever rider-designed course and zero-waste snowboard competition on the planet.

title: Como humo se va
description: Dos fumetas pasan de contrabando, sin saberlo, una camioneta hecha completamente de marihuana de México a Los Ángeles mientras el incompetente sargento Stedenko les pisa los talones.

title: Como la espuma
description: Un mensaje de texto circula de teléfono en teléfono. Un grupo de extraños acude a una mansión para practicar una orgía.

title: Compadres
description: Un policía mexicano y un joven americano hacker de computadores, unen fuerzas para entregar un criminal a la justicia en esta comedia de acción llena de altas emociones y risas escandalosas.

title: Companeros
description: When a Swedish arms dealer and Mexican bandit team up to kidnap a professor who holds the key to a fortune in gold, they find themselves hunted by the American army, stalked by a crazed sadist and trapped in the middle of a revolution about to explode.

title: Company Business
description: Agent Gene Hackman is called out of retirement to escort a Soviet spy (Mikhail Baryshnikov) to Berlin for a prisoner trade. But when the former adversaries are double-crossed, they work together to uncover double operatives within the CIA and KGB.

title: Compañeros de bodas
description: Nate y Brooke asistirán a las mismas cuatro bodas, cuatro fines de semana consecutivos. Para evitar citas a ciegas, deciden ir juntos como "compañeros de bodas" pero lo que comienza como una amistad, pronto se convierte en algo más grande.

title: Compliance
description: Inspired by true events, Compliance tells the story of just how far one might go to obey a figure of authority.

title: Complices (LAS)
description: Un seductor experto lleva a su sobrino en un viaje a la playa en busca de mujeres calientes. Pero la única mujer capaz de causarle problemas, aparece allí.

title: Complicit
description: In fighting the War on Terror, is torture ever justified? This tense and compelling single drama explores the murky moral compromises that underpin the hidden intelligence war, as an MI5 agent takes desperate measures to protect the country he loves.

title: Compromising Positions
description: An ex-newspaper woman who is now a suburban housewife can't resist getting involved in an investigation of the murder of a philandering dentist who had been having affairs with several of her neighbors.

title: Con el culo al aire
description: Tino es el líder de un caótico camping. Vive acampando, va con su furgoneta de feria en feria y alardea de llevar un estilo de vida alternativo, al margen de la legalidad y de sus vecinos.

title: Con el diablo adentro
description: En 1989, los servicios de emergencia recibieron una llamada al 911 de Maria Rossi confesando tres brutales asesinatos. Los tribunales la hallaron con demencia, pero algo más la encontró primero.

title: Con Job
description: A selfish narcissist and his cash-strapped best friend hire a corrupt notary to swindle his estranged brother. After the notary dies in a freak accident, their elaborate scheme goes off the rails.

title: Con olor a fresas
description: Burak, un rico mujeriego, se vuelve pobre. La vida de Asli da un vuelco cuando él la hace perder su trabajo. Sin embargo, tendrá la oportunidad de enmendar sus errores en un encuentro romántico en el hotel de su padre en Bodrum.

title: Con Queens
description: Betrayed by her closest friend, a woman seeks to break out of jail to get back control of her life.

title: Conan
description: Viewers from around the world thrill to the exploits of Conan the barbarian and his unruly cast of friends and enemies.

title: Conan at Comic-Con
description: Join legendary talk show host Conan O'Brien as he brings his trademark humor to exciting interviews with celebrities, politicians and more.

title: Concrete Blondes
description: Three girls discover $3 million in missing drug money and decide to steal it. All goes well until one of the girls' boyfriend concocts a plan to steal the money from the girls to pay off his debts to a vicious two-faced gangster.

title: Concussed: The American Dream
description: As NFL players deteriorate, a grim truth emerges: head trauma's toll. Through the stories of Tyler Sash and Brett Favre, football's hidden dangers are exposed, shedding light on a long-covered correlation between head trauma and the sport.

title: Condemned
description: A pathogen turns residents of an old building into killers.

title: Condor's Nest
description: A decade after the fall of Nazi Germany, an American aviator travels across South America in search of war criminals and encounters more than he bargained for.

title: Condorito: la película
description: ¡La más amada tira cómica cobra vida en una hilarante aventura de otro planeta para toda la familia!

title: Conduct Unbecoming
description: At a British Regimental party in Colonial India, the widow of Captain Scarlett is assaulted in the garden, and she accuses one of the newly arrived junior Lieutenants of the crime.

title: Cone Of Silence
description: In a rare villainous role, Peter Cushing stars as an arrogant pilot who attempts to undermine the investigation into the cause of an airline disaster.

title: Conexión Navideña
description: Una azafata se une a un columnista de un periódico para investigar cómo se conocieron sus padres.

title: Conexión yoga
description: El yoga se ha transformado, de un maravilloso entrenamiento y medio de relajación,  a una solución completa para una vida plena y saludable.

title: Confession of Murder
description: When the statute of limitations expires on a series of high-profile murders, a handsome and mysterious young man emerges with a tell-all book, taking credit for the crimes.

title: Confessions Of A Dangerous Mind
description: Mientras el inconformista creador de los programas de juegos favoritos de EE. UU. gana notoriedad por sus éxitos, se ve atraído al mundo de las operaciones encubiertas del gobierno. George Clooney dirige esta historia más extraña que la ficción.

title: Confessions of a Gay Poet
description: Explore a life's journey of love and loss, triumph and tragedy with LGBT rising star Wade Radford (Twink, 1 Last Chance at Paradise). Deeply personal, inspiring and moving, enjoy this candid, poetic exposé into a complex soul.

title: Confessions of a Prodigal Son
description: It is a coming-of-age tale following Sean (Nathan Clarkson) as he rebels and leaves his home, family, and father (Kevin Sorbo) to figure out life on his own.

title: Confessions of a Serial Killer
description: The hit UK series returns for a second season, featuring more in-depth analysis of the taped confessions of some of the worst murders in recent history - all brought to life by actors and cutting edge LIP-SYNC technology.

title: Confessions of a Sociopathic Social Climber
description: Bold, sexy, and deliciously wicked, Jennifer Love Hewitt plays a fashion-obsessed social climber willing to do whatever it takes to crash the most important party of the year and win over the man of her dreams.

title: Confessions of A Superhero
description: Confessions of a Superhero is a feature length documentary that chronicles the lives of three mortal men and one mortal woman who make their living working as superhero characters on Hollywood Boulevard.

title: Confessions of an Alien Abductee
description: Follow the work of one of Britain's most unusual phone-based services, the Anomalous Mind Management Abductee/Contactee Helpline, set up for people who claim to have had close encounters with extraterrestrials.

title: Confessions Of An Alien Abductee
description: This film focuses on one of Britain's most unusual phone-based services. The 'Anomalous Mind Management Abductee/Contactee Helpline' was set up for people who claim to have had close encounters with extraterrestrials.

title: Confine
description: Years after a horrific accident turns model Pippa into an agoraphobic shut-in, she finds herself host to a terrifying home invasion.

title: Conflict of Interest
description: A successful attorney's past begins to haunt her when a man she prosecutes could be her long lost son.

title: Confused By Love
description: A non-social author and his wife invites his successful best friend & former ex-girlfriend to stay with them to save their home from foreclosure.

title: Confusión en el Mediterráneo (LAS)
description: Un cocinero se hace pasar por su hermano gemelo, que es Chef, para competir en un concurso culinario y se enamora de la mujer a cargo del evento. Protagonizada por Jeremy Jordan y Jessica Lowndes.

title: Congo
description: When an explorer’s quest for a diamond mine ends tragically in the Congo, his father and the operation’s CEO sends Dr. Karen Ross, into the jungle to continue the hunt…maybe for his son, but definitely for the diamonds.

title: Congo (ESP)
description: Cuando la misión de un explorador en búsqueda de una mina de diamantes termina trágicamente en el Congo, su padre y la operación CEO envían a la Dra. Karen Ross a la selva para continuar con la búsqueda… Quizá de su hijo, pero definitivamente.

title: Congo - River of No Return
description: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it.

title: Congreso Internacional de Brujería
description: En 1975, Bogotá se convierte en sede del primer Congreso Internacional de Brujería, donde se reunien chamánes, sacerdotes del vudú, telepatas, alquimistas, regresionistas, hipnotistas y hasta un espacio para el aterrizaje de OVNIs.

title: Conociendo a las Suricatas
description: En el desierto Namíb, las suricatas confían en su grupo para sobrevivir. Una joven hembra es forzada a marcharse tras un brutal ataque.

title: Conociendo a los Marsupiales
description: Los marsupiales son extrañas criaturas que llevan a sus crías en su marsupio. Saltan, trepan y vuelan, son animales fascinantes.

title: Conquerors
description: The king crab, the pine processionary caterpillar, the lionfish and the fire ant. As far as biologists know, these four species are responsible for the fastest animal invasions in recent decades, making them the most successful invaders on the planet.

title: Conquest of Everest Revisited 1952-2003
description: This documentary covers the famous and successful expedition of the Everest conquest by Tenzing Norgay and Edmund Hillary, the first climbers to reach its peak.

title: Consejos para amar
description: Cuando un autor de consejos de amor y una columnista de citas cruzan sus caminos, la atracción florece. Usando estrategias de sus propios libros es posible que ambos hayan encontrado su pareja ideal. Protagonizada por Erinn Westbrook, Brooks Darnell.

title: Conspiracy of Fear
description: In a chilling dystopian future, a terrifying virus turns humans into "hybrids," hunted for their very existence. A brave journalist stands against a sinister pharmaceutical giant intent on using public fear to enforce a life-altering drug.

title: Conspiracy of Lies (2015)
description: We have now discovered the NSA can and does spy on every American citizen and we only need the national media to see that many of the New World Order plans are already in place.

title: Constitution Alive Series
description: Join Christian historian David Barton and former Texas legislator Rick Green as they advocate for the original intent of our founding documents.

title: Construction Site
description: Enter the world of Construction Site! Come along with Diggs and his machine friends as they learn how to behave and do their best.

title: Consumed
description: Trapped between a madman and a skin-stealing monster, a married couple must fight to make it out of the woods alive.

title: Contact with Aliens: Abductions, Conspiracy and Deception
description: Many UFO experiencers claim to have made contact with aliens. While it's clear they have an interest with our planet but what is their interest in mankind?

title: Contacto sangriento
description: El maestro de Ninjutsu Frank Dux viaja a Hong Kong para participar en el Kumite, las olimpiadas de artes marciales, y conoce a una hermosa periodista estadounidense. Al poco tiempo deberá enfrentarse a Chong-Li, un despiadado maestro coreano de taekwondo.

title: Contagion of Fear
description: When her father is framed for a biological gas attack suspended Federal cop Leyla is set on a mission to clear her father's name and uncover the truth behind the attack.

title: Container Masters
description: Repurposed shipping containers—turned into beautiful homes and unique building projects. Jim Russell, also known as the Container Master, brings clients' unique shipping container dreams to life.

title: Containment
description: Neighbors in an apartment complex wake up to find they have been sealed inside by strangers in hazmat suits. Unable to identify the infected, the quarantined start turning against each other in an adrenaline-fuelled fight for survival.

title: Contamination
description: A deserted ship arrives in New York City carrying its slaughtered crew and a horrific cargo: Mutant green eggs the size of footballs that pulsate with life until they spray hideous chest-bursting death.

title: Contemporary Color
description: In the summer of 2015, legendary musician David Byrne staged an event at Brooklyn's Barclays Center to celebrate the creativity of color guard: synchronized dance routines involving flags, rifles, and sabers, colloquially known as “the sport of the arts.”

title: Continuum (2012)
description: Detective Kiera Cameron (Rachel Nichols), from the year 2077, finds herself trapped in present-day Vancouver, where she's searching for ruthless criminals who have escaped from the future.

title: Continuum en español
description: La detective Kiera Cameron (Rachel Nichols) del año 2077 se encuentra atrapada en el Vancouver actual, en busca de criminales despiadados del futuro.

title: Contraband
description: Luca Di Angelo is an idealistic family man and cigarette smuggler in the treacherous Naples underworld. But when a rival gang massacres his brother and abducts his wife, Luca triggers a psychotic mob war that goes far beyond mere revenge.

title: Contract Killer
description: Two hitmen, one a novice and the other a veteran with poor luck, band together to find the "King of Killers" for whom there is a large reward.

title: Contracted
description: An assault leads a young woman down a terrifying path.

title: Contraplato
description: ¡La realidad de la competición está aquí! Bravo y Peláez se cambian de set y salen con una cocina móvil. Dos competidores deberán preparar el plato del día. El jurado es el público y el premio ... efectivo.

title: Contrarreloj
description: Un ex ladrón busca desesperadamente a su hija que ha sido secuestrada y encerrada en el maletero de un taxi. Protagonizada por Nicolas Cage y Malin Akerman.

title: Control
description: Wanting to emulate his musical heroes, Ian Curtis joins a band, Joy Division. The singer's professional, personal, and romantic troubles slowly begin to eat away at him; leading him to commit suicide at the age of 23.

title: Control
description: While locked in a strange room, Eileen must complete specific tasks in order to save her daughter’s life. As the tasks progress from difficult to virtually impossible, Eileen is forced to unlock dormant kinetic powers out of desperation.

title: Control Room
description: Una lejana colonia espacial en la que Olivia y su colega Arlo están a cargo de la sala de control de la colonia, velando por la seguridad y el bienestar de la comunidad. Pero la colonia se ve asediada por criaturas alienígenas.

title: Control Room
description: CONTROL ROOM is a rare film that is timely and timeless: timeless because it explores the ancient and complex relationship between the Western and Arab worlds, timely because it reveals how satellite television has changed the way wars are reported.

title: Conversations with Other Women
description: When a man and woman flirt with each other at a wedding reception, the sexual tension seems spontaneous. As they break from the party to a hotel room, the flirtation turns into a night filled with passion and remorse.

title: Conversion
description: A psychologist practicing conversion therapy has a chance encounter with a young gay activist, resulting in his own epiphany concerning the very practice he was conducting.

title: Convict
description: War vet Ray is sent o prison for manslaughter and has to navigate his way around a new kind of war. The only way to get back to his girl is to get down in the gutter and fight dirty.

title: Convict's Code (1939)
description: Dave Tyler (Robert Kent) is being released from prison after serving three years for a crime he claims he didn't commit.

title: Conviction - Murder At The Station
description: Conviction: Murder at the Station follows a team of experts as they investigate whether evidence exists that could challenge the conviction of a man in prison for a murder he denies.

title: Conviction - Murder In Suburbia
description: Inside Justice investigates the conviction of Glyn Razzell, found guilty of his wife’s murder. Glyn maintains his innocence, and now there’s an alleged link with a double murderer.

title: Conviction Kitchen
description: Join world-renowned executive chef Marc Thuet and his wife and business partner Biana Zorich as they put their reputations on the line with a high-stakes challenge that will push them—and their charges—to the limit.

title: Convoy
description: Feuding with Sheriff Lyle Wallace (Ernest Borgnine), Martin Penwald (Kris Kristofferson) unites scores of his fellow-drivers via Citizen Band radio into a mile-long convoy which, powered by pent-up resentments, rolls along the Arizona highways.

title: Cook Clever, Waste Less with Prue & Rupy
description: Two of Britain's best loved cooks, Prue Leith and Dr Rupy Aujla, are going to transform the cooking and food shopping habits of four British families.

title: Cook Like a Chef
description: This is a series about how to cook, not what to cook. We take you out of grandma’s kitchen and into a rock n’ roll paced studio-based environment where the focus is the food and on the techniques used to create incredible cuisine.

title: Cook Off
description: Amateur chefs from around the country compete for a million-dollar prize in the ultimate food fight.

title: Cook's Country
description: Cook’s Country features the best regional home cooking in the country, where family-friendly recipes from every corner of America are reimagined for home cooks everywhere.

title: Cool Dog
description: A family must relocate to an apartment in New York City that has a strict "no pet" policy. Unwilling to let his master go without a fight, pup Rainy embarks on a cross-country journey to New York.

title: Cool McCool en español
description: Junto con su compañero, Ventoso, su papá, Harry y los Komedy Kops, Cool McCool frustra las cobardes acciones de los locos criminales en una escandalosa variedad de aventuras caricaturescas repletas de locuras a capa y espada.

title: Coolest Places on Earth
description: Coolest Places on Earth takes viewers on a journey of discovery to astonishing places- cities, landmarks, and jaw-dropping works of nature - exploring the history and learning why it deserves to be called one of the coolest places.

title: Cooley High
description: Set in 1964 Chicago, "Cooley High" is a slice-of-life tale of two high school students--best friends--coping with the challenges of everyday life and growing up in the shadows of the housing projects. Glynn Turman and Laurence-Hilton Jacobs star.

title: Cooties
description: Teachers have the worst Monday ever when their students are turned into little killer savages in this horror comedy with unexpected laughs and unapologetic thrills.

title: Copper
description: This gripping crime series set in 1860s New York City centers on an intense, rugged Irish-American cop working the city's notorious Five Points neighborhood.

title: Copper Bill
description: Two thieves attempt to steal 80 million dollars of hidden Texas drug money from a dead member of the Cowboy Mafia.

title: Copperhead
description: A family is torn apart during the American Civil War.

title: COPS
description: COPS provides a real-life glimpse into the tireless work of law enforcement in the U.S..

title: Cops en español
description: COPS lleva a los espectadores de costa a costa, en primera línea con los hombres y mujeres de las fuerzas del orden estadounidenses, donde la acción es visceral, impredecible y real.

title: Cops UK: The Bodycam Squad
description: Follow the daily action of these cops using bodycams and other unique footage and experience their world up close and personal as they deal with the good and the bad.

title: Coral Reef Adventure
description: Coral Reef Adventure follows the real-life expedition of ocean explorers and underwater filmmakers Howard and Michele Hall. The Halls guide us to the islands and sun-drenched waters of the South Pacific to document the health and beauty of coral reefs.

title: Corazones con suerte
description: Una fabricante de maquillaje encuentra su gran oportunidad al asociarse con un ejecutivo de inversiones para mejorar la comercialización de sus productos. ¿Podrá conservar la magia que hizo de su maquillaje un éxito?

title: Corazón apasionado
description: Patricia Montesinos Campos-Miranda es una joven que vive con sus hermanos, Virginia, David y Mariela en el rancho de su abuela, doña Úrsula Villacastín. Doña Úrsula es conocida como “La Generala”.

title: Corazón indomable
description: Una camarera apenas nota a un tímido ayudante de camarero que la ama en secreto; hasta que una noche la atacan y él viene a rescatarla. A partir de ahí, su relación se convierte en una de las historias de amor más inolvidables del cine.

title: Corazón Invernal
description: Un diseñador de interiores le da una segunda vida a la casa de un viudo y en el proceso  encuentra el amor de su vida. Protagonizada por Jill Wagner, Victor Webster, Rukiya Bernard.

title: Corazón satánico
description: Un investigador privado es contratado por Louis Cyphre para encontrar al cantante Johnny Favorite. Pero la investigación da un giro inesperado y sombrío.

title: Core
description: Core goes to the heart of climbing. Join an international cast of the sport's most dedicated athletes as they stick it when it matters most. Shot in 35mm Ultra High Definition, get ready to see every detail of some of the nastiest pieces of rock ever c...

title: Coriolanus
description: Ralph Fiennes directs and stars in this dramatic thriller about the revered and feared General Coriolanus' revenge on the city of Rome following his banishment.

title: Corner Gas
description: A quirky hit sitcom about a bunch of nobodies who get up to a whole lot of nothing in the fictional prairie town of Dog River, Saskatchewan.

title: Corner Gas: The Movie
description: As Dog River, Saskatchewan goes bankrupt, its residents make a last-ditch effort to save their beloved town.

title: Cornerstore
description: CornerStore chronicles one hot summer day at a convenience store in Detroit. The store is operated by Earl Jenkins, father of  Gerard and Gail. Gerard's dream is to attend culinary school in New York to become a chef.

title: Corona de Lagrimas
description: Refugio trabaja como contadora para poder mantener a sus tres hijos. Sin embargo, la vida de todos da un giro cuando uno de ellos es llevado a la cárcel y tienen que resolver sus propios problemas.

title: Coronation Street
description: The U.K.'s longest-running television soap, "Coronation Street" focuses on the everyday lives of working-class people in Manchester, England.

title: Corporate Animals
description: Lucy (Demi Moore), an egotistical CEO, takes her staff on a corporate team-building caving weekend. When disaster strikes, this mismatched and disgruntled group must pull together in order to survive.

title: Cortez
description: When a struggling musician tracks down his ex in a small town in New Mexico, the consequences of his past decisions force him to evaluate his choices.

title: Cosa de hombres
description: Jason Lee interpreta a un ejecutivo en la ciudad de Seattle que se va a casar con la hija de su jefe (Selma Blair). Su vida se convierte en una pesadilla cuando no se acuerda si la engañó durante su despedida de soltero.

title: Cosecha de amor
description: Cuando su familia cae en bancarrota, una chica de la ciudad viaja al campo para tratar de levantar una granja de calabazas en dificultades, que su padre adquirió como una inversión para recuperar su dinero. Allí conoce a Brett, el apuesto administrador.

title: Cosmetics Coming Clean
description: With stories from organic boutique producers and the labs of major manufacturers this documentary will examine the shifting tide of current cosmetics, always with an eye on how science separates fact from fear.

title: Cosmic Conspiracy
description: There is a conspiracy to rule the world, but the truth is far stranger than fiction. Reality isn't what it seems. With UFO sightings and Alien Abductions on the rise, now is the time to awaken, and realize the biggest conspiracy of them all.

title: Cosmic Dawn
description: After witnessing the abduction of her mother as a child, Aurora, now a young woman, joins the UFO cult The Cosmic Dawn after discovering a book written by the group's leader Elyse.

title: Cosmic Highway
description: From the search for extraterrestrials to the theory of black holes, this hit Discovery Channel series explores the intersection of current science and ancient mythology.

title: Cosmic Sin
description: Bruce Willis and Frank Grillo star in the epic sci-fi adventure set in the year 2524. Retired General Ford (Willis) partners with General Eron Ryle (Grillo) and a team of elite soldiers in a race to stop an interstellar war before it's too late.

title: Cosmic Sin (ESP)
description: Siete soldados renegados lanzan un ataque preventivo sobre una civilización extraterrestre recién descubierta con la esperanza de terminar una guerra interestelar antes de que comience.

title: Cosmic Vistas

title: Crímenes imperfectos

title: CSI: Miami en español

En una de las bodas, a la que el grupo ha sido invitado, Charles conoce a Carrie (Andie Macdowell), una americana de la que se enamora a primera vista. Esa noche la pasan juntos, pero no vuelven a verse. Tendrán que esperar a la siguiente boda, en la que Carrie le presenta a su prometido.
