description: A pro ball player with a substance abuse problem is forced into rehab in his hometown, finding new hope when he gets honest about his checkered past, and takes on coaching duties for a misfit Little League team.

title: Home Sweet Home
description: A romantic comedy for all ages.  The heart of the story brings to light the selfless act of serving others in need.

title: Home to Homestead
description: After seven years in a house packed with two high-energy boys, a fun-loving in-law, and an endearing Corgi named Hank – the Finns are heading to the Texas backcountry to build their dream home from the ground up.

title: Homecoming
description: A jilted ex-girlfriend plots revenge after her former beau comes back to their hometown with a new lover.

title: Homefront
description: A former DEA agent relocates his family to a small Louisiana town in hopes of starting a new life. There, he finds himself face-to-face with a local drug kingpin out for revenge after discovering the agent's past cases in this crime thriller.

title: Homegrown
description: Life is good for Jack, Carter and Harlan, three inept ne'r-do-wells who help run master dope-grower Malcoms flourishing marijuana plantation. But then Malcom is killed by an assailant the naive trio decide to take over the business themselves.

title: Homeless For Holidays
description: Jack Baker was a successful marketing director on the fast track to the top of the corporate ladder. However, when a fellow employee changes a label at the pharmaceutical company, Jack is wrongfully accused and loses his job.

title: HomeMADE
description: HomeMADE is the biggest renovation competition ever attempted on television. Ten talented designers from around Australia will compete for a $100,000 cash prize when they take on the biggest challenge of their lives, to make over two homes every week.

title: Homestead
description: A family of homesteaders is taken captive by a gang of outlaws in this cat-and-mouse Western thriller. Their survival comes to rest in the hands of Irene, a loud-mouthed 12-year-old girl who's got an uncanny knack for shooting guns.

title: Hometown Holiday
description: Krista vows to start fresh with a new business and cautious heart. When she meets Ryan, an LA lawyer in Rust Creek, sparks fly—but past baggage forces them to decide if love is worth the leap.

title: Homeward
description: A boastful elf and his prank-happy orc brother must learn to work together to stop a fiendish orc gang from retrieving a magical stone that will give them the power to take over the world.

title: Homicide
description: A Jewish homicide detective investigates a seemingly minor murder and falls in with a Zionist group as a result.

title: Homicidio en la pasarela
description: El mariscal de los EE.UU. Jack Devlin intenta proteger a una joven de los gángsters. Desafortunadamente, la capacidad de Devlin para hacer su trabajo está restringida después de que una explosión lo cegó temporalmente.

title: Hondo
description: John Wayne plays Hondo Lane, a cavalry rider who becomes the protector of Angie Lowe as well as a father figure to her boy, Johnny. Angie, determinedly awaiting the return of her husband, refuses to leave their homestead despite the growing danger.

title: Honest Thief
description: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

title: HoneyBee
description: A teenage girl is pulled into a battle against an archaic evil when a mysterious woman comes to a small town.

title: Honky Tonk Heaven: Legend of the Broken Spoke
description: Honky Tonk Heaven brings the world famous Austin, Texas dance hall, the Broken Spoke, to life on screen and gives us a nostalgic glimpse inside a world of cowboy boots, live country music, two-step dancing and cold longneck beers.

title: Honor and Glory
description: FBI agent Tracy Pride is on a mission to capture businessman Jason Slade, who is involved in extortion and murder. Teaming up with her is her sister Joyce, a news reporter; Dragon, Tracy's partner in Hong Kong, and Jake, a bodyguard who worked for Slade.

title: Honor Diaries
description: Nine leading women advocates fight back against gender-based honor violence.  Notions of shame and honor are challenged, and a dialogue that goes beyond assumptions emerges in their efforts to create change.

title: Honor y mentira
description: Dos novios de secundaria ingresan en academias militares separadas, lo que pone en peligro su relación cuando uno es infiel.

title: Hood of Horror
description: As told by the Hound of Hell, played by Snoop Dogg, Hood of Horror follows an all-star cast of depraved residents of in an inner-city neighborhood.

title: Hoodlum
description: 1930's New York. The black community of Harlem faces the same indignities as countless millions of refugees. If the seeds of Harlem's urban power would not grow in the White city, the Black underground would form to take control.

title: Hook
description: Fueled by "pixie dust," James Hook murders Wendy's brother, loses his hand to Peter Pan and is presumed dead after a fight

title: Hooked on the Palm Beaches
description: Saltwater and freshwater fishing in the beautiful Palm Beaches, Palm Beach County, Florida.

title: Hooligan
description: We may find football violence on the news shocking; but there are also many of us fascinated by it. Films such as The Football Factory and Green Street glorify violence and will stir peculiar emotions in us whilst we watch the fighting.

title: Hoop Dreams
description: A film following the lives of two inner-city Chicago boys who struggle to become college basketball players on the road to going professional.

title: Hoop Dreams
description: Dos niños comunes y corrientes del centro de la ciudad se atreven a soñar con la gloria imposible y profesional del baloncesto en esta crónica épica de esperanza y fe.

title: Hoop Soldiers
description: While investigating her brother's death, a lawyer uncovers an illegal basketball league where the games are often fatal.

title: Hoops Africa: Ubuntu Matters
description: From the first-ever NBA game held in Africa to the streets of Zimbabwe, this film explores the dreams of young players and a nonprofit that uses basketball as a force of good. Witness the power of Ubuntu and how it can change the world.

title: Hoosiers
description: A man gets a last-chance job coaching a small-town Indiana high-school basketball team and faces the dual challenge of bringing this underdog team to the 1951 state championship and redeeming himself from a mysterious past.

title: Hope Dances
description: A multi-talented young girl has a chance to win the lead role in the Nutcracker Ballet, and must choose between pursuing her mother’s dream of her becoming a prima ballerina and her father’s aspirations of making her a sports champion.

title: Hope For Christmas
description: Trying to win over a skeptical congregation, recovered war veteran turned Pastor, gears up for his first Christmas sermon when chaos ensues

title: Hope Gap
description: A couple's visit with their son takes a dramatic turn when the father tells him he plans on leaving his mother. Starring Annette Bening ('American Beauty') and Bill Nighy ('Love Actually').

title: Hope Lives
description: An inspiring drama that shows the triumphs and pains of a group of high school students who are victims of bullying, and how one man can make a difference.

title: Hope Lost
description: A young girl meets a producer who wants to cast her in a show in Italy. But when she arrives, she is sold into prostitution and then bought by a sadist who makes snuff movies.

title: Hope Ranch
description: A young girl and her mother are in danger of losing their ranch after the death of her military father. With a little help from their majestic white horse, they hatch a plan to save the ranch and learn to never lose hope.

title: Hope Street Holiday
description: Galia, an Afro Latina attorney, returns home to rediscover her self-worth, the true meaning of family and finds true love.

title: Hope's Legacy
description: When a young woman inherits her family's ranch, she is inspired to enter the world of competitive horse sports. With the support of her fiancée, family, and neighbors, she learns to grab life by the reins to make her dreams come true.

title: Hopeless
description: A teenager wants to escape his hometown where violence is very common. Desperate for money, he joins a gang to help his family. His new life begins to fall more and more into dangerous circumstances as he fights to survive.

title: Hopkinsville: Los duendes extraterrestres
description: Una familia lucha contra alienígenas goblins durante una noche. Una lucha que terminó siendo para detener una invasión alienígena. Sin embargo, no olvidemos que el miedo es lo que mueve las acciones del hombre.

title: Hopscotch
description: A disgruntled CIA agent quits after office politics confine him to a desk job. He heads to Europe, where he links up with a former lover. All goes smoothly until the CIA agent writes a tell-all autobiography.

title: Hopz And The Easter Mystery
description: Easter is just around the corner, and Hops the Easter Bunny is on a mission to solve the greatest Easter mystery ever: what came first, the chicken or the egg?

title: Hora cero
description: Hora cero dramatiza la hora que conduce a algunos de los eventos históricos más memorables a medida que se desarrollan minuto a minuto.

title: Horizontes de grandeza
description: Del legendario director William Wyler llega este estreno audaz, la historia de un capitán de barco (Gregory Peck) que aventura hacia el oeste donde hallará un hervidero de celos, odio y rivalidades.

title: Horn From The Heart: The Paul Butterfield Story
description: Paul Butterfield learned the blues from the Chicago masters and is considered to be the greatest blues harmonica player of all time. His interracial blues band, with its rock edge, struck a chord with rock audiences of the 60s and beyond.

title: Horns
description: A man wakes up after the death of his girlfriend to find he has grown horns.

title: Horny Teenagers Must Die!
description: A group of high school graduates travel to a cabin in the woods to celebrate and party, only to be picked off one by one by a demented psychopath who kills with farm tools and sex toys.

title: Horrible Histories
description: Rattus Rattus returns to present more history with the nasty bits left in!

title: Horrible Histories: The Movie - Rotten Romans
description: Atti, a quick-witted Roman teenager, manages to upset Emperor Nero with one of his schemes. For punishment, Atti is sent to work in a cold and wet Britain where he meets the Celts.

title: Horror Hospital
description: Jason, a member of a 1960's pop group, decides he needs a break at a country retreat. On the train, he meets Judy, niece of Aunt Harris who owns the place with her husband Dr Storm and who are using the guests for surgical mind-control experiments.

title: Horsehead
description: A shocking horror fantasy about a young woman haunted by fevered nightmares involving a horse-man.

title: Horsemen
description: A recently widowed detective still grieving over his wife's death discovers a shocking connection between himself and the suspects in a serial killing spree linked to the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse.

title: Horseplay: The History Of Horse Riding
description: Join Scout the horse as he hops on his trusty plane Axel, and sets off on an incredible learning journey about the amazing history of horse riding!! Grab your saddle and join them for Horseplay: The History Of Horse Riding!

title: Hostage
description: When a family is held hostage, former hostage negotiator Jeff Talley arrives at the scene. Talley's own family is kidnapped and Talley must decide which is more important: saving a family he doesn't even know or saving his own family.

title: Hostile Territory
description: When several flight passengers suddenly suffer gruesome, unexplained deaths, a young doctor on board begins to suspect that the shadowy, terrifying force behind her own worst childhood nightmare may be responsible.

title: Hot Bench
description: A panel of three judges hear court cases, argue the merits of the case amongst themselves, and render a verdict.

title: Hot Blooded: Once Upon a Time in Korea
description: A veteran gangster looking to retire from a life of crime in the violent port town of Kuam, Korea unexpectedly gets caught in the middle of a mob war with bloody consequences.

title: Hot Coffee
description: Filmmaker Susan Saladoff directs this documentary that examines the case of Liebeck v. McDonald's Restaurants, the so-called "hot coffee lawsuit" in which a woman sued the fast-food giant after she spilled her coffee and burned herself.

title: Hot in Cleveland
description: Betty White, Valerie Bertinelli, Jane Leeves and Wendie Malick star in this original comedy about three best friends from LA whose lives are changed forever when their Paris-bound plane makes an emergency landing in Cleveland.

title: Hot Ones
description: Host Sean Evans asks his celebrity guests questions while they attempt to complete rounds of chicken wings coated in spicy hot sauce.

title: Hot Poppin' Popcorn
description: Step right up and join in the fun as Anthony becomes the ringmaster and leads the Wiggly circus: there's juggling, ribbon twirling, trapeze acts and Wiggly clowns!

title: Hot Tub Time Machine
description: Four buddies share a wild night of drinking in a ski resort hot tub and wake up with hangovers in 1986! Now, they’ll need the help of a one-armed bellhop and a hot tub repairman to survive the crazy 80’s, but it may change their future forever!

title: Hot Tub Time Machine 2
description: Rob Corddry, Craig Robinson, and Clark Duke return for more side-splitting adventures in time! When Lou (Corddry) finds himself in trouble, the boys fire up the hot tub time machine and head back to the past…but end up in the future…with Adam's son!

title: Hotel
description: In a crumbling Venetian hotel, a film crew’s shoot spirals into chaos as murder, betrayal, and a vampire cult blur reality and fiction. Nothing - and no one - is what it seems.

title: Hotel Artemis
description: Alvin and Lance, his girlfriend’s brother, leave the city behind to spend the summer of 1988 repainting traffic lines on a desolate country highway, bickering and joking their way into an unlikely friendship.

title: Hotel Rwanda
description: The film chronicles the true story of Paul Rusesabinga (Don Cheadle), a brave hotel manager who risked his life and those of his family to take in more than 1,000 refugees during the 1994 genocide of the Tutsus by Hutu militia.

title: Hotel Rwanda
description: Cuando Paul Rusesabagina (Cheadle) ve que el mundo no va a intervenir en la masacre de la minoría tutsi, encuentra el coraje para abrir las puertas de su hotel a más de 1.200 refugiados.

title: Hotline
description: Filmmaker Tony Shaff eavesdrops on the inner workings of hotlines to put a face to the voice on the other end of the line.

title: Houdini
description: Tony Curtis gives a winning performance as the great Houdini, the struggling circus performer who emerged as the world’s most captivating magician and escape artist.

title: Hour Of The Gun
description: Director John Sturges presents a reworking of the Wyatt Earp/Doc Holliday legend and the struggle for political control of Tombstone, with a marvelous trio of antagonists: James Garner as Earp, Jason Robards as Holliday, and Robert Ryan as Clanton.

title: Hours
description: When Hurricane Katrina hits, a young father (PAUL WALKER) must take extreme measures to protect his newborn baby in their evacuated and darkened hospital.

title: House Hunt
description: House Hunt is a heartfelt series that follows the journeys of couples, families, and friends, across various regions of New Zealand, as they struggle to achieve the near impossible and buy their first home in the country’s overheated property markets.

title: House of Curves
description: House of Curves follows Atlanta-based, plus-size clothing designer, Kenyatta Jones as she kicks down fashion's doors.

title: House of Games
description: An uptight female psychiatrist attempts to intercede with a con man on behalf of one of her patients, a compulsive gambler who owes him several thousand dollars. She is sucked into a world of mirrors where nothing is what it seems.

title: House of Gucci
description: Inspired by the true story of the family behind the Italian fashion empire. When Patrizia Reggiani marries into the Gucci family, her unbridled ambition begins to unravel the family legacy and triggers a spiral of betrayal, decadence, and murder.

title: House of Hummingbird
description: Eun-hee is a curious 14-year-old growing up in a country on the brink of enormous change. Ignored and rejected by her family, Eun-hee finds her escape roaming her neighborhood with her best friend, experiencing all that life has to offer.

title: House of Lust
description: 27-year-old Emma becomes a prostitute at a high-end brothel in order to research her next novel. But was it really for research or all for pleasure?

title: House of Mortal Sin (The Confessional)
description: A deranged priest takes it upon himself to punish his parishioners for their moral transgressions.

title: House of Pride 2021
description: Shea Diamond, Laganja Estranja, Sam Tsui and House of Balmain shine in the new show Revry Presents House of Pride Brought to You By McDonald's and hosted by Manila Luzon, Ryan Mitchell and Shar Jossell.

title: House of Pride 2022
description: Pride has never been this fun with the 2nd annual “House of Pride”– only on Revry!

title: House of Sand and Fog
description: Russian filmmaker Vadim Perelman makes his feature-film debut with the psychological drama House of Sand and Fog, based on the novel by Andre Dubus III, Ben Kingsley plays Massoud Amir Behrani, an Iranian immigrant living the United States.

title: House of Secrets
description: After Julie Manning and her husband divorced, she decides to move into the house he was building for them. Soon she realizes someone is breaking into the house and spying on her.

title: House of the Long Shadows
description: The Four Kings of Horror -- Vincent Price, Christopher Lee, Peter Cushing and John Carradine -- star with Desi Arnaz, Jr. in this delightfully ghoulish comedy about a novelist, an eccentric family and a dinner party where murder is on the menu!

title: House Of The Witch
description: A group of teens become trapped in a haunted house by a demonic witch on Halloween night.

title: House On Haunted Hill
description: A millionaire offers $10,000 to five people who agree to be locked in a haunted house overnight

title: House On Haunted Hill
description: A millionaire offers $10,000 to five people who agree to be locked in a large, spooky, rented house overnight with him and his wife.

title: House on Haunted Hill (1959)
description: Rich oddball Frederick Loren (Vincent Price) has a proposal for five guests at a possibly haunted mansion: Show up, survive a night filled with scares and receive $10,000 each. The guest of honor is Loren's estranged wife, Annabelle (Carol Ohmart), who, with her secret lover, Dr. Trent (Alan Marshal), has concocted her own scheme to scare Loren's associate, Nora Manning (Carolyn Craig), into shooting the potentially crazy millionaire. But more spooks and shocks throw a wrench into the plan.

title: House Under Siege
description: When one of three thieves is hurt during a jewelry heist, the trio seeks the help of a local doctor. But when the diamonds go missing, the thieves take the doctor and his family hostage.

title: Housebound
description: A young woman is forced to return to her childhood home after being placed under house arrest, where she suspects that something evil may be lurking.

title: How China Got Rich
description: Over the last 40 years, China has been transformed out of all recognition. How did an impoverished and backward communist country become an engine of global capitalism? What lies ahead for this economic behemoth?

title: How I Live Now
description: Set in the near-future UK, Saoirse Ronan plays Daisy, an American teenager sent to stay with relatives in the English countryside. Initially withdrawn and alienated, she begins to warm up to her charming surroundings and strikes up a romance.

title: How It Ends
description: In this feel-good apocalyptic comedy, Liza (Zoe Lister-Jones) embarks on a hilarious journey through LA in hopes of making it to her last party before it all ends, running into an eclectic cast of characters along the way.

title: How Long Will I Love U
description: In this rollicking romantic comedy, a man and a woman living in the same apartment nearly twenty years apart wake one day to find their timelines have merged.

title: How Much Wood Would A Woodchuck Chuck?
description: Herzog examines the world championships for cattle auctioneers, his fascination with a language created by an economic system, and compares it to the lifestyle of the Amish, who live nearby.

title: How Not to DIY
description: DIY is big business; billions are spent on it each year. This series delves into this toolbox of stupidity, taking us into the homes of DIY disasters around the world, proving that anything that can go wrong will go wrong!

title: HOW SARAH GOT HER WINGS
description: In order to gain access to Heaven, Sarah is sent back down to earth as an "angel in training" with 12 days to help a soul in need.

title: How Stella Got Her Groove Back
description: Stella's vacation to Jamaica takes a hot and steamy turn when she encounters a young islander.

title: How Tech Works
description: How Tech Works takes viewers around the world to meet the inventors and innovators behind the planet’s most cutting edge science and technology.

title: How the Nazis Lost the War
description: Hitler's war machine was feared and ruthless - for a time. It cut a swathe through Europe and North Africa, and threatened Russia. Early in the War, Hitler's dream of dominating Europe was a distinct possibility, but then cracks appeared.

title: How The Victorians Built England
description: In this series, we travel the length and breadth of Britain to find out how the Victorians built Britain.

title: How To Adventure
description: Riaan Manser is, without a doubt, one of the most accomplished adventurers of modern times. Now he’s leading some ordinary people on extraordinary adventures of their own in some of the wildest, most thrilling and beautiful locations in Africa.

title: How To Be
description: A young man having an existential crisis convinces a Canadian self-help guru to come to London and become his personal life coach.

title: How to Be a Gardener
description: In this series Alan Titchmarsh will inspire the reluctant gardener and give them the confidence to make the most of their garden.

title: How To Be A Latin Lover
description: Eugenio Derbez (INSTRUCTIONS NOT INCLUDED) and Salma Hayek head an all-star cast in this hilarious comedy about an aging ladies’ man who learns that love and trust must be earned.

title: How to Beat a Bully
description: This is a family comedy with an anti-bullying theme. When a new kid named Cory moves to town, he's picked on by the school bullies.

title: How To Beat The High Cost Of Living
description: A caper comedy about three suburban housewives who, in order to beat inflation and subsidize their alimony checks, plot to steal $1 million from a large plastic ball which is displayed in a local shopping center.

title: How to Build a Motorcar
description: This seriesis areal-life step-by-step in how to construct the most impressive vehicles on the planet, told by the specialists who do it every day.

title: How to Catch a Serial Killer
description: Sir Trevor McDonald presents this documentary which explores the extraordinary pursuit of serial killer Christopher Halliwell by detective Steve Fulcher.

title: How to Colonize the Stars
description: Leading physicists and engineers in the field of interstellar travel discuss some of the deep issues we face when considering the problem of sending spacecraft to other stars. Will mankind ever truly become a space fairing civilization?

title: How To Cook Well With Rory O'Connell
description: Rory O'Connell is probably Ireland's most experienced cookery teacher – he has been teaching people how to cook for more than 30 years, having co-founded the Ballymaloe Cookery School with his sister, Darina Allen.

title: How to Discipline Your Dragon
description: In this series, Little Lizard and Tiny Turtle must raise and train up their dragons. There are also Vikings along the way that will give them challenges in which they can win rewards, finally, they must defeat the big evil dragon!

title: How To Do Florida
description: Destinations in the Sunshine State; how-to features; cooking Florida-style.

title: How to Find Forever
description: Marley is brilliant at organizing other people's engagements. When designing her most important proposal yet, will the man who could jeopardize it all be her very own prince charming?

title: How to Get Away with Cheating
description: Although Professor Alex P. Keating and his wife Olivia's marriage has hit a bit of a dry spell, his professional life could not be better.

title: How To Grow A Band
description: Following a divorce and the break up of his platinum-selling band, virtuoso Chris Thile decides to start over. Filmmaker Mark Meatto shadows the enigmatic 26 year-old musician as he leads his new group, Punch Brothers, down an uncertain path.

title: How To Kill A Judge
description: Franco Nero stars as Giacomo Solaris, a director whose latest film depicts a prominent Sicilian judge as being on the Mafia's payroll. But when the actual judge is found murdered, Solaris begins his own investigation.

title: How to Kill Monsters
description: The sole survivor of a blood-drenched massacre must team up with a rag-tag bunch of rookie cops and lawbreakers to fight off an invasion of monsters from another dimension.

title: How to Kill Your Husband?
description: Chyna endures an abusive marriage with Mark, who is both violent and unfaithful. Her sisters plan to seek revenge, but Detective Rivera intervenes. With the support of Adriana, Chyna gains the confidence to finally leave Mark for good.

title: How to Live Forever (2016)
description: With intelligence, humor, and warmth, How to Live Forever offers a thoughtful, nuanced inquiry into what it is that gives our lives their meaning.

title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
description: A "How to..." columnist agrees to write a first-hand account about what it takes to drive a man out of your life... in exactly 10 days.

title: How To Love
description: How To Love tells a story about a man named Anthony who loses his wife Rachel, to a tragic illness and finds it hard to move on. Although Anthony is now single, he struggles with how to build a new relationship with a beautiful woman named Tiffany.

title: How to Make Money Selling Drugs
description: Want to make millions in a $400 billion global industry? Find out why no one is winning the war on drugs in this provocative investigation, featuring Russell Simmons, Susan Sarandon, David Simon (creator of "The Wire"), and 50 Cent.

title: How to Murder a Millionaire
description: Spoiled Beverly Hills housewife Irma Summers is convinced that her husband plans to kill her.  She escapes from her mansion with an enterprising con-woman, and the pair soon finds themselves up to their elbows in action, intrigue, and misadventures.

title: How To Rob
description: Sean Price and Jimmy Winters are a two man stickup crew, robbing criminals from Boston to Cape Cod. Sean wants out of the game but it's not so simple when a couple of killers are hunting them for retribution over a past robbery.

title: How to Snatch a Bachelor
description: Two sisters decide to kidnap a reality star bachelor for their New Year's resolution, but they don't account for the FBI being hot on their trails.

title: How to Steal Pigs and Influence People
description: This film follows the unique community of established vegan and ex-vegan influencers. Some are embarking on an escalating series of daring farmyard heists; others are devoted to their back-bedroom chicken sanctuaries and some are extreme ex-vegans.

title: How to Stuff a Wild Bikini
description: While stationed in Tahiti, Frankie (Frankie Avalon) learns he’s in danger of losing Dee Dee (Annette Funicello) to another guy! That is, until a wacky witch doctor (Buster Keaton) conjures up a gorgeous bikini-clad vixen...whom no man can resist!

title: How to Succeed in Business Without Really Trying (1967)
description: This hilarious musical stars Robert Morse as a charming and scheming window washer who climbs to the top of the corporate ladder by way of a self-help book.

title: How to Summon Dark Panther in Minecraft
description: Tiny Turtle and Scuba Steve summon a Dark Panther in Minecraft!

title: How To Survive A Murder
description: Witness the nefarious attempts to cover up a murder and protect an influential family in this true-crime miniseries.

title: How to Survive a Plague
description: Journalist-turned-filmmaker David France unveils the courageous story of the activists and scientists who fought to stop HIV from becoming a death sentence.

title: How to Win a Prince
description: A perennially single dating coach attempts to seduce a prince as she helps him navigate the cut-throat NYC dating scene, but starts to fall for his right hand man in the process. Will she win the prince, or find love in an unexpected place instead?

title: How We Got Gay
description: HOW WE GOT GAY tells the incredible story of how gay men and women went from being the ultimate outsiders to occupying the halls of power, with a profound influence on our cultural, political and social lives.

title: Howard And The Undersea Kingdom
description: After conquering R'yleh and the Frozen Kingdom young Howard Lovecraft must now travel to the Undersea Kingdom in order to free his captured family and prevent the impending wrath of Cthulhu.

title: Howard Lovecraft and the Frozen Kingdom
description: After visiting his father in Arkham Sanitarium, young Howard Lovecraft accidentally uses the legendary Necronomicon to open a portal to a strange frozen world filled with horrifying creatures and a great adventure.

title: Howard Lovecraft and the Kingdom of Madness
description: After returning from his previous adventure, young Howard Lovecraft must lead an expedition including his father, Winfield, Uncle Randolph, and Miskatonic Universitys Dr. Henry Armitage to Antarctica, to prevent the awakening of Cthulhu!

title: Howard Zinn : A People's History of the United States
description: With the tremendous success of his book, A People's History of the United States, Howard Zinn radically changed the way Americans see themselves.

title: Howl (2010)
description: James Franco delivers a career-defining performance as poet Allen Ginsberg. Through his search for personal and creative expression, Ginsberg writes HOWL, and must contend with attorney Jake Ehrlich (Jon Hamm) during HOWL’S bizarre obscenity trial.

title: Howl (2015)
description: Passengers on a night train are attacked by a vicious creature out of folklore and must band together in order to survive until morning.

title: Howling II: Your Sister Is A Werewolf
description: Ben White is investigating the death of his sister, a reporter killed with a silver bullet. At her funeral, Ben encounters an expert in the occult who says that Ben's sister planned her own execution after discovering that she was a werewolf.

title: Howling IV: The Original Nightmare
description: A successful author moves to a small town after suffering a mental breakdown and is tormented by demons and werewolves.

title: Howling VI: The Freaks
description: A villainous carnival owner traps a young werewolf to include in his growing menagerie of inhuman exhibits.

title: Howling Village
description: A psychologist visits an infamous haunted location known as 'Howling Village' to learn about her family's dark history.

title: Hua Mulan
description: Over the years, the name Hua Mulan has become synonymous with the Walt Disney animated film Mulan and more recently with the 2020 American action drama film by the same name. But Mulan’s roots go a lot deeper than that.

title: Huachicolero
description: Un enamoramiento inocente lleva a Lalo, de 14 años de edad, a descender al mundo criminal de la extracción ilegal de gasolina. Lo que comienza como un atajo hacia el último smartphone se convierte, rápidamente, en una pelea mortal por su vida.

title: Hubble's Canvas (Blue Ant International)
description: Hubble's Canvas presents the outer limits of space in unwavering clarity, as the Hubble Telescope transmits stunning images of the globe from high above Earth’s atmosphere.

title: Huelepega
description: Oliver huye de los malos tratos de su familia y se refugia en las violentas calles de Caracas, donde sobrevive en un entorno de corrupción, delincuencia y hambre inhalando pegamento para evadirse, como otros niños en su misma situación.

title: Huge Moves
description: Super-size missions, risky routes, and the biggest cargo on the planet—imagine hauling a submarine over dry land, transporting a fleet of mega-yachts across the Atlantic, or relocating 20 ancient Egyptian temples.

title: Hugo's Brain (2012)

description: Between the icy South Pole and a colourful sea-port, plays the adventure of the penguin brothers Jasper and Junior, who, with the help of 9-year-old Emma, retrieve the eggs of a threatened parrot species from the evil Dr. Block.

title: Jay and Silent Bob Reboot
description: Jay and Silent Bob return to Hollywood to stop a reboot of the BLUNTMAN AND CHRONIC movie from getting made.

title: Jay and Silent Bob Strike Back
description: The comic "Bluntman and Chronic" is adapted for the big-screen by Hollywood without the permission of the real-life stoner icons of CLERKS— Jay and Silent Bob.

title: Jay Sebring....Cutting To The Truth
description: Follows the life of artist, designer, and entrepreneur Jay Sebring, who was murdered alongside Sharon Tate by followers of Charles Manson.

title: Jay y el silencioso Bob
description: Hollywood adapta el cómic "Bluntman y Chronic" a la gran pantalla sin el permiso de los íconos drogadictos reales de DEPENDIENTES: Jay y Bob el Silencioso.

title: Jay-Z: Ultimate Hustle
description: It was hardly predictable when the boy from the Brooklyn projects became the world's first billionaire hip-hop star, Jay-Z. He turned his pain into passion and used the suffering to influence the words and lyrics in his music.

title: Jazz Giants of the 20th Century
description: Here are some of the greatest jazz artists of the 20th century in 17 rare, vintage performances you will not soon forget.

title: JCVD
description: Jean-Claude Van Damme gets involved in a bank robbery with hostages situation and reflects about his life during it.

title: Jeepers Creepers
description: After making a horrific discovery in the basement of a old church, Trish and her brother Darry watch their routine road trip home turn into a heart stopping race for their lives. They are now the chosen prey of a force that relentlessly pursues them.

title: Jeepers Creepers 2
description: The Creeper terrorizes a group of varsity basketball players, cheerleaders and coaches who are stranded on a highway after their bus breaks down. Fighting their own fears and prejudices the group of athletes are forced to come together to stay alive.

title: Jeff Beck: Live in Tokyo
description: Filmed at the Tokyo Dome City Hall in 2014, "Live in Tokyo" captures the best of guitar legend Jeff Beck. This performance features new music and Beck's new backing band.

title: Jeff Beck: Performing This Week Live at Ronnie Scott's
description: This special captures the unique experience of Jeff Beck in concert at Ronnie Scott's Jazz Club. The setlist features classic tracks and guest appearances by Joss Stone and Eric Clapton.

title: Jeff Beck: Rock 'n' Roll Party Honoring Les Paul
description: This music special features Jeff Beck and other musicians as they honor the late, great Les Paul.

title: Jeff Garlin: Young And Handsome (2009)
description: Jeff Garlin, known by many for his role as Jeff Greene on Curb Your Enthusiasm, returns to his hometown and his comedy roots for his first hour-long special.

title: Jeffrey
description: This romantic comedy centers on the chaotic love life of Jeffrey, a gay man who swears off sex only to fall in love with his ideal man.

title: Jeffrey Dahmer Files, The
description: A dark and disturbing exploration of America's most infamous serial killer, Jeffrey Dahmer, as seen through the eyes of the arresting officer and his next door neighbor.

title: Jeffrey Ross: No Offense (2008)
description: Respected and feared as a result of his show-stopping performances at the Comedy Central Roasts, the Roastmaster General, Jeffrey Ross returns to his home state for this 2008 special.

title: Jekyll And Hyde
description: For the young Dr. Robert Jekyll, a dark past lurks in the shadows. Jekyll has inherited his grandfather’s curse, and in extreme moments is overcome by an inexplicable power--Hyde. Superhuman and uninhibited, Hyde is everything Jekyll isn’t.

title: Jellyfish
description: A young carer discovers an unlikely talent for stand-up comedy.

title: Jennifer and Joanna: Absolutely Champers
description: Joanna and Jennifer take a trip to France's Champagne region and journey down memory lane, sharing special stories, funny moments, and favorite clips of filming Ab Fab and reminiscing about their friendship while serving something chilled.

description: There are multiple levels to global superstar actress Jennifer Aniston. Yet the road to success did not come without its challenges. Aniston radiates a vulnerable warmth both on and off-screen that keeps her audience loyal.

title: Jens Pulver: Driven
description: JENS PULVER | DRIVEN follows the legendary mixed martial arts champion through an emotional roller coaster ride toward his do or die comeback after four losses in the cage.

title: Jep & Jessica: Growing The Dynasty
description: Jep and Jessica: Growing the Dynasty follows Jep and Jessica Robertson as they introduce adopted baby Jules to their other children - Lily, Merritt, Priscilla, and River - and the rest of the extended Duck Dynasty family.

title: Jeremiah
description: Jeremiah tells the story of the prophet who abandons his family and the woman he loves in order to relay God's message in Jerusalem.

title: Jeremy Brooks
description: A rip-roaring saga of runaway ambition stars Chicago's own Simeon Henderson as an arrogant would-be news anchor whose after-word dalliance with the wrong alluring intern sets off a chain of fateful events.

title: Jeremy Clarkson: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
description: In an attempt to find the ultimate American car, US models are pitched against their European counterparts. The trademarks of opinions galore and dry humour are as evident in The Good, The Bad, The Ugly as in any other Clarkson spectacle.

title: Jeremy Clarkson: The Italian Job
description: Jeremy Clarkson travels around Italy to find the perfect super-car.

title: Jericho
description: Amnesiac gunman Jericho is rescued and befriended by a charismatic and itinerant cowboy/preacher named Joshua. Together they survive certain danger, while Jericho searches to find the answer to his lost identity.

title: Jericho (2016)
description: In 1870s Yorkshire, recently widowed Annie Quaintain and her two children start a new life in Jericho, a lawless shanty town teeming with workers constructing an enormous railway viaduct.

title: Jericho Ridge
description: Alone in a remote station, Deputy Temple finds they've been set up by a drug cartel. Trapped and with no backup, she must fight for her life.

title: Jerry Lee Lewis: Trouble in Mind
description: An electrifying glimpse into the life of music legend Jerry Lee Lewis — from his rise to the top of the Billboard charts to his tumultuous fall from grace. Featuring unparalleled performances from rock & roll's wildest pioneers.

title: Jersey Shore
description: Every summer, thousands of kids head to the Jersey Shore to take part in that East Coast rite of passage:  The Share House. Our eight cast members come together for the summer to live and work in Seaside Heights.

title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation
description: The gang kicks it off by heading to Las Vegas. After partying through Sin City, they head back to the East Coast, celebrating milestones in Atlantic City – and settle in for an extended summer stay at the Shore, reliving their glory days together.

title: JeruZalem
description: Two American girls on vacation follow a mysterious anthropology student on a trip to Jerusalem. The party is cut short when the trio is caught in the middle of a biblical apocalypse.

title: Jessabelle
description: Una chica se enfrenta cara a cara con un espíritu que, después de mucho tiempo de tormento, ha estado buscando su regreso.

title: Jessabelle
description: A girl comes face to face with a long-tormented spirit that has been seeking her return.

title: Jesse and Lester
description: Brothers inherit a plot of land and must work together

title: Jesse James
description: Jesse James and his brother Frank race to secure the family's buried gold as members of the James-Younger gang attempt to steal it.

title: Jesse James at Bay
description: Roy plays Jesse James as the Robin Hood of the west who helps settlers fight a greedy railroad magnate.

title: Jesse James Austin Speed Shop
description: El fabricante Jesse James vuelve a las fuentes con la forma del metal.

title: Jessica Watkins: SPECIALish
description: A struggling standup comedian decides to jump start her career by walking across the United States. Never having hiked before, and not a comedy club in sight, getting laughs won't be the only hard part.

title: Jester Till
description: Jester Till is on his way to the city to visit his grandfather, the slightly absent-minded wizard Marcus. The old man brews up a magical happiness potion he feels the townsfolk need.

title: Jesus
description: This is a superb production and should prove very helpful to stimulate interest on the part of a Biblically illiterate generation to want to know more about the Gospels and the extraordinary life, death, resurrection, and meaning of Jesus.

title: Jesus Camp
description: The youngest foot soldiers for the Lord are shown in their native environment in this documentary.

title: Jesus' Female Disciples: The New Evidence
description: The traditional story of the birth of Christianity is dominated by men, but were female disciples crucial to Jesus' mission? And why has the role those women played disappeared from history?

title: Jesus' Son
description: Based on the critically acclaimed book by Denis Johnson, a man (Billy Crudup), high on drugs, alcohol and careens through life and makes his way toward recovery and redemption.

title: Jesus, Maria y Jose
description: Por la persecución del Rey Herodés de Judea, el niño Jesús y sus padres Maria y José huyen por el desierto de Egipto, donde el niño aprende sus primeras letras, culminando con la iniciación de su vida secreta.

title: Jesús, el niño Dios
description: En Belén nace Jesús, el salvador enviado por Dios, pero el rey Herodes dispone que mueran todos los menores de tres años. Un ángel avisa a José para que se refugie con su familia en Egipto y un legionario conduce a la familia por el desierto.

title: Jesús, el niño Dios
description: La tierna historia de la infancia de Jesucristo, desde la Anunciación, la Natividad, la Visita de los Tres Reyes Magos, la Matanza de los Inocentes ordenada por el Rey Herodes y la Huida de la Sagrada Familia a Egipto.

title: Jesús, nuestro Señor
description: Ultima parte de la trilogía dedicada a la vida de Jesús, donde se narran vida pública, pasión y muerte.

title: Jet Set
description: In thirteen episodes covering twenty-six locations. Jet Set will take the audience to some of the world's most exclusive locations. But who wins the series?

title: Jetstream
description: At Cold Lake Air Weapons Range, a handful of pilots pursue their dream of flying the CF-18 Hornet supersonic jet. The documentary captures their elite training, offering insights into the techniques and tactics of military aviation.

title: JFK Declassified: The New Files
description: On October 26, 2017, the federal government released thousands of highly classified documents related to the assassination of President John F. Kennedy.

title: JFK's Women: The Scandals Revealed
description: John F. Kennedy, the charismatic president. However, with all that charm came a hidden life of reckless sexual adventure. He had a confirmed affair with Marilyn Monroe, and at least five of his endeavors posed a potential threat to national security.

title: JFK: A President Betrayed
description: Narrated by Morgan Freeman, this film reveals new evidence how JFK embarked on secret back channel peace efforts with Nikita Khrushchev & Fidel Castro, determined to get out of Vietnam despite intense opposition inside his own government.

title: JFK: The Making of a President
description: Explore how John F. Kennedy's worldview was influenced by his younger years, when he endured poor health, family tragedy, and a demanding father.

title: JFK: The Smoking Gun
description: Veteran Police Detective Colin McLaren spent four years on the forensic cold-case investigation of JFK's assassination. What he had, and other investigators did not, was modern technology and access to all the evidence, facts and eyewitness testimony.

title: JFK: The Ultimate Conspiracy
description: It was one of the darkest days in American history and the most horrifying public events of the 20th century. Decades later...Kennedy's assassination, is still a global mystery that affects the world to this date.

title: Jiang Ziya
description: To earn his place with the gods, commander Jiang Ziya must vanquish the fox demon behind a brutal clan war. Upon learning the creature’s fate is tied to that of a young girl, he faces an impossible choice: can he sacrifice one to save many?

title: Jigsaw
description: New York Assistant District Attorney Howard Malloy investigates a series of murders and uncovers an extremist group.

title: Jim & Chrissy: Vow or Never
description: Hip hop duo Jim Jones and fiancé Chrissy Lampkin move to Miami and decide it's finally time to tie the knot after 11 years. But when Jim insists on televising the nuptials live, Chrissy begins to have doubts given their on again, off again track record.

title: Jim Allison: Breakthrough
description: The astounding true story of one warm-hearted, stubborn man's visionary quest to find a cure for cancer.

title: Jim Morrison: Rider on the Storm
description: Jim Morrison's life story reveals a rock star chameleon, constantly seeking out his own true identity.

title: Jimi Hendrix: Feedback
description: Jimi Hendrix Feedback is a unique insight into the life and music of Jimi Hendrix.

title: Jimi Hendrix: Smash Hits
description: Smash Hits was the only compilation made prior to Hendrix’s death and in this retrospective, you can experience the best of the music in the company of Jimi’s contemporaries and leading critics.

title: Jimi Hendrix: The Uncut Story
description: From Seattle to his final days in London, this series explores the life behind the artist whom The Rock and Roll Hall of Fame declared "arguably the greatest instrumentalist in the history of rock music."

title: Jimi Plays Monterey
description: Jimi Hendrix's landmark concert in Monterey County Fairgrounds in California in which he plays signature songs like Purple Haze, Foxy Lady, and Wild Thing.

title: Jimi: All Is By My Side
description: A drama based on Jimi Hendrix's life as he left New York City for London, where his career took off.

title: Jiminy Glick In Lalawood
description: Culture critic Jiminy Glick gets tied up in a murder case at the Toronto Film Festival.

title: Jimmy
description: A mentally impaired youth who interacts with beings he calls "watchers" is asked to testify as a defense witness at a criminal trial.

description: After breaking the Guiness Book of World Record for the largest Margarita and opening the new Margaritaville Casino at the Flamingo Hotel, Jimmy Buffett performed two incredible shows at the MGM Las Vegas in October of 2011.

title: Jimmy DiResta: This Old House Makers Channel
description: When makers look for inspiration, they find it with master craftsperson Jimmy DiResta. I am an artist who seeks to share and inspire with the caveat, & Don't do the dangerous things I do.

title: Jimmy Neutron: Boy Genius
description: In the dark of night aliens fly their war ships to earth and abduct all the parents in Jimmy’s hometown of Retroville. So it’s up to Jimmy to rescue the abducted parents.

title: Jimmy Neutrón: El niño genio
description: Durante la noche, los extraterrestres llegan a la tierra en sus naves espaciales y secuestran a todos los padres del pueblo de Jimmy, Retroville. Jimmy debe rescatar a los padres secuestrados.

title: Jimmy Two Shoes
description: Animated series featuring a thrill-seeking teenager who endeavors to make Miseryville a fun, happy, and exciting place with aid from his two best friends.

title: Jingle Bell Rap
description: The K9-4 is a merry group of musical dogs that rap and rock their way through this colorful Christmas cartoon. Fetch, Licks, Rollover, Bones, and Roxie journey back to their hometown for a special Christmas Concert.

title: Jingle Hell
description: A witty comedy about the Fitzgeralds, a large Irish Catholic clan from New York, whose grown children and spouses and grandchildren have gathered for a holiday that turns out to be a far cry from the Currier & Ives Christmas anyone had in mind.

title: Jinn
description: A man turns to a mysterious pair and a shackled mental patient for help in combating an ancient family curse.

title: Jiro Dreams Of Sushi
description: A thoughtful and elegant meditation on work, family and the art of perfection, chronicling Jiro Ono’s life as both an unparalleled success in the culinary world and a loving yet complicated father.

title: Jivin' In Be-Bop
description: Featuring treasured musical and dance numbers from some of the greatest minds of the music industry, this documentary-style musical is sure to get viewers moving.

title: JL Family Ranch: The Wedding Gift
description: Hallmark Original Movie. After Rebecca's engagement, a visitor from her past comes to the ranch.

title: JLO: From the Block
description: Jennifer Lopez is one of Hollywood's leading ladies. Throughout her illustrious career, she has starred in major blockbusters, released multi platinum albums and raised thousands for charities.

title: Jndia: The Fast Life
description: Conozcan a Jndia Erbacher. Solo una muchacha normal a la que le gusta salir de fiesta irse de vacaciones y conducir autos en picadas a 550 kilómetros por hora.

title: Joan & Melissa: Joan Knows Best?
description: Melissa Rivers' world is rocked when mom Joan sets out to infiltrate her home. At times loving and at times tumultuous, this mother/daughter showdown will address the question plaguing daughters since the beginning of time: Does mother know best?

title: Joan Crawford: Always the Star
description: This glamorous and hugely popular actress raised herself from brutal poverty to Academy Award-winning stardom by guts, determination, and hard work.

title: Jobs
description: College drop-out Steve Jobs teams with childhood friend Steve ìWozî Wozniak to assemble the first Apple Computer in his parentsí garage. Driven by a relentless pursuit of excellence, Jobs transforms the world of computing at the cost of his personal life.

title: Joe (1970)
description: Anti-hippie Joe (Peter Boyle) finds a kindred spirit in Bill Compton (Dennis Patrick) who boasts that he killed a drug-dealing hippie (Patrick McDermott). When a news report confirms the incident, vigilante justice is set in motion.

title: Joe (2013)
description: Academy Award® winner Nicolas Cage gives an intensely powerful performance as Joe, a hard-living ex-con who must face ruin or redemption when he meets a homeless boy in need of help.

description: As the front man of the Clash from 1977, Joe Strummer changed people's lives forever. Four years after his death, his influence reaches out around the world, more strongly now than ever before.

title: John and Lisa's Weekend Kitchen
description: Top chef John Torode and champion cook Lisa Faulkner share not only their kitchen but also their favorite recipes, cooking shortcuts and culinary inspirations.

title: John Apple Jack
description: When playboy John (Chris McNally) discovers his sister's fiancé is childhood crush Jack (Kent S. Leung), passions ignite and his life spirals out of control. Losing his job, reputation and underwear, John ventures to find a better recipe for life.

title: John Dies At The End
description: An otherworldly invasion is underway, and mankind needs a hero. What it gets instead is John and David, a pair of college dropouts who can barely hold down jobs.

title: John Edward Cross Country
description: Acclaimed psychic medium John Edward travels across America to conduct readings and help families reach their deceased loved ones.

title: John Grisham's: el poder de la justicia
description: Matt Damon es Rudy Baylor, un abogado novato superado por un caso de alto perfil. En su contra, un ejército de tiburones de la ley. De su lado, Deck Shifflet, un batallador "para-abogado" que nunca consiguió obtener su título.

title: John Lennon: Hard to Imagine
description: John Winston Ono Lennon was the co-founder of the most successful and influential band of all time, an unrivaled songwriter, a political activist, and pacifist and a visionary.

title: John Lennon: In Performance
description: John Lennon, a look back at his amazing career.

title: John Lennon: Plastic Ono Band (Classic Album)
description: This documentary dives deep into the making of John Lennon's first post-Beatles solo album, Plastic Ono Band, a fierce and emotional album showcasing some of his most personal songs. Featuring exclusive interviews with Yoko Ono and Ringo Starr.

title: John McEnroe: In the Realm of Perfection
description: Though John McEnroe was the No. 1 tennis player of his day, he never won the French Open. Director Julien Faraut uses the toughest of those losses -- to Ivan Lendl in 1984 -- to anchor this cinematic study of McEnroe's wily game and notorious anger.

title: John Paul II in Ireland: A Plea for Peace
description: In 1979 John Paul II was one year into his papacy. Northern Ireland was a decade into a bloody conflict that shrouded all of Ireland in gloom. This is the dramatic encounter between the charismatic Polish Pope and the "land of Saints and Scholars."

title: John Rabe - The Good Nazi of Nanking
description: John Rabe saved more than 200,000 Chinese by setting up a neutral zone in the center of Nanjing to provide refuge to civilians.

description: Chaos reigns on the wide open plains as a host of stars, including Burt Lancaster and Lee Remick, have their eyes set on a shipment of whiskey and let loose in this wild comedy that spoofs nearly every convention of movie westerns.

description: This is the story of a man who climbed the Hollywood ladder, one rung at a time, until he reached the top and became the most popular American actor of his era.

title: John Wayne: An Innocent Man
description: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, a man escapes and infiltrates a gang of outlaws to find the real killer. In Vibrant Color!

title: John Wayne: Cold Vengeance
description: When his father is gunned down by bandits, John Mason (Wayne) hatches a plot to catch the killer. In Vibrant Color!

title: John Wayne: Gold Strike River
description: A tough guy and cranky friend strike it rich on a gold claim and become the target of ruthless assayers. In Vibrant Color!

title: John Wayne: Guns Along The Trail
description: A government agent goes undercover in a traveling medicine show to infiltrate a gang of counterfeiters. In Vibrant Color!

title: John Wayne: Stagecoach Run
description: A man runs afoul of the villain who attempts to cheat him out of a lucrative mail delivery contract. In Vibrant Color!

title: John Wayne: Stolen Goods
description: A town is repeatedly victimized by "The Polka Dot Bandit" and it's up to the Marshall to save the day. In Vibrant Color!

title: Johnny Be Good (1988)
description: A comedy about a star high-school jock and how every major college in the United States attempts to recruit him and other promising football stars illegally by promising them free booze, willing cheerleaders, hard cash, lear jets and no homework.

title: Johnny Carson
description: Johnny Carson is the undisputed King of Late Night Television. “The Tonight Show Starring Johnny Carson” ran for over 30 years and created the blueprint for every television host working today. The absolute best episodes are now available!

title: Johnny Cash: Live
description: Known as the Man in Black American country singer-songwriter Johnny Cash was one of the greatest musical artists of the 20th century!

title: Johnny Cash: One Song at a Time
description: Retrace the remarkable story of America’s greatest country artist, one song at a time. Watch and experience the highs and lows of Johnny Cash’s career, the original man in black.

title: Johnny Cash: The Man in Black
description: Johnny Cash is one of the most accomplished and influential artists of the 20th century.

title: Johnny Frank Garrett's Last Word
description: When a young man is executed for committing a murder for which he always maintained his innocence, he leaves behind a curse letter in which he promises to take vengeance on all those connected to his trial.

title: Johnny Guitar
description: Gambling house operator Vienna seeks control of a town as archrival Emma Small sets out to force Vienna out of town. The timely arrival of Johnny Guitar thwarts Emma's dark plans, but doesn't prevent a showdown between the women.

title: Johnny Mathis: In Concert
description: Johnny Mathis is one of a handful of artists who truly deserves a legendary status. Since his impact on scene in the 1950s, Johnny has maintained a high levels of performance, both on recordings and on stage.

title: Johnny's Girl
description: When Johnny and his young daughter Amy move from L.A. to Alaska, Amy's wish for a normal life is made difficult when shady people begin to emerge from Johnny's past.

description: Here is the story of the tragic 1889 disaster which claimed more than 2,200 lives. Pennsylvania's South Fork Dam exploded and unleashed a 40-foot wall of water. The flood devastated the valley below under the force of a 20-million-ton tidal wave.

description: The story of the Joestar family, who are possessed with intense psychic strength, and the adventures each member encounters throughout their lives.

title: Jonathan
description: In this sci-fi-tinged thriller, Ansel Elgort plays two brothers living very separate lives – inside the same body. Previously content to live life in shifts, their delicate balance is ruined when they fall for the same woman (Suki Waterhouse).

title: Jonestown: Paradise Lost
description: Using survivor testimony and dramatic reenactments, this documentary tracks the build-up to a horrific doomsday.

title: Joni
description: Based on Joni Eareckson's autobiography. She becomes paralyzed after breaking her neck in a swimming accident at age 17. Trying to cope with her new life, she learns to paint using her mouth and finds strength in her new Christian faith.

title: Joseph & Mary
description: JOSEPH AND MARY is a story of inspiration and hope, of mercy versus revenge, in the years before Jesus became the Man that ultimately changed the course of humanity forever.

title: Josh Widdicombe - And Another Thing
description: A perfectionist pedant, Josh finds potential in even the most mundane of subjects, entertaining a packed house with his astute observations. Each topic is treated with his trademark befuddled outrage and packaged with easy-going charm.

title: Joshua
description: A black soldier returns from fighting in the Civil War only to find out that his mother, maid to a frontier family has been murdered by a gang of bandits. He becomes a bounty hunter, determined to track down and kill the men who killed his mother.

title: Joshy
description: Joshy and his friends turn a getaway into a weekend of debauchery in this wickedly amusing portrayal of male bonding and emotional incompetence.

title: José
description: La vida de un joven de 19 años en la ciudad de Guatemala es rutinaria y sin eventualidades, hasta que encuentra pasión, dolor y autorreflexión a través de una relación con un migrante caribeño.

description: Follow two accomplished female cavers as they descend deep inside treacherous and beautiful ice caves in Greenland, underwater labyrinths in Mexico's steamy Yucutan Peninsula and twisted caverns within the walls of the Grand Canyon.

description: Follow the creation of the San Francisco Opera's production of Amy Tan's bestselling book. This cross-cultural tour de force brings together artists from China and the U.S., and tells a story about the bond between mothers and daughters.

title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
description: From the Jules Verne classic, a hi-tech drilling rig must rescue a research team trapped deep below the Earth's surface. There they discover an exotic world -- rich with spectacular flora and fantastical creatures.

title: Journey To The End Of The Night
description: The tale of a son and his father separately plotting to escape the desolation of their lives in the lurid underworld of Brazil's sex industry.

title: Journey To The West
description: In a world plagued by demons who cause great human suffering, young demon hunter Xuan Zang risks his all to conquer a water demon, a pig demon and the demon of all demons, Sun Wukong.

title: Journey to the West 2
description: Based on the beloved classic 16th century Chinese novels, Journey to the West tells the story of Monkey, a most unlikely hero on a most extraordinary journey… where adventure lurks beyond every turn.

title: Journey's End
description: With a German offensive imminently approaching, the company anxiously awaits their unknown fate. Based on the Tony award winning play.

title: Joyland
description: Pooda Johnson is celebrating his last weekend on house arrest with a kickback (party) that could jeopardize the very freedom he's celebrating.

title: Joysticks

description: Singer, Songwriter, Producer, Actor, Businessman, Philanthropist and w with his third album released there's denying the powerhouse Justin has become. Follow his journey from child star to A-list status as one of the biggest stars on the planet.

title: Juan pistolas

description: El director Raúl Arteaga nos trae un documental en el que el director Juan Sebastián Bollaín repasa su obra a través de sus títulos más emblemáticos.

title: Juana la Virgen

description: Stephen Fry is Peter Kingdom, a wise, warm-hearted solicitor in the small Norfolk town of Market Shipborough. Aided by trainee Lyle Anderson (Karl Davies) and faithful assistant Gloria (Celia Imrie).

title: Kingdom Of War: Part 1
description: Part 1 introduces Naresuan as a child prince captured by the Burmese King Bayinnaung in order to keep the province of Ayudhya subservient. Naresuan spends almost seven years away from home studying as a novice Buddhist monk.

title: Kingdom Of War: Part 2 (Aka King Naresuan Part 2)
description: Part 2 portrays Naresuan as a young adult prince, already a formidable military strategist, as he leads his army on exploits against breakaway kingdoms.

title: Kings of Beer
description: Kings of Beer is a documentary about a diverse group of elite Brewmasters from around the globe who compete in the world's most intense brewing competition.

title: Kings of Mulberry Street
description: An epic tale of two 9-year-old misfits who must overcome their differences and defeat the bullying local crime lord who's threatening their families.

title: Kinjite: Forbidden Subjects
description: International superstar Charles Bronson is a vice squad veteran forced to battle his own racial prejudices when he's assigned to track down a young Japanese girl enslaved by a vicious child prostitution ring.

title: Kinks: IP
description: Leading the British invasion of America, The Kinks in Performance.

title: Kinky Boots
description: To save his family's shoe business from imminent bankruptcy, young Charlie Price turns to an unlikely new creative consultant: a fabulous drag queen whose creative style and wild designs are a breath of fresh air in the stuffy old factory.

title: Kirstie Allsopp's Home Style
description: This series is Kirstie's definitive guide to having a home you're proud of. Across four episodes she'll deliver master-classes that will show you how to be the ultimate home-maker. She will handpick her favorite moments and demonstrate bite-sized crafts.

title: Kirstie's Best of Both Worlds
description: Kirstie Allsopp, the walking encyclopaedia of house-buying knowledge, is back with a brand new series, helping people who are looking for the perfect home that will provide them with a slice of classic country living in easy reach of the city.

title: Kirstie's Celebrity Craft Masters
description: Kirstie Allsopp is back, and she's on a mission to share her love of all things handmade with some of the country's best-loved celebrities. Famous faces are taking on Kirstie's challenge to learn a host of new craft skills & let their creativity run wild.

title: Kirstie's Crafty Christmas
description: Kirstie shows how fast crafts can beat the clock. Her home-made delights include mince pie popcorn with pine tree syrup, a velvet Christmas cheesecake, a contemporary neon star, dramatic Christmas crowns, and traditional gifts.

title: Kirstie's Fill Your House for Free
description: Kirstie Allsopp takes on the challenge of transforming two homes each episode without spending any money! Showing how simple it can be to transform, repair, and give a new lease of life to once-loved furniture.

title: Kirstie's Handmade Christmas 2014 Special
description: Christmas is coming and Kirstie home and crafting inspiration for the festive period.

title: Kirstie's Handmade Christmas 2016
description: In this set of specials, Kirstie travels the UK to celebrate and indulge in everything that makes a great British Christmas. She visits castles, Christmas markets, stately homes, and drops in studios of some of the country’s most creative crafters.

title: Kirstie's Handmade Christmas 2017
description: One great big Christmassy episode of festive cheer packed with wall-to-wall craft. We'll see Kirstie with some of the best crafters in the country, learning to make beautiful things that will make everyone's Christmas just a little bit more lovely.

title: Kirstie's Handmade Christmas 2018
description: Kirsty returns with a joyful mix of festive makes, tricks, tips, and inspiration to help you celebrate the holiday magic. And they're all crafts that anyone can do.

title: Kirstie's Handmade Christmas 2019
description: She's back with a joyful mix of festive makes, tricks, tips, and inspiration to help you celebrate the holiday magic. And they're all crafts that anyone can do.

title: Kirstie's Handmade Christmas 2020
description: Kirstie provides a flurry of jovial festive fun - with enough competitions, makes, decorations, gifts, food and drink to inspire every kind of crafter.

title: Kirstie's Handmade Christmas: Special: 2018
description: Kirstie shares her love of festive crafting and luxury presents.

title: Kirstie's Handmade Christmas: Special: 2019
description: Kirstie shares her love of festive crafting and luxury presents.

title: Kirstie's Handmade Christmas: Special: 2020
description: Kirstie's Handmade Christmas returns, bringing comfort and joy by the sleigh-load.

title: Kirstie's House of Craft
description: Combining archive favorites with brand new material shot in lockdown Kirstie proves there's a craft for everyone, sharing how to make bug hotels, homemade body scrubs, cushions and much more. You'll be surprised by the wonders you can create.

title: Kirstie's Vintage Home Christmas 2012
description: There’s a warm, festive glow in Kirstie’s vintage café, where she and her experts mentor homemakers and show how to inject a bit of vintage style into homes for the holiday season.

title: Kiss at Pine Lake
description: Luke Garvey buys his uncle's Camp Pine Lake only to find himself the owner of a sinking business.  Zoe McConnell, Luke's girlfriend from years ago, wants him to sell until an old flame is rekindled.

title: Kiss Me for Christmas
description: This Christmas, an unnoticed personal assistant has an unexpected encounter with her dream man, who's in a relationship with her boss. They're assigned to a project, growing closer, but their feelings risk her career.

title: Kiss Me For Christmas
description: After a chance encounter, a young assistant falls in love with her boss' Fiancee..He has no idea who she is.. She soon finds out that they are assigned to work on a Christmas project together.

title: Kiss Me, Stupid
description: In this comic gem from the legendary Billy Wilder and his long-time writing partner I.A.L. Diamond, Dean Martin is a famous singer targeted by two would-be songwriters who encourage a waitress (Kim Novak) to coerce Dino into a song-buying mood.

title: Kiss the Bride
description: An openly gay man returns to his hometown to see if he can kindle a relationship with the boy he had a crush on before it's too late.

title: Kiss The Bride
description: Danni is about to be the first Sposato daughter to walk down the aisle, that is if her three wild sisters don't tear the family apart first. Niki, Chrissy, and Toni return home for the long overdue, Italian-style family reunion.

title: Kiss the Cook
description: Food blogger Kacey is approached with the opportunity to write a cookbook. The only problem is...she is actually not a good cook! With a little help from chef Gavin and a dash of chemistry, they may just have the recipe for success.

title: Kiss: Live in Las Vegas
description: This is the concert the world never got to see from the biggest live act in the music business. Go onstage with the world's hottest band as they perform the show over one billion people missed when the Internet servers crashed.

title: Kit Carson
description: Indian fighter, trapper, and frontier scout Kit Carson leads a wagon train of settlers from Fort Bridger, along the Oregon Trail through Shoshone territory, to California, which plans to secede from Mexico.

title: Kitchen Brigade
description: Cathy is a sous-chef wanting to open a restaurant. With financial difficulties, Cathy accepts a job at a shelter for young migrants. At first she hates the job then her passion for cuisine starts to change children's lives.

title: Kitchen Criminals
description: Kitchen Criminals is about the people who can't even boil water. These are the people that top chefs Angela Hartnett and John Burton Race are going to try and teach to cook like professionals.

title: Kitchen Nightmares
description: Celebrity chef and Michelin Star-winner Gordon Ramsay ("Hell's Kitchen," "MasterChef") travels across America attempting to turn failing restaurants into sought-after venues.

title: Kitchen Nightmares en español
description: El célebre chef y ganador de una estrella Michelin, Gordon Ramsay, viaja por Estados Unidos intentando convertir restaurantes a punto de la quiebra en lugares de prestigio y convocatoria.

title: Kittie: Origins/Evolutions
description: Thrust into heavy metal stardom as teenagers with their debut release, the all-female Kittie has thrashed the heavy metal world for more than twenty years.

title: Kitty 911 (Blue Ant International)
description: Helpless and abandoned stray cats and kittens live in peril from predators and disease. Frontline cat sanctuary volunteers save kitties in crisis in these heart-warming rescues, relocations and adoptions.

title: Kitty is not a Cat
description: Kitty is Not a Cat is about a little girl 'Kitty' who believes she can be anything in life, even a cat. When Kitty arrives on the doorstep of a house full of partying felines.

title: Kitty the Killer
description: A highly trained teenage assassin, Dina, and her mentor, Charlie, form an unlikely duo as they unexpectedly join forces to stop a sinister plot and save millions of lives.

title: Klondike
description: The story of a Ukrainian family living on the border of Russia and Ukraine during the start of the war. Shortly after they find themselves at the center of an international air crash catastrophe on July 17, 2014.

title: Klondike: Quest For Gold
description: As seen on PBS comes this new \"living history\" series about eight \"average people\" who volunteer to relive an adventure. The epic 1200 kilometer journey by the Hudson's Bay Company fur traders of 1840s from Winnipeg, to the Hudson Bay.

title: Klowns asesinos
description: Cuando aterriza una nave con forma de carpa de circo y una tripulación de payasos alienígenas, la policía se muestra escéptica, pero al poco tiempo descubren que han venido para convertir a los habitantes de la Tierra en algodón dulce.

title: Knievel's Quest: Bigfoot
description: Join Kaptain Knievel, James “Bobo” Fay, and the Bluff Creek Group on their journey into the heart of Bigfoot Mecca – Willow Creek, CA. Explore this undeniably awesome Bigfoot habitat, discover recent encounters, and see evidence of its existence.

title: Knight Club
description: A wannabe actor becomes a bouncer and is seduced by the fast-paced world of Los Angeles nightlife.

title: Knight Hunters Eternity
description: Elite assassins Aya, Yoji, Ken and Omi return to fight a sinister new villain: a criminal organization masquerading as a school.

title: Knight Of Cups
description: A writer indulging in all that Los Angeles and Las Vegas have to offer, undertakes a search for love and self via a series of adventures with six different women.

title: Knightriders
description: A medieval reenactment troupe find it increasingly difficult to keep their family-like group together, with pressure from local law enforcement, interest from entertainment agents and a growing sense of delusion from their leader.

title: Knights of Badassdom
description: Live-action role players conjure up a demon from Hell by mistake and they must deal with the consequences.

title: Knights Templar: Rise and Fall
description: Eons ago, an enigmatic group of warrior monks made history together. The Knights Templar has been linked to the Holy Grail, the Ark of the Covenant, keeping mankind's greatest secret for centuries, and even the bloodline of Jesus Christ.

title: Knock knock: seducción fatal
description: El gesto amable de un hombre de familia (Keanu Reeves) se convierte en una peligrosa seducción y el juego mortal del gato y el ratón cuando les abre la puerta a dos desamparadas jovencitas.

title: Knock Off
description: Jean-Claude Van Damme plays a fashion designer who must join forces with a C.I.A. agent to combat terrorism.

title: Knock, Knock, Hogi's Halloween
description: Sing and Dance with Hogi and Pinkfong!

title: Knockout Sportsworld
description: This Action Packed series brings you spectacular knockouts from across the globe. Knockout Sportsworld has all the jabs, hits, and collisions, slammed into one exciting show!

title: Knuckleball
description: After his Grandfather unexpectedly dies in the night, 12 year old Henry finds himself cut off and alone on an isolated farm.

title: Knuckleball!
description: A documentary that showcases baseball's most unpredictable pitch. Follow MLB's Tim Wakefield and R.A. Dickey through a dramatic MLB season. Featuring Phil Niekro, Charlie Hough, and Jim Bouton.

title: Knuckledust
description: A former marine is trapped in an elite underground fight club. When cops swoop in they discover only one man left alive, him. But all is not as it seems. Is he the sole survivor or a mass murderer?

title: Kobe Bryant: A Tribute
description: Kobe’s dedication to his career, his family and his charity work led to him being adored the world over. But on Sunday January 26th 2020 his life would come to a sudden and tragic end.

title: Kon Tiki
description: Based on the Academy Award-winning documentary, KON TIKI is the story of legendary explorer Thor Heyerdal's epic crossing of the Pacific on a balsa wood raft in 1947.

title: Kon Tiki
description: This is the classic Academy-Award winning documentary film of an astonishing adventure, a journey spanning 4,300 nautical miles across the Pacific Ocean by raft.

title: Kong - King of the Apes
description: Kong is saved as a young ape by a young boy, Lucas. Lucas and his family raise Kong, but Lucas' twin brother is jealous and tries to get rid of Kong.

title: Kong – El rey de los monos
description: Kong es salvado cuando era joven por un chico llamado Lucas. Lucas y su familia crían a Kong, pero el hermano gemelo de Lucas se pone celoso e intenta deshacerse de Kong.

title: Kong: "King of Atlantis"
description: The ancient empire Atlantis is returning to Earth.

title: KONG: RETURN TO THE JUNGLE
description: Kong is entered in the valley of konhi here he is forced to live like a monkey so he struggles his living.

title: Kong: The Animated Series
description: When King Kong fell to his tragic death off the Empire State Building, there was a young scientist, Dr. Lorna Jenkins who cloned him and took him back to Kong Island, so he could finally be protected again from the world.

title: Kontroll
description: A tale about a strange young man, Bulcsu, the fellow inspectors on his team, all without exception likable characters, a rival ticket inspection team and racing along the tracks - and a tale about love.

title: Korea: The Unfinished War
description: This is the story of the Korean War. Through the use of gripping reenactments, and the words of those who fought and lived through it, this miniseries will take you through the horrors of the war.

title: Korn: Live
description: To celebrate the release of their tenth studio album, The Path Of Totality, legendary rockers performed live to a sold-out crowd, at the famed Hollywood Palladium.

title: Koyaanisqatsi
description: A motion picture essay which takes a revealing and shocking look at modern life and its imbalances. The first film in a trilogy which was followed by Powaqatsi.

title: Kraftwerk and The Electronic Revolution
description: Night Flight Presents: As innovative as they are influential, Kraftwerk's contribution to the development of electronic music since their formation in 1970 remains unsurpassed.

title: Krisha
description: Tensions rise at a Thanksgiving gathering when Krisha shows up at her sister's Texas home and reunites with the extended family that she abandoned years earlier in an emotionally charged familial reckoning.

title: Krispr
description: A family's holiday turns deadly when a genetically enhanced clone exposes their darkest secrets'and seeks revenge.

title: Krispr
