description: This long-running drama series follows the work and home lives of a London fire brigade. The knife-edge reality of the job spills over into each squad member's personal life — with dramatic results.

title: Lone Wolf
description: Students use a computer to track the werewolf preying on their high school.

title: Lone Wolf McQuade
description: A maverick Texas Ranger throws down his guns to indulge his talents in the martial arts when he meets his match in the leader of a gun-smuggling ring.

title: Lonesome Dove
description: Based upon the Pulitzer Prize-winning book by Larry McMurtry and set in the late nineteenth century, this sprawling epic of the Old West is the story of the last defiant frontier, a daring cattle drive, and an undying love.

title: Lonesome Dove: The Making Of An Epic
description: Documentary tracing the development and production of the mini-series 'Lonesome Dove' (1989), from Larry McMurtry's novel of the same name.

title: Long Day's Journey into Night
description: This magnificent autobiographical account of Eugene O'Neill's early years tells the story of a mother with a drug addiction, an embittered alcoholic father, and two maladjusted brothers. Based on Eugene O'Neill's play "Long Day's Journey into Night."

title: Long Gone Wild
description: The killer whale is once again under siege, hunted for sale into the exploding marine theme park industry. An in-depth look at the case against captivity, the Whale Sanctuary Project, and covert missions in search of orcas held captive.

title: Long Island Railroad Massacre
description: On December 7, 1993 a crazed gunman shot twenty-five people on the LIRR, killing six. This is the worst crime in New York history prior to the 9-11 attacks.

title: Long Live Rock…Celebrate The Chaos
description: A deep dive into the hard rock music culture where members of Metallica, GnR, Slipknot, Ice-T, MGK, Rob Zombie, Five Finger Death Punch, Halestorm and more disccuss the maligned genre & the symbiotic relationship they have with their fans.

title: Long Lost Family (UK)
description: Offering a last chance for people who are desperate to find long lost relatives, this series uncovers family secrets and takes us all over the world, finding people who no one else has been able to trace.

title: Long Lost Family: What Happened Next? UK
description: The spinoff series What Happened Next? follows up with participants after reunions. Relationships become more complicated, new truths come to light, and never-before-known family members come forward.

title: Long Nights Short Mornings
description: An examination of the romantic life of a young man in New York City and his sometimes fleeting, sometimes profound experiences with the women he encounters.

title: Long, Lonesome Highway: The Story Of Michael Parks
description: Long Lonesome Highway is the story of the greatest performer that you've likely never heard of.

title: Look Around You
description: Harking back to the halcyon days of 1970s and '80s, follow a unique educational approach to the world.

title: Look Away
description: Maria, an alienated high-school student, has her life turned upside down when she switches places with her sinister mirror image.

title: Look to the Sky
description: These are the inspiring true stories of young people who have demonstrated the spirit of Superman.  This film explores the power of hope and the importance of positive ideals while encouraging viewers to find the superhero within themselves.

title: Looking For Her
description: When her family guilt-trips her into going home for the holidays and bringing her girlfriend along, perfectionist Taylor concedes, but there's one little problem: they broke up.

title: Looking For Johnny: The Legend Of Johnny Thunders
description: Night Flight Presents: Looking For Johnny, a 90-minute film that documents Thunders' career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991.

title: Looking for Lenny
description: Looking for Lenny is an in-depth, controversial documentary that uses Lenny Bruce's legacy to explore the present condition of the fear of words and expression.

title: Looking for Lenny
description: Lenny Bruce was one of the key anti-Establishment figures of 1960s America, who constantly pushed the boundaries with his numerous brushes with the law and his convictions for obscenity in 1964. Now is the time to find the man behind the myth.

title: Looking for Lincoln
description: Hosted by Henry Louis Gates, Jr., "Looking for Lincoln" addresses many of the controversies surrounding Lincoln by carefully interpreting evidence from those who knew him and those who study him today.

title: Looking Glass
description: A couple buy a desert motel where they find out that strange, mysterious events occur.

title: Looks and Smiles
description: Mick and Alan have just left school and are full of dreams, but against the background of Thatcher's Britain the two soon wake up to reality. Directed by Ken Loach ('I, Daniel Blake'), this film won the Young Cinema Award at the Cannes Film Festival.

title: Loopers: The Caddie's Long Walk
description: Centuries old and enjoyed by millions, golf is more than a sport. Loopers: The Caddie's Long Walk explores the bond between golfer and caddie. Featuring never before seen stories, Loopers is an account of golf like you've never seen before.

title: Lord All Men Can't Be Dogs
description: LORD, ALL MEN CAN'T BE DOGS is a riveting story of the lives of two people, Lisa and Tim Johnson, whose struggles are closely tied with the four spirits that reside in their home.

title: Lord Lucan: My Husband, The Truth
description: The 40-year mystery uncovered by his wife. This is the story of Lord Lucan, playboy, aristocrat, gambler, and murderer.

title: Lord of the Elves
description: In an ancient age, the peace-loving Hobbits are enslaved by the Java Men, a race of flesh-eating dragon-riders. The young Hobbit Goben must join forces with their neighbor giants, the humans, to free his people and vanquish their enemies.

title: Lord of War
description: Oscar winner Nicolas Cage stars in this taut, action-packed tale of a notorious arms dealer who sold weapons to dictators and successfully outran the law for nearly twenty years.

title: Lords of Salem
description: From the singular mind of horror maestro Rob Zombie comes a nightmare world where evil forces from a Salem, Massachusetts legend unleash terror upon the modern-day town.

title: Lorelei
description: Wayland is released from prison after 15 years. He reunites with Dolores, his high school girlfriend, who is now a single mother of three. What follows is a lyrical take on love, regret, and second chances.

title: Loreto: The Mystery of The Holy House
description: A documentary investigation into one of the most fascinating mysteries of Christianity. How was the Holy House of the Virgin Mary transported from its original location in Nazareth, Palestine, to the town of Loreto on Italy's Adriatic coast?

title: Los 10 mejores videos
description: Presenta: "Los 10 mejores videos." 10 divertidas compilaciones con los videos favoritos que incluyen divertidos videos caseros y momentos de comedia de personas como tú.

title: Los 100 mejores knockouts de la historia
description: Los más grandes boxeadores de la historia, y algunos desconocidos, en sus mejores knockouts.

title: Los 12 perros de Navidad
description: Un padre viudo y desempleado envía a regañadientes a su hija a permanecer con su tía en una ciudad que ha prohibido los perros. En el camino a la escuela un día encuentra un perrito y decide quedárselo.

title: Los Abandonados
description: Los Abandonados  narra la historia del principal fiscal de Argentina, Alberto Nisman, y plantea la dolorosa pregunta de si alguna vez se encontrará justicia.

title: Los Alegres Aguilares
description: El aventurero Manuel se encuentra con Carlos, quien es casi idéntico a él. Uno es de familia rica y el otro no. Entonces Manuel le ofrece dinero a Carlos para que se haga pasar por él con una señorita con la cual no se quiere casar.

title: Los Amores Cobardes
description: Eva regresa a su ciudad natal para pasar las vacaciones de verano. Allí la esperan su madre y Gema, su incondicional amiga. Lo que Eva no esperaba es encontrarse con Rubén, quién solía ser su mejor amigo hasta que perdieron el contacto.

title: Los archivos del FBI
description: Producido con la cooperación total del Buró Federal de Investigaciones, Los archivos del FBI dan una mirada semanal a cómo el FBI utiliza la ciencia forense y la determinación absoluta de los investigadores para resolver los casos más increíbles.

title: Los archivos del FBI
description: Producido con la cooperación total del Buró Federal de Investigaciones, los archivos del FBI dan una mirada semanal a cómo el FBI utiliza la ciencia forense y la determinación absoluta de los investigadores para resolver los casos.

title: Los archivos del FBI: Crueles decepciones
description: 12 años después de su salida de prisión, las oscuras obsesiones de un falsificador se salen de control. Lo que comienza como un simple plan para imprimir dinero se convierte en una violación en serie y termina en una secuencia de asesinatos.

title: Los archivos del FBI: El dentista letal
description: Para las personas de su comunidad, el Dr. Glennon Engleman parece ser un dentista de modales apacibles. Pero en realidad, Engleman ha ocultado un secreto oscuro durante más de dos décadas.

title: Los archivos del FBI: La verdadera historia de D.B. Cooper
description: El perfil de Richard McCoy desafía los niveles de comprensión, es padre, maestro de catequesis y un héroe de guerra condecorado. Pero también es secuestrador, extorsionador y ladrón de bancos.

title: Los archivos del FBI: Persecución peligrosa
description: En 1974, Paul John Knowles lo tenía todo, era inteligente, encantador y guapo. Pero cuando Knowles se embarca en un viaje por el país, solo tiene un objetivo en la vida.

title: Los asesinatos de Midsomer
description: Un veterano detective inspector en jefe y su joven sargento investigan asesinatos en la comunidad regional del condado de Midsomer.

title: Los astronautas
description: En el planeta Venus, el líder del sindicato de maridos oprimidos desea que se devuelva de nuevo el poder a los hombres.

title: Los bandidos (LAS)
description: Tres bandidos mexicanos huyen de los franceses internándose en Estados Unidos dónde salvan de la horca a tres bandoleros estadounidenses, junto a los que deciden robarles un tesoro a los franceses.

title: Los bosques olvidados de Malasia
description: Malasia cuenta con algunos de los bosques más antiguos del planeta. Estos son tesoros biológicos; hogar de una riqueza sin igual de la vida.

title: Los buscapleitos
description: Thomas y David llevan una vida simple en España, trabajando en su camión de comidas rápidas pero todo cambia completamente por culpa de una hermosa ladrona, Sylvia.

title: Los campeones
description: Cinco historias reales de victorias de atletas rusos. Todas las victorias son historias humanas, donde el amor, la traición, la amistad, el respeto, el trabajo y la fe se entrelazan en una sola. Historias sobre creer en uno mismo, creer en la victoria.

title: Los chimpancés del Congo rescatados, con Jane Goodall
description: Jane Goodall ofrece al mundo una ventana extraordinaria a los parientes vivos más cercanos de la humanidad.

title: Los chimpancés del Congo rescatados, con Jane Goodall: El especial
description: La Dra. Jane Goodall crea un santuario, se reúne con el chimpancé Gregoire, la madre sustituta, La Vielle, y el huérfano Motambo.

title: Los Cuatro Juanes
description: Los cuatro famosos Juanes: Juan Colorado, Juan Sin Miedo, Juan Pistolas y Juan Charrasqueado pasan peligrosas aventuras para llevar un importante cargamento de armas y municiones desde  Veracruz hasta un pueblo sitiado por las fuerzas del gobierno.

title: Los Desenfrenados
description: Viruta y Capulina son dos camioneros conocen a unas hermosas fugitivas que huyen de un internado femenino.

title: Los diablos del terror
description: Un policía federal llega a un pueblo desolado por una secta de encapuchados que deja una cara de satanás en sus víctimas.

title: Los diarios de Ol Pejeta
description: OI Pejeta, es una de las mayores reservas de caza en África. Conozca al personal de la conservación de la vida silvestre y vea sus desafíos diarios de criar animales para detener la extinción y aprender a dominar a las criaturas salvajes.

title: Los Doodlebops
description: Esta serie de comedia musical para niños tiene como protagonistas a Deedee, Rooney y Moe Doodle; las multitalentosas estrellas de rock que están siempre bailando, cantando y aprendiendo de los demás.

title: Los Dos Rivales
description: Los Treviño y Los Guereña mantienen una rivalidad originada muchos años atrás. Por necesidad de dinero, el heredero de los Treviño, y la heredera de los Guereña, tienen que disfrazarse usando ropa del sexo opuesto para proteger y vender sus ranchos.

title: Los días de la ballena
description: La historia de Cristina y Simón, dos jóvenes grafiteros y muralistas de Medellín, de espirítu salvaje, que desafían la violencia de la ciudad.

title: Los elegidos
description: En este clásico de culto de Troy Duffy, dos hermanos irlandeses católicos se convierten en vigilantes y eliminan el inframundo criminal de Boston en nombre de Dios.

title: Los exiliados románticos
description: Tres amigos viajan en auto de Madrid hasta París sin ningún motivo, tan solo para buscar un amor idílico y efímero. La única misión es sorprenderse, sentirse vivos de nuevo y alargar su juventud.

title: Los fabulosos má mejores
description: Un equipo dominicano de béisbol infantil y su loco entrenador deben encontrar la manera de usar su encanto y habilidades para recaudar los fondos necesarios para competir en el primer Torneo de Béisbol de la Liga Pequeña y ganar el campeonato.

title: Los Fiscales: En busca de la justicia
description: Un examen escalofriante de la mente criminal en medio de la cruda realidad de los tribunales atrasados, las estaciones de policía con poco personal y las calles endurecidas de Estados Unidos.

title: Los Guerreros Del Zodiaco: El Lienzo Perdido
description: Desde los tiempos de leyenda, estas batallas se han repetido entre la diosa Athena y Hades. ¡La historia nunca antes contada de la Guerra Santa entre el Caballero Pegaso, Hades el Dios del Inframundo y la Diosa Athena, ha comenzado!

title: Los herederos del monte
description: La vida de cinco hermanos cuyos destinos cambian para siempre con la llegada de Paula, la única hija biológica de Emilio del Monte. Con la lectura del testamento que deja su padre comienza una historia en la que estarán irremediablemente atrapados.

title: Los Hermanos Grimm
description: En esta película visionaria, Will y Jake Grimm sorprenden a los pueblos con sus folclores creativos e ilusiones elaboradas, pero descubren que los personajes fantásticos y las situaciones emocionantes en sus amadas historias son reales.

title: Los hijos de la novia
description: Cuando Margret Becker se compromete con un hombre más joven, sus hijos plantean algunas preocupaciones. Pero Margret tiene otras cosas en mente, como planificar una boda y convertirse en abuela.

title: Los hombres de la compañía
description: Tres hombres replantean sus vidas tras perder sus empleos y el sueño americano. Con Ben Affleck, Chris Cooper y Tommy Lee Jones.

title: Los inquilinos
description: Una historia de suspenso gótico sobrenatural de un huérfano que pelea para liberarse de una hórrida y ancestral maldición familiar.

title: Los insectos investigadores
description: Un montón de bichos raros que resuelven misterios.

title: Los Legionarios
description: Viruta y Capulina huyen disfrazados de mujer de la legión extranjera, pero los confunden con esclavas y son vendidos  para el harem del príncipe Omar. La odalisca Farida los descubre y avisa al sultán, quien los manda a decapitar.

title: Los Lobos: Kiko Live (2006)
description: Los Lobos celebrates the 20th anniversary of their album Kiko with the release of Kiko Live, which captures their February 24, 2006, performance at the House Of Blues in San Diego, CA.

title: Los locos Addams II
description: El futuro de la familia se torna incierto cuando la malvada niñera se casa con Lucas mientras los niños están embarcados en un campamento de verano, pero Merlina tiene aún una o dos cartas bajo la manga…

title: Los locos efectos del divorcio
description: Un adulto atrapado en el fuego cruzado de los 15 años de divorcio de sus padres descubre que formó parte de un estudio sobre niños divorciados y es reclutado para un seguimiento años después, lo que provoca nuevos estragos en su familia.

title: Los lunes a las 9
description: Basado en el exitoso programa que cambió la historia de la televisión puertorriqueña "No te duermas", por el estilo ingenioso, controvertible, espontaneidad e indiscutible talento de su anfitrión Tony Sánchez, El Gángster.

title: Los mejores goles de la Champions
description: Los más grandes goles marcados en la Champions, desde 1955 hasta nuestros días.

title: Los mejores goles de la historia
description: Jugadores famosos y desconocidos, de equipos grandes o modestos, pero siempre convirtiendo nada más y nada menos que… Los mejores goles de la historia.

title: Los mejores goles de los mundiales
description: En este programa se muestran los mejores goles logrados en las Copas del Mundo de fútbol, desde 1930 hasta 2018.

title: Los mejores tries de la historia
description: Los grandes tries conquistados en el mundo desde el año 1930 hasta la actualidad.

title: Los mejores tries de los mundiales
description: Un programa para los amantes del rugby, con los mejores tries marcados en las Copas del Mundo, desde la primera en 1987 hasta la última en Japón 2019

title: Los ministros
description: Un detective de Nueva York investiga una serie de asesinatos ligados a un oscuro culto religioso, mientras desentraña secretos que podrían destruirlo todo.

title: Los misterios del Oráculo
description: Los hermanos mellizos de 15 años de edad Cally (Paula Brancati) y Lance Stone (Alex House) descubren “Los Misterios del Oráculo”, un inquietante libro de comics que muestra situaciones que sucederán en el futuro.

title: Los miércoles no existen
description: En el Madrid actual y a lo largo de cuatro años, las decisiones de seis personas, van a influir directamente sobre todos ellos. Diez momentos de sus vidas que marcarán el final de una etapa y el comienzo de otra.

title: Los mosqueteros
description: En las calles de París del siglo XVII, la ley y el orden son más una idea incipiente que una realidad, y los mosqueteros son mucho más que simples guardaespaldas reales del rey Luis XIII.

title: Los nuevos detectives
description: Desde los laboratorios forenses de el Smithsonian Institute hasta el laboratorio de bombas ATF y el Instituto de Patología de los Armed Forces, Los Nuevos Detectives describe el trabajo de expertos forenses e investigadores criminales renombrados mundial.

title: Los papeles póstumos del Club Pickwick
description: Samuel Pickwick desea respuestas. Viaja a la parte oscura de la sociedad inglesa para descubrir por qué la gente es como es. A lo largo del camino, se encuentra con personajes coloridos, mujeres hermosas y peligros.

title: Los paranoicos
description: Luciano Gauna, un guionista fracasado en Buenos Aires, se le tira el mundo patas arriba cuando su exitoso amigo productor de televisión regresa de Madrid con una deslumbrante novia.

title: Los parecidos
description: En la lluviosa noche del 2 de octubre de 1968, ocho personajes que esperan en una remota estación un autobús con destino a Ciudad de México comienzan a experimentar un extraño fenómeno...

title: Los peleadores de la batalla Bakugan
description: Un chico quiere ser el mejor en la clasificación de un juego unidimensional.

title: Los perros de la guerra
description: En esta fascinante adaptación de la famosa novela de Frederick Forsyth  y protagonizada por Christopher Walken y Tom Berenger, los mercenarios son contratados por un peligroso cártel con el cometido de destronar a un dictador africano.

title: Los profesores
description: Un grupo de estudiantes de secundaria descubren que el cuerpo docente está bajo el control de parásitos alienígenas. Con el guion inteligente de Kevin Williamson “Scream” y dirigida por Robert Rodriguez “From Dusk Till Dawn”.

title: Los quién
description: Sitcom que narra las peripecias del matrimonio Peña Zunzunegui, una pareja que a comienzos de los años ochenta protagoniza el primer divorcio en la España democrática.

title: Los recién llegados
description: Un niño de 12 años y su familia comienzan su vida en una nueva ciudad.

title: Los reyes del volante
description: Dos taxistas se hacen cargo de una niña que dejan en su puerta, y cuando ella crece finge ante su novio ser hija de ricos.

title: Los reyes pal palacio
description: Momentos divertidos al lado de los talentosos Miguel Céspedes y Raymond Pozo, con más de 600 programas de televisión producidos y viendo la sonrisa de la gente de manera directa en los espectáculos que han realizado en vivo.

title: Los secretos de la civilización
description: La ciencia moderna revela las fuerzas ambientales que han dado forma a la historia de la humanidad.

title: Los secretos de una Australia salvaje
description: Un vasto continente insular de casi tres millones de millas cuadradas, el espléndido aislamiento de Australia lo ha convertido en el hogar de algunos de los animales más extraordinarios.

title: Los siete sellos del apocalipsis
description: En esta película épica de desastres y fe, una madre y un padre buscan desesperadamente a su único hijo, mientras que un asteroide gigante que se dirige a la Tierra desencadena una serie de eventos apocalípticos.

title: Los tentáculos de las Bermudas
description: Cuando Air Force One cae sobre el Triángulo de las Bermudas, la Marina envía a su mejor equipo de rescate. Pero al salvar al presidente, el equipo despierta a un monstruo que amenaza a toda la Costa Este.

title: Los testigos: encuentros con antiguos alienígenas
description: El contactado, el vidente y el abducido comparten experiencias similares y diferentes con seres de otras dimensiones, dejando una marca duradera de su presencia.

title: Los tres amigos
description: Las locuras de tres actores hollywoodenses (Steve Martin, Chevy Chase y Martin Short) que enfrentan a un grupo de bandidos mexicanos. ¿Qué podría salir mal?

title: Los tres días del cóndor
description: Un investigador de la CIA, que es pagado para leer libros, regresa del almuerzo para encontrar a todos sus compañeros de trabajo asesinados.  "Cóndor" debe averiguar quién hizo esto antes de que los sicarios lo atrapen.

title: Los tuyos, los míos, y los nuestros
description: Un almirante viudo de la Guardia costera y una viuda diseñadora de bolsos se enamoran y se casan, para la consternación de sus hijos, ocho de él y diez de ella.

title: Los valientes
description: Gene Hackman hace el papel del coronel Jason Rhodes, un hombre obsesionado, en esta aventura llena de acción.

title: Los Wánabis
description: Tres amigos, en busca de un mayor estatus social, arriesgan sus vidas y las de sus familias al aceptar una misteriosa propuesta de negocio que promete convertirlos en millonarios de la noche a la mañana.

title: Los últimos caballeros
description: Clive Owen protagoniza esta épica aventura del arte de pelear con espadas, un guerrero caído que lucha para vengar a su deshonrado maestro (Morgan Freeman).

title: Los últimos días de Franky, La Mosca
description: El afable y mezquino pandillero Frankie La Mosca tiene la oportunidad de cumplir su sueño de vengarse de su jefe después de pasar una noche con una actriz porno de buena naturaleza.

title: Lose To Gain
description: Lose to Gain introduces professional skate boarder Brian Sumner, Comedian Michael Jr. and young professional Shannon Culpepper. Each wanted something different- success, laughs, and love.

title: Losers Take All
description: A band is given the chance of committing the ultimate sin: selling out. They must decide if they'll stick to their roots or give in to corporate rock.

title: Losin' It
description: Set in 1965, four rowdy teenage guys travel to Tijuana, Mexico, for a night of partying when they are joined by a heartbroken housewife who is in town seeking a quick divorce.

title: Losing Chase
description: Helen Mirren stars as a woman recovering from a nervous breakdown whose bond with her young caretaker (Kyra Sedgwick) arouses the suspicion of her husband (Beau Bridges).

title: Losing Isaiah
description: Jessica Lange plays an adoptive mother who gives an abandoned child a new chance at life. Halle Berry is the birth mother who cleans up her life and sets out to reclaim the child.

title: Loss Prevention
description: A bar owner and his daughter get caught up in a cat-and-mouse game of corporate espionage.

title: Lost And Found
description: British reality series showing the work of the dog rescue charity Dogs Trust, as well as following dog owners as they search for their missing pets.

title: Lost Angel
description: Lisa's quest for the truth about her sister's death leads her to uncover shady criminal activity that puts her own life in danger. Her only ally, a mysterious man called Rich, is hiding a dark secret of his own.

title: Lost Army of King Cambyses
description: While escaping the Egyptians 2,500 years ago, the Persian King Cambyses led his army into the desert and disappeared forever. Despite efforts in the 1930s to discover what happened to him, no clues were found until 1996.

title: Lost at Christmas
description: In this feel-good festive romance, two strangers come together to try and get home for Christmas.

title: Lost Bombs: The True Story of America's Broken Arrows
description: Nuclear weapons, even unused, can be accidents waiting to happen. Hear how 10 aircrews dealt with disaster resulting from mishaps inside bomb bays.

title: Lost Christmas
description: A year after his parents' death, the young Goose searches for his lost dog one Christmas Eve. He meets Anthony, a man with no memory who can see things people have lost upon touching them.

title: Lost Cos
description: Recovering from a severe traumatic event, Eni finds refuge in a New York underground Cosplay community, but when her life spirals even further out of control,  she finds super hero strength in order to survive.

title: Lost Girls and Love Hotels
description: In Tokyo’s neon-lit nights, Margaret seeks escape from her past. A passionate, dangerous affair with a Yakuza enforcer pulls her deeper into the city's shadows. Will she find herself—or lose everything?

title: Lost In America
description: The world's wealthiest country has 4.2 million homeless teenagers. Director Rotimi Rainwater along with the help of celebrities and politicians who have been homeless themselves, take a large scale issue down to a very personal level.

title: Lost In Austen (Shout! Factory TV)
description: Amanda, an ardent Jane Austen fan, lives in present day London, until she finds she's swapped places with Austen's fictional creation Elizabeth Bennet

title: Lost in Florence
description: A heart-broken ex-college football star gets deeply involved with a dangerous Florentine sport and an alluring local woman.

title: Lost In Hong Kong
description: A revered Asian leader needs a rare blood transfusion. His disciple, aided by a courageous cop, hunts three potential donors as they battle terrorists and uncover police traitors, racing to save Lama amidst escalating danger

title: Lost in Paris
description: Filmed in Dominique Abel and Fiona Gordon’s signature whimsical style, LOST IN PARIS stars the filmmakers as a small-town Canadian librarian and a strangely seductive, oddly egotistical vagabond.

title: Lost In Thailand
description: Jiang Ziya is banished to the mortal realm after violating the code of the gods.

title: Lost in the Moonlight
description: Hyunjuli travels to the moonlight world and meets Mr. Squirrel and warrior Won. She must save the moonlit palace and return home.

title: Lost in the Sun
description: John is a rugged small-time crook, running from a past full of mistakes and regrets. He soon crosses paths with Louis, a newly-orphaned teenage boy, who becomes an unwilling accomplice on an open-road adventure fueled by robberies, guns, and deception.

title: Lost Island with ExplodingTNT
description: Lost Island is a Modded Minecraft movie that follows ExplodingTNT, Failboat, Notch, and Herobrine as they go on vacation together, but things start going wrong on the plane ride there.

title: Lost Secrets of the Pyramid
description: Lost Secrets of the Pyramid unearths what may be humanity's greatest achievement—the Great Pyramid of Giza. Using immersive CGI imagery and incredible excavations, experts recreate the daunting tasks it took to build a pyramid.

title: Lost Solace
description: Lost Solace is the story of psychopath Spence Cutler’s encounter with a new drug that causes Spence's brain to begin experiencing emotions, empathy, and guilt. As his brain rapidly changes, he is unable to continue the life he once had.

title: Lost Soul: The Doomed Journey of Richard Stanley's Island of Dr. Moreau
description: The filming of the ill-fated 1996 THE ISLAND OF DR. MOREAU is a sensational story of what could have been a science fiction masterpiece but which became a huge creative and financial disaster; the story of the outsider artist versus Hollywood machine.

title: Lost Transmissions
description: When an acclaimed music producer goes off his medication for schizophrenia, his friends chase him though the LA music scene to help commit him to a psychiatric hospital, revealing the troubling inadequacies of our mental health care system.

title: Lost Treasures Of The Ancient World: Ancient Egypt
description: This program visits, explores and restores such wonders as the Temples at Al Karnak and Luxor, the Temple at Abu Simnel and more.

title: Lost World, The
description: At the dawn of the 20th century, a band of adventurers find themselves trapped in a dangerous land of Dinosaurs and other creatures.The adventurers must fight to survive as they search for a way to return home.

title: Lotoman 003
description: Miguel y Modesto Marchena están de vuelta en la pobreza. Un enfrentamiento con un par de ciclistas ladrones los convierte en héroes locales y los pone en contacto con una agencia secreta que los recluta para una tarea.

title: Lottie Dottie Chicken Mini
description: Lottie Dottie and her family are going to the beach. The characters end up discovering that they are not alone.

title: Louder Than Bombs
description: LOUDER THAN BOMBS explores the death of a famous photographer (Isabelle Huppert), and how her husband (Gabriel Byrne) and sons, (Jesse Eisenberg and Devin Druid) cope while unraveling the truth behind the mysterious accident that claimed her life.

title: Louis Armstrong: 100th Anniversary
description: Louis Armstrong dazzled millions of fans with his virtuoso trumpet playing and his irresistible vocal style. Celebrate his life as past performances are revisited and first hand accounts of his life are given by individuals touched by him.

title: Love & Dance
description: When Chen decides to enroll in dance lessons, he upsets his Israeli father but pleases his Russian mother. Amid mounting tensions at home, Chen finds joy in his lessons and in the true source of his interest in the sport: his crush and classmate, Natalie.

title: Love & Hip Hop Hollywood Series
description: Love & Hip-Hop Hollywood follows music business newcomers and veterans like Kimberly, Moniece Slaughter, Fizz, Lyrica, A1, La'Britney, Ray J and Apple Watts as they put it all on the line for a taste of industry success.

title: Love & Hip Hop Miami
description: There's never a dull moment as established stars and up-and-coming rappers, singers, producers, and promoters flourish, fight and fall in love under the Miami sun.

title: Love & Hip Hop New York
description: Love & Hip Hop New York follows the lives and relationships of hip-hop artists as they make their mark on the Big Apple.

title: Love & Hip Hop: Atlanta
description: Atlanta is the new frontier in entertainment, the Dirty South, where the opportunity to make it big in the rap game is always one hustle away. Centered in the heart of the South, these fiery ladies and gentlemen aren't looking to lead the debutante life.

title: Love & Murder: ATL Playboy Part 1
description: BET+ ORIGINAL. This two-part crime drama stars Taye Diggs as Lance Herndon, a womanizing local legend living life in the fast lane while trying to make his mark on the tech industry.

title: Love & Murder: ATL Playboy Part 2
description: BET+ ORIGINAL. In the conclusion of this movie, notorious womanizer Lance Herndon (Taye Diggs) is found brutally murdered in his home, leaving police to narrow down a long list of suspects.

title: Love Affair
description: A French playboy and an American nightclub singer fall in love aboard a ship

title: Love Afloat
description: When Lorelei inherits a sailboat from a distant relative, she hires Rob to help clean, fix and sail it from its present location at a Caribbean island to Miami. The two have a definite culture clash as romantic sparks fly.

title: Love Again
description: A distant father (Kevin Sorbo) and losing his girlfriend to his best friend (Ben Davies) leads Nathan (Jason Burkey) on a journey of rediscovery.

title: Love Ain't Supposed To Hurt II - The Wedding
description: Tracie has decided to take the plunge and walk down the aisle, but an unexpected accident causes her to face yet another issue from her past.

title: Love Alaska
description: It may not be the happiest of circumstances but two childhood friends, Maggie and Finn, have come home and are reunited in Love, Alaska. While starting their lives in and dealing with their pasts, these two get a second chance at love.

title: Love Amongst the Stars
description: Heidi, a professor of astronomy at a prestigious university, is convinced that a rare planetary alignment which occurs every couple thousand years is the key to getting an observatory for her students. But AUGUST, a hotshot archaeologist and the newest history professor, might be either the answer or the downfall of her research.

title: Love and Action in Chicago
description: Government hitman Eddie Jones falls for Lois, but quitting the job makes him the target of his own employers.

title: Love And Bullets
description: The FBI sends a loner (Charles Bronson) to kidnap a mobster's mistress in Switzerland.

title: Love and Death
description: Woody Allen invades the spirit of Tolstoy in this hilarious spoof of 18th Century Russia, when Napoleon is preoccupied with perfecting his pastry and before Wellington markets his beef.

title: Love and Leftovers
description: A successful chef is torn between his current girlfriend and a new flame that sees his potential.

title: Love and Terror On the Howling Plains of Nowhere
description: Author Poe Ballantine investigates the disappearance of a brilliant mathematics professor, who then is found tied to a tree and burned beyond recognition.

title: Love and the Radio Star
description: Savannah, a single parent and consultant, is hired to rebrand a New York radio show. When she accidentally ends up on the air with the host, she discovers that love might have the last word after all.

title: Love and Videotapes
description: In the summer of 2001, in a small town in the Philippines, 16-year-old Andoy searches for his long-lost father in the most unlikely of places: VHS tapes. Together with his best friend and fellow movie nerd Pido, he explores life on film.

title: Love at First Like
description: A journalist who is out of her depth in the social media world is partnered with the leading dating advice influencer on a profile. Can they move past their clashes and open up their hearts?

title: Love at Lookout Lake
description: A gossip columnist returns to her family's lake cabin to uncover a mystery novelist's identity, only to rekindle a romance with her childhood crush and uncover life-changing secrets.

title: Love At Mariposa Beach
description: A woman struggling in her career returns to her mother's exotic hometown on a journey of self-discovery and finds love in the process.

title: Love At Sky Gardens
description: A barista and event planner team up to plan a rooftop garden wedding and find love in the process.

title: Love at the Bootcamp
description: When a scattered marketing exec is tasked with helping an unpopular small-town bootcamp turn its image around, she finds that the strict, regimented ways of its owner might just be the perfect 'fit' for love.

title: Love at the Christmas Contest
description: A young woman enters a Christmas tree decorating contest to honor the memory of her mother, only to discover that the competition includes her recently widowed high school sweetheart and his adorable 10-year-old daughter.

title: Love at the Ranch
description: Allison Sawyer is the go-to reporter at Metropolis Post, known for breaking high-profile stories. Her next story is writing a profile piece on one of her favourite authors, Annabelle Lee. Annabelle based all her romantic novels on the timelessly beautiful Clybourne Ranch, far away from city life. Allison heads to the ranch and meets Hank and his adorable Grandma Stella, who have been running the place together for years. As Allison gets closer to Annabelle’s life, she also becomes a lot closer to Hank. Sparks fly and there are surprises around every corner…

title: Love at the Thanksgiving Day Parade
description: The annual Chicago Thanksgiving Day parade has to cut costs or it's going to be cancelled this year.  When the city brings in consultant Henry Baldwin to analyze the books, he goes to toe to toe with parade manager Emily.

title: Love Between the Covers
description: Romance fiction is the behemoth of the publishing industry; it outsells mystery, sci-fi, and fantasy combined. Yet no filmmaker has ever taken an honest look at the global community romance writers and readers have built - until now. This funny and ins...

title: Love Birds
description: Sometimes the best things in life happen on the fly.

title: Love Bites
description: A 300-year old vampire (rock star Adam Ant) tries to "re-humanize" after falling in love with a beautiful "mortal." His attempts are thwarted, however, by his jealous vampire lover and his new love's jealous fiancee.

title: Love Blossoms
description: Hallmark Original Movie. Perfumer Violet hires a botanist with an uncanny ability to identify scents.

title: Love Blows
description: Lisa runs Chicago's premiere matchmaking service, but working with her ex-husband AND the mistress who broke up their marriage makes every day hilariously dysfunctional.

title: Love Bomb
description: A mysterious dating app designed for one night stands brings three strangers together with deadly consequences.

title: Love by Accident
description: While on a road trip, Daphne and her godmother Fran get into an accident. Wanting to keep Fran off the road, Daphne enlists their mechanic, Matthew, as her fake boyfriend. But soon, their fake relationship will not be so fake after all.

title: Love By Design
description: Broken-hearted Brooke Yeardley makes her 30th birthday wish on the vision board she made as a teen. But as her wishes start coming true she finds out that life doesn't always follow a plan.

title: Love By Design
description: After designer Danielle loses her boyfriend and her job in New York, a trip to her native Romania may help her find herself again.

title: Love Chronicles
description: Through the unbelievable stories of callers, a disc jockey and his guest therapist explore the struggles of relationships in L.A. In the process of listening to their stories, the disc jockey discovers his own issues about love.

title: Love Come Down
description: A heart-wrenching tale of two brothers, each the other's keeper since their family was torn apart by tragedy. Starring Larenz Tate and Grammy Award nominee Deborah Cox.

title: Love Covers All
description: On the eve of his wife's due date, Michael has to leave on a business trip 400 miles away. When he gets stranded in the middle of nowhere and she goes into labour, he seeks help from a gas station owner who questions his faith.

title: Love Everlasting
description: High school senior Bridger (Lucky Blue Smith) in an escape from his abusive stepfather, ends up stuck in a small middle-of-nowhere town. He soon meets fellow outcast Clover, and sparks fly.

title: Love Field
description: A Dallas beautician and housewife is enthralled by President and Mrs. John F. Kennedy, and is like an excited schoolgirl at the thought of their visit to her hometown in November 1963.

title: Love for Starters
description: To save her father's lake-front restaurant, a talented interior designer must partner with the celebrity chef her father hired without her knowledge to revamp the place before time runs out.

title: Love Gets a Room
description: In 1942 Nazi-occupied Poland, a Jewish actress faces heartrending choice: love or flee ghetto? Real-time narrative akin to "Buried," the film depicts romance and survival amid dire circumstances.

title: Love Hina Again
description: After Keitaro goes overseas, Keitaro's step sister, arrives on the scene. She claims to be the new manager of Hinata Lodge starts to go against all the tenants. Thing gets complicated in this classic harem anime...

title: Love Hurts
description: A newly separated father has to learn how to date again with help from his teenage son who himself dreams of conquering one girl's heart.

title: Love In Bloom
description: When her soon-to-be-married little sister and fiancé become marooned at a mountain retreat days before their wedding, Amelia and the best man, Grayson Tanner, are tasked with stepping in to save the wedding.

title: Love in Full Swing
description: Becks, an aspiring romance columnist, decides to help her best friend Casey as he goes back home in search of his first love. As they start their journey to win back Cassie's first love, they both discover more about each other than they thought they knew. With their friendship on the line, Becks now faces a dilemma: help Casey or risk opening her heart to the love of a lifetime.

title: Love in Tokyo
description: Tom is an American who moves to Tokyo on what he thinks is to be a temporary situation. He struggles to fit into the Japanese culture and hides behind the Internet. He meets Saki, a free-spirited Japanese woman who changes the way he views the world.

title: Love is Love is Love
description: This is a woven tale of three stories that explore love, commitment, and loyalty between couples and friends. The stories are all about finding the effortlessness at the heart of the deepest friendships and romances.

title: Love is Not Enough
description: The love and lives of recent college graduates and the pitfalls they must overcome dating and in corporate America.

title: Love Is the Drug
description: Scholarship student Jonah becomes infatuated with a wealthy drug user at his private school, stealing drugs for her friends in order to get closer to her.

title: Love it or List it Australia
description: 'Love It or List It: Australia' helps couples solve a common dilemma of falling out of love with your house.

title: Love it or List It UK
description: Kirstie and Phil are back to helping couples who've fallen out of love with their houses.

title: Love It or List It Vancouver
description: Love It or List It is moving west to Vancouver!

title: Love it Or Lose It
description: Would you give up your keys for a chance on a free home makeover? Putting extreme designers in the driver's seat, Love It or Lose It is the ultimate interior decorating adventure.

title: Love Jacked
description: Maya has artistic ambitions - her father wants a dutiful daughter to run the family store. Taking her independence a step further, Maya decides to travel to Africa for inspiration and returns with a fiancé.

title: Love Kills: The Story of Sid and The Pistols
description: The Sex Pistols, bringing the revolution of punk music to Britain. One of the most influential bands of the era. We hear from members of the band about their unique story and get to know of the key pioneers of UK punk; Sid Vicious. Described as an arch...

title: Love Laughs at Andy Hardy
description: Andy Hardy goes to college after returning from World War II. He is in love with Kay Wilson this time.

title: Love Letters (1983)
description: A disc jockey's (Jamie Lee Curtis) affair with a married man (James Keach) is like the one in her mother's old love letters.

title: Love Locks
description: A woman returns to Paris after 20 years and begins a journey of romance and rediscovery when she reconnects with her college boyfriend and first love. Stars Rebecca Romijn and Jerry O'Connell.

title: Love Map
description: A journalist on the verge of launching a dating app is tasked with writing a map of the most romantic places in Florida. The only problem is that she has to team up with a tour guide whose tastes are diametrically opposed to hers.

title: Love Marks the Spot
description: Ghostwriter Becca goes to Barbados with action star, Lee, to secure movie rights to a popular novel series. Their trip becomes an adventure when they find themselves on the trail of the last novel.

title: Love On Repeat
description: A woman repeats the same day over and over as she tries to get back together with her boyfriend but finds love in unexpected places.

title: Love on Retreat
description: Jenny takes beauty brand, Bloom, in a new eco-friendly direction at the corporate retreat. Sparks fly when Jenny clashes with the activities of director, Nate, who turns out to be the brother of her boss.

title: Love on the Reef
description: A smart and serious marine biologist and a fun-loving and laissez-faire dive instructor must team up to save their beloved reef from being destroyed before it's too late.

title: Love On The Rise
description: A baker mistakes a wealthy bachelor for a waiter, and the two quickly fall in love, not realizing his company is trying to evict her bakery.

title: Love on the Side
description: When a big-city blonde bombshell rolls into the small town of Squamish she throws the entire male population into an uproar.  By unexpectedly making Eve, a waitress in a local diner, the center of attention.

title: Love On Trend
description: When Allie left her small town to move to San Francisco to pursue her dream of becoming a fashion designer, little did she imagine that the city had big plans for her...and for her heart.

title: Love on Your Doorstep
description: A talented TV host show profiles a local florist with a groundbreaking same-day-delivery florist service and a long-running flower competition for a chance to land her show.

title: Love Paleo
description: Doctors, nutritionists, authors, and entrepreneurs from four countries share why they choose to go against conventional health wisdom to promote paleo. The film also reflects on how they were profoundly transformed by the lifestyle beforehand.

title: Love Sarah
description: A young woman wishes to fulfill her mother's dream of opening her own bakery in Notting Hill, London.

title: Love Served Here
description: Passed over for promotion, a chef, she bets her boss that she can turn around the worst restaurant in the city. But when she starts to fall for the owner, she'll realize the key ingredient is love.

title: Love Songs
description: Three separate but interconnected dramas set in the same predominantly black neighborhood of North Philadelphia.

title: Love Stinks
description: Seth Winnick has it all: a successful career in television, good friends, and a passionate relationship with beautiful Chelsea. However, when he fails to make a timely marriage proposal, Chelsea tries to make his life hell.

title: Love the Beast
description: Eric Bana casts himself in his perfect role: exploring the meaning of a 25-year-long relationship with his first car, The Beast.

title: Love the one you love
description: Across the city of Cape Town, a sex-line operator, a dog handler and a computer technician begin to suspect that their romantic relationships are the subject of a bizarre conspiracy, involving their family, friends, and possibly even greater forces.

title: Love Thy Neighbor
description: Plagued by flashbacks of a home invasion and looking for a fresh start, Laura and her husband relocate. Their new community seems idyllic, until a series of strange and terrifying events unfold.

title: Love Thy Sister
description: Glamorous sisters Ruby, Ellen and lone Rucker come from a respected Southern family. Yet they're outrageously funny, and there's no holding back when it comes to dealing with life, love, and each other.

title: Love To Kill
description: Nick,a happily married man,learns that his wife Francis murdered her previous husbands. She stalked,she married and then she killed. Francis Sweet a 29 year old gorgeous woman who uses her beauty and charm to lure wealthy men.

title: Love Triangle
description: Justice & Laurie, friends since childhood, discover their true feelings for one another, as Laurie gets set to marry Quinton, Justice's best friend.

title: Love Unexpected
description: Chase is a young and confident college student, who is a self-proclaimed "ladies man" but also feels that love is for suckers. That is until he meets his match Kary, the fiercely independent student who isn't interested in wasting time on anything casual.

title: Love v. Kentucky
description: An intimate account of how two Kentucky attorneys with no background in civil rights navigate their passionate opponents, wrangle their reluctant allies, and convince the U.S. Supreme court to rewrite our nation's definition of marriage

title: Love Won't Let Me Wait
description: A charismatic playboy (Lamman Rucker, "Why Did I Get Married?") manages to juggle relationships with three sisters while convincing all of them Ð and their mother Ð that he is a nice guy.

title: Love's Fast Lane
description: Lindsay and Will bond after agreeing the dating service that matched them has made a mistake. But as they spend more time together they start to question if maybe they're a good fit after all.

title: Love's Kitchen
description: After a poor review from a critic, a talented chef turns a country pub into a gourmet eatery. His dessert catches the eye of Kate, and they soon discover that the recipe for true happiness is a pinch of teamwork and a whole lot of love.

title: Love's Playlist
description: Streaming music exec Amanda is partnered with arrogant brand rep Sam on an important launch party, discovering that he is the same person she has been flirting with in an online chatroom.

title: Love's Secret Ingredient
description: The owner of a struggling organic market is forced to team up with a bad-boy celebrity chef to create a line of meal kits and revive each other's reputations.

title: Love, Antosha
description: A portrait of late actor Anton Yelchin, 'Love, Antosha' explores his successes and struggles through his journals, photography, original music, and interviews with his colleagues, including Chris Pine, Kristen Stewart, and Jennifer Lawrence.

title: Love, Bubbles and Crystal Cove
description: When Skye's childhood sweetheart arrives to help her improve her bath and body business, sparks begin to fly.

title: Love, Game, Match
description: When the new economics teacher Liz team up with tennis coach Ted to organize the school carnival, sparks fly.

title: Love, Gilda
description: In her own words, comedienne Gilda Radner looks back and reflects on her life and career.

title: Love, Kennedy
description: Kennedy Hansen is a funny, loving child but inexplicably she begins to fall. It takes years for the diagnosis; Juvenile Batten Disease, an extremely rare, terrible and terminal prognosis. There is no cure for Batten Disease and after living only sixteen.

title: Love, Weddings & Other Disasters
description: Diane Keaton, Jeremy Irons, and Maggie Grace lead this warmhearted romantic comedy that follows a colorful cast of characters searching for love against the backdrop of a wedding.

title: Love/Hate
description: Local boy Darren Tracy (Robert Sheehan) returns to Dublin after a year abroad. When one of his old gang is killed, suspicions between old friends quickly turn into thoughts of vengeance.

title: Lovelace
description: After the release of "Deep Throat" in 1972, porn star Linda Lovelace (Amanda Seyfried) becomes an international sensation and spokeswoman for sexual freedom and hedonism; six years later, she presents a darker side to her story.

title: Lovely And Amazing
description: Self-esteem and insecurity are at the heart of this comedy about the relationship between a mother and her three confused daughters.

title: Lover Girl
description: Jake is a 16-year-old girl whose mother left her. Neighbor Marci takes pity on Jake, allowing her to stay over. When Jake discovers that Marci is a manager in a massage parlor, she convinces Marci to hire her.

title: Lover's Prayer
description: In 1800s Russia, a man falls in love with a tragic girl who flirts with and manipulates her older suitors. With Golden Globe and Emmy nominee Kirsten Dunst and Oscar nominee Julie Walters.

title: Lovers in a Dangerous Time
description: A man attempts to break off an affair with an unstable woman as his fiancée prepares to return home after being away with family.

title: Loves Sweet Recipie
description: Courtney is a chef who runs her family's restaurant. Armed with a family heirloom her father left behind called the 'Rule Book of Love' to guide the way.

title: Lovesick
description: The comic tale of Charlie Darby, who has everything going for him except every time he falls for a girl, he goes clinically insane. When he meets Molly Kingston, he must find a way to overcome his psychosis to claim his chance at true love.

title: Loving Every Minute
description: Stephanie inherits a watch that allows her to travel back in time five minutes. But as she uses it more and more, her romance with her coworker, Hunter, doesn't shake out the way she hoped.

title: Loving Spoonfuls
description: Each week charming host David Gale cooks with a different ethnic grandmother in this hilarious show about character, culture and food.

title: Loving The Bad Man
description: When a young Christian girl has a baby boy from a rapist, she sets out to try and give her child a chance at a somewhat normal family by forgiving and visiting the man in prison.

title: Loving Vincent: The Impossible Dream
description: Loving Vincent: The Impossible Dream recalls a 10 year journey that brought the world's first fully painted feature film to the cinema screen.

title: Low Winter Sun
description: AMC's original series Low Winter Sun is a contemporary story of murder, deception, revenge, and corruption. Get your lies straight.

title: Lt. Gen. Spence Armstrong On The Air War In Vietnam
description: In Vietnam, Lieutenant General Spence Armstrong pilots and leads F105's into battle as a flight commander during Operation Rolling Thunder.

title: Luces
description: En 1984, Pablo, un joven promesa del baile, se enamora perdidamente de Luz, otra bailarina. Cuando viaja dieciséis años hacia el futuro descubre la terrible verdad.

title: Lucha capital
description: La lucha libre es uno de los deportes favoritos de los capitalinos y se muestra a través de las muchas funciones en la ciudad de México.

title: Lucha fighter
description: Lucha fighter.

title: Lucha libre AAA
description: ¡La lucha libre mexicana vive 24 horas al día, 7 días a la semana en Lucha Libre AAA! Es emocionante, divertida, llena de máscaras coloridas, movimientos aéreos y patadas voladoras para emocionar a todos.

title: Lucha Mexico
description: In Mexico, the war between good and evil has been waged each week with the spectacle of Lucha Libre.

title: Luciferina
description: El argentino Gonzalo Calzada dirige una película visualmente explosiva donde la religión, la inocencia, la sexualidad reprimida y la maldad chocan espectacularmente.

title: Lucille Ball: We Love Lucy
description: The trail-blazing life of Lucille Ball.

title: Lucky Day
description: Red, a safe cracker who has just been released from prison, is trying to hold his family together as his past catches up with him in the form of Luc, a psychopathic contract killer who's seeking revenge for the death of his brother.

title: Lucky Dog Reunions
description: Animal trainer Brandon McMillan revisits his most heartwarming dog rescue stories, training and pairing them with a forever family.

title: Lucky Dog: Down Under
description: Hosted by Brandon McMillan, Lucky Dog: Down Under captures the heartwarming journeys of Australian shelter dogs as they transition from rescue and rehabilitation to becoming cherished members of loving forever families. The series will impart important life lessons, such as embracing responsibility, building positive habits, and fostering an appreciation for both life and animals, all in a manner accessible and understandable to children aged 13-16.

title: Lucky Grandma
description: Set in New York City, an ornery, chain-smoking Chinese Grandma goes all in at the casino, landing herself on the wrong side of luck…and in the middle of a Chinatown gang war.

title: Lucky Stiff
description: Based on the hit Off-Broadway musical. A young, down-and-out British shoe salesman (Dominic Marsh) learns that he’s inherited $6 million from an American uncle. However, in order to get the money, he must take his uncle‘s corpse on a wild, parties-and-g...

title: Lucky U Ranch
description: In 1953, 11-year-old Junior McCaully is bullied and stuck at an Arizona trailer court with his hardworking mom. All seems lost until the arrival of Melissa, an energetic free-spirit, who teaches him baseball, self-confidence and changes everything.

title: Lucy And Desi: Before The Laughter
description: This made for TV movie tells the story of Lucille Ball and Desi Arnaz. It begins in the 1930's when they met as actors under contract at RKO and ends with their divorce in 1960.

title: Lucy Shimmers' Christmas Miracle
description: Second chances start when a hardened criminal crosses paths with a precocious little girl who is helped by an angel to change hearts during the holiday season.

title: Lucy's Really Lost Moments
description: The legendary Lucille Ball as you've never seen her before! Laugh along with Lucy and Desi in these extremely rare television appearances, beautifully restored and in color!

title: Luke Combs: Dive Bars to Country Star
description: They told him he wasn't TV-worthy. Now he's a country icon. See how Luke Combs turned rejection into a record-shattering rise.

title: Luna de porcelana
description: Un apasionado thriller de suspenso sobre un detective veterano en una pequeña ciudad de Florida, cuyo romance clandestino con una viuda joven y rica teje una telaraña de engaño, traición y asesinato.

title: Lunana: A Yak in the Classroom
description: A young teacher in modern Bhutan, Ugyen, shirks his duties while planning to go to Australia to become a singer

title: Lupin III: parte 1
description: Lupin III es el nieto del infame ladrón fantasma Arsène Lupin que con su pandilla de tres roban tesoros en todo el mundo.

title: Lupin The 3rd "Blood Seal of the Eternal Mermaid"
description: The Mermaid's Scale is a mysterious aquamarine gemstone that Lupin has been hired to steal it... but it turns out to be a forgery. Now, he needs to find the real jewel before it can be used to destroy the whole world!

title: Lupin The 3rd "Good-Bye Partner"
description: When Zenigata is arrested for suspicion of being part of the Lupin gang, Lupin is talked into stealing Time Crystal to prove Pops' innocence.

title: Lupin The 3rd "Green vs. Red"
description: If Lupin is stealing something in one place, how can he be shoplifting in another place? One Lupin wears red; the other wears green. In the final standoff, whose side will Jigen, Goemon and Fujiko choose?

title: Lupin The 3rd "Italian Game"
description: The stage is set in Italy. Rebecca has been kidnapped! She belongs to one of the most prominent families in the Republic of San Marino and the young woman is the CEO of the Rossellini conglomerate which operates the largest chain of hotels in Italy.

title: Lupin The 3rd "Prison Of The Past"
description: When the Lupin gang hears the news that Finnegan Corbett, fondly referred to the 'Modern Day Robin Hood', is finally set to be executed, they travel to Kingdom of Dorrente to break him loose…

title: Lupin The 3rd "The Secret Of Mamo"
description: The world's most wanted master thief, Lupin III is dead! Despite a coroner's report, Interpol Inspector Zenigata is skeptical and discovers that Lupin is actually alive and well and stealing! But who had set up Lupin's death and why?

title: LUPIN THE 3rd TVSP #10 Tokyo Crisis
description: When Lupin and his bandit buddies attempt to steal a set of historically significant photographic plates, it turns out they're not the only ones with eyes on the prize in this thievish tale of mayhem and millionaires.

title: LUPIN THE 3rd TVSP #11 The Columbus Files
description: Lupin and Fujiko are after the mysterious treasure known only as Columbus' Egg. Fujiko was able to memorize the Egg's location, but when she's attacked and loses her memory, all seems lost. No one else knows where it is. What's a thief to do?

title: LUPIN THE 3rd TVSP #12 Missed by a Dollar
description: At an auction in New York, attendees are shocked when a mysterious man bids $1,000,000 on a plain diamond ring. The man himself is even more astounded when the President of the World Bank outbids him by a single dollar. The man is Lupin!

title: Lupin the 3rd TVSP #13: Alcatraz Connection
description: Master thief Lupin III, gunslinger Jigen and swordmaster Goemon are back for a new caper, this time aboard the casino-ship Machine Gun Kelly. Between the mafia, interpol, and a secret organization based under Alcatraz!

title: LUPIN THE 3rd TVSP #14 Episode 0: The First Contact
description: The stickup that started it all! Lupin and Fujiko are both after an ancient artifact Jigen is supposed to protect, while Goemon happens to be searching for his clan's lost treasure nearby. Of course, Inspector Zenigata isn't far behind.

title: Lupin the 3rd TVSP #15: Operation: Return the Treasure
description: Lupin sets his sights on the legendary Trick Diamond, stolen by his late rival Mark Williams. Instead of finding the diamond, Fujiko relays Mark's dying challenge: return all the other treasures he stole to reveal the location of the gem.

title: Lupin the 3rd TVSP #16: Swallowtail Tatoo
description: A mysterious criminal captures Lupin and Fujiko with a very specific order: in order to save Fujiko's life, Lupin must infiltrate a high-security museum and steal the Bull's Eye jewel. One little problem: the jewel is cursed to kill anyone who steals it.

title: Lupin the 3rd TVSP #17: Tactics Of Angels
description: Lupin faces his toughest opponents yet! Four women known as the Bloody Angels are after the strange metallic sphere he stole from Area 51. To get their hands on potential alien technology, they're willing to do anything.

title: Lupin the 3rd TVSP #19: The Elusiveness of the Fog
description: Lupin's attempt to steal a time machine causes a crazy mishap! Now stuck in ancient Japan, his team and Inspector Zenigata must join forces to get back to their own time. But notorious thief Lupin has enemies everywhere... and everywhen!

title: LUPIN THE 3rd TVSP #20: Sweet Lost Night
description: Turns out the Magic Lamp is real, and Lupin's found a way to steal it! But this genie has a price: to grant his wish, she demands half his memories.

title: LUPIN THE 3rd TVSP #21: The Last Job
description: Lupin and his companions have their sights on a Japanese cultural treasure, a priceless Buddha statue. But when a mysterious group of ninja thieves get the jump on them, it might just be the gang's last job!

title: LUPIN THE 3rd TVSP #6 Dragon of Doom
description: On the bottom of the ocean, within the sunken Titanic, the golden dragon statue waits. When Lupin and the gang are hired to retrieve it, Goemon recognizes the dragon as one of his clan's treasures. Now, he's ready to fight his own friends to protect it!

title: LUPIN THE 3rd TVSP #7 The Pursuit of Harimao's Treasure
description: To retrieve the Harimao's Treasure, Lupin and the gang must gather three lost statues.  Lupin reluctantly partners with the aging "double-O" MI-6 agent Sir Archer and his granddaughter Diana to gather the statues.

title: LUPIN THE 3rd TVSP #8 The Secret of Twilight Gemini
description: As Lupin's mentor Don Dolune lies on his deathbed, he hands the master thief a gift: the diamond named Twilight. But it's only half of the treasure-the other half of the Twilight can be found in Morocco…

title: LUPIN THE 3rd TVSP #9 Islands of Assasins
description: The den of the deadly Tarantulas gang, this island is the most dangerous place on Earth… and Lupin's right in the middle of it! A dark mystery haunts his past, and the key to it is on the island.

title: Lupin the 3rd, Part 2
description: After 5 years, master thief Lupin and his gang are back! While evading his ICPO nemesis, Inspector Zenigata, is all in a day's work for Lupin and his gang, as their heisting adventures around the globe begin again!

title: Lupin the 3rd: Bye Bye, Lady Liberty
description: Foiled repeatedly by the predictions of Interpol's supercomputer, professional looter Lupin III has settled down. A sinister secret organization and a young computer genius are thrown into the mix. And whose side is the buxom Fujiko on this time?

title: Lupin the 3rd: From Siberia With Love
description: Ultimate thief Lupin III has a new target: the lost gold of the Romanov dynasty! With the help of a mysterious blonde named Judy Scott, Lupin discovers the treasure hidden in Texas, at the Bank of Liberty.

title: Lupin the 3rd: Napoleon's Dictionary
description: Lupin learns of his grandfather's secret treasure, supposedly hidden in the pages of a dictionary previously owned by Napoleon Bonaparte! Said dictionary just happens to be the prize in a cross-country classic car race.

title: Lupin the 3rd: Part 1
description: Lupin III, the grandson of the infamous phantom thief Lupin, goes around the world stealing treasures along with his gang Daisuke Jigen, Goemon Ishikawa, and Fujiko Mine. They go against Inspector Zenigata and others who stand their way.

title: Lupin the 3rd: Part 3
description: Lupin III, the grandson of the infamous phantom thief Lupin, goes around the world stealing treasures along with his gang Daisuke Jigen, Goemon Ishikawa, and Fujiko Mine. They go against Inspector Zenigata and others who stand their way.

title: Lupin the 3rd: Part 4
description: Master thief Lupin III returns to the spotlight when he's poised to marry the danger-loving, Italian superstar Rebecca Rossellini.

title: Lupin the 3rd: Part 5 + 50th Anniversary Special
description: Lupin and Jigen find the developer of the security system of the target: Ami. Lupin and Jigen successfully capture Ami, but they get mixed up in a world-wide man-hunt: an event called "Arrest Lupin III."

title: Lupin the 3rd: The Hemingway Papers
description: The legendary last manuscript of the great Ernest Hemingway tells of a buried treasure on an island far away… and thief extraordinaire Lupin is on the trail! But he gets caught up in a local civil war, Lupin will have to keep his wits or risk his life!

title: Lupin the 3rd: The Woman Called Fujiko Mine
description: She's a thief. A killer. A saint and a scandal.  It's all in a night's work for the woman called Fujiko Mine. She's the slinky, sultry thread that holds Lupin III's crew together - and this is the heist that started it all.

title: LUPIN THE 3rd: Voyage to Danger
description: Someone sent orders to assassinate Lupin. Will he survive or die trying!?

title: Lured
description: British police are after a serial killer who lures his female victims through newspaper personal ads and sends cryptic poem clues to the cops.

title: Luxor
description: When British aid worker Hana returns to the ancient city of Luxor, she comes across Sultan, an archeologist and, former lover. Haunted by the familiar place, she struggles to reconcile the choices of the past with the uncertainty of the present.

title: Luxury Hunters
description: Imagine getting access to multi-million dollar dream homes. Bianca Solterbeck and Peter Verge have the keys… for 24 hours!

title: Luxury Travel Show
description: "The Luxury Travel Show" is a cultural and lavish travel series, exploring the globe's finest holiday destinations. It offers a magical journey, delving into world history, art, and culture for all ages.

title: Luz
description: Simón is a physicist who measures the length of Karma in space-time. This opens a new perception of reality where everything will collapse. Justice, truth and knowledge are metaphical representations of reality.

title: Luz: The Flower of Evil
description: El líder de un culto aislado pierde la credibilidad de sus fieles, incluidas sus tres hijas, luego de llevar a un falso mesías a la comunidad.

title: LX 2048
description: A terminally ill man tries to secure the future of his family in a world where the toxicity of the sun forces people to stay inside during the daytime.

title: Lyfe's Journey
description: A family man makes a mistake that changes his life forever. With help he starts the journey to forgiveness, hoping it will bring him back to his family.

title: Lyfe's Journey
description: A family man named David (Keith Robinson, "Dreamgirls") makes a terrible mistake that isolates him from the people he loves most in this heartfelt drama about forgiveness and redemption.

title: Lymelife
description: In this coming-of-age story, 15-year-old Scott is caught up in his first love while watching the relationship of his parents slowly crumble as they try to keep up with the changing 1970s. Featuring a star-studded cast including Emma Roberts.

title: Lynx - Close Up
description: The lynx is an exceptional hunter with an arsenal of skills at its disposal. Come and wonder at these skills in action!

title: Lynyrd Skynyrd - Gone With The Wind
description: This film revisits the story of Lynyrd Skynyrd in a manner previously unattempted. Using a mixture of new and archive interviews, contributions from band members and those closest to the group.

title: Lynyrd Skynyrd - I'll Never Forget You: The Last 72 Hours Of Lynyrd Skynyrd
description: I'll Never Forget You: The Last 72 Hours of Lynyrd Skynyrd chronicles the story of three survivors: security guard Gene Odom, lead backup singer Leslie Hawkins and guitar tech Craig Reed.

title: Líbranos del mal
description: Tras un secuestro, un agente secreto convertido en mercenario reaparece cuando descubre que el crimen golpea cerca de su casa. Sin embargo, cuando un mafioso infame se entera de que ha entrado en el país, se enfurece al frustrar la misión de rescate.

title: M.O.M. Mothers of Monsters
description: A distraught mother suspects her teenage son is a psychopath who may shoot up his high school, but when he outsmarts the system, she is forced to take matters into her own hands.

title: Ma Ma
description: La ganadora del Oscar Penélope Cruz se supera una vez más con su actuación como Magda, una mujer determinada a vivir la vida al máximo después de recibir un diagnóstico de cáncer de pecho.

title: Mac & Devin Go to High School
description: Rappers Snoop Doog and Wiz Khalifa team up to create this ultimate stoner comedy with a star-studded hip hop soundtrack.

title: Mac and Me
description: A young boy confined to a wheelchair finds a lost alien creature and helps him return to his home and learn many magical things in the process.

title: Macabra, la mano del diablo
description: Un arqueólogo mexicano desentierra una urna en la cual encuentra una mano humana que posee extraños poderes.

title: Macabre
description: In this horrific tale, a New Orleans wife and mother carries on a torrid affair behind her family's back. But when a violent accident leaves her lover dead, the woman returns from a mental institution determined to pursue her forbidden desires.

title: MacGyver
description: MacGyver (Richard Dean Anderson) applies his scientific knowledge to ordinary items to create a means of escape from impending doom.

title: Machine
description: A hard-hitting and eye-opening documentary about artificial intelligence, the most radical new technology of our time.

title: Machine Gun Kelly
description: The criminal exploits of Public Enemy number 1, George 'Machine-Gun' Kelly, during the 1930s.

title: Machine Gun McCain
description: After serving 12 years behind bars for armed robbery, Hank McCain finds himself the pawn of a ruthless mob runt's rebellion against a high-level don. Not blood, nor lust, nor wedding vows can come between McCain and his money...or his machine gun.

title: Machine Gun Preacher (2014)
description: Real life "Machine Gun Preacher", Sam Childers overcame a life of drugs and violence to become a symbol of hope for the children of Africa. Explore the life of this missionary who preaches justice with compassion and an iron fist.

title: Mackintosh and TJ
description: Roy Rogers stars as cowboy Mackintosh, who is exploring the west and working odd jobs. While passing through Dickens, Texas, Mackintosh's car troubles lead him to spend a little time in town, where he meets TJ. The two soon become fast friends.

title: Macon County Line
description: A vengeful Southern sheriff is out for blood after his wife is brutally killed by a pair of drifters. Low-budget film set in Georgia in 1953 and based on fact.

title: MacShayne: Final Roll Of The Dice
description: MacShayne is back, now he is the head of security at the hotel where he stayed in the previous movie. First, he has to take care of the grandson of the hotel's CEO, who is a kleptomaniac.

title: MacShayne: Winner Takes All
description: MacShayne is back, now he is the head of security at the hotel where he stayed in the previous movie. First, he has to take care of the grandson of the hotel's CEO, who is a kleptomaniac.

title: Mad Dog - From Chaos to Comeback
description: In 2013, UFC fighter Reza 'Mad Dog' Madadi was arrested for involvement in a smash-and-grab coup. He was sentenced to prison which led to him losing everything. 'MAD DOG' tells the story about his fascinating way back.

title: Mad Dog Morgan
description: The true story of Irish outlaw Daniel Morgan; who is wanted; dead or alive; in Australia during the 1850s.

title: Mad Max
description: Max and the gang's worlds converge when the gang wants Max as badly as he wants them, especially after they target him for the death of their former leader.

title: Mad Max: salvajes de autopista
description: En un futuro cercano y destruido, una brutal banda de moteros reina en la carretera, aterrorizando a civiles inocentes. Pero subestiman a un policía: Max (Mel Gibson). Cuando los moteros vejan a la familia de Max, entra en un frenesí de venganza.

title: Mad Men
description: Set in 1960s NY, Mad Men pulls the viewer into the high-powered "Golden Age" of advertising.

title: Mad Money
description: Deep inside the most secure bank in America, three desperate women from very different worlds cook up the most unlikely heist of the century: Smuggle out millions of dollars in worn-out currency headed for a Federal Reserve shredder every day.

title: Mad Tiger
description: Two best friends have spent the last fifteen years touring the country in their performance art punk band. When one of them decides to quit, they both face deeper challenges than expected.

title: Mad to be Normal
description: During the 1960s, a renegade Scottish psychiatrist courts controversy within his profession for his approach to the field, and for the unique community, he creates for his patients to inhabit.

title: Madagascar
description: Experience Madagascar, home to unique Fauna and Flora with a high percentage of endemic species and due to the lack of predators extraordinary animal species like the funny lemurs were able to develop in a unique way.

title: Madagascar - Land Of The Chameleons
description: Traveling through Madagascar, we search for some of the most fascinating lizards on earth: the chameleon. With 59 of its 150 species known today living on Madagascar, and only there, this island can claim to be the home of the chameleon.

title: Madame Bovary
description: Bored in her marriage and stifled by small town life, the restless Emma Bovary (Mia Wasikowska, "Alice in Wonderland") pursues her dreams of passion and excitement, whatever they may cost.

title: Maddigan's Quest
description: In this epic family adventure series, 14-year-old circus performer Garland is tasked with finding a new solar converter to save her home city.

title: Made for Each Other
description: Newlyweds struggle in their first year of marriage, plagued by money problems, illness and a live-in mother-in-law. Their son, dying of pneumonia, can only be saved by a serum from across the country, when all flights have been grounded due to weather.

title: Made In China
description: While working for a shady real-estate company in Shanghai, Bryan Zellerman is framed by his corrupt employers. Faced with a choice between escape or finding out the truth behind his betrayal, his path veers terribly out of control.

title: Made in France
description: After the horrible terrorist attacks that rocked Paris, this daring investigation thriller plunges you inside the extremist muslim groups that grow inside western countries and can strike at any moment.

title: Made In Heaven
description: Richard, a hopelessly awkward romantic, gets a second chance at life and love with only limited time after a tragic end.

title: Made in Japan
description: The remarkable story of Tomi Fujiyama, the world's ﬁrst Japanese female country music star. Tomi's career culminates in a 1964 performance at The Grand Ole. Forty years later, she sets out on a journey to perform at The Grand Ole Opry one more time.

title: Made Of Stone
description: A revealing journey through the life of one of the most revered and influential bands in British music history.

title: Madeline
description: The classic Cinar series based on the original Madeline books. In an old house in Paris that was covered with vines, lived twelve little girls in two straight lines… and one of them named Madeline.

title: Madeline (DIC)
description: Based on the classic children’s books by Ludwig Bemelmans, this award winning series chronicles the adventures of the little redheaded girl named Madeline, and the teacher and friends with whom she lives in Paris.

title: Madeline (LAS)
description: Basada en los clásicos libros para niños de Ludwig Bemelmans, esta galardonada serie narra las aventuras de la pequeña pelirroja llamada Madeline.

title: Madeline's Madeline
description: While her mom sees Madeline as a fragile, emotional teen, the director of her theater workshop sees her as a raw talent with a troubled history that can be exploited for her art. Before long, Madeline's loyalties are torn between mother and mentor.

title: Madeline: Lost in Paris
