title: RiffTrax Short: A Case of Spring Fever
description: The stars of MST3K bring their comedic riffing treatment to this short about the importance of springs. Join Mike, Kevin, Bill, and Coily for A Case Of Spring Fever!

title: RiffTrax Short: A Visit to Santa
description: Just in time for the holidays, RiffTrax presents our take on A Visit to Santa, a Christmas short of unknown origin that most probably was the result of Santa's short-lived collaboration with the producing team of Screwtape and Wormwood.

title: RiffTrax Short: Act Your Age
description: Young Jim is caught in a shocking act of pencil-based vandalism, leading him to look deeply into the core of his soul and come to the inexorable conclusion that he is kind of a weenie.

title: RiffTrax Short: Aqua Frolics
description: If you were told you were about to see a film that contained turtles bigger than men, cliff-diving Mexicans and a family that eats Thanksgiving dinner underwater, you'd probably complain "But I don't like David Lynch!" Wrong you would be!

title: RiffTrax Short: Are You Popular
description: The short Are You Popular? will help you solve the question once and finally: the question, "Are you popular?" There are no easy answers, friends (that is, the answer is "no", of course, which is not always easy to hear) but Mike, Kevin, and Bill are…

title: RiffTrax Short: As We Like It
description: "Ah, beer. Balm of hurt minds, great nature's second course, chief nourisher in life's feast! (We think that's what the Swan of Avon was referring to...) Beer provides everything the human body needs.

title: RiffTrax Short: Buying Food
description: Buying food - how hard can it be? You go to a store pick out a few items, and start mashing them into the side of your head, right? WRONG!

title: RiffTrax Short: Carnivorous Plants
description: Carnivorous Plants!  Like Wii Boxing, they're one of those things that instantly becomes 1000X less cool the moment you bring it home and try it out.  Rather than quickly earning their keep and chomping down on your neighbor's annoying labradoodle.

title: RiffTrax Short: Christmas Toyshop
description: Can't anyone tell me what Christmas is all about!? an exasperated Charlie Brown once asked. Well, pace Linus van Pelt, the true meaning of Christmas—according to Christmas Toyshop—is a criminally incompetent father.

title: RiffTrax Short: Coffeehouse Rendezvous
description: The youth of today, no longer content to roll a hoop with a stick, play endless hours of mumbly peg, or work a lathe at a factory 14 hours a day for just pennies, need something to occupy them.

title: RiffTrax Short: Damaged Goods
description: RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this short that is a cautionary tale about a couple of young men who go on a harmless adventure in search of beer and girls and end up finding exactly that!

title: RiffTrax Short: Down and Out
description: If you like your safety shorts served with a heavy dose of groovy, then this is for you! Down and Out lays out a litany of dangers inherent in your every move from one location to the other.

title: RiffTrax Short: Drugs Are Like That
description: There are so many things to which drugs can be compared that to even attempt to catalog them would be an act of incomprehensible madness.

title: RiffTrax Short: Each Child is Different
description: “Each Child Is Different” goes the saying, and no truer words have ever been spoken. Take Miss Smith's fifth-grade class for instance.

title: RiffTrax Short: Going Steady
description: It's the most important decision you'll ever make: should I eat the rest of this BK Stacker, or just trust my vague feeling of nausea and quit while I'm ahead?

title: RiffTrax Short: Good Eating Habits
description: For many of us, Good Eating Habits boil down to a simple rule: avoid any food whose name ends in "-ator" or "-o-rama". But fifty years ago, in an era food historians refer to as "Pre GoGurt", what constituted a Good Eating Habit wasn't as widely known.

title: RiffTrax Short: Good Health Practices
description: Washing your hands after using the restroom - most of us only do so because a fellow co-worker is in the bathroom with us, and we wonder if he'll tell other people if we don't. But evidently, we should be doing this even when a co-worker isn't there.

title: RiffTrax Short: How Much Affection?
description: It's a question we ponder every time we tip the pizza guy: How much affection? Is it necessary to set the box down before embracing him?

title: RiffTrax Short: If Mirrors Could Speak
description: Cruel self-assessment is given a new twist as vulnerable grade-schoolers are forced to look into the deep blackness of their own souls.

title: RiffTrax Short: It Must Be The Neighbors
description: Bill Duncan had it all until the day when he discovered that his garbage cans had been deemed unfit for use by the city sanitation committee.

title: RiffTrax Short: Kitty Cleans Up
description: Years in the spotlight had left Kitty with fame, riches, and a drug habit to rival all but the Busey-ist of addicts.

title: RiffTrax Short: Know For Sure
description: You think you don't have syphilis, but how do really know? Has anyone you trust told you you don't have it? Have you been in contact with anyone from a big city in.

title: RiffTrax Short: Lunchroom Manners
description: Meet Phil. Like all children from the fifties, he enjoys playing ball, building soapbox racers, and taunting his non-blond-haired, blue-eyed classmates.

title: RiffTrax Short: One Got Fat
description: Do you find that you're sleeping a little too well as of late? That your dreams are of the innocuous stripe, i.e., old friends turning into llamas and eating your baseball hat, rather than full out.

title: RiffTrax Short: Overcoming Fear
description: Fear: Most of us rejected it in the mid-90s by wearing trendy t-shirts emblazoned with slogans such as "Second Place is the First Loser."

title: RiffTrax Short: Patriotism
description: When you hear the word "patriotism" what's the first name that pops into your head? Wrong! The answer is Bob Crane. And not "Hogan's Heroes" Bob Crane, but rather creepy, post-"Hogan's Heroes" Bob Crane, home video, um, "pioneer".

title: RiffTrax Short: Playing Together
description: "You would like to play with Donny and Duncan."So the narrator for Playing Together confidently tells us, and we have no reason to doubt him. But as the minutes pass it becomes clear that he may have been overselling Donny and Duncan just a bit.

title: RiffTrax Short: Primary Safety
description: The follow-up to the smash hit "Primary Safety: In the Three Mile Island Cooling Tower", Primary Safety: In The School Building starts with a catchy name and builds from there.

title: RiffTrax Short: Right or Wrong?
description: Right or Wrong tells the gritty story of Harry, a boy who doesn't vandalize a warehouse and suffers the consequences for it.

title: RiffTrax Short: Safety - Harm Hides at Home
description: Your home is crawling with hazards! You are not safe! EVERYTHING WILL KILL YOU! In fact, never mind, because you're already dead; killed by your stupid house.

title: RiffTrax Short: Self-Conscious Guy
description: Do you find yourself in a constant state of niggling self-criticism, e.g., "I bet everyone is laughing at me just because I have a waffle stuck to my back", or "I know it's the right thing to do, but will people look down on me because I jar.

title: RiffTrax Short: Shy Guy
description: Shyness—for years it has prevented boys from becoming men and girls from landing men.

title: RiffTrax Short: Skipper Learns a Lesson
description: Snoopy, Lassie, Cerberus, Rin-Tin-Tin: lovable canine companions are a dime a dozen.  Which makes Skipper: The Racist Dog such a breath of fresh air!

title: RiffTrax Short: The Terrible Truth
description: Heroin, it turns out, is bad. The Terrible Truth lays waste to the all-too-common myth that regular heroin use is a healthy part of a balanced diet.

title: RiffTrax Short: The Trouble With Women
description: Women - what the hell, man? I mean, what's your problem? Thankfully, for all of us non-women, some very smart people have put their best be-crew-cutted minds into coming up with a solution.

title: RiffTrax Short: Understanding Your
description: Pop quiz hotshot:  Your father tells you that your grandmother has fallen and badly hurt herself.

title: RiffTrax Short: Why Doesn't Cathy
description: At long last, the question of the ages is met head-on. No facet of the issue is left unexplored. The philosophical, eschatological, teleological, epistemological, and cosmological aspects are all given a thorough exegetical going over.

title: RiffTrax Short: Why Vandalism?
description: Why Vandalism?  It's the one question that kept parents in the fifties up at night.  Why would my boy turn to vandalism for thrills when they could be listening to Burl Ives 45s or campaigning for Adlai Stevenson?

title: RiffTrax Short: You and Your Family
description: You and Your Family. Much like gunpowder and an open flame, combining the two is not recommended (especially if mom's been drinking.)

title: RiffTrax Short: Your Chance To Live
description: What happens when a public television studio realizes that it has to spend $2,000 of government grant money before Wednesday in order to qualify for full funding for the next fiscal year?  You get Your Chance to Live: Technological Failures!

title: RiffTrax Shorts: A Christmas Carol (Coronet)

title: RiffTrax Shorts: How to be a Friend

title: RiffTrax Shorts: Ladybug, Ladybug, Winter is Coming
description: The bug who happens to be a lady crawls around asking everyone she sees why it is so cold. She is told repeatedly it's because WINTER IS COMING and yet she persists in her willful ignorance. This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary.

title: Rifftrax Shorts: Let's Pretend: Magic Sneakers

title: RiffTrax Shorts: People Soup

description: Discover the untold story of David Moore, the filmmaker who first dreamed of sharks in a tornado and brought on disaster by using real sharks. The first SHARKNADO was to be a movie never seen, a crime never reported, a tale never told. Until now.

title: Sharks
description: Exceptional imagery depicts these amazing sea dwellers in a new and different way, as they've been around long before dinosaurs. The white shark, the hammerhead shark, or the whale shark can all be seen at a first-hand experience.

title: Sharks - Danger In the Sea
description: Examine sharks in their natural environments, study their behaviors and dispel common misconceptions about one of the world's most savage and intricate creatures.

description: Before being an earthly paradise with enchanting colours, the lagoon of New Caledonia is above all a paradise for sharks.  But not just any sharks: they are used to being considered as fearsome predators, they are essentially opportunistic scavengers.

title: Sharks: The Big Five
description: Delve deep into the African waters and discover a new side of these prehistoric predators of the sea, while reconsidering the Hollywood portrayal which has done much to damage the reputation of these gentle creatures.

title: Sharpshooter

title: Shattered

description: When your memory has been taken, whom do you trust? Tom Berenger, Bob Hoskins, Greta Scacchi and Joanne Whalley breathe life into this gripping neo-noir about the survivor of a car accident who begins to suspect his near-death was no accident.

title: Shattered
description: When his daughter is kidnapped, Neil (Gerard Butler) must take matters into his own hands to get her back. Also starring Pierce Brosnan and Maria Bello.

title: Shattered Glass
description: Hayden Christensen stars in this critically acclaimed true story of a disgraced journalist, directed and co-written by Billy Ray, Oscar®-nominated writer of CAPTAIN PHILLIPS.

title: Shattered Memories

description: The west ablaze with the Technicolor legend of the Shotgun Avenger! There was always open season on women like Abby!

description: A man with amnesia suddenly begins regaining consciousness in a new body every 12 hours. But with no memory—and no allies—his time is running out.

description: Spitfire is the epic tale of the world's most famous fighter plane, told by the last surviving veterans who flew her in the white heat of combat. Some say she saved the world, and today she is an international icon.

The rollicking comedy directed by two-time Oscar winner Frank Borzage also features great music from some of the top band leaders of the day, including Benny Goodman, Count Basie, and Xavier Cougat!

description: A former stagecoach robber is hunted by a vengeful US Marshal.

description: After his family is murdered, Martin ventures into the American badlands in search of Mister, hoping to reteam with him against a new Vamp threat.

title: Star Trek: Voyager

A cooperative effort of Starbase Command, Airwing and the Astro Marines, Starcom is the premier peacekeeping force in the growing planetary community.

Para poner su negocio en marcha, se ve obligado a contratar a un grupo de hombres para que le ayuden a despejar los sótanos y a realizar la limpieza del lugar. Conforme avanzan su trabajo, los hombres comienzan a notar cosas extrañas, el lugar no sólo está infestado de ratas, también comienzan a ocurrir cosas sobrenaturales a quienes trabajan durante la noche. Todo se sale de control cuando un empleado fallece de forma misteriosa. Un forastero decide tomar la oportunidad de trabajo, pero le esperará la misma amenaza misteriosa.

description: When a homeless ex-stockbroker rescues a famous model from a robbery attempt, she takes him home as an act of gratitude.

description: Hula-hooping's back. The Hooping Life's about the rise of a hot new trend: sultry dance, cool culture, slammin' clothes, outer struggle and inner peace. Featuring Shaq O'Neal, The String Cheese Incident, The Scissor Sisters, and a score by Basement Jaxx.

title: The Horde
description: Ex-Navy SEAL John Crenshaw accompanies his fiance and her students on a photo trip deep into the woods. A fun trip turns to horror as they are besieged by a horde of mutated humans. Things worsen and Crenshaw is their only hope to survive.

title: The Hornet's Nest
description: War changes a person. Take an unprecedented journey with an elite group of U.S. troops into battle. A riveting and powerful, authentic look into what was scheduled to be a one day mission yet turned into nine grueling days of combat.

title: The Horror Of Party Beach
description: Sea creatures created from radioactive sludge terrorize a beach community.

title: The Horse Dancer
description: When a promising young gymnast is cut from the Olympic team, she decides to follow her dreams of horseback riding by joining a girl’s horse camp.

title: The Horse Soldiers (1959)
description: John Wayne, Constance Towers and William Holden star in this 1863, fact-based story about a Union mission to destroy a railroad junction deep within Confederate territory.

title: The Horseman
description: When Christian’s daughter dies, so does any sense of remorse as he searches for vengeance at all costs. Tracking down the men responsible one by one, he reaches a new level of brutality and discovers how far he has to go to settle the score.

title: The Hospital
description: Paddy Chayefsky’s magnificently dark comedy, directed by Arthur Hiller, starring George C. Scott as the Head of Medicine at a hospital where, over one night, everything falls apart. Diana Rigg also stars as the free spirit who arrives just in time.

title: The Host (2013)
description: When an unseen enemy threatens mankind by taking over humans' bodies and erasing their minds, Melanie Stryder risks everything to protect the people she cares about most, proving that love can conquer all in a dangerous new world.

title: The Hot Flashes
description: Brooke Shields stars in this raunchy comedy that proves that women over 40 know how to do it better.

title: The Hot Potato
description: Kenny Smith and Danny Nash, a couple of local lads, try to find a buyer for a large lump of misappropriated Uranium, the so-called “hot potato.”

title: The Hot Spot
description: A lowlife drifter who sells used cars in a Texas burg robs the local bank and gets involved with two women: one bad, one innocent. Based on Charles Williams' 1952 novel "Hell Hath No Fury."

title: The Hotel Inspector
description: The Hotel Inspector is on a mission: to scare the hell out of the nation's hoteliers and to drag hotels, guest homes and B&Bs out of the doldrums — and up to a standard befitting a top tourist nation.

title: The Hotel Inspector Returns
description: Hotel Inspector Alex Polizzi revisits some of the struggling hoteliers and businesses she previously helped.

title: The Hottest State
description: A young actor from Texas tries to make it in New York while struggling in his relationship with a beautiful singer/songwriter.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
description: A captivating 21st-century version of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's chilling masterpiece.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
description: Upon his uncle`s death, Sir Henry Baskerville returns from abroad and opens up the ancestral hall on the desolate moors and Sherlock Holmes uncovers a plot to have Sir Henry murdered by a terrible hound.

title: The Hound Of The Baskervilles (1959)
description: A hellish hound feeds upon the flesh of the heirs of Baskerville Hall. But before this beast can sink its teeth into the newest lord, it must pit its vicious fangs against the searing intellect of Sherlock Holmes (Peter Cushing) and Dr. Watson.

title: The Hour
description: A behind-the-scenes drama and espionage thriller in Cold War-era England that centers on a journalist, a producer, and an anchorman for an investigative news programme.

title: The House in Between
description: A beautiful documentary telling the real story of a homeowner, and the team looking for answers that will move Alice back into her house. This documentary shows a detailed look at what could be the most haunted house in America.

title: The House of the Devil
description: Desperate for quick cash, college sophomore Samantha Hughes takes a babysitting job in the isolated mansion of the creepy Ulman family. Samantha has no idea that a nightmare of unspeakable fear and torment awaits her within these walls.

title: The House Of The Lost On The Cape [English-Language Version]
description: A strange old woman allows a teenage runaway and a young orphan to stay in an abandoned house overlooking the sea. However, when a menacing entity threatens their new home, they must band together and face their fears to save it.

title: The House Of The Lost On The Cape [Japanese-Language Version]
description: A strange old woman allows a teenage runaway and a young orphan to stay in an abandoned house overlooking the sea. However, when a menacing entity threatens their new home, they must band together and face their fears to save it.

title: The House Of The Spirits
description: Based on Isabel Allende's best-selling novel, is a hauntingly romantic tale spanning three generations of the Trueba family. At its core is the stormy passionate relationship between the supernaturally gifted Clara and her controlling husband Esteban.

title: The House Of Tomorrow
description: Sebastian is a sixteen-year-old who has spent most of his life with his Nana in their geodesic dome home, a tourist attraction where she raises him on the futurist teachings of her former mentor Buckminster Fuller

title: The House Of Yes
description: Marty just wants a normal life, but that blows up when he brings his fiancée home to meet his far-from-normal family. Soon, Mother is hiding the kitchen knives, but she can't hide the family's shockingly hilarious secrets!

title: The House on Sorority Row
description: After a seemingly innocent prank goes horribly wrong, a group of sorority sisters are stalked and murdered one by one in their sorority house while throwing a party to celebrate their graduation.

title: The House on the Hill
description: After years in a mental hospital, Megan goes home to visit her brother. But once she arrives, her brother has vanished, and no one in town remembers him ever existing. Is Megan losing her mind, or is something more diabolical at work?

title: The House Sitter
description: A family still reeling after the accidental death of one of their daughters, returns home after an aborted month long getaway to Rebecca, a seemingly pleasant house sitter. Since they returned early, Rebecca has nowhere to go, so the family invite her to

title: The House That Dripped Blood
description: Robert Bloch, the author of Psycho, presents a quartet of terrifying tales.

title: The House That Never Dies: Reawakening
description: A century after the Zhisheng household murders, relic restorer Song Teng unravels eerie events in the mansion, unveiling a haunting quest for justice from the restless dead.

title: The Houses October Built
description: Looking to find an authentic, blood-curdling good fright for Halloween, five friends set off on a road trip in an RV to track down the ultimate haunted house.

title: The Houses October Built 2
description: Recovering from being kidnapped last Halloween, five friends head back out to visit more haunted house attractions and a new terror begins...

title: The Howling III: The Marsupials
description: A female werewolf runs away from her family and falls in love with a man who works in the movie business, while a sociologist who studies these creatures is looking for proof of their existence.

title: The Howling V: The Rebirth
description: In this fifth installment of 'The Howling' films, a group of people is stranded in an ancient Hungarian castle with a werewolf.

title: The Howling: New Moon Rising
description: A number of brutal, werewolf-like slayings begin occurring in a small California town after the arrival of an unfamiliar motorcyclist.

title: The Human Factor
description: After his family is brutally murdered for an unknown reason, a computer engineer sets out to find those responsible.

title: The Human Torpedoes Of WWII
description: See the history of the mysterious 'Human Torpedoes' of WWII - and how they originated and developed upon the standard torpedo in top secret.

title: The Humanity Bureau
description: A dystopian thriller set in the year 2030 that sees the world in a permanent state of economic recession and facing serious environmental problems as a result of global warming.

title: The Humans
description: Based on the Tony Award-winning play, a family gathers for Thanksgiving in their daughter's apartment. Amidst the warmth and humor of the holiday, the tight-knit family tries to hold together in the face of an anxious and uncertain future.

title: The Humbling
description: Based on a Phillip Roth novel, this is the story of an over-the-hill stage actor (Al Pacino, The Godfather) and his controversially invigorating relationship with a young and lustful lesbian (Greta Gerwig, Frances Ha).

title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
description: In 15th-century Paris, the brother of the archdeacon plots with the gypsy king to foment a peasant revolt. Meanwhile, a freakish hunchback falls in love with the gypsy queen.

title: The Hunchback Of Notre Dame
description: In 15th-century Paris, the brother of the archdeacon plots with the gypsy king to foment a peasant revolt. Meanwhile, a freakish hunchback falls in love with the gypsy queen.

title: The Hunt
description: The Hunt is a disturbing depiction of how a lie is taken as truth when gossip, doubt, and malice are allowed to flourish and ignite a witch-hunt that soon threatens to destroy an innocent man’s life.

title: The Hunt For Dark Matter
description: The search for the substance that physicists and astronomers believe holds the universe together.

title: The Hunter (1980)
description: Steve McQueen's last movie shows the dynamic talent of the late, great actor in one of his most memorable roles: The true story of Ralph "Papa" Thorson, a modern day bounty hunter.

title: The Hunter (2011)
description: Willem Dafoe plays a mercenary sent by a shadowy corporation to the untamed wilderness of Tasmania to track down a tiger thought to be extinct, whose genetic code holds the secret to a dangerous weapon.

title: The Hunter Legacy
description: Grandchildren of big game hunters travel through Kenya to see how to save endangered species.

title: The Hunter's Prayer
description: An assassin (Sam Worthington) helps a young woman avenge the death of her family.

title: The Hunters
description: A group of friends spend a weekend in the woods and find themselves trapped with no way out. They will soon become prey to The Hunters!

title: The Hunting Party
description: A young journalist, a cameraman, and a discredited war correspondent go on an unauthorized mission to find the most wanted war criminal in Bosnia.

title: The Hunting Party (1971)
description: To cattle baron Brandt Ruger (Gene Hackman), his stunning wife (Candice Bergen) is just one of his possessions. So when a notorious bandit kidnaps her, an enraged Ruger organizes a posse to recover his property dead or alive in the searing western!

title: The Huntresses
description: When a mysterious assassin begins killing off royal messengers, three female bounty hunters, the Huntresses, are sent to foil the sinister plot. With a large reward on the table, Jin-ok, Hong-dan and Ga-bi team up to bring an end to the murders.

title: The Hurricane Express
description: When his father is killed in a train wreck, Larry Baker vows to unmask a mysterious criminal called "The Wrecker," who has targeted the L&M Railroad for deadly "accidents."

title: The Hybrids Family
description: Two teenage siblings have a secret—they’re the world’s first vampire/witch hybrids! Their supernatural parents have kept them hidden away for years, but when they move to Florida to start a new normal life, a family-filled adventure ensues.

title: The Hydra
description: “The Hydra” is about the rise of ecstasy and other synthetic drugs in Europe after the collapse of the Soviet Union in the early 1990s. The film tells the extraordinary covert operation to bring down the drug cartels.

title: The Hyena Lady - Wolves on the Waterline
description: The brown hyena lives in the coastal regions of Namibia. It provides an example of excellent adjustment in that it has developed a highly unusual hunting behaviour.

title: The Hyperborean
description: A whiskey magnate summons his contentious family to sample his legacy product: casks of Scotch aged 170 years, recovered from a ghost ship in the Canadian Arctic.

title: The Hyperions
description: In this inventive superhero thriller, Professor Mandulbaum grants three kids superpowers, creating the legendary Hyperions. Years later, a high-stakes heist threatens their legacy, forcing the fractured heroes to reunite and battle to save the world.

title: The Hütter Brothers
description: Austrian brothers and pilots, Wolfgang and Ulrich Hutter, have a passion for engineering and aviation that is harnessed by the Luftwaffe in WWII.

title: The Ice King
description: John Curry transformed ice skating from a dated sport into a new artistic medium. Coming out on the night of his Olympic win in 1976, he became the first openly gay Olympian in a time when homosexuality was not even fully legal.

title: The Iceman
description: The story of Richard Kuklinski, the notorious contract killer and family man. When finally arrested in 1986, neither his wife nor daughters had any clue about his real profession.

title: The Iceman Cometh
description: Theodore Hickman, a hardware salesman, makes by-yearly visits to Harry Hope's 1910-era waterfront bar for his periodical drinking binges. But on this visit he has decided to try to save the bar's patrons from their "lying pipe dreams."

title: The Iceman of Oetz Valley
description: Enter the mystery of the world's most investigated man - Otzi, an Austrian from the Alps whose corpse was uncovered in 1991, thousands of years after his death. Using modern technology, Kurt Mundl and his team of scientists examine Otzi for a glimpse.

title: The Ideal Husband
description: A couple is joyously expecting their first child, but a secret from the husband's past threatens to destroy their happiness.

title: The Identical
description: The story of twin brothers separated at birth in the Great Depression. With different upbringings, one brother becomes a music legend while the other struggles to find a balance between his passion for music and trying to please his father.

title: The Identity Theft of Mitch Mustain
description: In 2005, Mitch Mustain was the most decorated high school football player in all of America.

title: The Idolmaker (1980)
description: Vinnie Vacarri (Ray Sharkey) has the songs and the voice. He just doesn’t have the face of a teen idol. But Vinnie has a plan: if he can’t be an idol...he’ll create them! Peter Gallagher and Paul Land also star in this parable of ambition and fame.

title: The Illusionist
description: In turn-of-the-century Vienna, a magician uses his abilities to secure the love of a woman far above his social standing.

title: The Image Revolution
description: In 1992, Marvel Comics was the number-one publisher of comic books in the world, largely due to its dynamic artwork. But as a response to what was believed to be years of mistreatment toward creative talent by the industry's leading publishers.

title: The Imitation Game
description: Benedict Cumberbatch shines as real-life war hero and pioneer of modern-day computing, Alan Turing, who saved millions of lives by cracking Germany's so-called unbreakable code during WWII.

title: The Immaculate Room
description: Secrets and private demons emerge when a young couple joins a psychological experiment to compete for a $5 million prize by isolating themselves in an empty white room for 50 days. No phones, no family...only the room trying to break their resolve.

title: The Immigrant
description: Marion Cotillard, Joaquin Phoenix, and Jeremy Renner star in the story of Ewa, a recent immigrant to America who falls prey to a charming but wicked man who forces her into prostitution.

title: The Imposter
description: A documentary centered on a young man in Spain who claims to a grieving Texas family that he is their 16-year-old son who has been missing for 3 years.

title: The Imposters
description: Maya splits with her long-term girlfriend and meets the enigmatic Hattie but everything is not as it seems.

title: The Inbetweeners
description: Will McKenzie is on a bad run. His parents have just divorced and, to make matters worse, his mum has moved him from a posh private school and into the sixth form at the local comprehensive.

title: The Incomparable Rose Hartman
description: With a career spanning decades Photographer Rose Hartman is known for her Iconic Photos from Studio 54 and the fashion world, her boisterous personality and ever presence capturing the New York social scene.

title: The Incredible Five - A Cheetah's Tale
description: Cheetahs are the high-speed hunters of the Savannah.  Few attempt to take on larger prey than gazelles or smallish antelopes.  But on occasion, the predatory cats reveal their surprisingly different side.

title: The Incredible Journey of Apollo 12
description: It's the ultimate buddy movie. Pete Conrad and Alan Bean were the second pair of Apollo astronauts to land on the moon. They combined precision with a sense of humor. But it was the rocks they picked up that would define the mission's legacy.

title: The Incredible Journey of Mary Bryant
description: A true epic of an extraordinary young woman and her fight for the freedom and dignity of her young family in the penal colony of Botany Bay, on the open seas of the Pacific Ocean, in the fine homes of Timor and in the courts of Georgian England.

title: The Incredible Melting Man
description: In this sci-fi horror thriller, Col. West (Alex Rebar) returns from a trip to Saturn with a strange ailment: his flesh is melting! And only human flesh will keep him alive! While under observation, West escapes and begins an unending hunt for prey.

title: The Incredible Miniature Fighters
description: During WWII, Germany's incredible 'Miniature Fighter Competition' leads to aeronautical marvels.

title: The Incubus (1982)
description: A small town doctor and sheriff join forces to track down a vicious sex-killer who may be the indestructible incarnation of a demon spawned from hell.

title: The Indian Runner
description: In his writing and directing debut, Sean Penn delivers a profound picture of two very different brothers, one a cop, one a lawbreaking Vietnam vet, who attempt to get through life...one day at a time.

title: The Infinite World of H.G. Wells
description: Brings H.G. Wells' visions to life with an inventive speculation on the origins of his brilliant flights of fantasy.

title: The Inhabitant
description: A teenage descendant of Lizzie Borden grapples with paranoia and her dark family past amid a series of real-life small-town murders in this chilling psychological horror ride.

title: The Initiation
description: After breaking into a department store for a hazing ritual, sorority sisters and their boyfriends are hunted by a deranged killer. Starring Vera Miles (Psycho).

title: The Innkeepers
description: After over one hundred years of service, The Yankee Pedlar Inn is shutting its doors for good. The last remaining employees - Claire and Luke - are determined to uncover proof of what many believe to be one of New England's most haunted hotels.

title: The Innocence Network
description: The Innocence Network is a series of true crime stories derived through unprecedented access to two members of the Innocence Network, the Innocence Project New York and the Innocence Project New Orleans.

title: The Inquiry
description: In 35 A.D., a Roman tribune is sent to Palestine to investigate the death and possible resurrection of a certain Jesus from Nazareth.

title: The Insider: Reggie Yates
description: The Insider sees Reggie Yates live life for real inside some of the world's most brutal institutions.

title: The Insomniac (2016)
description: Believing he'll be robbed again, a burglary victim refuses to sleep until the thief is caught. Certain that the culprit is someone he knows, he grows increasingly unhinged as he scribbles accusations in his notepads.

title: The Inspection
description: Rejected by his mother and with few options, a young, gay Black man joins the Marines, doing whatever it takes to succeed in a system that would cast him aside, unexpectedly finding camaraderie, strength, and support in this new community.

title: The Inspector General
description: A town's corrupt officials think a fool is actually an investigator in disguise

title: The Instant Gardener
description: Presented by Helen Skelton and expert garden designer Danny Clarke, this refreshing series transforms unloved gardens into beautiful spaces using clever design and imaginative ideas.

title: The Institute
description: Many San Franciscans take part in an elaborate alternate-reality game created by Jeff Hull, but as more players become involved, the game begins to spin out of control.

title: The Instrumental Chemist
description: The Instrumental Chemist features the remarkable life of chemist, inventor, entrepreneur, and philanthropist Arnold O. Beckman. His brilliantly designed instruments enabled scientists to answer old questions faster and more accurately.

title: The Insufferable Groo
description: The film follows eccentric, indie filmmaker Stephen Groo as he tries and succeeds in casting super-fan Jack Black (SCHOOL OF ROCK) as the small-town sheriff in his original elf/human romance film.

title: The Integrity of Joseph Chambers
description: Desperate to acquire the skills necessary to provide for his family in case of an apocalypse, insurance salesman Joseph Chambers goes deer hunting for the first time ever, alone, when his experienced buddy is too sick to join him.

title: The Interrogation Room Hosted by Vivica A. Fox
description: Hosted by Vivica A. Fox, this true-crime series takes a unique look at the battle of wits between police and suspects in some of the most disturbing US and UK criminal cases in recent years.

title: The Intruder
description: After a whirlwind romance and rushed marriage, Catherine (Charlotte Gainsbourg, 'I'm Not There') moves into her husband's apartment. As strange things begin to happen, she finds herself questioning her own sanity. With Nastassja Kinski & John Hannah.

title: The Invisible Man
description: A scientist suffers a tragic accident in the lab which accidentally turns him invisible. While he works to reverse his ailment, the government puts him to work fighting crime

title: The Invisible War
description: From Oscar- and Emmy-nominated filmmaker Kirby Dick comes THE INVISIBLE WAR, a groundbreaking investigative documentary about one of America's most shameful and best-kept secrets: the epidemic of rape within the U.S. military.

title: The Invisibles
description: While Joseph Goebbels infamously declared Berlin "free of Jews" in 1943, 1,700 managed to survive in the Nazi capital through the end of WWII. The Invisibles traces the stories of four young people who learned to hide in plain sight.

title: The Invitation
description: In this taut psychological thriller by Karyn Kusama (Girlfight, Jennifer's Body), the tension is palpable when Will shows up to his ex-wife Eden and new husband David's dinner party.

title: The Invited
description: A young married couple discovers that a great evil has resided in their new home for nearly a century.

title: The Irish Mob
description: From the Irish gangs of New York in the late 1800s through to the 1970s, this six-part documentary series tells the stories of the first generation Irish kids who became some of America’s most notorious and wanted gangsters.

title: The Irish Pub
description: The Irish Pub is a eulogy to the greatest institution in Irish society, the pub or more specifically the traditional Irish publicans who run them.

title: The Iron Lady
description: OSCAR-winning Meryl Streep is Margaret Thatcher in this insightful and intimate portrait of the first and only female Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.

title: The Iron Orchard
description: "The Iron Orchard" is the story of Jim McNeely, a young man thrust into  the vibrant and brutal West Texas oilfields in 1939, who works his way through the ranks to ultimately become a formidable wildcatter.

title: The Iron Sheik - The Maim Event
description: The story of one hot night in Alabama as an Independent Pro Wrestling Show rolls into town with its cast of high flying characters in faded tights.

title: The Iron Sheriff
description: Sterling Hayden plays a sheriff with continuing moral dilemmas. Should he relate a deathbed confession which falsely implicates his son in a murder? Should he carry out his threat to cold-bloodedly kill the real murderer or bring him to legal justice?

title: The Island
description: A man goes on the run after he discovers that he is actually a "harvested being", and is being kept along with others in a utopian facility.

title: The Island
description: A cataclysmic event causes a man, who dreams of winning the lottery, to become stranded on an island with his co-workers.

title: The Island Diaries
description: Join host Sophie Fouron as she travels the globe to discover the unique lifestyles found on islands.

title: The Island of Lost Girls
description: When a riptide sweeps three young sisters away, they wash up on an island of sea caves, sea lions, and giant elephant seals and head to a distant lighthouse, learning the importance of never giving up and sticking together along the way.

title: The Island President
description: After bringing democracy to his country, President Mohamed Nasheed of the Maldives, the lowest-lying country in the world, takes up the fight to keep his homeland from disappearing under the sea.

title: The Island with Bear Grylls
description: In this series of epic survival, Bear Grylls maroons two sets of people from different generations on deserted islands. Wearing just the clothes on their backs and armed with some basic tools, which generation is better equipped to survive?

title: The Island with Bear Grylls UK
description: The ultimate survival challenge returns as 16 brave souls are dropped on a remote island in the Pacific. Half the group are high earners, while the other half earn below the UK national average wage.

description: In the age-old clash of IT vs. the corporation, a pair of basement-dwelling dweebs squares off against their cloddish owner-come-lately, with their ambitious but tech-illiterate manager running interference.

title: The Jack In The Box
description: When a vintage Jack-in-the-box is unearthed and opened, it's new owners soon have reason to believe the creepy clown doll has a life of it's own.

title: The Jack in the Box Rises
description: When Raven is sent to an all-girls boarding school, she unleashes a demon from a vintage Jack-in-the-box prompting a fight for survival.

title: The Jack in the Box: Awakening
description: When a Jack-in-the-box is opened by a dying woman, she makes a deal with the demon within, to be cured in return for it helping it claim six victims.

description: The Jackie Stiles Story is an inspirational film about a 5'8" girl from a small Kansas town who became a basketball legend in the Midwest.  Against all odds, Jackie became the all-time leading scorer in NCAA history and the WNBA Rookie-of-the-Year.

title: The Jade Pendant
description: The Old West becomes a battleground for power and revenge in this gripping epic based on true events. A young Chinese woman, Ying-Ying, finds herself on a boat to America after escaping the clutches of a bad arranged marriage.

description: This documentary, which was undertaken soon after James Dean's death, looks at Dean's life through the use of still photographs with narration, and interviews with many of the people involved in his short life.

description: A killer comedy that has an ex-cop trailing a serial murderer... and the mayor's sexy daughter! Kevin Kline leads an all-star cast that includes Susan Sarandon, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Harvey Keitel, and Rod Steiger.

description: In this one-man show, Jerry Lewis performs various sketches and bits, exhibiting his multi-faceted talents as a comedian, singer and dancer.

title: The Jerry Springer Show
description: Host Jerry Springer referees outrageous and hilarious guest confrontations with issues from infidelity to identity crises.

description: In this spin-off of The Big Lebowski directed by and starring John Turturro, bowler Jesus Quintana pairs up with fellow misfits Petey and Marie after his release from prison for a freewheeling joyride of petty crime and romance.

description: The Jewish Journey: America explores what it meant to be part of a tight-knit Jewish community and make the heartbreaking choice to leave family behind, whether for economic opportunity or to escape persecution.

description: Jimmy's (Frank Whaley, "Pulp Fiction") dead-end job in the grocery store has him feeling unfulfilled, but one night at a stand-up open mic gives him a glimpse into what could be.

description: This comedy series follows the misadventures of Joey Barnes, the host of a talk show in New York City, as he balances his personal and professional lives.

description: Anne-Marie Barton visits the homes of people who can't seem to get their spaces right, and with tons of takeaway, offers homeowners a transformation that will not only change their spaces, but also their lives.

description: Weekly eco-adventure series, hosted by international explorer Zay Harding, showcases the remarkable scientists, engineers, and people with innovative ideas who are creating environmental solutions.

title: The Vourdalak

description: The complete history of the world's favourite car the VW Beetle - with footage from the VW archive.

description: A misfit hen who can't lay eggs discovers she can talk, sing, and dance! Her talents take her on the road as a world-famous circus act.

description: Tras despertar de un coma en un hospital abandonado, el policía Rick Grimes ve al mundo que conocía devastado por una epidemia zombi apocalíptica. ¿Podrán Rick y los otros retener su humanidad mientras luchan por vivir en este nuevo mundo?

title: The Walrus and the Whistleblower

title: The War of the Worlds (1953)

title: The War You Don't See
description: A powerful and timely investigation into the media's role in war, tracing the history of 'embedded' and independent reporting.

title: The Ward

title: The Warlords (SUB)
description: In the midst of the Taiping Rebellion of the 1860s, three men take an oath to become blood brothers, pledging loyalty to one another until death, but soon become embroiled in a web of political deceit.

title: The Wasting

title: THE WATCHER
description: Unaware of its terrible history, a young couple purchases their dream home. It soon becomes clear that they may not be alone in the house and that someone, or something, is determined to drive them out.

title: The Wave
description: When Frank goes out on the town to celebrate a promotion, he is dosed with a hallucinogen that changes his life forever.

title: The Way Home
description: Based on an inspirational true story about how a rural community rallied around a distraught family.

title: The Way Of The Dragon
description: Legendary Bruce Lee's only complete directorial film is packed with action and epic fight scenes. Lee visits his relatives at their restaurant in Italy and has to help them defend against brutal gangsters harassing them.

title: The Way of the West
description: A lone mountie has come to town to clean up the corruption and crime. He prepares to take them down one by one in the most vicious showdown the town has ever seen.

title: The Way West

description: When Violet needs help preparing flower arrangements for a high-profile wedding, she calls upon Jack, a photographer who has taken over responsibility for his grandfather's flower shed.

description: When a wealthy couple can't decide on a wedding theme, they hire two wedding planners, TAYLOR and BEN, to compete for the job. As they compete for the gig and playfully sabotage each other's efforts but are growing closer together than they realise.

description: In this Minecraft Adventure, Little RoPo gets turned into a werewolf! When trying to deal with his new transformation madness ensues! This content is not an official Minecraft product, not approved by or associated with Mojang.

description: Outlaws, wealthy plantation owners, runaway slaves, a half Cherokee girl, a pair of brothel owners, and a pregnant woman all end up in a bloody shootout and running for their lives.

description: A rare surfing documentary film that gives an honest look at the darkest side of surfing and the aftermath of addiction and recovery.  It's a winner of many awards and some critics have even made the bold claim this is the best surfing documentary ever...

title: The Wheels On The Halloween Bus
description: Wheels on the Halloween Bus! Happy halloween season!

title: The White Orchid
description: A shy investigator assumes the identity of a small-town murder victim in order to solve her gruesome death.

title: The Whitest Kids U' Know

title: The Who: Videobiography

description: Keanu Reeves is a defense attorney trying to clear a teen in the brutal stabbing of his father. As more evidence comes to light, the whole truth seems darker than ever.

title: The Wiggles (Wiggles Show)

description: It's time for The Wiggles' BIG BIRTHDAY! Join The Wiggles and their friends for a Wiggly party! Joke with Captain, Murray and Dorothy, then get ready to dance!

title: The Wild
description: Three families with past conflicts struggle for cohesive future, bound by a game lodge in the wild.

title: The Wild Pacific
description: The Pacific Ocean covers one third of our planet, more than all the continents combined. For over 200 Million years, it has teemed with life, built new species, powered weather systems and affects every animal on earth.

title: The Wild Party (1957)
description: A night of terror in a sleazy nightspot, when an over-the-hill football star holds a thrill-seeking couple captive.

title: The Wild Roses
description: Two rival families clash in an epic battle to save what they believe to be rightfully theirs.

title: The Wild Wild West
description: An unlikely pair of Secret Service Agents, Artemus Gordon and James T. West, work to protect President Ulysses S. Grant and investigate federal crimes in the old west.

title: The Winter Lake
description: When Holly's dark secret is uncovered by her new neighbor, they are pulled into a violent battle with her father.

description: Contactees, sighters, and abductees share similar and different experiences with beings from other dimensions, leaving a lasting mark of their presence.

description: 40 years after the first haunting at Eel Marsh House, a group of children evacuated from WWII London arrives, awakening the house's darkest inhabitant.

description: A happily married advertising executive gets the 7-year itch and obsessively searches the streets of San Francisco for the gorgeous woman he saw in an underground garage.

title: The Woman In White
description: Based upon Wilkie Collins' Victorian mystery, the gothic tale tells of a pair of half sisters whose lives end up caught in a grand conspiracy revolving around a mentally ill woman dressed in white

description: The Woman Who Wasn't There is a psychological thriller that goes inside the mind of history's most infamous 9/11 survivor.

title: The Wonder List With Bill Weir
description: Bill Weir shares stories of extraordinary people, places and creatures.

description: In this action-packed western, ex-pat Martin Brady (Robert Mitchum) travels to Texas to broker an arms deal for Mexican Governor Castro (Pedro Armendariz). But things get complicated when the the guns he was returning to Mexico are stolen.

description: A child molester returns to his hometown after 12 years in prison.

description: An investigation into the workings of Amazon and its philosophy through insider interviews with business owners, employees and a former founding executive, to reveal the sky-high ambitions of the company run by the world’s first centi-billionaire.

description: Matt Green has been walking every block of every street in New York City.

title: The World From Above
description: Looking down on the world from above, one might see the incredible diversity of landscapes.

description: The World from Above is a uniquely different view of the world. From 10,000 feet in the sky down to just a few feet off the ground, a stabilized high def aerial camera seeks out both the beautiful and the dramatic. Journey across the world, and be amazed.

description: Peter Sellers had everything, yet believed he had nothing at all. Acclaimed director Tony Palmer has made the definitive portrait of this enigmatic comic genius.

description: Where the Internet meets Television. The greatest viral videos including bloopers and hilarious amateur productions are seen for the first time on broadcast television.

title: The World's Greatest Fair
description: A fascinating view of the largest World’s Fair in history held in 1904. Hundreds of images, early film footage, and engaging interviews bring to life stories of dog-eating tribes on exhibit, marathon runners openly administered drugs.

title: The World's Largest Ball of Twine
description: A quirky story about Francis Johnson, a Minnesota farmer, and creator of the original world's largest ball of twine.

title: The Worlds of Harry Connick Jr.
description: Narrated by Harry himself in a candid look at his own life and career, the program features interviews with jazz greats Branford and Wynton Marsalis and their father, Ellis Marsalis.

title: The Wraith
description: Jake is killed by neighborhood thugs, and returns as a mystical figure (The Wraith) to gain revenge. Starring Charlie Sheen and Randy Quaid.

description: When a group of friends return to their home town for a high school reunion, a tragic curse of the town's history emerges to terrorize them after horrifying revelations put all of their lives in peril for a shocking night they may not all survive.

description: Before WWII, Japan’s Temple of Hades abducts children to create assassins. Vajra, their deadliest killer, escapes after his brother’s death and flees to China, vowing revenge on those who turned him into a weapon while protecting the innocent.

title: The Writers' Room
description: The Writers' Room, hosted by Academy Award winning writer, Jim Rash, gets real with the most innovative voices in TV today. Join us for a frank and revealing conversation about what we all love: television! Go inside a place few people have ever been.

description: After troubled teen Katie is sentenced to house arrest, she falls for her handsome new neighbor John. Katie soon becomes convinced there's more to John than meets the eye.

title: The Wrong Child

title: The Wrong Cruise
description: A mother and daughter’s bonding cruise turns dangerous when a port excursion leads them into a web of deceit, leaving them stranded in a foreign country with two ruthless men hunting them down.

title: The Wrong Crush
description: A rising track star, haunted by a troubled past, faces a new admirer who threatens her future. Despite being in a committed relationship, she must keep him at bay before her secrets resurface.

title: The Wrong Daughter
description: Kate and Joe, who have longed to be parents, reconnect with the child Kate gave up for adoption many years ago. Soon, Kate begins to question if this is really her daughter.

title: The Wrong Friend
description: The moment Riley meets Chris, she thinks he is handsome, charming and affectionate. He seems perfect, but after a party at his house, Riley sees that Chris has a darker side.

title: The Wrong House
description: A personal trainer begins a campaign of harassment against a couple and their young daughter after the family moves into the house that she wanted.

title: The Wrong Housesitter
description: Successful editor Deb sends Dan on an out-of-town assignment just as he moves into his dream house. When he meets Kristin, his problem is solved because she seems like the perfect house sitter. But his problems are just starting.

title: The Wrong Marriage
description: Carrie escapes an abusive marriage, starts fresh, and meets a mysterious stranger. As sparks fly, her dark past resurfaces, threatening her new life and a passionate romance.

title: The Wrong Mommy
description: After receiving a promotion at work, a young woman hires a personal assistant who seems perfect, but the assistant has an ulterior motive for taking the job.

title: The Wrong Mother
description: Kaylene's dream finally came true: twins following an in vitro procedure. When she needs home care, the nurse is none other than the egg donor herself — who has come to claim 'her' babies.

title: The Wrong Neighbor
description: A recently separated father and his teenage daughter become the deadly obsession of their neighbor -- a beguiling, deranged young woman willing to do whatever's necessary to take her rightful place as their wife and mother.

title: The Wrong Obsession
description: Lisa tries to save her marriage with Mark, but her ex Jake’s obsession grows dangerously unstable, forcing her to navigate love, loyalty, and escalating threats to her safety.

title: The Wrong Prince Charming
description: A successful entrepreneur scores a meeting with a famed prince about a possible multimillion dollar investment in one of her properties. But the perfect partnership soon turns into a nightmare when she discovers he's not what he seems.

title: The Wrong Roommate
description: A college professor house-sitting for her sister discovers that her teenage niece has befriended a mysterious stranger living in the guest house.

title: The Wrong Stepfather
description: A happy engagement to a charming college adviser soon turns into real fear when a teacher worries her fiancé may be the wrong stepfather for her daughter.

title: The Wrong Student
description: Amber tries out for the soccer team and becomes acquainted with student Maddie Sawyer, who is also on the team. When Amber's aunt Kelly and coach Dominic fall in love, he gains the unwanted attention of unstable Maddie.

title: The Wrong Teacher
description: A teacher's affair with a younger man turns out to be a new student with dangerous consequences.

title: The Wrong Tutor
description: When star high school athlete Eric needs help with his school work, a woman named Emily convinces Eric's mother that she is the perfect tutor for her son, but she has other reasons that stem beyond helping him with his homework.

title: The Wrong Valentine

description: Detective Jones investigates a break-in at Ashley and Brad’s home, discovering their wedding planner, Mandy, is stalking Brad. Her obsession escalates, sabotaging his work and causing chaos.

description: Ellen Plainview, a sweet, caring, working wife and mother, learns that she is under arrest for attempted murder.

title: The wubbulous world of Dr. Seuss

title: The X-Files
description: The truth is out there and FBI agents seek it in this sci-fi phenomenon.

A sassy girl finds herself dead after trading bedrooms with her heiress friend. Her ghost seeks aid from banker Cosmo Topper to find out why and by whom.

Many consider this to be the best of the Topper trilogy, thanks largely to the sassy presence of Joan Blondell. Hollywood’s favorite wisecracker plays Gail Richards, a woman accidentally murdered while staying at the home of her friend, Ann Carrington (Carole Landis). Enlisting the help of Cosmo Topper (Roland Young) Gail’s ghost sets out to find her killer. This supernatural comedy was nominated for two Academy Awards, including one for Special Effects. TV buffs should keep an ear open for Rochester’s line about “Mr. Benny.” Funny stuff!
