description: Basada en hechos reales, cinco amigos juegan con una ouija y despiertan una presencia demoníaca que transforma su curiosidad en una pesadilla. Filmada en Super 8, su estilo crudo intensifica el terror psicológico.

title: Zulu
description: Outnumbered British soldiers do battle with Zulu warriors at Rorke's Drift.

title: Zulu (2013)
description: Based on the novel by Caryl Férey. Set against the backdrop of post-apartheid South Africa, two South African police officers on opposing sides of the apartheid divide work together to fight crime.

title: Zyzzyx Road
description: Two adulterous lovers head to the desert to bury the corpse of her jealous boyfriend, only to discover that the body is missing from the trunk.

title: ZZ Top: Live at Montreux 2013
description: ZZ Top has made a number of visits to Montreux over the years and this concert from the 2013 Festival is undoubtedly one of their finest live performances.

title: ¡Agáchate, maldito!
description: Un desenlace explosivo aguarda a un terrorista irlandés (James Coburn) obsesionado con la dinamita, quien se alía con un campesino mexicano convertido en revolucionario (Rod Steiger) en este trepidante relato de poder y política.

title: ¡ALTO! Frontera
description: Alto! Frontera te lleva a las fronteras de México, Brasil, Colombia, Chile, Bolivia y Perú, donde miles arriesgan todo para burlar los controles.

title: ¡ALTO! Frontera
description: ¡Alto! Frontera te lleva a las fronteras de México, Brasil, Colombia, Chile, Bolivia y Perú, donde miles arriesgan todo para burlar los controles.

title: ¡Ay, qué hijo!
description: El jugador más grande en la historia de Ridgefield College usa su influencia y reputación para conseguir que su único hijo; un enfermizo y descoordinado nerd, forme parte del equipo universitario de fútbol con resultados cómicos.

title: ¡Buenos días, Navidad!
description: Dos peleadores presentadores de televisión son enviados a un pequeño pueblo festivo en Navidad. Mientras fingen llevarse bien, descubren que hay más entre ellos de lo que pensaban.

title: ¡Bum, Bum! Mundo Dino
description: ¡Aquí vamos! ¡Bum-bum, Mundo Dino!

title: ¡Pinkfong! Especial de tiburón bebé
description: ¿Quieres pasar el tiempo con tiburón bebé? ¡Los mejores episodios de las canciones de la familia tiburón te están esperando!

title: ¡Ripley's, aunque usted no lo crea!
description: Únanse a Michael “Rip” Ripley, sobrino del célebre Robert Ripley, mientras recorre el mundo para descubrir historias extrañas y artefactos extraños.

title: ¡Salud por eso!
description: El chef José del Castillo nos cuenta los valores que lo ayudaron en su camino hacia la maestría y lo comparte con la nueva generación de cocineros que tienen el mismo objetivo. Mira las deliciosas propuestas gastronómicas que tienen para ti.

title: ¡Sigue la risa!
description: Entre Nos is a laugh-out-loud comedy special featuring top U.S. Latino comedians. Tune in for an evening of sure-fire entertainment, as the funniest folks in comedy share personal, yet universal, stories about life, love, and being Latino.

title: ¡Todos quieren algo!
description: Es 1980, Jake y sus locos amigos, estudiantes de primer año, viven su odisea con fiestas y partidos justo antes de comenzar las clases. Del guionista y director Richard Linklater, llega la película que demuestra que los buenos tiempos nunca envejecen.

title: ¡Átame!
description: Un desequilibrado pero seductor ex-paciente con problemas mentales toma a una estrella porno prisionera con la esperanza de convencerla de que se case con él.

title: ¿Alguien ha visto a Lupita?
description: Lupita se ve obligada a separarse de su familia pues quieren internarla en un hospital. Comienza así un viaje, en el cual ella nos llevará a descubrir un mundo que, al parecer, está mucho más loco que ella.

title: ¿Justicia y Olvido?
description: Este documental atraviesa las vidas de víctimas, victimarios, guerrilleros, rehenes políticos y autoridades del más alto nivel, y los desafíos de un proceso sin precedentes.

title: ¿Quién Diablos Es Juliette?
description: Es una historia verdadera, una ficción robada de la realidad, que comienza con el sorprendente paralelismo entre dos mujeres de piel dorada y ojos verdes: Juliette, una adolescente cubana, y Fabiola una modelo mexicana que vive en Manhattan.

title: ¿Quién es quién?
description: Dos hermanos gemelos, Perico y Leonardo, son tan idénticos que ni su madre podría diferenciarlos. Fueron separados al nacer y les tocó vivir vidas opuestas. Se reúnen tras años separados, esta vez, intercambian roles con resultados muy divertidos.

title: ¿Qué haría Jesús? 2: El tallador de madera
description: Matthew es un chico rebelde que destruye la iglesia que su padre está renovando como carpintero. Trabajando se dan cuenta que todo es posible con fe, familia y amistad.

title: ¿Qué le dijiste a Dios?
description: Martina y Lupita son empleadas domésticas que arriesgan todo por amor. Toman prestada la ropa de su jefa y viajan a su pueblo natal, pero su jefa les está pisando los talones. Una comedia musical inspirada en las canciones de Juan Gabriel.

title: ¿Soy Niño o Niña?
description: Desde el momento en que nace un bebé, lo primero que la gente quiere saber es si es niño o niña. ¿Qué sucede cuando sabes quién eres por dentro, pero el mundo exterior ve algo diferente?

title: ¿Y dónde está el piloto?
description: Considerada "una de las 10 películas más divertidas de la historia" por el American Film Institute, "¿Y dónde está el piloto?" es una obra maestra de la comedia de disparate.

title: ¿Y dónde está el piloto? II
description: El primer transbordador espacial comercial envía al chiflado Ted (Robert Hays) y a su exnovia (Julie Hagerty) a un viaje a la Luna.

title: Évocateur: The Morton Downey Jr. Movie
description: In the late '80s, Morton Downey Jr. tore apart the traditional talk format by turning debate of current issues into a gladiator pit. His blow-smoke-in-your-face style drew a rabid cult following, but also the title "Father of Trash Television."

title: Íconos de nuestra era: Che Guevara
description: La imagen del Che es un fenómeno mundial, visto en todas partes, desde los barrios más pobres hasta las ciudades más ricas. ¿Pero la verdadera historia del Che Guevara se ha separado completamente del ícono?

title: Última oportunidad para Navidad
description: Justo antes de Navidad, el encargado del almacén de Santa debe apresurarse a encontrar un reemplazo para un reno herido. Cuando encuentra uno, surgen complicaciones y amor.

title: Último viaje a Las Vegas
description: Cuatro mejores amigos de toda la vida van a Las Vegas para dejar de portarse como adultos de su edad y revivir sus días de gloria. Al llegar, se dan cuenta de que las décadas transformaron Sin City y pusieron a prueba su amistad de manera impensada.

title: Únicos: Papa Francisco
description: Preserva la memoria del Papa Francisco tras su fallecimiento. El primer Papa latinoamericano se hizo famoso por su humildad y compromiso con la justicia social.

title: #AMFAD: All My Friends are Dead
description: A group of college friends rent an Airbnb for the biggest music festival of the year. A weekend of partying quickly takes a turn, as the group is murdered one by one.

title: $100 Makeover
description: Interior designer Leslie Segrete, master carpenter Rib Hillis, and professional organizer Robbie Laughlin show how homeowners can spend just $100 a room and come up with de-cluttered and redesigned spaces.

title: 1 Buck
description: Shifting from one pocket to another, from one man's drama to another, a lowly dollar bill, 'one buck' takes us on an odyssey through the heart of a forgotten town in Louisiana.

title: 1 Million Followers
description: When Karissa, an Idaho farmgirl, is flown to a luxurious mansion in Thailand to join a host of social media influencers, she soon discovers the dark world of fame.

title: 10 Years
description: 10 Years follows a group of friends on the night of their high school reunion who, a decade after leaving school, still haven't quite grown up.

title: 10,000 Days
description: Ten thousand days ago, Comet 23 struck Earth with the magnitude of all the nuclear weapons in the world sending the planet into a deep freeze. Now, 27 years in the future, those who survived are locked in an epic battle of life or death.

title: 100 Streets
description: The interconnecting stories of three people, a separated wife and mother, a small time drug dealer and a cab driver, within one area of contemporary London. All three face major choices and change in their separate lives, as their paths sometimes cross.

title: 100% Wolf
description: Freddy Lupin is the heir to a proud family line of werewolves. Desperate to become a werewolf himself, Freddy is in for a shock when on his 14th birthday his first transformation goes awry, turning him into a ferocious - poodle.

title: 10th & Wolf
description: A tense and moody mafia thriller inspired by true events, from the Academy Award Winning Writer of Crash. A Marine Sergeant returns home from war to discover his family has become embroiled in a lethal mob war with the Philadelphia Mafia.

title: 12 Dogs of Christmas
description: It's Christmas time and it looks to be a dismal season for motherless 12-year-old Emma O'Connor who has been sent to her unwelcoming Aunt Delores...

title: 12 Dogs Of Christmas 2: Great Puppy Race
description: The Doverville puppy orphanage is in danger of being shut down when an out-of-town business magnate announces his plans for renovation...

title: 13 Hours
description: Sarah Tyler returns to her troubled family home for a much put-off visit, joined by her brothers and friends. As a storm rages on under a full moon, the young group find themselves cut off from the world and completely isolated.

title: 13 Sins
description: Elliot Brindle is an ordinary office worker who’s bright, bored and drowning in debt. He receives a phone call informing him that he’s on a hidden camera game show, where he must execute 13 tasks to receive a sum total cash prize of $6.2M...

A man writing a book about the paranormal travels to New York and stays in a hotel room that has been said to be responsible for the death of all the guests that come to stay. Based on the short story by Stephen King.
Jackie Chan stars as a commander who must free his country by leading a revolution against the oppressive Qing Dynasty.

title: 1917 - The Real Story
description: '1917: The Real Story' documents the true story behind the international blockbuster film '1917' - providing an insight into the real-life characters, and what became of them.

title: 1944 - The Longest Days
description: France 1944. Battle weary sergeant, John Kaufman, leads his disillusioned squad on a reconnaissance mission behind enemy lines. As events unfold and the reality of their situation becomes ever more apparent, the young squad begins to question their orders and sanity.

title: 20 Feet From Stardom
description: Millions know their voices, but no one knows their names. In his compelling new Oscar winning film 20 Feet from Stardom, director Morgan Neville shines a spotlight on the untold true story of the backup singers behind some of the greatest musical legends of the 21st century.

title: 2019: After the Fall of New York
description: After a nuclear war, society breaks down into two groups, the evil Euraks and the rebel Federation. A mercenary named Parsifal is hired by the Federation to infiltrate New York City, which is controlled by the Euraks, to rescue the only fertile woman left on Earth.

Award-winning director Damon Gameau embarks on journey to explore what the future could look like by the year 2040 if we simply embraced the best solutions already available to us to improve our planet and shifted them rapidly into the mainstream.

title: 2099: The Soldier Protocol
description: A biotech company promises a paraplegic inmate his legs back, in exchange for volunteering in an experiment – but in The Wheel no one survives.

title: 20th Century Women
description: Set in 1970s Santa Barbara, 20th Century Women is the story of Dorothea (Annette Bening), a single mother, and her son Jamie, as he comes of age at a time brimming with cultural change and rebellion.

title: 21 and Over
description: The night before his big medical school interview, a promising student celebrates his 21st birthday with his two best friends.

title: 21 Jump Street
description: The cases of an undercover police unit composed of young-looking officers specializing in youth crime.
A teenager on a ride along gets caught up in a bank robbery gone wrong, trying to tape all of the action on his cell phone as it happens.

title: 23 Walks
description: Dave and Fern, two older strangers, have been bruised by their individual circumstance. They meet walking their dogs in a North London park, and over the course of twenty-three walks together romance begins to blossom.

title: 24 Hour Catwalk
description: In hopes of winning the $20,000 prize and the change to become the next big fashion star, two designers battle it out to complete their own line for a star-studded runway show in just 24 hours.

title: 24 Hours In London
description: After 10 years in prison, a killer seeks revenge for his sister’s murder, launching a 24-hour rampage with allies he trusts. As bodies pile up, a detective races to uncover the truth, facing pressure from above. 24 Little Hours is a gripping British crime thriller.

title: 265 Days Without Waves
description: A unique and extraordinary story about surfing in Barcelona's Mediterranean coast. With barely 100 days of waves a year, a group of local surfers manage to create a community and promote a surf culture against all the odds.

title: 3 Days With Dad
description: The last thing Eddie Mills wants to do is go home to deal with his dying Dad Bob. But the Catholic guilt gnaws at him, and he returns home to his crazy family.

title: 3 Hearts
description: A touching and tense drama about destiny, connections and passion, '3 Hearts' presents a headily romantic look at a classic love triangle.

title: 36 Husbands
description: 36 Husbands is a mystical, musical, Kung Fu spy comedy starring 3 powerful women - and a bunch of husbands. Krista, top spy and Kung Fu master, has extraordinary powers and she puts them in action on her quest to slow down the steady march towards World War III.

title: 4 Minute Mile
description: A former track coach decides to train a student with natural athletic talent. Tragedy strikes right before the biggest race of his life, forcing him to confront everything that has been holding him back.

title: 400 Days
description: Four aspiring astronauts are sent on a simulated mission to a distant planet to test the psychological effects of deep space travel. Locked away for 400 days, the crew's mental state begins to deteriorate when they lose all communication with the outside world.

title: 4th Man Out
description: Adam, a small-town mechanic, decides it's time to tell his friends and family he's gay. Will his straight-as-an-arrow best bros have his back? A lighthearted and unexpectedly subversive comedy about coming out of the blue-collar closet.

Coming of age comedy inspired by the true story of a nerdy, alienated, hopeful filmmaker named Pat Johnson about growing up, falling in love, and becoming the very first fan of the movie that changed everything, Star Wars.

title: 500 MPH Storm
description: At 500 MPH disaster is inevitable. When an experiment goes disastrously wrong, a rash of massive hurricanes rips across North America. A scientist must get his family to safety before the hurricanes merge, creating a "hypercane" with the power to wipe America off the map.

title: 7 Below
description: A group of strangers are trapped in a time warp house where a terrible event transpired exactly 100 years prior.

What starts out as just another day on the job quickly turns into a life-or-death struggle for a soft-spoken American co-pilot when a group of terrorists attempt to take control of his Paris-bound flight.

A young woman comes to in a roadside diner with no idea where she is or how she got there. Split between two timelines, she gets taken on a violent journey as she seeks out the person responsible for her lover's death, a man called Cyrus (Christopher Lloyd).

Based on actual events  -  A group of 5 people find themselves trapped in an elevator in the World Trade Center's North Tower on 9/11. They work together, never giving up hope, to try to escape before the unthinkable happens.

title: A 2nd Chance
description: A 2nd Chance is a children's and family film based around gymnastics. It's an inspirational feel good story about a young gymnast and her coach overcoming adversity for a chance to win a place in the national gymnastics team.

title: A Bittersweet Life
description: In this classic neo-noir from Kim Jee-woon, a hitman becomes the target when he spares his boss's cheating mistress.

title: A Boy Called Po
description: After his wife dies of cancer, an overworked engineer struggles to care for his son with autism. His son in response to bullying regresses into a fantasy world escape.

title: A Case Of You
description: A young writer (Justin Long) woos a cute and quirky barista (Evan Rachel Wood) by studying her Facebook profile and making himself into the man of her dreams.   When she falls for his alter ego, he must keep up the act or risk losing her.

title: A Christmas Gamble
description: A former gambling addict needs $60,000 to save his mother from nursing home eviction. He's never lost a bet on Christmas. Is this the Christmas miracle he's been waiting for?

title: A Christmas in New Hope
description: A single mother enters a home improvement competition to save her bungalow before Christmas, but complications arise after she falls for her musician neighbor.

title: A Christmas Promise
description: Uptight city accountant Michael Thompson is hired to help a family save their stable before the bank shuts them down. Michael reluctantly agrees, but as he searches for ways to save a family's legacy, he finds something he never expected.

title: A Clear Shot
description: A hostage situation at the Good Guys electronic store in Sacramento California goes a wry when bullets start flying. Will law enforcement be able to come in and save the day or will the hostage takers win.

title: A Coffin for the Sheriff
description: Anthony Steffen stars as Shenandoah, a man of mystery who joins a vicious band of highwaymen after passing a near impossible and death defying initiation. When the gang begins to suspect Shenandoah may be a traitor in their midst; they learn the real reason he joined their gang.

title: A Crooked Somebody
description: After being kidnapped, Michael's floundering career as a spirit medium is granted new life when he attempts to use the situation to boost his ratings.

title: A Cure for Wellness
description: An ambitious young executive is sent to retrieve his company's CEO from an idyllic but mysterious "wellness center" at a remote location in the Swiss Alps. He soon suspects that the spa's miraculous treatments are not what they seem.

title: A Dangerous Method
description: Drawn from true-life events, it takes a glimpse into the turbulent relationships between fledgling psychiatrist Carl Jung, his mentor Sigmund Freud and Sabina Spielrein, the troubled but beautiful young woman who comes between them.

title: A Day to Die
description: Ex-military ops officer Conner Connolly (Kevin Dillon) must reunite with his old crew to save his kidnapped wife from a ruthless drug lord by repaying $2 million in 12 hours.

title: A Family Man
description: From the Writer of The Accountant and Ozark comes an unforgettably moving drama with an all-star cast featuring Gerard Butler, Gretchen Mol, and Willem Dafoe.

title: A Family Matters Christmas
description: Christmas is anything but ordinary when three siblings from a newly blended household cannot see eye to eye. With the help of some magic, they switch bodies and cannot change back until they learn to spend the holidays as a loving family.

title: A Few Dollars For Django
description: A ruthless bounty hunter, Django, and a repentant outlaw take over from small-town authorities to restore order.

title: A Game in the Woods
description: After a Texas rancher dies, his granddaughter and her girlfriend discover masked hunters at his ranch competing in a twisted game of life and death. Will the beauties and their already rocky romance survive the brutal carnage?

title: A Good Old Fashioned Orgy
description: A Comedy About Old Friends In New Positions. A Good Old-Fashioned Orgy is about a close group of 30-somethings who spend every weekend of the summer throwing elaborate parties at the house belonging to group member Eric in the Hamptons.

title: A Great Divide
description: The Lee family leave the Bay Area for a fresh start in the rural expanses of Wyoming, only to encounter hostility and xenophobia in their new community. How they confront these issues will break them - or make them stronger.

title: A Guide To Recognizing Your Saints
description: A coming-of-age drama about a boy growing up in 1980s New York who believes he was saved from a culture of drugs and violence by various so-called saints. With Shia LaBeouf and Robert Downey Jr.

title: A Haunted House
description: In this outrageous spoof of "found footage" movies, young couple Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) and Kisha (Essence Atkins) have just moved into their dream house. As they settle in, they quickly find they're not alone. But it's not the house that's haunted, it's Malcolm's girlfriend!

title: A Hologram for the King
description: A Hologram for the King follows businessman Alan Clay (Tom Hanks) on a journey halfway around the world, far from his American roots, to a rising Saudi Arabian city.

title: A Kid Like Jake
description: Alex Wheeler and her husband Greg (JIM PARSONS) are approaching a crossroads that is all too familiar to New York City parents - finding the "right" primary school for their son, Jake.

title: A Kind of Magic
description: Tom and Cindy have left the world of fairy tales for the real world, along with their parents; a carefree fairy, a repentant ogre and a terrifying witch-aunt who’s anything but repentant.

title: A Little Something For Your Birthday
description: Senna, a struggling designer who hasn’t quite found herself has given up on finding her soulmate. Despite attempts, by her best friend, to get her to settle down and pursue her passion of fashion, Senna continues down a path of irresponsible behaviour, lost jobs, and casual hook-ups with younger men

title: A Little White Lie
description: When a handyman living in New York City is mistaken for a famous and famously reclusive writer, he's brought to a university where he is to deliver a keynote address to save the school's literary festival.

title: A Love Song for Bobby Long
description: After the death of her estranged mother, a headstrong young woman returns to New Orleans. Starring Scarlett Johansson and John Travolta.

title: A Miracle on Christmas Lake
description: After a teenage boy loses his best friend and his Dad both around Christmas he quits his favorite sport of hockey and turns from is friends. When an ice rink magically appears on the frozen lake near his home, he reminisces the good times.

title: A Monster Calls
description: From the director of THE IMPOSSIBLE and the producers of PAN’S LABRYNTH, A MONSTER CALLS is a searing and fantastical story of one boy’s journey to confront the truth.

title: A Murder of Innocence
description: Based on a true story, a community is rocked by a double-homicide and the police struggle to find the killer.The resident pastor helps his town overcome the aftershocks while his wife comes to grips with fear through her faith.

title: A New Breed of Criminal
description: Inspired by Stephen Sayers' rise from the backstreets of Newcastle's West End to the top of the criminal ladder and the authorities subsequent attempt to bring him crashing back down again.

title: A Perfect Day
description: Benicio del Toro & Tim Robbins star in this war zone comedy where a band of rescue workers are confronted with a crisis.

title: A Perfect Plan
description: Four notorious thieves wake up in a fortified warehouse and are forced to commit an audacious diamond heist to win their freedom.

title: A Perfect Plan
description: In Isabelle's family, every first marriage has ended in divorce. To circumvent the family's curse Isabelle devises a plan; marry and divorce a complete stranger before wedding her faultless fiancé Pierré.

title: A Pistol for Django
description: Django's fiancee was abducted. So he must rescue her but that's not very easy. The problem is that the kidnappers are the Cortez brothers and their gang.

title: A Prayer Before Dawn
description: Living in Bangkok, where he fights bare-knuckle in the local gyms, heroin addict Billy Moore (Joe Cole) is arrested and sent to Klong Prem jail for selling drugs...

title: A Private War
description: In a world where journalism is under attack, Marie Colvin (Academy Award nominee Rosamund Pike) is one of the most celebrated war correspondents of our time.

title: A Rainy Day in New York
description: Woody Allen’s romantic comedy A RAINY DAY IN NEW YORK tells the story of college sweethearts, Gatsby (Timothée Chalamet) and Ashleigh (Elle Fanning), whose plans for a romantic weekend together in New York City are dashed as quickly as the sunlight turns into showers.

title: A Score to Settle
description: After a diagnosis of a terminal illness Frank is released from prison to live out his final days as a free man. He must quickly decide what is more important…family or revenge.

title: A Ship of Human Skin
description: Two women go into the fringe of rural culture to seek a revelation. They get trapped in a fierce place, and one must kill a man with an axe in order to save her friend. While in prison, she levitates.

title: A Shot Through The Wall
description: A Chinese-American police officer's life unravels after he accidentally shoots an innocent Black man.

title: A Single Man
description: Previously featured at the London Film Festival. A SINGLE MAN, tells the story of a British professor who dwells on the past and cannot see his future. We follow him through a single day, where a series of events leads him to decide if there is meaning to life after the death of his partner,Jim.

title: A Sky Full of Stars for a Roof
description: Two drifters meet and soon become travelling companions. But one of them, Tim (Gemma), is being chased by a crazed killer and his band of gunmen to settle an old score.

title: A Slice of Chicago Romance
description: In a suburb of Chicago, Romanos & Juliatos, two pizza places, have competed for the town’s business for years. When both restaurants get passed down to—RILEY (30s) and SARAH (30s)—after a new pizza chain moves into town, the new bosses struggle to compete after they begin to fall for one another.

title: A Snapshot of Forever
description: After leaving her big city life behind, wedding photographer Jessie Brookes is happier than ever. When famous actor Nate Brown shows up on her parent’s vineyard for his sister’s wedding, she quickly realizes that there is more to him than meets the eye.

title: A Soldier's Revenge
description: Frank Connor is a Civil War hero turned bounty hunter that must face up to his past and head towards a showdown with a notorious major with whom he has an old score to settle.

title: A Stranger in Paso Bravo
description: A drifter returns to a small town to avenge the murder of his wife and daughter.

title: A Summer to Remember
description: Jessica Tucker, a widow and successful doctor, is trying to juggle work and family when she learns she’s up for the top job at the hospital.

title: A Taste of Love
description: A struggling TV chef returns home to find that her family’s restaurant is for sale, not able to compete with contemporary cuisine.  Trying to save it, she reconnects with her childhood sweetheart and finds the inspiration she was seeking.

title: A Tooth Fairy Tale
description: In a magical land divided by tradition, a rebellious tooth fairy and a daring goblin girl join forces on an epic quest to unite the kingdom!

title: A Week in Paradise
description: A film star with a newly broken heart jets off to paradise in the Caribbean, where she finds not only herself again, but maybe even a new love.

title: A.R.C.H.I.E
description: Isabel moves to a small town after losing her parents in a car accident. Alone and friendless, Isabel befriends a robot dog named A.R.C.H.I.E. Though he looks like a normal dog, he is anything but. He can talk, run at blinding speed, has super strength, x-ray vision and they become fast friends.

title: A.R.C.H.I.E 2: Mission Impawsible
description: In this sequel, the super intelligent artificial robotronic dog, Archie, befriends Gregory, a young boy who is the son of a carnival owner. Gregory is concerned that someone has been stealing from the carnival and enlists his new friend to help find the culprit.

title: Abduction
description: A thriller centered on a young man who sets out to uncover the truth about his life after finding his baby photo on a missing persons website.

title: About Heaven
description: Filmmaker Stéphane Goel goes out in search of answers about the existence of an idyllic place after death. Several Swiss in the fall of their lives, whether they are believers or atheists, tell us what they think about this idea.

title: Above and Below
description: Above and Below is a rough and rhythmic roller coaster ride seating five survivors in their daily hustle through an apocalyptic world.

title: Above Suspicion
description: In ABOVE SUSPICION, three-time Emmy Nominee EMILIA CLARKE plays Susan Smith, a destitute single mother with dreams of escaping her remote Appalachian town. Susan's prayers seem to be answered when a handsome and married FBI agent recruits her as his paid informant, offering her a way out.

title: Above The Clouds
description: When Charlie discovers her parents have hidden her real father from her, she does what any 18-year old would - recruits a homeless guy as her 'responsible adult' and sets off to Scotland on her provisional driving licence to go find him.

title: Above the Shadows
description: 'Above the Shadows' is a magic realism tale about a young woman who has faded to the point of becoming invisible and must find her way back into the world.

title: Absolute Boyfriend
description: Love is never easy, which is why Da Da (Minah) has sworn off men forever. The long-time girlfriend of a popular actor, Ma Wang Joon (Hong Jong Hyun), Da Da never had an easy love life.

title: Acceleration
description: Vladik, a crime lord whose tentacles permeate the underbelly of a seedy Los Angeles, finds himself double-crossed by his most trusted operative Rhona.

title: Accidental Family
description: A lonely girl finally finds the perfect family and the love of her life… they just don’t know it yet! They think she’s a long lost relative and he is unfortunately engaged to the wrong girl.

title: Accidental Love
description: A small town waitress gets a nail accidentally lodged in her head causing unpredictable behavior that leads her to Washington, D.C., where sparks fly when she meets a clueless young senator who takes up her cause - but what happens when love interferes with what you stand for?

title: Ace Crawford, Private Eye
description: Tim Conway stars as a hilariously incompetent private detective who can't stay out of hassles or accidents, all while trying to woo his dream woman.

title: Acidman
description: When Maggie tracks down her estranged and reclusive father, she discovers the paranormal phenomena that he has been investigating and together they attempt to make first contact.

title: Acts of Vengeance
description: A lawyer transforms his body and takes a vow of silence, not to be broken until he finds out who killed his wife and daughter.

title: Adam
description: When Adam is mistaken for a transgender man at a party, he decides to keep up a charade.

title: Adam Resurrected
description: In the aftermath of World War II, a former circus entertainer who was spared from the gas chamber becomes the ringleader at an asylum for Holocaust survivors.

title: Adiós Compañeros (Ballad of Django)
description: A lone gunman tracks down the members of an outlaw gang that killed his friends.

title: Adrift
description: Adrift is based on the inspiring true story of two sailors who set out to journey across the ocean from Tahiti to San Diego...

title: Adventure Mouse
description: Dreaming of adventure, city mouse Gamba joins a crew of Ship Mice ready to set sail - just as young Chuta bursts in, pleading for help. Stowing away on a boat, the gang heads for Dream Island to defend Chuta's family of mice against Noroi the White Weasel and his wicked weasel clan.

title: Adverse
description: A ride-share driver with a questionable past attempts to pay off a dangerous crime syndicate to save his sister. With nowhere else to turn, he is driven to retribution and must settle the debt…or die trying.

title: Affliction
description: Nick Nolte gives an Oscar Nominated performance as Wade, a washed-up, troubled cop who embarks on an unlawful investigation into a local shooting accident. Convinced that it's murder, Wade begins to jeopardise his own sanity in an obsessive pursuit for the truth.

title: Africa Express
description: John Baxter is a freight forwarder in Africa. His only friend is a very smart chimpanzee and his dream is to make some money quickly to go back to Detroit, and buy a gas station. But fate makes him meet Madeleine, a British spy looking for Robert Preston, and John’s life will take an unexpected turn

title: After Darkness
description: As the world suffers a solar catastrophe and light and heat become scarce, Raymond and his wife Georgina wait in their country home for a friend who is coming to take them to safety. After Darkness is a tense sci-fi thriller about the struggle for survival as the world ends.

title: After Life
description: After a horrific car accident, Anna (Christina Ricci) wakes up to find the funeral director (Liam Neeson) preparing her body for her funeral.

title: After The End
description: A coming-of- age story that follows a 17-year- old doomsday prepper in Oklahoma, who turns out to be right and prepares for everything except being lonely.

title: After The Wedding
description: Isabel (Michelle Williams) has devoted her life to running an orphanage in a Kolkata slum. With funds running dry, she lands uncomfortably in the sights of a possible benefactor, Theresa Young (Julianne Moore), a multi-millionaire media mogul. Theresa's life couldn't appear to be more perfect.

title: Afterglow
description: A handyman with marital problems meets a housewife with the same.

title: Afternoon Delight
description: Rachel, a stay-at-home mother, takes her husband to a strip club to make her marriage exciting. There, she meets a stripper, McKenna, and hires her as a nanny to bring a positive change in her life.

title: Against The Tides
description: It took five athletes a lifetime to complete the Oceans Seven, the swim challenge that consists of crossing the seven great sea channels of the world. In this documentary, one brave woman hopes to do it in just one year.

title: Ainbo: Spirit of the Amazon
description: Moana meets Brave with the hit new animation Ainbo: Spirit of the Amazon. The story of a young girl who was born and grew up in the deepest jungle of the Amazon.

title: Air
description: From award-winning director Ben Affleck, "Air" reveals the game-changing partnership between a then undiscovered Michael Jordan and Nike’s fledgling basketball division which revolutionized the world of sports and culture with the Air Jordan brand.

title: Air Bud
description: A lonely boy’s life is transformed when he befriends a “wonder” dog who teaches him to play basketball.

title: Air Bud: Golden Receiver
description: Buddy’s got a new trick up his paw – football. When Buddy’s owner suddenly becomes his school’s next quarterback, Buddy falls in with the huddle as well! The dynamite pairing of Buddy and Josh help carry the Timberwolves to the state championship.

title: Air Bud: Seventh Inning Fetch
description: With Josh off to college, Buddy joins the local baseball squad with his little sister Andrea. Once again, Buddy is a natural at anything with a ball! He is having a great season when suddenly, his puppies start to disappear from their homes!

title: Air Bud: Spikes Back
description: Buddy is taking his show to the beaches and getting into a whole new sport: beach volleyball! Life on the beach isn’t as relaxing as it sounds. A rash of mysterious crimes has been plaguing the town and paw prints at the scene seem to point all fingers at Buddy!

title: Air Bud: World Pup
description: Pup Star is back, and bigger than ever as the hit singing pup competition goes global! After achieving international stardom, Tiny the adorable Yorkie joins the inaugural Pup Star World Tour as a celebrity judge.

title: Air Buddies
description: The Next Generation in the famous Air Bud franchise is here!! This time it’s Air Bud’s five adorable puppies (The Buddies) and they’re off on a daring rescue mission to save their parents.

title: Airborne - The Last Stand
description: In Germany's Hurtgen Forest, during the final days of World War 2, an exhausted and overwhelmed band of American army paratroopers fight for survival amid a deadly hidden threat, escalating internal conflict and seemingly impossible odds.

title: Alex of Venice
description: Workaholic Alex (Winstead) must reinvent her life after her husband walks out, discovering her inner strength as she tries to hold her family together.

title: Ali Baba And The Pirates
description: Ali Baba sets out on the Sultan's magnificent sailing ship to find his brother and father. But the ship is wrecked on an island, where Ali finds his brother Tahieb. Leaving the island in search of their father, the two boys run into some shipwrecked pirates on a raft, who try to seize the ship.

title: Alien Code
description: After deciphering a message found in a satellite, genius cryptographer Alex Jacobs finds himself being stalked by government agents and otherworldly beings.

title: Alien Country
description: Reeling from the news of an unexpected pregnancy, Jimmy and Everly unknowingly release an alien invasion in their small town and learn to work together in order to save each other, their town and evidently, the entire galaxy.

title: Alien Reign of Man
description: Earth has fallen! A small team of humans are stranded on an alien planet, light years from home. They must work together to battle aliens and activate a machine that will restore earth to a time before it was destroyed.

title: Aliens Abducted My Parents and Now I Feel Kinda Left Out
description: Itsy (Emma Tremblay) is the new girl in a small town, with dreams of returning to the big city to pursue her dream career as a journalist.

title: Aliens in the Attic
description: An adventure/comedy about kids on a family vacation who must fight off an attack by knee-high alien invaders with world-destroying ambitions. At the same time the youngsters try to keep their parents in the dark about the battle upstairs.

title: Alive
description: In this twisted horror, a man and woman awake in an abandoned sanitarium to discover that a sadistic caretaker holds the keys to their freedom, and the horrific answers as to their real identity.

title: All for Love
description: When an engaged romance novelist is teamed with a Navy man as research for her latest book, she is taken aback by his boisterous personality and egotistical nature.

title: All Good Things
description: Two big-city teenage sisters are sent to their grandparents' farm for Christmas break against their wishes. While there, the sisters connect to their roots and help save the farm from foreclosure.

title: All Hallows’ Eve: Inferno
description: From an executive producer of Terrifier 2 comes All Hallows' Eve: Inferno, a new installment of the franchise that first introduced the world to Damien Leone's Art the Clown and the short film Terrifier.

title: All Hallows’ Eve: Trickster
description: When a lost traveler on Halloween night comes across an isolated rural gas station, she thinks she's found her way home. Unbeknownst to her, the eerie gas station is the residence of a family of degenerate, devilish creatures.

title: All I See is You
description: A blind woman's relationship with her husband changes when she regains her sight and discovers disturbing details about themselves.

title: All The Devil's Men
description: Jack Collins (Milo Gibson), a former Navy SEAL turned bounty hunter, tracks down terrorists in missions so hazardous that the CIA outsources them to private companies.

title: All the Lost Ones
description: In a dystopian and climate-ravaged future America torn apart by civil war, a group hiding in a remote cabin become the target of a ruthless rebel militia leader and his platoon, viciously hunted in a fight for survival.

title: All You Can Eat
description: A 280 pound 27-year-old diabetic decides to join a gym and eat healthy after being rejected by the girl of his dreams because she doesn’t want to be with a man who might die young from a heart attack like her father.

title: Almost Love
description: Adam and Marklin’s 5-year relationship has gone from a passionate flame to a simmer, forcing them to reconcile with each other’s shortcomings while their friends endlessly search for love in New York City.

title: Aloha
description: A celebrated military contractor returns to the site of his greatest career triumphs and re-connects with a long-ago love while unexpectedly falling for the hard-charging Air Force watchdog assigned to him.

title: Aloha Surf Hotel
description: An ex surf pro is forced to take a job at a beachfront hotel teaching obnoxious tourists how to surf. Soon he's the tennis pro, the yoga instructor, the handyman - he might even be key to saving this family-run, Hawaiian hotel.

title: Alone In Berlin
description: Alone in Berlin sees a couple in Nazi Germany stand up to Hitler and the SS regime after their son is killed in action. By placing postcards around Berlin with revolutionary messages on, the Quangel's hope to rally other anti-Hitler supporters, and disrupt the slow creep of war.

title: Alpha & Omega
description: Kate and Humphrey are two wolves who are trying to get home after being taken by park rangers and shipped halfway across the country. Back home rival wolf packs are on the march and conflict is brewing. Only Kate and Humphrey can restore the peace...

title: Altered Reality
description: A man is given a mysterious undiscovered miracle drug, selling it for billions.  When his young daughter unexpectedly vanishes, he learns that his family vacation spot allows time travel, offering him the chance to save her.

title: Altitude
description: Five teenage friends – including rookie pilot Sara (Jessica Lowndes of TV's 90210) – rent a small plane for a weekend getaway. But shortly into the flight, something suddenly goes wrong. The instruments begin to malfunction. The plane won’t stop climbing.

title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
description: A struggling songwriter named Dave Seville finds success when he comes across a trio of singing chipmunks: mischievous leader Alvin, brainy Simon, and chubby, impressionable Theodore.

title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
description: The vacationing Chipmunks and Chipettes are turning a luxury cruise liner into their personal playground, until they become "chipwrecked" on a remote island.

title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
description: Through a series of misunderstandings, Alvin, Simon and Theodore come to believe that Dave is going to propose to his new girlfriend in Miami... and dump them.

title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
description: The world famous singing pre-teen chipmunk trio return to contend with the pressures of school, celebrity, and a rival female music group known as The Chipettes.

title: Amelia 2.0
description: When the husband of a dying woman is approached by a corporation pioneering a new program to extend life through robotics, they get caught in a public debate over human's relationship with technology.

title: American Badger
description: The lives of a reclusive hitman and an abused call-girl collide in this action packed spectacle of deceit, redemption, and revenge.

title: American Carnage
description: A group of young ICE detainees join a program to provide care to the elderly. They soon realise something is seriously wrong with their elderly charges.

title: American Dharma
description: A portrait of controversial political strategist and former Donald Trump advisor, Steve Bannon.

title: American Dreamer
description: American Dreamer follows Phil Loder, an economics professor whose dream of homeownership seems impossible - until a widow offers him her estate for pennies in a life-changing twist.

title: American Sicario
description: Based on the true story of America's most dangerous drug trafficker "La Barbie"; Edgar Valdez, drug lord and cartel leader, works with the Feliz brothers.

title: American Siege
description: An ex-NYPD officer-turned-sheriff of a small rural Georgia town has to contend with a gang of thieves who have taken a wealthy doctor hostage.

title: American Stoner
description: Fed up with modern American living, two vagabonds rob a psychotic drug dealer and decide to flee the country, taking a road trip and beholding the beauties of the great American West, en route for Canada where they plan to start new lives.

title: American Summer
description: For a bullied overweight teen like Bobby, summer isn’t fun. With his parents fighting non-stop, his best friend away in New York and a job working all hours for a local real estate owner, he realises it’s time to learn how to stand up for himself.

title: American Traitor: The Trial of Axis Sally
description: American Traitor follows the life of American woman Mildred Gillars (Meadow Williams) and her lawyer (Al Pacino), who struggles to redeem her reputation.

title: Amish Abduction
description: Amish wife and mother Annie faces a crisis when her husband leaves the word of the Amish to live among “normal Americans,” or the “English” as the Amish dub them. But things turn even more dire when her husband returns, seeking custody of their son, and is willing to kill to achieve his goal…

title: Among The Shadows
description: Kirtsy is a private eye with a secret - she is descended from werewolves! Whilst investigating the murder of her uncle, she discovers a political conspiracy that goes right to the top. Now she must unravel the mystery of his death, while all the time trying to keep her true werewolf nature a secret.

title: Amsterdam
description: “Amsterdam” is an original crime epic about three friends at the center of a shocking secret plot.

title: An Accidental Studio
description: An Accidental Studio tells the remarkable story of HandMade Films. Featuring never-before-seen interviews, this feature-length documentary captures an extraordinary moment in film history through the eyes of the filmmakers and actors and the man who started it all, former Beatle George Harrison.

title: An American In Texas
description: An angry, crackling and defiantly disordered underclass of nowheresville punk-rock kids, see their band Surgeon General’s Warning (SGW) as their ticket out of small town Texas, as 1990 comes to a close.

title: An American Werewolf in London
description: Two American college students in London are bitten by a wolf with terrifying results -- one is killed while the other begins to have nightmares and starts to receive visits from his mutilated friend's ghost.

title: An Eskimo Tale
description: Far North. Autumn 1910. An encampment of Inuit nomads is threatened by famine and the situation is growing dire. Day after day, the hunters return empty-handed.

title: An Imperfect Murder
description: An Imperfect Murder is a cat and mouse thriller which will leave you guessing until the very end – staring Sienna Miller and Alec Baldwin.

title: An Intrusion
description: Sam and his family are terrorized by a malicious stalker...but as an investigation mounts, he fears the attacks may be related to secrets he has violently kept from his family and detectives.

title: An Irish Angel
description: Aine is a secondary school girl from the wrong side of the tracks, who lives in Portrush.

title: Anarchy Ride or Die
description: In a city where corruption reigns and the loyal are betrayed, Posthumus  and Imogen break the rules when they secretly marry. So erupts a war between dirty cops and outlaw bikers as a drug kingpin Cymbeline tries to protect his empire and the queen demands justice for their daughter.

title: Anatomy of a Fall
description: When her husband Samuel is mysteriously found dead in the snow below their secluded chalet, Sandra becomes the main suspect when the police begin to question whether he fell or was pushed.

title: And God Said to Cain
description: A man takes his revenge on the family responsible for his wrongful sentence to ten years of hard labor.

title: And So It Goes
description: A self-absorbed realtor enlists the help of his neighbor when he's suddenly left in charge of the granddaughter he never knew existed until his estranged son drops her off at his home.

title: Andromeda
description: Captain Dylan Hunt (Kevin Sorbo) and the crew of the Andromeda Ascendant set out on a mission to rebuild the Systems Commonwealth 300 years after its fall. Created by sci-fi legend Gene Roddenberry.

title: Andrés Iniesta, The Unexpected Hero
description: This is the story of a normal person who does extraordinary things. Someone who pursues and achieves triumphs through taking care of the small details, because these are, after all, the ones that make him a different soccer player.

title: Angelica
description: A couple living in Victorian London endure an unusual series of psychological and supernatural happenings following the birth of their child.

title: Animal Within
description: The film is a psychological thriller based on the director's own experiences. The story follows the rules of Greek Tragedy as the Greek Chorus narrates the fateful proceedings. The movie explores the often-overlooked effects of workplace sexual harassment on domestic relationships.

title: Anna and the Apocalypse
description: A zombie apocalypse threatens Little Haven - at Christmas - forcing Anna and her friends to fight, slash and sing their way to survival, facing the undead in a desperate race to reach their loved ones.

title: Another Happy Day
description: A wedding at her parents' Annapolis estate hurls high-strung Lynn into the center of touchy family dynamics.

title: Another World
description: In a post-apocalyptic future, a biological warfare program gone wrong leaves only four survivors defending themselves from "the infected" - mindless killers. As they struggle to survive and make sense of what is happening, they find another survivor, intent on revealing the truth.

title: Anti-Social
description: Marcus is a robber who leaves a trail of chaos as he leads his motorbike gang on an inner-city crime-wave, while younger brother, Dee, a graffiti artist, lashes out at society with his spray-cans, searching for a new way of life.

title: Anuktatop: The Metamorphosis
description: This beautiful hybrid film navigates between documentary and fiction to illustrate, from their imaginary, the changes faced by the Wayana, an indigenous community living between French Guiana and Suriname.

title: Anything Else
description: Jerry Falk (Jason Biggs), a young writer in New York City, leaves his girlfriend for free-spirited Amanda (Christina Ricci). Seeking advice, Jerry turns to an older, struggling artist who helps him deal with his messy love life.

title: Anything for a Friend
description: Two cowboys are robbed of their gold in the rocky mountains and decide to fight back by taking on the bandits.

title: Apartment 1BR
description: What if your neighbours weren’t who you thought they were? After leaving behind a painful past to follow her dreams, Sarah lands the perfect Hollywood apartment.

title: Apex Predator
description: Let the hunt begin. Serving a life sentence for a crime he did not commit, Jim (Bruce Willis - Die Hard, McClane) is offered a chance of freedom. But the price of freedom could be his life as he finds himself face to face with the world’s greatest hunters…

title: Apocalypse Earth
description: When Earth is invaded by a militant alien race, soldiers and civilians are loaded onto arc-like spaceships, to flee to habitable planets beyond the galaxy. One such group of survivors lands on a mysterious and seemingly alluring planet, only to discover they're not alone.

title: Apocalypse: End of Everything
description: Episodic stories include an engineer circling a black hole in a pod, a 14-year-old girl and her father on the return journey to earth when an explosion cripples their aircraft, and a self-conscious Artificial Intelligence goes to the 4th dimension to fix humanity's future.

title: Applewood: House of Secrets
description: After her husband's death, Kaitlynn continues his dream of renovating Applewood, an old Georgia Mansion. Struggling with grief, she begins to have flashbacks to a previous era. Can she solve the mysterious disappearance of 15-year old Lucy Applewood?

title: Arcadia
description: In the not too distant future, the population has risen to dangerous numbers and a deadly disease has gripped the world. To combat the death toll rising, 'Arcadia' has been built as a safe disease-free haven for the privileged, where life expectancy is more than 130 years.

title: Archenemy
description: Max Fist, who claims to be a hero from another dimension who fell through time and space to earth, where he has no powers.No one believes his stories except for a local teen named Hamster.

title: Arctic
description: Full of shock turns, moments of horrific injury, polar bear action and tense emotional scenes, Arctic will keep your hands clenched to your chair until its brilliant, breathless conclusion.

title: Arctic Void
description: When almost everyone vanishes from a tourist ship in the Arctic, a dark truth emerges that forces the three who remain to ally or perish.

title: Are You Here
description: When Steve Dallas hears that his friend Ben Baker has lost his estranged father, the two return to Ben's childhood home to discover Ben has inherited the family fortune.

title: Aristotle and Dante
description: Mexican teenagers Aristotle Mendoza and Dante Quintana explore their friendship while struggling with racial and ethnic identity, sexuality and family relationships in 1987 El Paso, Texas. Based on the book by Benjamin Alire Sáenz

title: Armour of God
description: Asian Hawk (Jackie Chan) and his bumbling sidekick are sent on a quest through Europe to find a mysterious treasure held by a shadowy organisation of monks. Presented here in a Brand New Restoration.

title: Armour of God 2: Operation Condor
description: Jackie, a talented treasure hunter, is hired to recover 240 tonnes of gold that a German commander, Hans von Katterling, and his regiment buried in the Sahara Desert before the end of World War II.

title: Armstrong
description: Neil Armstrong became NASA's most famous astronaut when his small step and giant leap changed the world forever on July 20 1969. Famously reticent about his accomplishments he preferred to focus on the team that helped to get him on the Moon rather than his own success.

title: Arranged
description: In "Arranged," three couples from different cultural backgrounds have one thing in common – the belief in arranged marriages. Viewers will follow each couple's relationship from the lead-up to their weddings through the months after.

title: Arrowhead
description: A tech is sprung from prison by a revolutionary leader who promises him an opportunity to save his father from a scheduled execution if he completes a data-stealing mission. But it goes awry, stranding him on a strange alien moon.

title: As Dreamers Do: The Amazing Life of Walt Disney
description: Behind every great mouse there is a man…Follow Walt Disney through his early life, as his ever growing imagination and eternal optimism lead to the birth of a legend.

title: As I Am
description: One week of school remains for Kai, an aspiring writer, and his friends. How they spend this time will cost one of them their life and leave them changed forever.

title: As of Yet
description: Told entirely through video calls and digital diaries, Naomi navigates a problematic roommate and a burgeoning romance all while locked down during the Coronavirus pandemic.

title: As They Made Us
description: Featuring a powerful performance from Dustin Hoffman, As They Made Us is moving drama about family and forgiveness.

title: Ascension
description: In 1963, the U.S. government launched a covert space mission sending hundreds of men, women and children on a century-long voyage aboard the starship Ascension to populate a new world.

title: Ashes
description: Frank (Ray Winstone) is confined to a residential home, stricken with Alzheimer's - past, present and future steadily disintegrating.

title: Asian Persuasion
description: An underachiever comes up with an outlandish plan to avoid alimony obligations to his fashion executive ex-wife.

title: Asier and I
description: Told in first person, the director of this documentary narrates the story of his friendship with Asier Aranguren, a member of the terrorist organization ETA.

title: Ask the dust
description: In 1930's Los Angeles, the love between a struggling writer (Colin Farrell) and a bold Mexican waitress (Salma Hayek) is put to the ultimate test.

title: Assassination
description: When an ex CIA agent discovers his family have been kidnapped he sets out to rescue them, only to discover they are being held hostage and won t be released unless he carries out a mission to assassinate the President.

title: Assault on VA-33
description: Decorated veteran and PTSD sufferer, Jason Hill (Flanery) meets his wife, Jennifer, for lunch at the Veteran's Affairs hospital where she works.

title: Astérix: Mansions of The Gods
description: In order to wipe out the Gaulish village, Caesar plans to have an estate built next to the village to start a new Roman colony.

title: At a Distance Spring is Green
description: The handsome son of a wealthy family, Yeo Joon (Park Ji Hoon) had what most people could only dream of having. Assigned to work together on a class project, Yeo Joon inexplicably finds himself drawn to his partner, Nam Soo Hyun (Bae In Hyuk).

title: At Eternity´s Gate
description: During a self-imposed exile in Arles and Auvers-Sur-Oise, France, Dutch painter Vincent van Gogh develops his unique, colorful style of painting.

title: ATM
description: After leaving their company Christmas Party together, David and Emily’s impromptu first date takes an unexpected turn when their co-worker, Corey, asks them to make a late-night stop at an ATM.

title: Attack of the Unknown
description: Like a cross between `Independence Day' and `Assault in Precinct 13'. A SWAT team transporting a high profile inmate through the streets of Los Angeles find themselves trapped inside a county detention centre as the world burns around them.

title: August
description: ‘Wall Street’, ‘Boiler Room’ and ‘Shattered Glass’ come crashing into the Internet Age in this intense, edge-of-your-seat and emotional tale about one man’s fight to keep his dreams alive during the dot-com collapse of 2001.

title: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery
description: In 1967, fashion photographer by day and super-agent by night Austin Powers (Mike Myers) is on the verge of catching his arch-nemesis, Dr Evil.

title: Automata
description: Fast forward fifty years into the future, planet earth is in the midst of gradual desertification. Mankind struggles to survive as the environment deteriorates and the slow regression of the human race begins in AUTÓMATA.

title: Avarice: Take Down Your Enemies
description: An Olympic level archer must rescue her investment banker husband after he is abducted by a team of mercenaries during a vicious home invasion.

title: Away
description: Joseph and Ria are kindred spirits, both looking for a way out. Ria wants out of this town and is trying to scrape enough money together to get her and her friend, Kaz, away to the coast.

title: Away From Her
description: A double-Oscar-nominated, beautifully subtle exploration of Alzheimer's disease.

title: Awoken
description: A medical student attempts to cure her brother from a terminal sleep illness, but a more sinister reason for his condition is revealed.

title: Baby Assassins
description: Chisato and Mahilo are two high school girls who are about to graduate. They also happen to both be highly skilled assassins. When the organization they work for orders them to share a room, the relationship between turns sour.

title: Babysitter Must Die
description: The young babysitter of a wealthy family uses the skills she honed at camp to fight a pack of intruder cultists through a long night of terror.

title: Backtrace
description: Brought to you by the producers of 2 Guns and Escape Plan, action legend and three-time Academy Award® nominee Sylvester Stallone (Rocky, The Expendables) stars in this riveting crime thriller that hinges on memory, fury, and betrayal.

title: Bad Behaviour
description: Chaos ensues at a spiritual retreat when troubled former actor, Lucy (Oscar winner Jennifer Connelly), becomes obsessed with a fellow celebrity guest.

title: Bad Blood
description: Hannah (Abigail Breslin) is a bright teen girl trapped in the dark Southern underworld of violence, guns, drugs and vicious biker gangs. Neglected by her angry sister Amber (Alexa Vega), her only refuge is her troubled uncle Donny, who is a drug addict.

title: Bad Ink
description: In "Bad Ink," tattoo artist Dirk Vermin and his sidekick Ruckus search out Sin City's most cringe-worthy tattoos and the strange stories behind them.

title: Bad Investigate
description: Romeu, a corrupt cop, hires the services of Cid and Alex, to catch a notorious criminal, who left Mexico and is on his way to Galicia, Spain to find the killer of his brother, also trying to catch the same criminal is an FBI agent.

title: Bad Lieutenant
description: While investigating a young nun's rape, a corrupt New York City police detective, with a serious drug and gambling addiction, tries to change his ways and find forgiveness and redemption.

title: BAM!
description: The lives of gig economy workers intersect as they try to make ends meet in Chicago. A non binary bike messenger delivers sexy toys, two sisters deliver art, and two roommates sell drugs for their friend while he's on vacation.

title: Banana Joe
description: Bud Spencer is Banana Joe, a banana trader who defends a village and its inhabitants from the aims of a shady character.

title: Bandidas
description: Two women become bank robbers to help the poor and seek revenge on a ruthless land baron.

title: Bang Bang Club
description: Four photographers, collectively known as the Bang Bang Club, travel to South Africa to document the bloody final days of the country's white apartheid government. Based on the memoir by Bang Bang Club members Greg Marinovich and Joao Silva.

title: Banksy Most Wanted
description: The infamous yet mystery graffiti artist Banksy has left his mark across the world. But behind the stunts, the stories and the political statements is one of art’s biggest unanswered questions... who is Banksy?

title: Barbie Doll Adventures 1
description: Barbie and Barbie welcome you to the NEW Doll World! Join the Dolls for adventures, dancing, and fun in Fantasylocationlandplace, Reveal World and You Can Be Anything Land!

title: Barbie Doll Adventures 2
description: Welcome BACK to Doll World! A beautiful place where all dolls live and play in harmony with a shared goal of inspiring future generations of girls to dream big and be anything!

title: Barbie Dream Besties: The Dream DJ Festival
description: Get ready for more fashion, bigger dreams, and juicier drama with the Dream Besties; Barbie, Barbie, Teresa, Renee, Daisy, and Ken!

title: Barbie Dream Vacation
description: Barbie and her sisters set sail for the dreamiest vacation ever on the pink island oasis of Imagination Bay!​ The girls sing, dance, and explore their imaginations in ways we've never seen before​!

title: Barbie Dreamtopia: Festival of Fun
description: Barbie: Dreamtopia is an all-new magical, make-believe world imagined by Chelsea, Barbie’s youngest sister. Join Chelsea and her puppy Honey as they swim through rainbow rivers with beautiful mermaids and fly through cotton candy clouds with fairies.

title: Barbie: Big City Big Dreams
description: Discover double the singing and double the fun in the all-new musical movie Barbie Big City, Big Dreams™.

title: Barbie: Dream Besties
description: "Dream Besties" Barbie, Barbie, Teresa, Renee, Daisy, and Ken explore their biggest dreams in an alternate reality where anything is possible! The Dream Besties inspire each other to pursue their passions and believe in themselves! Live Out Your Best Dreams!

title: Barbie: Dream Magic
description: In Barbie: Dream Magic, Barbie discovers that true magic lies not in spells or enchantments, but in believing in yourself and the power of dreams.

title: Barbie: Dream Squad
description: When Chelsea discovers a magical music box in Barbie and Barbie's dance studio, the music box projects rainbow holograms, showing the girls who needs help in Dreamworld! ​Barbie, Barbie & co. spring into action and form the Dream Squad! ​

title: Barbie: Dreamtopia
description: Barbie's youngest sister Chelsea is entered into a local bike race by her friend, she is embarrassed about not being able to ride without training wheels. Inspired by Barbie's stories, Chelsea finds herself transported to the magical world of Dreamtopia, where her imagination runs wild.

title: Barbie: Fashion Stories
description: Barbie and Barbie work together to fix a technical glitch in the new Dreamhouse and host the best housewarming party ever, complete with 'Get Ready With Me' video tutorials!

title: Barbie: Life in the City
description: Join me, Barbie "Brooklyn" Roberts, for my exciting new digital diary about New York City!

title: Barbie: Summer Adventure
description: Barbie, Barbie & her sisters are excited for the first day of summer break, but things don't go according to plan! Things take an unexpected twist and turn into a wild adventure filled with fashion, hair styling, ice cream messes, & more!

title: Barbie: The Barbie Band
description: For over 62 years, Barbie has led girls on a path to self-discovery and helped them to imagine the possibilities. After over 180 inspirational careers, Barbie—along with her friends and family—continues to inspire and encourage the next generation of girls that they can be anything.

title: Barcelona: Surf Destination
description: Tokyo, 2020. For the first time in history, surfing became recognised as an Olympic sport and named its first men's champion: Brazilian Ítalo Ferreira. In “Barcelona: Surf Destination”, Ferreira travels to Barcelona, Spain to check out the waves and the surf community in this coastal metropolis.

title: Battle for Skyark
description: In the near future the earth has become desolate and dangerous. Now inhabited by by a mysterious race of creatures, humanity has been forced to find refuge in the Skyark, a man-made city in the sky.

title: Battle in Seattle
description: In November 1999, Seattle broke into a full-scale state of emergency as thousands of peaceful protestors gathered in resistance to the World Trade Organization. The city’s mayor, a SWAT cop on the streets and four demonstrators are caught in the crossfire as their lives intersect in theriots.

title: Battle of the Bulge
description: Battle Of The Bulge is an epic film starring Tom Berenger, set during the last great battle of World War II over Christmas 1944, when Germany make one final push against the attacking allied armies.

title: Battle Over Britain
description: At the height of the Battle of Britain, a handful of exhausted spitfire pilots fight to the last man in defence of their country, in this brand new World War II drama from the producers of Lancaster Skies and Spitfire Over Berlin.

title: Be Cool
description: John Travolta is back as Mafia loan shark turned Hollywood Producer Chili Palmer in this sharp sequel to "Get Shorty." With an unbelievably hip all-star cast that also includes Uma Thurman, André 3000, Steve Tyler, Christina Milian and The Rock, and bursting with the hottest music in the biz.

title: Be Natural: The Untold Story of Alice Guy-Blaché
description: When Alice Guy-Blaché completed her first film in 1896 Paris, she was not only the first female filmmaker, but one of the first directors ever to make a narrative film. In Be Natural, Pamela B. Green acts as a detective, revealing the real story of Guy-Blaché.

title: Bear-Like
description: Immersed in the heart of the wild, filmmaker Roman Droux and bear researcher David Bittner show us what life is like for wild grizzlies in their own natural habitat.

title: Beasts Clawing At Straws
description: In this slick crime thriller, the lives of 10 strangers collide and come crashing down when a shopkeeper finds an abandoned bag stuffed with money. Starring Academy Award winner Yuh-Jung Youn (Minari).

title: Beats
description: Two best friends in a small Scottish town in the summer of '94 who head out for one last night together before life takes them in different directions.

title: Beaus Of Holly
description: When Holly proposes to Phil, he admits he needs closure with an ex. Heartbroken, she confides in sleigh driver Jake, who offers unexpected comfort. Is Phil her true love, or is Jake the Christmas miracle she’s been waiting for?

title: Beautiful Things
description: Beautiful Things is a journey into our obsessive consumption. The many objects we accumulate and we believe to be essential begin their production journey in silent secluded industrial and scientific sites.

title: Because We're Done
description: A married man going thru a mid life crisis believes that the fate of his marriage rest solely in his hands. Only to learn that the ultimate decision will be made by his wife.

title: Becoming Me
description: Born a woman, Marion decides to become Marian, a man. This documentary follows Marian over 10 years documenting her gender change. Can she really be who she is in a society that questions her?

title: Bedazzled
description: Elliot Richards is a hapless young man consumed by unrequited love, and desperate to change his life, he makes a deal with the Devil who slyly promises to do just that - for a price.

title: Bee Season
description: Richard Gere stars in this gripping tale about a father obsessed with training his talented daughter for the National Spelling Bee.

title: Before Dawn
description: Jim Collins (Levi Miller), a young man from the outback, leaves his family-run sheep station to join the soldiers on the western front with hopes of making a difference. Soon, the realities of the muddy, ruthless, and entirely unforgiving war take their toll on a guilt-ridden Jim.

title: Before You Know It
description: An unmissable New-York- based “dramedy” in the vein of Woody Allen. Stage manager Rachel (Hannah Pearl Utt) is the only thing standing between her family and utter chaos. She then discovers that her presumed-dead mother (Judith Light: Transparent) is alive and thriving as a soap-opera star!

title: Behind The Line - Escape to Dunkirk
description: Occupied France, 1940. A Nazi Commander discovers one of his prisoners, Danny (Sam Gittins) is a champion boxer. He forces him to fight for his companies entertainment.

title: Being Bruno Banani
description: This is the extraordinary story of Bruno Banani, the only inhabitant of the small island of Tonga, in the South Pacific, to qualify for the winter Olympic games.

title: Being Frank: The Chris Sievey Story
description: The official documentary about maverick Manchester comedian Frank Sidebottom, and the life and art of his hidden creator Chris Sievey.

title: Being the Ricardos
description: During one production week of their hit television show "I Love Lucy," stars Lucille Ball and Desi Arnaz face a series of personal and professional crises that threaten their show, their careers and their marriage in this behind-the-scenes drama.

title: Bel Canto
description: A famous soprano (Julianne Moore) travels to South America to give a private concert at a party for a wealthy Japanese industrialist (Ken Watanabe).

title: Belly of the Beast
description: In this action-packed flick, a former CIA agent (Steven Seagal) goes to Thailand to rescue his daughter from the clutches of an Islamic terrorist group.

title: Ben and Charlie
description: Two outlaws, companions in adventure, meet after jail and try to make their fortunes together, but soon get into trouble. With G. Gemma.

title: Beneath Hill 60
description: A platoon of tunnelers fight to protect a tunnel system packed with enough explosives to change the course of the War.

title: Benji: Off the Leash!
description: Lost on the streets of a small Mississippi town, Benji and some unlikely friends work together to rescue his sick mother, all the while evading two dopey dogcatchers.

title: Bennett's Song
description: When two very unique and diverse families with 7 kids each collide, they find laughs, music, love, and a few answers about what it means to be a t-so-rmal American family in the 21st century.

title: Bermondsey Tales: Fall of the Roman Empire
description: When a powerful London crime boss falls ill, an ensuing succession crisis spirals out of control as family loyalties are tested, and rivalries ignite.

title: Bernard
description: Bernard is a hapless anthropomorphic polar bear who always tries to fix the troubles that regularly occur in each episode, but only succeeds in doing even worse damage, often even physically hurting himself. The character does not speak, but expresses himself with gestures and noises.

title: Betrayed
description: When the Cartel comes to Detroit and tries to push the Russian Mafia out, things don’t go as planned. The Mayor must do whatever it takes to get his kidnapped daughter back.

title: Betrayed
description: Five years after her husband David (Michael Bergin) was killed in a tragic car accident, Linda (Emmanuelle Vaugier) has picked up the shattered pieces and moved on with her life.

title: Better Criminal
description: A police officer is forced to work for two warring crime syndicates while under an internal investigation.

title: Between The Lights
description: When skeptical scientist Alice falls for reluctant medium Jay, she's taken on an odyssey of love, loss and discovery that will turn her world upside down.

title: Between us
description: Henry and Dianne fear that settling down means giving up on their dreams. It will take the universe conspiring to keep them apart for them to realize just how much they need each other.

title: Between Waves
description: When a best-selling author has a midlife crisis, he returns to his coastal hometown and embarks on a wild adventure in a desperate attempt to reclaim his youth.

title: Beyond Hatred
description: A family of pioneers is almost completely destroyed by Indians in search of revenge: Little George was left fainted on the ground, and his small sister adopted by the Indian chief. Fate will bring them together again.

title: Beyond Sixty
description: Conceived as a kind of carousel of inspiring stories of women over sixty, this documentary will change your preconception of old age and femininity.

title: Beyond the Gates
description: Two estranged brothers reunite at their missing father's video store to liquidate the property and sell off his assets.

title: Beyond the Law
description: A former mobster turned businessman and a police detective must contend with a dirty ex-cop looking to bring the killer of his son to justice.

title: Beyond the Neon
description: A dangerous social experiment performed by a reckless YouTuber and his crew exposes human sex trafficking in Las Vegas.

title: Beyond the Sky
description: Chris is a filmmaker whose father was always convinced his own wife was abducted by Aliens and Chris now wants to expose the hoax about the alien abduction that destroyed his family.

title: Biarritz Surf Gang
description: "Biarritz Surf Gang" reveals the true story of six lunatic surfers who set fire to their surfboards at Biarritz' Grande Plage, in the 1980s. The local crew, inspired by the punk movement, had a thirst for trouble and breaking the law.

title: Big Boys
description: A teenage boy's unexpected crush turns a camping trip into a weekend of self-discovery in this heartwarming coming-of-age comedy, starring a Best Breakthrough Performance from lead talent Isaac Krasner.

title: Big Boys Gone Bananas!*
description: In order to release a documentary that unveils the implementation of banned pesticides in banana plantations in Central America, two filmmakers will have to face the opposition of one of the largest agricultural multinational corporations.

title: Big House
description: Two sisters have their plans for a fun weekend getaway with their boyfriends interrupted by an unexpected guest.

title: Big Kill
description: A tenderfoot from Philadelphia, two misfit gamblers on the run, and a deadly preacher have a date with destiny in a boom town gone bust called Big Kill.

title: Big Momma's House
description: FBI agent Malcolm Turner is known best for being a brilliant, master of disguise. Malcolm's latest assignment sends him to small-town Georgia, where he's assigned to trap a brutal bank robber who the FBI suspects will be coming down to visit his ex-girlfriend Sherry and her son.

title: Big Momma's House 2
description: Undercover Agent Malcolm Turner is back and this time he's out to expose the suspected designer of a deadly computer "worm" that would allow outside forces access to sophistical and critical government intelligence files.

title: Big Mommas: Like Father, Like Son
description: Big Momma is back — and this time he has big backup: his teenage stepson Trent (Brendan T. Jackson). Martin Lawrence returns as FBI agent Malcolm Turner and as Turner’s deep-cover alter-ego Big Momma.

title: Billie
description: The definitive story of Billie Holiday, the world’s greatest and most controversial jazz singer, is now revealed through a wealth of never-before-heard taped interviews and research undertaken by the journalist Linda LipnackKuehl.

title: Birdman
description: A black comedy that tells the story of an actor who struggles to mount a Broadway play. In the days leading up to opening night, he battles his ego and attempts to recover his family, his career, and himself.

title: Birds Like Us
description: The story follows a group of birds on a journey where they try to find a better life for themselves and the ones they love.

title: Birth Days
