description: Oh no! The mischievous Jabberwock has stolen the dreams of all the inhabitants of the galaxy! Enter Captain Snow White and the crew of the Fairytale Fun Force the superpowered team of fairytale heroes, King Arthur, Little Red Riding Hood, Pinocchio and Robin Hood!

title: Falling
description: John lives with his partner, Eric, and their daughter, Mónica in California, far from the traditional rural life he left behind years ago.

title: Falling For A Killer
description: An Assistant District Attorney’s younger sister’s fiancé seems too good to be true. As she learns of his dark past and his behavior becomes more bizarre, she must convince her family of the truth or risk none of them surviving.

title: Famous
description: Interracial brothers in the music business are opposites at life, love and sobriety.

title: Fanboys
description: A group of Star Wars fans travel to Skywalker Ranch to steal a copy of "The Phantom Menace" so that their terminally ill friend can see it before it's released in cinemas several months later.

title: Fast Food Nation
description: The hit satirical mockumentary taking a deep dive into the health issues and social consequences of America's love affair with fast food.

title: Fast Forward
description: Fast Forward is a five-episode documentary series that looks into the future through emerging technologies aimed to tackle some of the most vital challenges that the world is facing today.

title: Fasthand
description: A gang of former confederates lay siege to a Cavalry fort.

title: Father of Invention
description: Robert Axle (Kevin Spacey of AMERICAN BEAUTY, HORRIBLE BOSSES), an eccentric inventor-turned-egomaniacal-infomercial-guru, loses it all when one of his inventions maims thousands of customers.

title: Fear Inc.
description: A horror junkie and his friends sign up with a company that brings their customer's greatest fears to life.

title: Fear of Rain
description: Fear of Rain is a twisty, unsettling and terrifying horror thriller starring Katherine Heigl (Knocked Up, Firefly Lane), Madison Iseman (Jumanji franchise, Annabelle Comes Home) and Harry Connick Jr. (PS. I Love You), that will keep you guessing whether there is real horror hiding next door.

title: Fear the Night
description: Follows Iraqi war veteran Tess, as she prepares to strike back after a group of home invaders attack during her sister's bachelorette party, and she discovers that they are hellbent on not leaving any witnesses behind.

title: Fighting Demons
description: Ex-boxer and former alcoholic, Vian, just got out of prison after serving time for a fatal accident and is desperate for a fresh start. He moves in with his sister Bethley and her son with the understanding that he will not drink at all.

title: Film Stars Don't Die In Liverpool
description: Liverpool, 1978: What starts as a vibrant affair between a legendary femme fatale, the eccentric Academy Award®-winning actress Gloria Grahame, and her young lover, British actor Peter Turner (Bell), quickly grows into a deeper relationship, with Turner being the person Gloria turns to for comfort.

title: Filth
description: Bruce Robertson, a bigoted and corrupt policeman, is in line for a promotion and will stop at nothing to get what he wants. Enlisted to solve a brutal murder and threatened by the aspirations of his colleagues, Bruce sets about ensuring their ruin.

title: Final Kill
description: An aging protection specialist takes on one last job before retirement, protecting a couple who stole eight million dollars from a ruthless crime family.

title: Find Me Guilty
description: The true story of mobster Jack DiNorscio and the longest mafia trial in US history. Charged with drug dealing, Jack decides to defend himself in court, despite having no legal experience. Can this New York wise guy convince a jury he's not the monster he's portrayed as?

title: Finding Altamira
description: 1879, nine-year-old Maria Sautuola and her father, Marcelino, discover the first cave art and accomplished paintings of galloping bison. But Maria's mother, devout Conchita, is disturbed at the idea that prehistoric savages could have created such magnificent art.

title: Finding Hope Home
description: Filmmakers Wambui Ndegwa and Cole Lewis make the Kenyan reality visible through the story of a family that began adopting homeless children in Nairobi in 1996.

title: Finding Jesus
description: Join faith-fueled friends, Muggles and Joy, as they visit the beautiful Finding Jesus Bay, a place where Christian stories are told night and day! Guided by the sea's best storyteller, Professor Shark, they hear all about the endless kindness and boundless love of their Creator!

title: Finding Jesus 2
description: Join faith-fueled friends, Muggles and Joy, as they visit the beautiful Finding Jesus Bay, a place where Christian stories are told night and day! Guided by the sea's best storyteller, Professor Shark, they hear all about the endless kindness and boundless love of their Creator!

title: Finding Steve McQueen
description: Based on the true story of the Youngstown mob, President Richard Nixon, the FBI, and the biggest bank heist in US history! In 1972, a gang of likeminded thieves plan a heist to steal $30 million in illegal campaign contributions from the President's secret fund.

title: Fire on the Amazon
description: A photojournalist (Craig Sheffer) and an environmental activist (Sandra Bullock) investigate the murder of a famous environmentalist deep in the hot and steamy Amazonian jungle.

title: Firecracker
description: When a heist goes dramatically wrong, leaving a hostage in peril, an unlikely trio find themselves fighting for their lives and their sanity on bonfire night.

title: Firehouse Dog
description: Hollywood's most pampered pooch gets lost during a commercial shoot and ends up as the mascot for a local fire station.

title: First Date
description: After being conned into buying a shady '65 Chrysler, Mike's first date plans with girl-next-door Kelsey implode as he finds himself targeted by criminals, cops, and a crazy cat lady.

title: First Daughter
description: Samantha Mackenzie wants what every college freshman desires: to experience life away from home and parents. It's not going to be easy, however, because home for Sam is the White House, and her dad is the President of the United States.

title: First Snow
description: A psychic's ominous predictions send a man into a tailspin.

title: Fitting In
description: In this coming-of-age drama, 16 year-old Lindy's life plans are thrown off course when she is diagnosed with a life changing reproductive condition. In coming to terms with the news she must rethink her presumptions about womanhood, her relationships and her sense of self.

title: Five Fingers For Marseilles
description: In this bold and brutal Western, a gang of outlaws fight over the fate of Marseilles.

title: Five Nights in Maine
description: A man, reeling from the tragic loss of his wife, travels to rural Maine to seek answers from his estranged mother-in-law, who is herself confronting grief. With David Oyelowo and Dianne Wiest.

title: Fixed
description: On the night low-level gambler, Daz Clemance is leaving Birmingham to start a crime-free life with his girlfriend in Spain, he's accused of fixing a bareknuckle fight in a warehouse. He is beaten, stabbed and locked in a cupboard.

title: Flag Day
description: John Vogel (Sean Penn) lives a double life as a counterfeiter, bank robber and con man in order to provide for his daughter Jennifer (Dylan Penn).

title: Flashback
description: After an encounter with a man from his past, Fred experiences terrifying flashbacks.

title: Flight 7500
description: A flight from Los Angeles to Tokyo is rocked by turbulence—and a terrifying force is unleashed in this spine-chilling journey into fear from the director of The Grudge.

title: Flirting With Love
description: Two male actors/close friends want to jumpstart their careers. They end up making a big shot producer think that they have a hot script that everyone wants to get their hands on.

title: Flow
description: Sam, 76, a retired poet, is thrown out of his own home by his daughter. His son Bo leaves him at an assisted living facility where old age takes over. Bored out of his mind he approaches another resident Carl and asks him to record a rap song.

title: Flypaper
description: A man caught in the middle of two simultaneous robberies at the same bank desperately tries to protect the teller with whom he's secretly in love.

title: For a Few Dollars Less
description: A bank clerk and his cousin, a "general", join forces to track down a Mexican outlaw.

title: Forbidden City Cop
description: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities but a talent for making futuristic machines and must save the kidnapped emperor.

title: Forensic Files: A Special Tribute
description: 25 years after its premiere, "Forensic Files" remains the most successful true crime series of all time. Inspired by the O.J. Simpson murder case, the series succeeded 400 episodes proving science catches the bad guys.

title: Forever In My Heart
description: Jenna and Charlie found love in Ireland but their dreams drove them apart. Five years later, they reunite and Jenna has to decide where her heart belongs—back home or in the Emerald Isle.

title: Forgetting Dad
description: A man suffers a minor car accident, and a week later constructs a new identity, claiming he can't "remember" being a father. Nearly twenty years later, his amnesia persists, yet no brain damage or physical cause are ever found.

title: Forgotten Soldiers
description: A four-man team sent from headquarters to repair a com-station suddenly falls into a terrorist ambush on the peaks of a mountain.

title: Fortress
description: Fortress is an all-out-action cyber thriller from the producers of Lone Survivor and The Irishman and starring the action powerhouse Bruce Willis, Escape Plan II’s Jesse Metcalfe, One Tree Hill’s Chad Michael Murray and Shannen Doherty (90210, Charmed).

title: Fortress: Sniper's Eye
description: Fortress: Sniper’s Eye is an explosive, all-out-action cyber-thriller starring action megastar Bruce Willis with Jesse Metcalfe (Escape Plan II) and Chad Michael Murray (Riverdale).

title: Fortunes of War
description: When a raid in Normandy goes wrong, a British commando team find themselves holed up in a barn, cut off from their comrades and encircled by Wehrmacht forces. Survival seems unlikely until an unexpected discovery offers them a chance at escape.

title: Foster Boy
description: A for-profit Foster care agency puts a known sex offender into the same foster home as a lawyer's young client, Jamal, with catastrophic results.

title: Found Footage
description: An acclaimed documentary crew quickly realizes they have triggered a real and terrifying rampage when sinister phenomena begin to unfold as they chronicle a budding filmmaker as he creates the world’s greatest “found footage” horror film on Bigfoot.

title: Four Came to Kill Sartana
description: Seven masked bandits kidnap young Susy, cousin of the mayor of Clayton City, Frank Clonny. Frank accepts the $15,000 ransom requested by the bandits and thinks of a plan which will permit him to recover the money and capture the outlaws.

title: Four Pistols For Trinity
description: A girl escapes death at the hands of some bandits and leaves, taking with her the valuable documents they wanted to take possession of. A journalist and a sheriff, who intends to find the bandits, protect her, but the showdown is near.

title: Frances Ha
description: The tale of one New York dancer and her joyful (yet hilarious) pursuit of her dreams.

title: Frank & Penelope
description: A tale of love and violence when a man on his emotional last legs finds a savior seductively dancing in a run-down strip club. And a life most certainly headed off a cliff suddenly becomes redirected - as EVERYTHING is now worth dying for.

title: Free Birds
description: On a quaint, family-owned farm, a giant turkey flock lives a quiet, corn-stuffed life. All everyone cares about is feeding time and grazing in the sun and being in “Turkey Paradise.” Everyone, that is, except for Reggie, a whipsmart turkey who is an outcast among his flock.

title: Freeheld
description: Diagnosed with terminal cancer, decorated New Jersey detective Laurel Hester (Julianne Moore) wishes to leave her pension benefits to domestic partner Stacie Andree (Elliot Page).

title: Freehold
description: An oily, amoral estate agent is preyed upon by one of his victims, who quietly moves into his flat and, unseen, begins a deliciously malicious campaign of revenge.

title: Freshman Year
description: Lonely college freshman Alex has closed himself off from his peers, who all appear to have this whole "college thing" figured out. But everything changes one night when Alex takes a leap and attends a legendary frat party, where he forges a strong connection with Maggie.

title: From Below
description: A couple on a romantic getaway find themselves stranded at sea when a tropical storm sweeps away their villa. In order to survive, they are forced to fight the elements, while sharks circle below.

title: From Time to Time
description: In 1940s England, thirteen year old Tolly is sent to Green Knowe, the country estate of his grandmother, while his mother searches for any information concerning his missing in action father. Tolly soon finds that he can pass through time to witness the family stories Grandmother Oldknow tells him.

title: Frozen Ground
description: An Alaska State Trooper partners with a young woman who escaped the clutches of serial killer Robert Hansen to bring the murderer to justice. Based on actual events.

title: Fukushima 50
description: Workers at the Fukushima Daiichi facility in Japan risk their lives and stay at the nuclear power plant to prevent total destruction after the region is devastated by an earthquake and tsunami in 2011.

title: Funhouse Massacre
description: Six of the world's scariest psychopaths escape from a local Asylum and proceed to unleash terror on the unsuspecting crowd of a Halloween Funhouse whose themed mazes are inspired by their various reigns of terror.

title: Future My Love
description: A unique love story challenging our collective and personal utopias in search of freedom. At the brink of losing the idealistic love of her life, filmmaker Maja Borg takes us on a poetic road trip through the financial collapse...

title: Fuzzy the Hero
description: Tequila and Bobo travel to the town of Chedron with the intention of robbing the local bank whose owner, De Koven, is trying to oust all ranchers in the area by the simple expedient of foreclosing on the mortgages his bank holds on their land.

title: Fyre Fraud
description: FYRE FRAUD is a true-crime comedy exploring a failed music festival turned internet meme at the nexus of social media influence, late-stage capitalism, and morality in the post-truth era.

title: G-Loc
description: In a world on the brink of environmental collapse, mass migration to neighbouring planet, Rhea, is humanity's final hope for survival.

title: G.B.H.
description: A bouncer is called in to help fight off a mob boss who is trying to take over local night clubs.

title: Gambit
description: Harry Deane is a man with a plan. Art curator for media tycoon Lord Lionel Shahbandar, Harry devises an elaborate plot to con Shahbandar into purchasing a fake Monet painting.

title: Gangland Revenge
description: After his son is killed in a gang hit, a father must protect his broken family and seek justice. Drawing on his past as a fighter, he enters the brutal gangland underworld to take down his son’s killers. Gangland Revenge is a tense British crime thriller.

title: Gardens of the Night
description: In this harrowing story of survival, a teenage boy and girl find themselves living on the streets after being abducted as children and suffering years of abuse. With John Malkovich.

title: Garringo
description: Johnny witnesses the murder of his father, an officer accused of treason. Adopted by a sheriff, Johnny grows up with the trauma of this crime and leads a double life. The friendly and loving young man is in reality a wild outlaw.

title: Gatlopp: Hell of a Game
description: Jumanji meets Escape Room. It’s going to be one hell of a game. Four friends reunite for game night to forget the trauma of adult life. With mischief, booze and mayhem on the cards, are they playing the game or is the game playing them?

title: Genius
description: Nicole Kidman and Colin Firth star in this stirring drama about the friendship between Thomas Wolfe and editor Maxwell Perkins (who discovered F. Scott Fitzgerald and Ernest Hemingway).

title: Ghost Killers vs. Bloody Mary
description: Four YouTubers with expertise in supernatural events are seeking recognition from the audience whilst solving the urban legend of the Bathroom Blonde Case. The spirit that haunts the schools' bathroom in Brazil.

title: Ghoster
description: An inquisitive girl and her father must unravel the secrets of Echoville Manor which has held the world's cutest spirit Ghoster captive for 50 years, before Yuto the ghost dragon wipes them all out in his quest for immortality.

title: Ghosthunters: On Icy Trails
description: When the often-fearful eleven-year-old Tom discovers a slimy green ghost in his cellar called Hugo, he is understandably afraid. However, Tom soon realises that Hugo, who is an ASG (Averagely Spooky Ghost), is not only completely harmless but also desperately in need of his help.

title: Giallo
description: An FBI agent with deep rooted past issues is on the prowl for the infamous serial killer, "Giallo (Yellow)" as he is known. No ordinary killer... he seeks victims that are beautiful women only to disfigure and eventually kill them off.

title: Giant Little Ones
description: Franky and Ballas have been best friends since childhood. They are high school royalty: handsome, stars of the swim team and popular with girls. They live a perfect teenage life – until the night of Franky's 17th birthday party, when they're involved in an incident that changes their lives forever.

title: Girl Asleep
description: The world is closing in on Greta Driscoll. On the cusp of turning fifteen she can't bear to leave her childhood, it contains all the things that give her comfort in this incomprehensible new world.

title: Girl Gang
description: 14-year-old Leonie from eastern Berlin is conquering the world as a teenage influencer. She has millions of followers and companies shower her with products. When Leonie‘s parents recognize the enormous economic potential in their daughter, they decide to take over her management.

title: Girl Most Likely
description: Kristen Wiig stars as Imogene, once a promising young New York playwright whose promise has fizzled, thanks to a crisis of confidence. Heavily in denial about being dumped by her society boyfriend, Imogene uses her skill for drama to stage an elaborate fake suicide as an appeal for his sympathy.

title: Girls Girls Girls
description: Best friends Mimmi and Ronkko discover the highs and lows of love and desire when they find themselves welcomed into a new social circle. Whilst Mimmi experiences the earth moving effects of first love, Ronkko is on a quest to find pleasure.

title: Girls of the Sun
description: A Kurdish female battalion prepares to take back their town from extremists.

title: Give Or Take
description: After the death of his father, a New Yorker returns to Cape Cod to prepare his childhood home for sale. With his father's boyfriend still living there, they butt heads and negotiate how to remember the man they both loved.

title: Give Them Wings
description: Give Them Wings is based on the true story of wheelchair bound Paul Hodgson. A man who fought back and won.

title: Give Up Tomorrow
description: In the Philippines, an innocent man faces the death penalty in a controversial murder case that separated two families and an entire nation.

title: Glastonbury
description: A rocking celebration of the world's longest running and best-known music festival, suffusing the real experiences and videos of festival goers, with Julien Temple's own camera work and BBC coverage of legendary performances.

title: Gliitch
description: A film crew goes on an adventure to report on extreme tourism by choosing a haunted forest as their destination.

title: Global Child - Travel with Purpose
description: Augusto explores the world through the best experiences as he shares uplifting life lessons with global friends.

title: Gloria Bell
description: Gloria (Julianne Moore) is a free-spirited divorcée who spends her days at a straight-laced office job and her nights on the dance floor, joyfully letting loose at clubs around Los Angeles. After meeting Arnold (John Turturro) on a night out, she finds herself thrust into an unexpected new romance.

title: Gloves Off
description: Doug was an amazing fighter, but a less than amazing businessman. Saddled with a gym in debt he is struggling to keep his business afloat. Now he will have to try and save his beloved gym from being turned into a modern chain-gym by training a gentle giant for a bare-knuckle figh.

title: Glumpers
description: The Glumpers are a gang of friends who live together in their home which becomes a kind of nuclear reactor where even a small interaction between its particles can cause a chain reaction with disastrous consequences.

title: Go for It
description: To outrun the cops, two petty crooks pose as two passengers at the airport by getting caught up in a secret CIA mission.

title: Go Forth
description: Through the life story of his grandmother, a filmmaker explores his roots in Algeria while portraying the universe of the Parisian suburb.

title: Go with Me
description: A modern fable set against the rugged backdrop of a Pacific Northwest logging community, GO WITH ME tells the story of Lillian, a young woman newly returned to her hometown who becomes the subject of harassment by a man named Blackway, an ex-cop turned violent crimelord...

title: Goats
description: Fourteen-year-old Ellis is getting ready to leave his luxurious home in the foothills of Tucson for his freshman year at Gates Academy, an East Coast prep school. This means leaving behind Wendy, his flaky, new age mother and the only real father he has ever known, Goat Man.

title: God Help The Girl
description: GOD HELP THE GIRL is a coming of age tale set in Glasgow over the course of one hazy summer.  Written, directed and with original songs by Stuart Murdoch, lead singer of the group Belle and Sebastian, GOD HELP THE GIRL is a story of a young girls problems entering adult life.

title: God's Own Country
description: Johnny Saxby (Josh O'Connor) works long hours on his family's remote farm in the north of England. He numbs the daily frustration of his lonely existence with nightly binge-drinking at the local pub and casual sex.

title: God's Soldier
description: An Orphaned Child with a price on her head seeks refuge in a Chapel run by a beautiful Nun, but all is not what it seems. High Octane action as they flee the clutches of a Rogue CIA Agent.

title: Goldilocks & The Three Bears: Death and Porridge
description: When friends arrive at the wrong address for their annual reunion, they’re stranded in the middle of nowhere. Breaking into a house, they discover it belongs to psychotic killers dressed as Goldilocks and the Three Bears, turning a getaway into a brutal fight for survival.

title: Good Hair
description: Find out what prompted comedian Chris Rock's own daughter to ask \"Daddy why don't I have good hair?\". Follow Rock on a raucous adventure as he sets to work answering his daughter's question...

title: Good Luck Chuck
description: Meet Charlie Logan, he's a good luck charm and women are guaranteed to find true love after they sleep with him.  But what seems like a blessing feels like a curse when he meets Cam, the girl of his dreams.

title: Good People
description: A debt-ridden couple take the cash they find in a dead tenant’s apartment. But they soon become the target of a deadly adversary – the thief who stole it.

title: Goodbye Lover
description: In sun-dappled Los Angeles, sly, sexy and unscrupulous Sandra Dunmore zealously pursues a much bigger piece of the good life. On the way up Sandra may have to step on a few toes--in her stiletto heels. But that doesn't make her bad.

title: Gordon Ramsay's Passion for Flavour
description: The superstar chef as never seen before – not the renowned hothead – but the thoughtful young chef who caught the attention of the world with his extraordinary talent and personality.

title: Gosford Park
description: In 2001, Robert Altman (MASH, The Long Goodbye) took the unexpected step into Agatha Christie territory with Gosford Park, a murder-mystery whodunit set in an English country house starring a host of British acting greats and with an Oscar-winning screenplay by Downton Abbey creator Julian Fellowes.

title: Goshen
description: Through an educational approach, this documentary transports us to the mountains of Mexico to shows us the sustainable life of the Tarahumara indigenous people and how their traditions are in danger of disappearing.

title: Gotti
description: GOTTI follows infamous crime boss John Gotti’s rise to become the “Teflon Don” of the Gambino Crime Family in New York City. Spanning three decades and recounted by his son John Jr., GOTTI examines Gotti’s tumultuous life as her and his wife attempt to hold the family together...

title: Gracie and Pedro: Mission Impossible
description: Meet Gracie and Pedro, two family pets who couldn't be more different. Gracie is a purebred pampered pooch, whilst Pedro is a brazen, rescue cat, and their brawling is about to have disastrous consequences!

title: Granada Nights
description: A British tourist is stuck in Granada, Spain with a broken heart. Feeling lost and abandoned, he befriends a group of young foreigners and crashes into the heart of the international student scene.

title: Grand Isle
description: Vietnam veteran Walter lives with his wife in a Victorian house on a quiet island in Louisiana. Walter hires local handyman Buddy to fix his fence, but when a hurricane strikes the island Buddy finds himself trapped at the Franklins residence. As tensions rise, the night takes an expected turn.

title: Grand Piano
description: Tom Selznick, the most talented pianist of his generation, stopped performing in public because of his stage fright. Years after a catastrophic performance, he reappears in public in a long awaited concert in Chicago.

title: Gray Matters
description: They finish each other’s sentences, dance like Fred and Ginger, and share the same downtown loft – the perfect couple? Not exactly. Gray and Sam, are a sister and brother so compatible and inseparable that people actually assume they are dating.

title: Greener Grass
description: GREENER GRASS is a hilariously deadpan hellscape of competitive suburbia with a boldly stylized absurdist chain of events that unfurls with increasing fervour after one soccer mom gifts another her infant daughter just to be polite.

title: Gretel & Hansel
description: A long time ago in a distant fairytale countryside, a young girl (Sophia Lillis) leads her little brother (newcomer Samuel J. Leakey) into a dark wood in desperate search of food and work, only to stumble upon a nexus of terrifying evil.

title: Grey Lady
description: After the murder in Boston of his police partner and lover, homicide Detective James Doyle follows a clue embedded in her dying words to the remote island of Nantucket to hunt for her killer in the lonely off-season.

title: Grey Matter
description: Teenager Chloe has never been close with her Nan Peg but when she gets diagnosed with Alzheimer's and moves into the family home, Chloe's forced to become her stay-at-home carer overnight.

title: Guardians of the Tomb
description: An innocent discovery of a well-preserved mummified Emperor from 200 B.C. China unearths a two thousand-year-old nightmare, a secret that should have remained buried.

title: Guess Who
description: A sarcastic father (Bernie Mac) has plenty to say about his daughter wanting to marry a white boy (Ashton Kutcher).

title: Gunner
description: When ruthless drug traffickers kidnap his children, ex-special forces operative Lee Gunner embarks on a violent life-or-death mission. With his unique skills and nothing to lose, he'll take on an army to bring his family home.

title: Guns & Moses
description: A beloved small town rabbi in the high desert becomes an unlikely gunslinger after his community is violently attacked.

title: Guns, Girls and Gambling
description: Five Elvis impersonators are hunted by assassins when a valuable Elvis mask is stolen from a casino.

title: Habit
description: When a drug deal goes wrong, street smart party girl Mads and her best friends find a possible way out by masquerading as nuns.

title: HairStyle, The Talent Show
description: ‘HairStyle, The Talent Show’ is a new hairstyling format created by Shine Iberia (A Banijay Company) in which 10 of the nation's top hairstylists compete in a series of cut, color and styling challenges to become the next big name in the USA hairstyling industry.

title: Half Nelson
description: A self-destructive teacher with a drug habit forms an unlikely friendship with one of his students after she discovers his secret.

title: Halleluja For Django
description: A gang sets up a Middletown bank robbery, a perfect heist that yields a haul of half a million dollars in gold coins. The robbers go their separate ways, only to meet up a short time later in a town near the Mexican border to split the money, as arranged.

title: Halloween
description: Michael Myers is released from the mental institution where he was committed for 17 years, and goes on a rampage to find his younger sister. No one is safe. Remake of the 1978 film directed by John Carpenter.

title: Hamburger Hill
description: The men of Bravo Company are facing a battle that's all uphill… up Hamburger Hill. Fourteen war-weary soldiers are battling for a mud-covered mound of earth so named because it chews up soldiers like chopped meat. They are fighting for their country, their fellow soldiers and their lives.

title: Hamlet
description: Ian McKellen stars in the classic tale of revenge that has stood the test of time, reimagined for the modern day as a psychological thriller.

title: Hands of Steel
description: A story about a cyborg who is programmed to kill a scientist who holds the fate of mankind in his hands.

title: Hangman
description: Decorated homicide detective Ray Archer (Al Pacino) partners with criminal profiler Will Ruiney (Karl Urban) to catch one of the city's notoriously vicious serial killers, who is playing a twisted version of murder inspired by the children's game Hangman.

title: Hannah Takes the Stairs
description: Over the course of one hot post-graduate summer in Chicago, Hannah (Greta Gerwig), now a production office intern, falls precariously in and out of love.

title: Happily
description: Tom and Janet have been happily married for years. But a visit from a mysterious stranger leads to a dead body, a lot of questions, and a tense couples' trip with friends who may not actually be friends at all.

title: Happy Hunting
description: An alcoholic drifter must battle withdrawal and psychotic rednecks after he becomes the target of a deranged sporting event.

title: Hara-Kiri: Death of a Samurai
description: A poverty-stricken Samurai seeks revenge after discovering his friend's fate, igniting a tense showdown against the House of a feudal lord.

title: Hard Cash
description: This fast-paced crime thriller stars Christian Slater and Val Kilmer. Released from prison, an infamous thief and his new crew pull off a brilliant robbery and become embroiled with a corrupt FBI agent when they discover the money is marked.

title: Hard Kill
description: A team of fearless mercenaries, led by security expert Derek Miller, are considered the best fighters on Earth that money can buy. They are strategically hired by billionaire tech CEO Donovan Chalmers to protect a piece of technology that, if exposed, could destroy the world.

title: Hard Night Falling
description: A criminal mastermind, has come up with a plot to steal a fortune from the Rossini family villa during a party hosted by them. Unbeknownst to him and his crew, one of Rossini's guests is a highly trained foreign operative who will fight to the death to save the hostages and his family.

title: Harold & Kumar Get the Munchies
description: Harold & Kumar Get the Munchies is a hilarious, outrageous road trip. Our heroes go on an epic journey they’ll never remember, to get a burger they’ll never forget. In one wild night, they’ll go further, stoop lower and get higher than ever before!

title: Harry Styles: Are You Curious?
description: Relive the incredible evolution of Harry Styles and discover how he transformed himself from a teen idol to an era-defining global superstar.

title: Haunt
description: An introvert teen befriends his new neighbor, and together the couple begin to explore the haunted house that his family has just purchased.

title: Havoc
description: A group of wealthy Los Angeles teenagers try to become part of the "gangsta" lifestyle but soon run into trouble when they come face to face with a real gang of Latino drug dealers.

title: He Dreams of Giants
description: From the makers Lost in La Mancha. Follow the iconic director Terry Gilliam as he fights to finish his elusive passion-project.

title: He Kills at Night
description: On Christmas Eve, a mother desperate to reconnect with her estranged family is abducted by a Serial Killer and forced to help him flee the country.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
description: Witness the continuation of He-Man's epic journey as he battles Skeletor for the future of Castle Grayskull, and the rest of Eternia.

title: Heart of Dragon
description: Jackie Chan plays a good-hearted cop looking after his learning-disabled brother Danny (Sammo Hung) but doesn't always succeed in keeping him out of trouble. When Danny is taken as a hostage, his brother risks everything to rescue him.

title: Heart of the Man
description: A coming-of-age drama that follows the story of Chris Wundurra, a rising amateur boxer torn between pleasing his father and following his heart.

title: Heartbreakers
description: Max and Page are a mother and daughter con team with a devious routine. Max targets wealthy men, lures them into marriage and then Page seduces them, leaving Max to discover their infidelity and reap the huge divorce settlements which tide them over until they target their next victim.

title: Heartless
description: This gritty Faustian tale set in the East End of London follows Jamie, a troubled young man with a birthmark on his face, which has left him feeling isolated and fearful, hiding from the world outside. He lives in the East End of London, an area notorious for its violent hooded gangs.

title: Heathers: The Musical
description: Based on the 1989 cult classic film starring Winona Ryder and Christian Slater, and recorded live in its original London home, The Other Palace.

title: Hector and the Search for Happiness
description: Hector is an eccentric yet irresistible London psychiatrist in crisis: his patients are just not getting any happier. He’s going nowhere. Then one day, armed with buckets of courage and an almost child like curiosity child-curiosity...

title: Heidi
description: Heidi is based on the novel by Johanna Spyri.  The film follows the adventures of Heidi, a young orphan girl, whose gift for happiness helps her when she is forced to leave the mountains for a new life in the city.

title: Heidi: Rescue of the Lynx
description: When eight-year-old Heidi finds and rescues an injured lynx cub from a trap, she names him Pepper and secretly nurses him back to health. But as the cub's playful antics draw unwanted attention, Heidi learns of industrial plans that threaten not just the cub, but the entire Alpine ecosystem.

title: Heir of the Witch
description: An underprivileged seamstress, haunted by her past, seeks love and acceptance in high society but is faced with the curse from her evil roots.

title: Heist
description: Francis 'Pope' Silva is a popular, soon to be retiring casino owner and feared mafia boss. When one of his employees Luke Vaughn desperately needs cash for his daughter's much needed operation...

title: Hell On The Border
description: Having escaped from slavery after the Civil War, Bass Reeves arrives in Arkansas seeking a job with the law. To prove himself, he must hunt down a deadly outlaw with the help of a grizzled journeyman.

title: Hell's Kitchen USA
description: In this five-time Emmy-nominated reality show, celebrity chef Gordon Ramsay roasts aspiring restauranteurs as they compete for the opportunity to run one of his eateries. Contains strong language.

title: Hellboy: The Crooked Man
description: Stranded in a remote community tormented by witchcraft, Hellboy must hunt down the source of this evil - a demon known only as 'The Crooked Man'.

title: Herd
description: When a woman trying to outrun her past ends up trapped between a zombie outbreak and warring militia groups, she must fight to find her way back home.

title: Here Alone
description: A young woman struggles to survive alone in the woods after a mysterious epidemic decimates society. Bleak, gritty, and teeming with fear, HERE ALONE tells a story of survival and emotional redemption in a post-apocalyptic landscape.

title: Hero Mode
description: A teenage coding genius has just 30 days to create the world's greatest video game or his family loses everything. No pressure. Starring Mira Sorvino, Chris Carpenter and Sean Astin.

title: Hesher
description: Starring Joseph Gordon Levitt, Natalie Portman and Rainn Wilson in a comedic, dark fairy tale about an eccentric, unhinged drifter who appears out of nowhere to help a struggling family deal with loss in the most unconventional of ways.

title: Hey Amigo! A Toast to Your Death
description: A postman officer, Dove Williams, pursues a group of outlaws who have robbed a stagecoach in Texas.

title: Hierarchy
description: As adopted brothers prepare for the biggest and most dangerous heist of their lives, they find themselves caught in a high-stakes game of survival against a relentless foreign mafia, vengeful ties, and a determined police force.

title: High Crimes
description: A woman's life becomes embroiled in a huge military cover-up when it's revealed her husband is not who he says he is.

title: High Ground
description: Young Aboriginal man Gutjuk joins forces with bounty hunter Travis to track down Baywara, the most dangerous warrior in the Australian outback.

title: Higher Power
description: With mind blowing special effects, and a compelling new character, HIGHER POWER is ‘X-Men’ meets ‘Chronicle’ - the story of a true everyman who risks his life to save his daughter and ends up with powers beyond his wildest imagination.

title: Hijacked
description: A female FBI agent is offered millions to help a thief escape from a hijacked airplane.

title: Hint of Love
description: A cookbook literary agent with culinary training is tasked with helping elevate the brand of a food channel personality known for his convenience-oriented recipes. However, as the agent works with her client on a new cookbook, she must choose between following the directions or her heart.

title: His Name was King
description: A bounty hunter tracks a vicious gang of gunrunners across the border into Mexico.

title: His Name Was Pot... But They Called Him Allegria
description: Pot and his brother Ray rob a bank. Pot is arrested but soon escapes and meets a bandit named Steve. They plot to rob the local bank and with the help of an old undertaker, who digs his graves with dynamite, they empty the safe.

title: Hitch-Hike
description: On a cross-country drive, a writer and his beautiful wife pick up a stranded motorist. But when this happens, their road trip takes a vicious detour, where the miles are marked in mayhem and vengeance is the ultimate rule. He turns out to be a depraved psychopath.

title: Hitler versus Picasso and the Others
description: An extraordinary report on how Hitler looted "the great beauty" of Europe: the art that was the expression of its culture.

title: Hitler: The Last Ten Days
description: Berlin, 1945. In the Fuhrerbunker, the last hiding place of the man who unleashed a reign of terror across Europe, it is Adolf Hitler's 56th birthday.

title: Hive
description: Fahrije's husband has been missing since the war in Kosovo. She sets up her own small business to provide for her kids, but as she fights against a patriarchal society that does not support her, she faces a crucial decision.

title: Hole
description: Two con artists seduce and rob lonely women. But things go terribly wrong when they accidentally kill one of their victims and try to bury her body in the woods.

title: Holy Water
description: A rural Irish village will never be the same again after a group of bachelors hijack a truck full of Viagra pills as part of a get-rich-quick scheme. With special ops on their case, the boys hide the loot down the Church's Holy Well... only for it to seep out into the town's water supply.

title: Home Again
description: Reese Witherspoon stars as Alice Kinney in HOME AGAIN a modern and heartwarming romantic comedy. Recently separated from her husband (Michael Sheen, Passengers), Alice decides to start over and move back to Los Angeles with her two young daughters as she struggles to get a new career off the ground.

title: Home of the Brave
description: Shortly after receiving the news that they will soon be reunited with their families back in the United States, an army unit serving in Iraq is deployed on a humanitarian mission to deliver medical supplies to a remote Iraqi village.

title: Homewrecker
description: Michelle is in her early 30s. Linda is in her late 40s. Michelle is an interior designer and newlywed to Robert. Linda lives alone; she fills her days with painting and exercise classes.

title: Honeymoon
description: Jorge, an eccentric and lonely medical doctor, kidnaps Isabel his neighbour in an apparent effort to submit her to a classical conditioning experiment to make her his woman.....but appearances often hide a more terrifying truth.

title: Honeytrap
description: Honeytrap is a tragic teen romance, set in South London and inspired by true events. It tells the story of fifteen year-old Layla who gets sucked into gang activity and sets up the boy who's in love with her to be killed.

title: HONG KONG: Forging an Unbreakable Bond
description: Right after Hong Kong's return, an unprecedented financial crisis swept across Asia.  With international speculators "hunting" around, stock markets were collapsing and currencies falling sharply.  In retrospect, many believe the central government offered the right amount of support to Hong Kong.

title: Honour
description: An urban thriller set in London with Paddy Considine and Aiysha Hart. After a failed attempt at an honour killing at the hands of her family, Mona is forced to go on the run. The family, enlist the services of a bounty hunter to trawl through the streets of London to track her down.

title: Hope Gap
description: Annette Bening, Bill Nighy and Josh O’Connor shine in William Nicholson’s intimate portrait of a family crisis.

title: Hope's Hollywood Christmas
description: A struggling single mom takes a temp job with an aging movie star and teams up with the star's chauffeur to stop a scheming lawyer and agent from stealing her fortune, finding love and holiday magic along the way.

title: Horns
description: Ig Perrish is accused for the violent killing of his girlfriend. After a hard night of drinking, Ig awakens, hungover, to find horns growing out of his head; they have the ability to drive people to confess sins.

title: Hostile
description: Juliette, a lone survivor of an apocalyptic era, fights to survive against hunger, thirst, a broken leg and strange, disturbing creatures that only come out at nighttime.

title: Hot Ones
description: Host Sean Evans asks his celebrity guests questions while they attempt to complete rounds of chicken wings coated in spicy hot sauce.

title: Hot Property
description: Hot Property is an anarchic satire for 'generation rent'. An un-romantic comedy about love, greed and psychotic estate agents. Set amid London's deranged property market and self-parodying hipster culture. STARRING MyAnna Buring (Kill List/Ripper Street/Downton Abbey)

title: Hot Pursuit
description: An uptight and by-the-book cop (Reese Witherspoon) tries to protect the sexy and outgoing widow (Sofia Vergara) of a drug boss as they race through Texas pursued by crooked cops and murderous gunmen.

title: Hot Wheels City
description: In a world of wheels, all tracks lead to Hot Wheels City! Strap in with Chase and Elliot, two brothers who spend their days racing the streets in their favorite Hot Wheels.

title: House at the End of the Street
description: Elissa and her mother move to a new town only to find that they are living next door to a house where a young girl murdered her parents.

title: House of Bodies
description: As incarcerated serial-killer Henry Lee Bishop (Peter Fonda, Easy Rider, 3:10 to Yuma, Ghost Rider) serves his sentence on Death Row, strange happenings arise in his former home.

title: House of Darkness
description: Hap (Justin Long) drives Mina (Kate Bosworth) home to her mysterious estate after a night of drinking. Hap gets more than he bargained for when unexpected occurrences offset his attempts at a romantic connection with this mysterious object of his desire.

title: House of Ho
description: This multigenerational docusoap follows the Hos, a Houston-based Vietnamese-American family whose multimillion-dollar empire epitomizes the “American Dream".

title: How About You
description: A star studded festive comedy. Ellie (Hayley Atwell) is left in charge of an elderly residential home over Christmas, and while most of the residents have left to spend time with their families, four grumpy residents remain.

title: How It Ends
description: In this feel-good apocalyptic comedy, Liza (Zoe Lister-Jones) embarks on a hilarious journey through LA in hopes of making it to her last party before it all ends, running into an eclectic cast of characters along the way.

title: How to Find Forever
description: Marley’s brilliant at organizing other people’s engagements, but unlucky in finding romance herself. When designing her most important proposal yet, the man who could jeopardize it all may be the one who helps find her own love story.

title: Hudson
description: After his mother’s death, Hudson, a reclusive but charming man, embarks on a journey with his distant cousin to scatter his mother’s ashes in the Hudson Valley region of New York.

title: Human Carbon Footprint
description: This 54-minute documentary takes the viewers on a global journey to explore how carbon has shaped our energy-intensive modern world and lifestyles, and what we need to do to wean ourselves off fossil fuels and ensure humanity's lights stay on.

title: Humor Me
description: A once-acclaimed New York playwright, Nate (Jemaine Clement), is struggling to finish his new play when his wife (Maria Dizzia) leaves him, taking their son.

title: Hunt
description: Agents of the Korean National Intelligence Service (KNIS), Pyung-ho at Int'l Dept. and Jung-do at Domestic Dept. are both independently hunting a North Korean mole within the agency.

title: Hunt to Kill
description: When Jim's (Steve Austin of TV's WWE) teenage daughter is kidnapped, he's forced to lead a band of ruthless killers into the wilderness to retrieve their share of a missing heist score.

title: Hunter
description: When Rick Hunter, a renegade cop who takes justice into his own hands, partners with the stunning and rebellious Sgt. McCall, they set out to crack down on L.A.'s slimiest criminals.

title: Hunting Games
description: After a bag of stolen of money is unexpectedly lost during Law enforcement intervention, a group of hired ex-military is brought in to bring it back. A predicted easy mission is interrupted by a lone hunter, Will, who finds the bag and decides to keep it for himself.

title: Hyena
description: As Detective Sergeant Michael Logan extorts his way into the drug trade, Albanian and Turkish gangs take over London’s criminal world.  With events spiralling out of control, Logan takes a ruthless course leading to irrevocable consequences.

title: Hyena Road
description: Three different men, three different worlds, three different wars – all stand at the crossroads of modern warfare. It's a murky world in which they must save lives - but all is not as it seems

title: I Am Breathing
description: Within a year, Neil Platt goes from being a healthy man to becoming completely paralysed from the neck down, thanks to the devastating illness he has inherited. As his body gets weaker, he puts together a memory box for his baby son and communicates his experience about life in a blog.

title: I Am Love
description: The matriarch of a wealthy Milanese family finds her well-ordered world blown wide open by the revelation of an unspoken love.

title: I Am Not Your Negro
description: Told entirely in the words of James Baldwin, through both personal appearances and the text of his final unfinished book project, I Am Not Your Negro touches on the lives and assassinations of Malcolm X, Martin Luther King Jr.

title: I am Samuel
description: An intimate portrait of a Kenyan man torn between duty to his family and their traditions - and wanting to live his truth – one of openness about his sexuality and his dreams for the future, in this verité style film that spans five years.

title: I Am Woman
description: The story of Helen Reddy, who in 1966 landed in NYC with her three-year-old daughter, a suitcase and $230 in her pocket. Within five years she was one of the biggest superstars of her time, and an icon of the 1970s feminist movement.

title: I Am Wrath
description: Golden Globe winner John Travolta returns to the action genre with a hard as nails performance as a man with nothing left to lose, seeking bloody vengeance! Unemployed engineer Stanley Hill witnesses the brutal murder of his wife Vivian who was attacked by thugs in a parking garage.

title: I Blame Society
description: In this acclaimed black comedy, a struggling filmmaker realises that she has the skill set to commit the perfect murder.

title: I Can Only Imagine
description: It's the song that brings ultimate hope to so many...often in the midst of life s most challenging moments.

title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
description: An upbeat and acerbic romantic comedy featuring stellar cast: Michelle Pfeiffer, Paul Rudd, Saoirse Ronan, Jon Lovitz, Stacey Dash, Fred Willard, Sarah Alexander, Tracey Ullman, Henry Winkler.

title: I Feel Pretty
description: A woman struggling with insecurity wakes from a fall believing she is the most beautiful woman on the planet. Her new confidence empowers her to live fearlessly, but what happens when she realizes her appearance never changed?

title: I Kill Giants
description: Barbara Thorson is a teenage girl who escapes the realities of school and a troubled family life by retreating into her magical world of fighting evil giants.

title: I Love My Dad
description: Inspired by a true life experience, the film follows Chuck, a hopelessly estranged father who desperately wants to reconnect with his troubled son Franklin. Blocked on social media and concerned for his son’s life, Chuck impersonates a waitress online and starts checking in with Franklin.

title: I Love Your Work
description: Gray Evans is living in a bubble.  He’s a movie star, married to a movie star.  He fears his fans almost as much as he fears life.

title: I Picked Up A Celebrity On the Street
description: Contract worker Lee Yeon Seo daydreams about teaching her manager a lesson but accidentally acts out her vengeful fantasy on the top Hallyu star, Kang Joon Hyuk in a twist of events.

title: I Protect Myself Against My Enemies
description: A few people are on the search of three one Dollar coins with numbers that Show where a treasure is burried.

title: I Smile Back
description: Laney Brooks does bad things. Married with kids, she takes the drugs she wants, sleeps with the men she wants, disappears when she wants but when her family falls apart, she tries to get some redemption back.

title: I Spit On Your Grave
description: In 1978, one film changed the face of cinema forever. Long established as one of the most debated and divisive movies of all time, I Spit On Your Grave has been condemned by some as 'vile and depraved', whilst others hail it as a 'misunderstood masterpiece of cinema', 'the ultimate feminist movie'.

title: I Think We're Alone Now
description: Del (Peter Dinklage) is alone in the world. Literally. After the human race is wiped out, he lives in a small, empty town, methodically going from house to house, collecting batteries and other useful items, and burying the dead...

title: I Want You Back
description: Peter and Emma thought they were on the precipice of life’s biggest moments – marriage, kids, and houses in the suburbs – until their respective partners dumped them.

title: I Wrecked My House
description: You need a licence to drive a car but you don’t need a licence to own a home! I Wrecked My House is a home renovation series that features homeowners who have literally wrecked their houses and need to be rescued.

title: I'll Be Next Door For Christmas
description: When 16-year-old Nickey’s boyfriend visits for the holidays, she hides her family's extreme Christmas obsession by staging a fake dinner next door with hired actors as her parents. What could possibly go wrong?

title: I'm Still Here
description: Academy Award-winner Casey Affleck takes a turn behind the camera to document a tumultuous year in the life of fellow Oscar-winning actor, Joaquin Phoenix, as he announces his retirement from a successful film career and sets off to reinvent himself as a hip-hop musician.

title: I've Never Wanted Anyone More
description: Charming, passionate, and totally irresponsible Werther (Douglas Booth) meets lovely Charlotte (Alison Pill) by chance, and her allure and commitment to her impressive, stable fiancé Albert (Patrick J. Adams) turns Werther’s life upside down.

title: I.T
description: A high-tech revenge thriller from the writer of 'Terminator 1 & 2'. Mike Regan (Pierce Brosnan) is a self-made man who has it all: a gorgeous wife, a beautiful teenage daughter, and a sleek, state-of-the-art smart home.

title: Ice Cream in the Cupboard
description: Carmen and Pat's marriage is turned upside down by a diagnosis of early onset Alzheimer's. As the time draws closer when Carmen will no longer recognize her husband, Pat finds refuge in his memories of their life together.

title: Ice Sharks
description: Floating above the ice, in a research station deep in the Arctic, a team of expert scientists are studying the effects of climate change on marine life under the thick ice below them.

title: Iceman
description: Ying a highly skilled martial arts warrior of the Ming Dynasty palace guard, is ordered to escort the precious Golden Wheel of Time, said to have the power of time travel and ability to see into the future, from Sindu back to China.

title: Ida Red
description: Ida "Red" Walker might not survive her terminal illness while incarcerated for armed robbery, so she turns to her son, Wyatt, for one last job and a chance to regain her freedom.

title: If I Stay
description: A chronicle of a fatal car accident involving 17-year-old musician Mia and her boyfriend.

title: If You Want to Live... Shoot!
description: A young cowboy, Johnny, playing in a rigged poker game is forced to shoot one of the other players.

title: Imperial Dreams
description: A 21-year-old reformed gangster's devotion to his family and his future is put to the test when he is released from prison and returns to his old stomping grounds in Watts, Los Angeles.

title: Implanted
description: Sarah, a struggling young woman living in Brooklyn, agrees to volunteer as an experimental test subject for a company to be implanted with a nanochip in her cerebral cortex. When the implant turns sinister and orders her to commit crimes, Sarah has only one choice: to live or die.

title: Imprisoned
description: While visiting the home country of his Arab girlfriend, Frank is wrongfully imprisoned by corrupt police after a tragic accident leads to her death. Desperate, he turns to the prison’s top shot-caller (Mickey Rourke) as he attempts to unravel the corruption that lead to his incarceration.

title: Impuratus: The Devil's Confession
description: A police detective Clayton Douglas (Tom Sizemore) is summoned to a remote hospital to witness a mysterious Civil War veteran's outrageous death-bed confession that forces him to accept the supernatural.

title: Impy's Wonderland
description: Impy the friendly little dinosaur and his friends join together in order to rescue their new baby panda.

title: In a Relationship
description: Long-term couple Owen and Hallie are breaking up—or maybe not? —and just as they adjust to single life, Matt and Willa start a romance of their own.

title: In from the Side
description: In from the Side' is the story of an adulterous affair between two members of a fictional South London gay rugby club. The film explores the multiple types of connections that can occur within a large group of gay men in a team sports environment…

title: In Hell
description: A man must survive a prison where hardened criminals battle to the death for the wardens' entertainment. Starring movie icon Jean-Claude Van Damme.

title: In Her Hands
description: A troubled young man gets the chance to show his talents by attending the National Conservatory of Music, but he soon feels out of place in this upper-class world.

title: In the Blood
description: The death of his safe cracking grandfather has landed Johnny as the only one left alive who can open a safe for a degenerate crew of violent gangsters, but he's just a junkie with little more on his mind than getting that next fix.

title: In The Electric Mist
description: Louisiana Detective Dave Robicheaux (Tommy Lee Jones) is on the hunt for a serial killer, where he encounters Hollywood star Elrod Sykes (Peter Sarsgaard) and local crime kingpin Baby Feet Balboni (John Goodman). As Dave gets closer to the murderer, the murderer gets closer to Dave and his family.

title: In the Fire
description: A doctor travels to a remote plantation to care for a disturbed boy who has inexplicable abilities. She ignites a war of science versus religion with the local priest who believes the boy is possessed by the Devil.

title: In The Turn
description: A ten-year-old transgender girl finds in a queer team of Roller Derby the confidence to continue her transition.

title: In-Law Wedding Wars
description: A must-see wedding show with a fantastic twist, In-Law Wedding Wars is the all-new series where soon-to-be-weds hand over total control of their big day to one of their mothers!

title: Incendies
description: Canadian twins Jeanne and Simon, are left two envelopes in their mother's will asking them to find a brother and father they never knew they had.

title: Incoming
description: The International Space Station is now a prison - the ultimate black site. No one's getting out. And no one knows it's there. But when the imprisoned terrorists take over the Station and turn it into a missile aimed at Moscow, only a shuttle pilot and a rookie doctor can stop them.

title: IncrediTales
description: Cinderella, Snowhite, Rapunzel, Robin Hood... We all love their stories but have you ever wondered what their lives might be like behind their fairytales?

title: India Sweets and Spices
description: When Alia returns home from university, she challenges her parents' elitist lifestyle; expensive jewellery, lavish dinner parties, and gossiping aunties. But when she invites the son of a local shopkeeper to her mother's upcoming soiree, family secrets begin to surface.

title: Infamous
description: Two young lovers rob their way across America, posting their crimes on social media, and gaining fame and followers as a result.

title: Infini
description: Humanity has become the victim of mass overpopulation and the line between middle class and poverty no longer exists. Whit Carmichael has accepted a high-risk security job that requires off-world travel using Slipstream.

title: Infinitum: Subject Unknown
description: In this mind-bending sci-fi, Jane must find a way to alter her reality before it is too late. Featuring Sir Ian McKellen.

title: Inhabitants
description: A young woman moves in with her lapsed Catholic boyfriend, only to discover that they're being haunted by the vengeful ghost of his childhood youth minister.

title: Innocence
description: Beckett (Sophie Curtis) is a beautiful young teenager that is still mourning the loss of her mother. She's moved to the Upper West Side of Manhattan with her father Miles (Linus Roache) and is set to begin school at Hamilton, an exclusive prep school.

title: Inside
description: Transferred from juvenile to adult prison, young offender Mel is taken under the wing of Australia's most despised criminal, Mark Shepard, and Warren Murfett, a soon-to-be paroled inmate. When Murfett is forced into murdering Shepard to pay his debts, he finds a surprising accomplice in Mel.

title: Inside Man
description: Based on true events, a disgraced police detective seeking redemption by going undercover to expose a violent crime syndicate. But as he sinks deeper into the mob, the price for absolution may be higher than he can afford.

title: InstaPsycho
description: As teenager Maddie enters her senior year, she and her besties use social media to gain popularity – but when one of their stunts results in the death of a friend, Maddie is blamed, and the consequences are dangerous. Can her mother Gwen save her daughter from the real killer?

title: Instrument of War
description: Instrument Of War is an harrowing yet uplifting true story about survival against seemingly impossible odds. When U.S. B-24 bomber pilot Clair Cline is shot down and captured in northern Germany, one war ends and another begins -- to keep hope alive.

title: Into the Blue
description: Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure. When they take some friends (Scott Caan, Ashley Scott) on an extreme sport adventure, the last thing they expect to see below the water is a legendary pirate ship rumored to contain millions in gold.

title: Into The Blue 2: The Reef
description: Free-spirited scuba divers Sebastion and Dani run a modest diving company in Hawaii. The young couple is delighted when they’re hired by mysterious jet-setters who are searching for sunken treasure and will pay big money for diving help.

title: Into the Forest
description: In the not-too-distant future, two young women, Nell (Ellen Page) and Eva (Evan Rachel Wood) must struggle to survive after a mysterious continent-wide power cut.

title: Ip Man: The Awakening
description: The legendary Ip Man returns to the big screen to uncover the first action-packed chapter in the story of the man who would become a world-renowned martial arts master.

title: Iron Chef
description: "Iron Chef" is an innovative cooking competition from Japan combining the excitement of a one-on-one sports competition with gourmet cooking.

title: Iron Fury
description: In 1944, a young lieutenant leads a courageous group of Russian soldiers in a German POW camp, plotting a daring escape from captivity in a half-dest

title: Iron Sky
description: The Nazis set up a secret base on the dark side of the moon in 1945 where they hide out and plan to return to power in 2018.

title: Iron Sky - The Coming Race
description: Twenty years after the events of 'Iron Sky', the former Nazi Moonbase has become the last refuge of mankind. Earth was devastated by a nuclear war but buried deep under the wasteland lies a power that could save the last of humanity or destroy it once and for all.

title: It Is In Us All
description: Hamish must face himself when a shocking car accident rips him apart. A dark thriller starring Cosmo Jarvis (Calm With Horses).

title: It Lives Inside
description: An Indian-American teen struggling with her cultural identity unwittingly releases a demonic entity that grows stronger by feeding on her loneliness.

title: It Snows All The Time
description: Paul did everything a person is supposed to do to keep their mind healthy - until he gets Dementia. As his disease progresses, his family comes together to decide what to do.

title: It's A Boy Girl Thing
description: It's A Boy Girl Thing is a brilliantly funny romantic comedy about next-door neighbours who live worlds apart. Woody Deane and Nell Bedworth are life long sworn enemies who wake up one day to find themselves in a very strange place: each others bodies.

title: It's Christmas
description: Visiting her husband's family for the holiday season, Charlie sees them struggling to find their festive spirit in the wake of her mother-in-law's death.

title: Ithaca
description: When his older brother leaves to fight in WWII, 14-year-old Homer Macauley takes a job as a bicycle messenger to provide for his widowed mother and siblings.

title: Jack Strong
description: Based on a true story of how a Polish colonel defied the Soviet Union to become a double agent for the CIA.  In the process, he avoided all-out nuclear war and helped to end the Cold War.

title: Jackals
description: Set in the 1980s, an estranged family hires a cult deprogrammer to take back their teenage son from a murderous cult, but find themselves under siege when the cultists surround their cabin, demanding the boy back.

title: Jane Got a Gun
description: JANE GOT A GUN is the story of Jane Hammond, a young mother living in a secluded ranch on the vast New Mexico prairie. When her family’s life is threatened by a conniving gang of outlaws led by the nefarious John Bishop (McGregor).

title: Jazzy
description: Jazzy is a portrait of Jasmine Bearkiller Shangreaux alongside her best friend Syriah and their peer group as relationships shift, change, and leave the dreamlike world of childhood behind.

title: Jeepers Creepers
description: An uneventful road trip home turns into a journey straight from Hell for two unsuspecting college kids, Trish and Darry. A heartstopping high-speed pursuit down a deserted highway leads to a terrifying discovery: their pursuer has more in store for them than they ever imagined.

title: Jeepers Creepers: Reborn
description: The Horror Hound festival is a big deal, and now, it’s coming to Louisiana for the very first time – the excitement is immense. The geeks, freaks and die-hard horror fans are coming from far and wide to experience the fear and the fun.

title: JFK
description: John F. Kennedy in Dallas, Texas, in 1963. What he learns leads him to suspect that there is more to the story than the public is being told.

title: Jimmy P
description: A troubled Native American veteran forms an extraordinary friendship with his maverick French psychoanalyst as they try to find a cure to his suffering.

title: Jiu Jitsu
description: NICOLAS CAGE is back and this time he’s got a sword and an alien invasion knocking at his door!

title: Jobs
description: Ashton Kutcher is Steve Jobs, the iconic Apple innovator and groundbreaking entrepreneur. This inspiring and entertaining film chronicles Jobs early days as a college dropout, to his rise as the co-founder of Apple Computer Inc.

title: Joe
description: Gary, a young lad who is subject to constant physical abuse by his alcoholic father, turns up at Joe’s workplace one day, asking for work. Joe takes him in, but it soon becomes clear that the benevolent boss has his own demons to face down...

title: Joe Somebody
description: Tim Allen is Joe, a guy whose life has been steadily changing for the worse.  When the office bully goes too far, Joe decides it's time to turn himself from a nobody into a somebody.

title: Joey & Ella: A Kangaroo Tail
description: When a baby kangaroo gets accidentally swept up in a jewelry heist, she becomes separated from her mother for the first time in her young life.

title: John and the Hole
description: A desperate game of survival unfolds after 13-year-old John traps his innocent family in an unfinished bunker in the ground.

title: Johnny & Clyde
description: Johnny and Clyde are two serial killers who are madly in love and on an endless crime spree. They have their sights set on robbing a prosperous casino - owned by crime boss Alana and guarded by a demonic slayer that she commands.

title: Johnny Mnemonic
description: It’s the year 2021 and data courier (Keanu Reeves) is in a race against time to deliver a dangerous stash of information in his head to save himself.

title: Johnny Z
description: Johnny Z is a horror-action feature film about a half human, half zombie named Johnny who, under the guidance of a martial arts master seeks vengeance on the evil corporation that created him.

title: Josie
description: The residents of a small, southern town are forever changed when the tattooed, sweet-talking stranger Josie (Sophie Turner) struts into town.

title: Journey to the Christmas Star
description: When her kingdom falls under an evil curse, a courageous young girl embarks on a perilous journey to find the Christmas Star and rescue a long lost princess, but not everyone wants her to succeed.

title: Journey to the End of the Night
description: Oscar winner Brendan Fraser and Emmy nominee Scott Glenn star as exiled Americans plotting to escape the desolation of their lives in the lurid underworld of Brazil's sex industry.

title: Joy Ride
description: Two brothers on a cross-Country driving trip make the mistake of playing a practical joke on a mentally deranged trucker, and pay dearly for the prank when he becomes a homicidal stalker.

title: Jumper
description: The epic adventures of a man who discovers that he possesses the exhilarating ability to instantly teleport anywhere in the world he can imagine.

title: June Again
description: During a fleeting bout of lucidity from her dementia, June Wilton has precious little time to bring together her estranged children, save the family business, and rekindle an old flame.

title: Juniper
description: Troubled teenager, Sam, has been on a self-destructive streak, so bad that it could have resulted in his own death. Returning home from boarding school he discovers that his wheelchair-bound English grandmother, Ruth, has moved in with them.

title: Just for the Summer
description: Teacher Penelope Campbell loves visiting her Grandma Dot every summer – despite her constant attempts to find Penelope a man! This year, she bumps into her childhood sweetheart Jason Humphrey, who explains his grandmother is desperate to pair him off, too.

title: Just Getting Started
description: An action comedy in the vein of MIDNIGHT RUN about an ex-FBI agent (Jones) and an ex-mob lawyer in the witness protection program (Freeman) having to put aside their petty rivalry on the golf course to fend off a mob hit.

title: Just My Luck
description: Sexy Manhattanite Ashley is known as the luckiest woman around, but after a chance romantic encounter with down-and-out Jake, she realizes that she's swapped her fortune for his.

title: Justin and the Knights of Valour
description: Set in a magical world that children still dream of, JUSTIN AND THE KNIGHTS OF VALOUR is about the determination of a boy to fulfil his dream. A heart-warming story about friendship, honour and courage, filled with adventure, action and fun.

title: K-9: Legend of the Lost Gold
description: When Kassie and her friends stumble across an old, broken pocket watch they begin an unexpected journey to unlock the secret of the legendary Garrison Gold. They'll have to solve riddles and follow clues to find the lost treasure. Kassie is about to go on the adventure of a lifetime!

title: K-PAX
description: When a man arrives in New York claiming to be from the planet K-Pax, the police turn him over to a psychiatrist. His behaviour might be unusual and his claims unbelievable, but the truth may be even stranger yet...

title: Karate-do: The Path of Sandra Sánchez
description: Sandra Sánchez is not a dragon, though in the dojo you'd swear otherwise. The transformation is all the more remarkable when we learn about the challenges of her daily life. We fight beside the karateka in her record-smashing 2021 season, securing an Olympic gold medal and the coveted triple crown.

title: Kat and The Band
description: Seventeen year old, music obsessed school girl Kat Malone tricks her way into managing struggling band Dollar Days, pretending to be a band manager in her twenties.

title: Keasha's Perfect Dress
description: Keasha owns a wedding dress store. Costumers come every day and with the help of her employee Aeron she helps them to find their perfect dress

title: Keyboard Fantasies: The Beverly Glenn-Copeland Story
description: Emerging from years in isolation to an enraptured crowd, a transgender, septuagenarian musical genius finally finds his place in the world. Part biopic, part tour documentary, Keyboard Fantasies tells the time-travelling tale of this mystical musician and vocalist.

title: Khumba
description: Khumba is a fantastic family adventure with voice talent from Liam Neeson, Catharine Tate, Richard E Grant, Steve Buscemi and more.

title: Kidnap
description: One peaceful afternoon in the park spirals into a living nightmare for single mother Karla (Halle Berry) as she spots her son being dragged off by a stranger. With no time to spare waiting for the police, she jumps into her car and risks everything to chase down the kidnappers.

title: Kidnap Syndicate
description: The son of an industrialist and his friend are kidnapped; in order to persuade the man to pay, the kidnappers kill the son’s friend.

title: Kill Shot
description: When a hunting guide and his mysterious new client stumble across $100 million of dirty money among the wreckage of a plane crash in the mountains of rural Montana, they must fight their way out of hostile territory as a group of ruthless mercenaries are sent to track them down and recover the cash.

title: Kill Switch
description: Set in a future version of the world, the video game style plot follows an experiment for unlimited energy, harnessing parallel universes, which goes wrong. Chased by drones and soldiers, pilot and physicist Will Porter must race through an imploding world to get the Redivider box to a tower...

title: Kill The Irishman
description: Oscar®-winner Christopher Walken, Val Kilmer, and Ray Stevenson star in KILL THE IRISHMAN, the true story of a tough Irish thug working for mobsters in Cleveland during the 1970s.

title: Kill the Poker Player
description: Federal agent Alan Fields, undercover as Jonathan Pinkerton, an employee of Lloyds of London, is investigating a bank robbery where one of the three thieves has killed the other two to take possession of all the money.

title: Kill Zone
description: Lt. Samuel Drake is a troubled vet plagued by his actions whilst deployed in Iraq. Recently discharged, he is trying to piece his life back together. He attends counselling sessions led by Marshall  to help cope with the horrors of his past.

title: Killer in Suburbia
description: Gina and her teenage daughter Kelsey move into a new town so Kelsey can attend a better high school.

title: Killer Instinct
description: In this darkly comedic home invasion thriller, a psychopathic widower comes to blows with the millennial renting his house.

title: Killer Kid
description: The ruthless and cruel Captain Ramirez hunts down and kills revolutionaries in his search for The Saint, the righteous leader of the Mexican insurrection against the Federales.

title: Killer Party
description: Three teenage thieves infiltrate a mansion dinner party secretly hosted by a group of recovering murderers for the social elite.

title: Killers
description: Spencer Aimes is just your average, undercover, super-assassin accustomed to a life of flashy sports cars and even flashier women. But when he meets Jen Kornfeldt, a fun-loving computer tech, he finds true love… and happily trades international intrigue for domestic bliss.

title: Killing Gunther
description: A dysfunctional team of young assassins set out to make a name for themselves by killing the most notorious hitman of all time, Gunther (Arnold Schwarzenegger).

title: Killing Season
description: Two veterans of the Bosnian War - one an American named Benjamin Ford , the other a former Serbian soldier, Emil Kovac  - engage in a tense, action-packed cat and mouse game, against the backdrop of America’s most forbidding and remote landscape.

title: Kim's Rude Awakenings
description: Join domestic diplomats, Kim and Mike, as they attempt to overhaul the country’s rudest and messiest families. Sticklers for order and cleanliness, these two firecrackers are determined to clean up our acts, our homes, and our heads.

title: KIN
description: KIN, a pulse-pounding crime thriller with a sci-fi twist, is the story of an unexpected hero destined for greatness. Chased by a vengeful criminal and a gang of otherworldly soldiers, a recently released ex-con and his adopted teenage brother are forced to go on the run with a weapon...

title: Kindergarten Teacher
description: A kindergarten teacher in New York becomes obsessed with one of her students who she believes is a child prodigy.

title: King of California
description: An unstable dad who after getting out of a mental institution tries to convince his daughter that there's Spanish gold buried somewhere under suburbia.

title: Kingslayer
description: Prince Richard the Lionheart pursuing his love for a stable girl is ambushed and must fight for his life, love and kingdom, while learning the harsh responsibilities of leadership.

title: Knowing
description: Nicolas Cage stars in KNOWING, a gripping action-thriller of global proportions about a professor who stumbles on terrifying predictions about the future and sets out to prevent them from coming true. Rose Byrne and Lara Robinson also star in director Alex Proyas' riveting feature.

title: Kobe: The Legend of the 81-Point Game
description: A documentary that looks at the life of Los Angeles Lakers forward and guard Kobe Bryant. The film tells the player's story on and off the court through firsthand narratives and exclusive archival footage and photos.

title: L.O.V.E.
description: If we were to ask people to name one thing money couldn’t buy… Some would say happiness, some would say health and some would say love. For Azra and Kerem, love was all they had. They met at the Sports Academy and never left each other.

title: La Vie En Rose
