description: A struggling martial arts teacher must compete in an underground fight ring in order to save his brother from a crime boss and reunite with his family.

title: Planet Dune
description: A crew on a mission to rescue a marooned base on a desert planet turns deadly when the crew finds themselves hunted and attacked by the planet's apex predators: giant sand worms.

title: Planet of the Sharks
description: In the near future, glacial melting has covered ninety-eight percent of Earth's landmass. Sharks have flourished, and now dominate the planet, operating as one massive school led by a mutated alpha shark.

title: Playhouse
description: In a remote Scottish castle, an irreverent writer faces terrifying consequences when his daughter falls prey to an evil curse lurking within the walls.

title: Playing for Keeps
description: Playing For Keeps is a romantic comedy about a former soccer star who returns home to put his life back together. Looking for a way to rebuild his relationship with his son, he gets roped into coaching the boy’s soccer team.

title: Playing it Cool
description: A screenwriter working on a script for a romantic movie is having a hard time because he is a little jaded when it comes to love since his mother abandoned him when he was a boy.

title: Please Stand By
description: A young autistic woman runs away from her caregiver to boldly go and deliver her 500-page Star Trek script to a writing competition in Hollywood. On an adventure full of laughter and tears, Wendy follows the guiding spirit of Mr. Spock on her journey into the unknown.

title: Plunder Quest
description: After catching wind of valuable prohibition-era whiskey hidden on an island, Thomas Waters embarks on a quest for liquid gold and ends up on the priceless adventure of a lifetime.

title: Plus One
description: Longtime single friends Alice & Ben agree to be one another's plus ones as they power through an endless parade of hilarious and insufferable weddings

title: Poetry Sans Frontiers
description: "Poetry Sans Frontiers" is a cross-cultural exchange program launched by CGTN that breaks the language boundaries through the narration and poetry recitation of different countries and characters, employs poetry to tell the story of beautiful love, genuine friendship...

title: Poker with Pistols
description: After losing everything in a poker game and finding himself indebted, Lucas agrees to deliver a wagon to the town of Chamaco for the $5000 payment. He soon finds himself in deep trouble with bandits, the town's local kingpin and a pretty saloon worker.

title: Polaroid
description: From the Producer of IT and IT: Chapter Two. High school loner Bird Fitcher has no idea what dark secrets are tied to the mysterious Polaroid vintage camera she stumbles upon, but it doesn't take long to discover that those who have their picture taken meet a tragic end.

title: Police Story: Lockdown
description: Jackie Chan stars as Wen, a cop with a history of violence, whose reunion with his daughter exposes a high-stakes hostage plot.

title: Poltergeist
description: In this terrifying take on a classic, a suburban family tormented by inter-dimensional spirits must save their daughter from being lost to the ghosts forever!

title: Poms
description: POMS is an uplifting comedy about Martha a woman who moves into a retirement community and starts a cheerleading squad with her fellow residents, Sheryl, Olive and Alice, proving that it's never too late to follow your dreams.

title: Posh Pawn
description: This exclusive documentary series goes behind the scenes with the kings of high-end pawn broking with unprecedented access to industry experts and extraordinary clients.

title: Poster Boys
description: When broke Irishman, Al Clancy, mistakenly agrees to mind his smart-ass 10-year-old nephew, Karl, for a week, his job and home are placed in jeopardy.

title: Postman Pat: The Movie
description: Postman Pat, a mail carrier, lives an idyllic life in the quaint British town of Greendale. When a national talent TV show comes to town, Pat enters.  But when he comes face-to-face with the temptations of money – can he resist?

title: Pound of Flesh
description: In China to donate his kidney to his dying niece, Deacon Lyle (Van Damme), a former black-ops agent, awakes the day before the operation to find he is the latest victim of organ theft.

title: Press Play
description: A young woman has a chance to save the love of her life when she discovers that the mix-tape they made together can transport her back in time.

title: Pressed
description: Seeing no other option, Brian decides to go all in and invests his remaining savings into a short-term drug deal, promised to yield the funds necessary to preserve his high-flying lifestyle.

title: Pressure Point
description: Friday Night Lights meets The Social Network. Starring Oscar nominee Michael Shannon and featuring Alexander Ludwig (Vikings) and Charles Melton (Riverdale) is inspirational sports drama, Pressure Point...

title: Pretenders
description: Life imitates deadly art as French New Wave obsessed film student Terry (Jack Kilmer, The Nice Guys) and his best friend, the smooth talking Phil (Shameik Moore, Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse) are both seduced by mysterious actress Catherine (Jane Levy, Evil Dead ).

title: Prevenge
description: A pitch black, wryly British comedy from the mind of Alice Lowe, Prevenge follows Ruth, a pregnant woman on a killing spree. It's her misanthropic unborn baby dictating Ruth's actions, holding society responsible for the absence of a father.

title: Primal
description: A hunter (Nicolas Cage) must fight for his life on a ship when his deadly animals—including a rare white jaguar—are set loose by a dangerous criminal out to kill everyone on board.

title: Primal Rage
description: In an American laboratory engaged in genetic research, a scientist conducts complex experiments on monkey brain cells. One day something goes wrong and a baboon bites a student passionate about journalism. The boy falls prey to an uncontrollable fury and spreads contagion in the college.

title: Prime
description: A career driven professional from Manhattan is wooed by a young painter, who also happens to be the son of her psychoanalyst.

title: Prince Avalanche
description: Two highway road workers spend the summer of 1988 away from their city lives. The isolated landscape becomes a place of misadventure as the men find themselves at odds with each other and the women they left behind.

title: Princess and the Pony
description: A sheltered young princess is sent to live with relatives in America, where she befriends a pony held captive by a shady carnivalowner.

title: Professionals for a Massacre
description: Caught selling stolen guns, three Confederate soldiers get a reprieve from the firing squad, provided they go into Mexico on a mission to recover stolen gold belonging to the Confederacy.

title: Project Nim
description: From the Oscar-winning team behind Man on Wire comes the story of Nim, the chimpanzee who in the 1970s became the focus of a landmark experiment which aimed to show that an ape could learn to communicate with language if raised and nurtured like a human child.

title: Project Wolf Hunting
description: During an extradition to South Korea, a group of dangerous criminals unite to stage a coordinated escape attempt from their floating prison.

title: Promised
description: In 1953, two young Italian children are promised in marriage by their fathers. Twenty one years on - despite changing times, fading traditions and 70's liberation - the pair are expected to marry, or face the consequences.

title: Proximity
description: Close Encounters of the Third Kind' meets 'Independence Day'. Earth is in danger and a loner named Isaac holds the key to unravelling the mystery that will expose the truth behind alien abduction.

title: Prozac Nation
description: A talented young writer struggles with self-destructive behavior and paralyzing depression during her first year at Harvard. Featuring an all-star cast including Christina Ricci, Anne Heche and Michelle Williams.

title: Public Schooled
description: Sixteen years old and homeschooled his entire life, Liam is a socially awkward genius whose universe revolves around his single mom, Claire. When early acceptance to Cambridge University collides with love, Liam deliberately bombs his final exams and forces his way into public school...

title: Pulp: A Film About Life, Death and Supermarkets
description: PULP found fame on the world stage in the 90’s with anthems like ‘Common People’ and ‘Disco 2000’. 25 years later, they return to Sheffield for their last UK concert. Giving a career best performance exclusive to the film, the band share their thoughts on fame, love, mortality & car maintenance.

title: Pumpkin Reports
description: Max Green’s new brother and sister are aliens sent to Earth as the advance party for an invasion - and he’s the only one who can stop them turning humans into unwilling slave-gardeners.

title: Punch
description: Seventeen-year-old Jim is a small-town boxing hero who carries the hopes and dreams of his father Stan on his shoulders.

title: Pup Star
description: A Yorkshire Terrier, competing in a televised singing competition, is separated from her owner by an opportunist dog pound worker.

title: Pup Star: Better 2Gether
description: After winning Pup Star and becoming an international pup sensation, Tiny has her world turned upside down when an evil rival switches her out in competition with a street pup named Scrappy.

title: Pup Star: World Tour
description: Pup Star is back, and bigger than ever as the hit singing pup competition goes global! After achieving international stardom, Tiny the adorable Yorkie joins the inaugural Pup Star World Tour as a celebrity judge.

title: Puppy Love
description: Despite a dreadful first date, two dog owners with opposite personalities are forced to continue seeing each other when their dogs hit it off, and puppies end up on the way. But maybe puppy love isn't all that's in the cards for this couple!

title: Puppy Star Christmas
description: The Pup Star family just got bigger! And the new pups: Cindy, Rosie, Charlie, and Brody will have to learn the true meaning of Christmas. When Pup Star’s mean team, scheme to ruin Christmas, the pups end up in the North Pole to save Santa and the holiday spirit...

title: Pura Vida
description: On the south face of Annapurna, at 7,400 metres, Iñaki Ochoa de Olza is dying. His rope companion sounds the alarm. And, from the other side of the world, the biggest rescue attempt in the history of the Himalayas gets underway.

title: Push
description: Riveting Sci-Fi action-thriller Push is set in a deadly world of psychic espionage where the ability to move objects using only the mind, see the future, create new realities and kill without ever touching the victim can turn a person into a lethal weapon - or a target.

title: Pusher
description: A street dealer has his life spin out of control over the course of a week when he borrows money from a drug lord and isn’t able to pay it back. Now he must come up with the cash before he is killed...and that may mean others have to die.

title: Pusher
description: The cult classic from Nicolas Winding Refn (Drive) follows drug pusher Frank as he comes to blows with Copenhagen’s underworld.

title: Pushing Tin
description: Fueled by caffeine and machismo, a rivalry ensues between Nick and Russell. The one-upmanship becomes a contest of wits and wills, where stress is the great equalizer and bravado is the lowest common denominator...

title: Quarantine - 19
description: One million dollar prize money and instant celebrity are at stake but when their reality TV show is shut down, the contestants will have to deal with a world in the grip of a Pandemic.

title: Queen of the Desert
description: Gertrude Bell, a daughter of wealthy British parents, has no interest in the social life of the London elite. Balls, receptions, and the British aristocracy bring her only boredom.

title: Quicksand
description: Ray (Tanner Presswood) and Paul (Simon Elias) are best friends and co-best men in their buddy’s wedding. But when they lose the ring just days before the wedding, their fateful road trip to get it back accelerates into a loud exploration of life, love, and how to not die.

title: Quinto: Fighting Proud
description: A gang of outlaws gather at a desert saloon after robbing a bank. However, the loot is missing and paranoia sets in, as the outlaws start knocking each other off.

title: R BnB
description: A wealthy Manhattan couple celebrates their first year anniversary at a secluded Airbnb only to realize they are being secretly videotaped.

title: R.A.D.A.R.: The Adventures of the Bionic Dog
description: A boy and his dog with bionic powers save a small town from two bumbling crooks.

title: Radius
description: A man wakes up with no memory of who he is, and finds that everyone who comes within a certain distance of him suddenly dies.

title: Raise Hell: The Life & Times of Molly Ivins
description: Raise Hell: The Life & Times of Molly Ivins tells the story of media firebrand Molly Ivins, six feet of Texas trouble who took on the Good Old Boy corruption wherever she found it. Her razor sharp wit left both sides of the aisle laughing, and craving ink in her... — Guardian

title: Raise Your Hands, Dead Man, You're Under Arrest
description: The sole survivor, named Sando Kid (Peter Lee Lawrence), of a Northern slaughter seeks vendetta. After suffering atrocity, Kid executes a single-handedly revenge, he ravages, he hits and kills each person involved in the massacre.

title: Rani Rani Rani
description: Rani, a caretaker at an abandoned factory, is lured by a group of opportunists with a mysterious device and becomes trapped in a time loop with her husband on one hand, and his brother and ruthless sister-in-law on the other.

title: Raptus: Companion Robot
description: In the wake of a savage attack, Sarah Mathis orders a new form of android therapy called Raptus, and reveals a path to recovery with twisted surprises.

title: Ratchet & Clank
description: Get ready for an action adventure of GALACTIC PROPORTIONS! Ratchet is the last of his kind, a foolhardy Lombax who grew up without a family. Clank is a pint-sized robot with more brains than brawn.

title: Rattler Kid
description: Falsely convicted for robbing an army treasury Tony Garrett manages to escape and looks for the real culprits to take revenge.

title: Reasonable Doubt
description: After being involved in a fatal hit and run incident Assistant DA Mitch Brody must prosecute an innocent man. Due to some inconclusive evidence Brody manages to throw the case, however he quickly realizes the man he thought to be innocent could just be the most dangerous man he has ever met.

title: Rebel in the Rye
description: The story of the life and mind of the legendary author J.D. Salinger and the events that led to the birth of his iconic book The Catcher in the Rye.

title: Red Corner
description: In this provocative thriller, an American (Richard Gere) on a business trip in China is framed for a brutal murder and soon finds himself at the mercy of a foreign court system he doesn't understand. Can he find the true killer before it’s too late?

title: Red Dawn
description: The citizens of Spokane, a small town in Washington state, awaken to the sight of North Korean paratroopers dropping from the sky. The U.S.A. has been invaded and their hometown is the initial target. Without warning, the town is unable to fight back and finds itself under enemy occupation.

title: Redcon-1
description: After a zombie apocalypse spreads from a London prison, the UK is brought to its knees. The spread of the virus is temporarily contained but, without a cure, it's only a matter of time before it breaks its boundaries and the biggest problem of all... any zombies with combat skills are now enhanced.

title: Redeeming Love
description: Sold into prostitution as a child, Angel knows nothing but betrayal. Can her heart ever be mended? Based upon the novel by Francine Rivers.

title: Redemption Day
description: US. Marine Captain Brad Paxton is on a rescue mission to save his wife, kidnapped by a terrorist group leader.

title: Redirected
description: Lock Stock And Two Smoking Barrels’ meets ‘The Hangover’ in the outrageous action comedy Redirected, starring Hollywood hard man Vinnie Jones. Redirected tells a story of four friends turned first-time robbers – John, Ben, Tim and Michael – who accidentally get stranded in a middle-of-nowhere...

title: Refined in China: Xinjiang
description: What do a juicy Angus steak, red wine and northern whitefish have in common?  All are produced in China.  China has a growing appetite for gourmet food, and these cravings are being satisfied domestically.

title: Rekindling Christmas
description: Drafted by the NFL Jesse left his college sweetheart behind. Now, years later, he’s back with only one goal, to win Annika back.

title: Relative Strangers
description: On a mission to locate his birth parents, a tightly wound professional (Ron Livingston, "The Conjuring") is befuddled to find that his biological parents aren't exactly upper class. With Neve Campbell, Danny DeVito and Kathy Bates.

title: Renegade
description: Reno Raines, a tough, young street cop, is framed for a murder he didn't commit. Fleeing from the only system of justice he knows, Raines takes to the streets as a modern-day bounty hunter.

title: Renegade Gunfighter
description: A man trains himself to become the best shot in the West in order to get rid of a gang of killers in his home town who murdered his parents.

title: Renegades
description: When a retired Green Beret soldier is murdered by an international drug gang in London, four of his veteran SAS comrades set out to avenge him, dispensing their own brand of justice on the streets of London.

title: Repeat
description: A zealous cognitive psychologist dedicates his life to university lecturing. While tinkering with one of his many experiments he stumbles across an unbelievable discovery-a way of communicating with the other side.

title: Reprisal
description: This gritty, action-packed crime thriller pairs action legends Bruce Willis and Frank Grillo in a chilling tale of justice and revenge. After surviving a brutal bank robbery, Jacob teams with his ex-cop neighbor to track down the ruthless thief and avenge the assault...

title: Resistance
description: The story of world-famous mime Marcel Marceau (Jesse Eisenberg), who worked with the French Resistance to save the lives of ten thousand orphans from the Nazis during World War II.

title: Resistance
description: 1944, when the women from a Welsh village find their husbands are missing, they must work with a German platoon to survive.

title: Resurrecting the Champ
description: Samuel L. Jackson plays a boxer who has fallen on hard times and become homeless. He crosses paths with a small-time sports journalist (Josh Harnett) who's looking for the article that will catapult him to fame: he finds his opportunity in the figure of the champion who's now living on the streets.

title: Rev
description: A young thief with a history of grand theft auto becomes an informant and helps police bring down a criminal enterprise involved in the smuggling of hundreds of exotic super cars.

title: Revenge for Jolly!
description: Harry (Brian Petsos) is having a very, very bad day. He returns home from an all-night drinking binge with his cousin Cecil (Oscar Isaac) to discover that his little dog Jolly - Harry's one true love and the source of light in his dark, solitary life - has been murdered.

title: Revenge Note
description: Ho Goo Hee (Kim Hyang Gi) is a quiet, sweet girl who is constantly bullied by the other students, partly because her name sounds like the word “fool.” Ji Hoon (Park Solomon) is a brooding, popular boy who reluctantly comes to her rescue more times than he would like.

title: Reverend's Colt
description: Reverend Miller arrives in Tucson where he wants to build a church but on the very day of his arrival a gang carries out a raid on the bank and the people of Tucson, who are suspicious of the new reverend because he carries a gun, immediately blame him for the robbery.

title: Revolver
description: Conman and hotshot gambler Jake Green has spent the last seven years in prison, taking the rap for a crime he did not commit. Now he’s out and itching for revenge against crime boss and casino owner Dorothy Macha.

title: Rex
description: Rex is based on the true-life story of young Marine Corporal Megan Leavey whose unique discipline and bond with her military combat dog saved many lives during their deployment in Iraq.

title: Rhino
description: Narrated by Academy-Award nominee Tom Hardy: an audacious mission to save the critically endangered Black rhino, against impossible odds.

title: Rich Man, Poor Woman
description: A man who can’t distinguish faces meets a woman who is unforgettable. Lee Yoo Chan (Suho) is the founder and CEO of the IT company Next In, which has become the most desirable place to work.

title: Riddle of Fire
description: In the rolling hills of Wyoming, three mischievous children are tasked with collecting a blueberry pie from their local store.

title: Ride
description: Jackie travels cross-country to California to be with her son after he decides to drop out of school and become a surfer.

title: Ride On
description: Action legend Jackie Chan (Vanguard, Rush Hour, Police Story) is back in an action-packed and heart-warming tribute to the world of stunts which made him an international superstar. Luo (Chan) is a washed-up stuntman whose glory days are far behind him.

title: Ride the Eagle
description: Leif (Jake Johnson) inherits a picturesque log cabin when his estranged mother Honey (Susan Sarandon) dies. But there is a condition; he must first complete her elaborate to-do list.

title: Ride Your Dream
description: Motorcycling was a man’s world, until now. This documentary introduces us to Ana Carrasco, the Spanish rider who has revolutionised the two wheels’ world and who, from an early age, had a clear dream: being world champion. +

title: Righteous Kill
description: The story begins with highly decorated Detectives Turk and Rooster of the NYPD facing a retirement which neither of them are ready for.  Before they can hang up their badges, they are called to investigate the murder of a notorious pimp, who appears to have ties to a case they solved years before.

title: Riki-Oh: The Story of Ricky
description: Set in 2001, where all correctional facilities have been privatised, martial artist Ricky finds himself victim to the corrupt system when he is found guilty of manslaughter. In jail he must fight for survival when he's thrown into a world of enemies.

title: Riot Girls
description: In an alternate 1995, a mysterious disease has wiped out all of the adults. In this new age, two gangs are pitted against each other in a brutal war for territory, resources and survival.

title: Riptide
description: The cases of a private investigations agency run by two Vietnam War veterans and their computer geek friend from high school, armed with toughness, their own helicopter, and the third's technical ability.

title: Rise of the Jurassic
description: A young scientist and her team arrive at a mysterious island, looking for answers as to what happened to her father who disappeared there years ago. What they find is beyond what any of them expected.

title: Rise of the Viking
description: From the director of epic fantasy favourite, 'Black Sails', and starring 'Breaking Bad's' Jonathan Banks, is historical actioner 'Rise of the Viking'.

title: Risen
description: Disaster unfolds in Badger, a farming town in the state of New York when a meteor strike contaminates the air, turning it toxic. People begin to die. The entire town drop dead - plants, animals, and humans.

title: River Memories
description: A community is about to disappear. Faced with a government-imposed plan, the inhabitants of The Platz, a huge shanty town in Turin, Italy, face eviction. This film documents the last months of its existence.

title: River Runs Red
description: Taye Diggs, George Lopez and John Cusack star in this action-packed battle for revenge at any price.

title: Road
description: Stunning action, candid race day scenes and a gripping narrative, Road is the story of two generations of one family that have been united by tragedy.

title: Road Wars: Max Fury
description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, two sisters leave their stronghold to save their wounded mother. Armed only with a muscle car and limited ammo, they race against ruthless raiders to secure lifesaving supplies from a distant outpost.

title: Rob1n
description: When a robotics expert channels the grief of losing his 11-year-old son into building 'Robin', a series of horrific events makes it clear Robin wants his creator all to himself.

title: Robin's Wish
description: Robin's Wish is the final word in the story of what really happened to Robin Williams at the end of his life, it reveals the beauty and power behind the mind of one of the greatest entertainers of all time.

title: Robot Riot
description: A group of soldiers awaken in an abandoned town with no memory, only to find they’re test subjects for giant battle robots controlled by a mad general. Trapped and outgunned, they must fight to survive and uncover the truth. Robot Riot is nonstop action.

title: Rocket Jo
description: In the city of Ultrapolis, informed by his fellow pigeons, Randolf is fighting swindlers and crime. He transforms into a mysterious, comical and lovable hero named Pigeon Boy. He may be more Charlie Chaplin than Batman or Superman but he does his best to catch criminal…

title: Romance and Cigarettes
description: A down-and-dirty' musical set in the world of working-class New York, tells a story of a husband's journey into infidelity and redemption.

title: Romance in the Wilds
description: Amid a deadly wildfire, an unexpected romance ignites between a forest ranger and a geologist as they race to escape the flames.

title: Romance Retreat
description: After a break-up, journalist Dana Willingham finds herself alone and stuck at a couple’s yoga retreat while the biggest story of her career breaks far away. But when she meets handsome fellow retreater Stefan Gonzales who’s lying low after being the center of a scandal, she smells a good story.

title: Row
description: Washed ashore in Scotland on a blood stained rowing boat, a young woman suffering from severe memory loss appears to be the sole survivor of a doomed trans-Atlantic World Record attempt.

title: Rules Don't Apply
description: An aspiring young actress and her ambitious young driver struggle hopefully with the absurd eccentricities of the wildly unpredictable billionaire Howard Hughes, for whom they work.

title: Rules of Engagement
description: An attorney defends an officer on trial for ordering his troops to fire on civilians after they stormed a U.S. embassy in a Middle Eastern country.

title: Rumeysa: Walking Tall
description: After a lifetime of physical challenges and adversity, the world’s tallest woman is ready to fulfil her dream and travel to California, USA. Her mission: to spread awareness for those with visible differences. On her journey, she’ll encounter some of the world's most extraordinary women.

title: Runaway Jury
description: Set in New Orleans, this is the story of a mysterious man, Nick Easter. Nick gets himself not only on the jury of a landmark case against a gun manufacturer, but as the foreman, in an attempt to influence the other jury members to vote a certain way.

title: Runner Runner
description: Princeton grad student Richie, believing he’s been swindled, travels to Costa Rica to confront online gambling tycoon Ivan Block. Richie is seduced by Block’s promise of immense wealth, until he learns the disturbing truth about his benefactor...

title: Running Naked
description: The friendship of cancer survivors Ben and Mark is tested when a piece of news forces each character to change their perspective. Old wounds are opened as they discover their true selves.

title: Running with the Devil
description: When a cocaine shipment is compromised to the dismay of the Cartel's ringleader, The Boss (Barry Pepper) orders his most trusted Man (Laurence Fishburne) and another master drug trafficker, The Cook (Nicolas Cage), on a dangerous journey to audit the company's supply chain.

title: Russell Madness
description: For Russell, a lovable terrier, family means everything and he'll do anything to find one to call his own – even get in the wrestling ring and take on the reigning champion!

title: Rust Road
description: An act of fate sees two brothers collide with two criminals and a bag of stolen money. They decide to run off with the loot, leaving one man dead at the scene. However the remaining criminal, is still alive and escapes custody to hunt down his money.

title: Ruth & Alex
description: When Ruth and Alex opt to put their apartment on the market over one crazy weekend, they discover that finding a new apartment is not about winding down...

title: Ruthless
description: A high school coach, whose teenage daughter was murdered, takes matters into his own hands by going after the men who kidnap his student for their human trafficking operation.

title: Sabotage
description: Sabotage, an action thriller that follows one of the best assault teams on the planet, an elite special operations team of ten DEA agents.

title: Sabotage
description: When an ex-Navy commando turned body guard fails to protect his client from assassination, he discovers ties between the assassins, himself and the failed mission that led to his discharge from the services years earlier.

title: Safari Express
description: John Baxter comes across the beautiful Miriam, who has lost her memory. Becoming his protector and friend, he finds himself involved in a series of attacks on the life of the woman, the only witness to the criminal activities of a Dutch engineer, van Daalem.

title: Safe
description: When ex-Government agent Luke Wright exposes the Russian mafia for rigging an illegal fight, they seek revenge on his family and threaten to kill anyone close to him.

title: Safety123
description: Seen from afar, the Alps may look like a picturesque fantasy, but those who live beneath them know how menacing they can be.

title: Saints & Soliders 2: Airborne Creed
description: On August 15th 1944, the 517th Parachute Regimental Combat Team (PRCT) jumped over the south of France. In their effort to complete the mission and rendezvous with their unit, three isolated paratroopers come across a group of French resistants in desperate need.

title: Saints and Soldiers - Battle of the Tanks
description: Germany, May 1945, deep in the Harz Mountains a U.S. tank crew discovers a platoon of Germans preparing to ambush U.S. supply trucks. A deadly game of cat and mouse quickly unfolds as the Americans find themselves out-gunned and out-manned by three German tanks.

title: Salt and fire
description: A scientist blames the head of a large company for an ecological disaster in South America. But when a volcano begins to show signs of erupting, they must unite to avoid a disaster.

title: Salvation Boulevard
description: Set in the world of mega churches in which a former Deadhead turned born again Christian finds himself on the run from fundamentalist members of his mega church who will do anything to protect their larger than life pastor.

title: Sam & Kate
description: Starring Academy Award®-winners Dustin Hoffman and Sissy Spacek, Sam & Kate is a heartwarming, multi-generational family story bringing together four people who are given a second chance at love, and life.

title: Samaritan
description: Twenty years ago, Granite City’s hometown hero, Samaritan, was reported dead after a fiery warehouse battle with his rival, Nemesis. Most in the city believe he perished in the fire, but one young boy holds out hope that Samaritan still lives!

title: Samba
description: Samba came to France 10 years ago from Senegal. He plugs away at various lowly jobs. Alice is a senior executive who has recently undergone a burnout. He is willing to do whatever it takes to get working papers, while she is trying to get her life back together by doing volunteer work...

title: Sanctioning Evil
description: After being dishonorably discharged from the military, a Staff Sergeant finds his way back into society through a charismatic politician with a covert military operation to eliminate an underground criminal entity on U.S soil.

title: Sanctuary
description: The enigmatic Dr. Helen Magnus (AMANDA TAPPING) recruits an insightful forensic psychiatrist Will Zimmerman (ROBIN DUNNE) to join her in the quest to track, study and protect the strange, and often terrifying creatures that secretly populate our world.

title: Santa Claws
description: Tommy leaves his kittens out for Santa to take back to the North Pole, but after a major allergic reaction Santa can't deliver presents anymore, so the kittens have to deliver the rest of the presents to all the boys and girls.

title: Santa's Cousin
description: Disaster strikes when a man promises to give away his uncle's fortune during the holidays.

title: Santa's Promise
description: Disaster strikes when a man promises to give away his uncle's fortune during the holidays.

title: Sartana and His Shadow of Death
description: Sartana tries to avoid the bounty on his head by negotiating with a politician who wants him engaged in the hunt for the Randal brothers.

title: Saturday Church
description: La La Land meets Moonlight. A 14 year-old-boy struggling with his identity, creates a world of musical fantasy.

title: Savage
description: Inspired by the true stories of New Zealand's street gangs across 30 years, Savage follows Danny at three defining moments in his life as he grows from a boy into the violent enforcer of a gang.

title: Savage Justice
description: Newly engaged Shelby John (Jack Huston) and Ruby Red want a fresh start after their struggles with addiction, but when Shelby discovers his beloved Ruby dead on their porch, he embarks on a vengeful killing spree of the dealers who supplied her.

title: Save the Date
description: Lizzy Caplan and Alison Brie star in a romantic comedy about 2 very different sisters, and their adventures in love, lust and a race to the altar.

title: Saving Santaland
description: Sparks fly between a famous model and a farmer with a young daughter when she visits her childhood home. The town is in danger of losing their beloved Santaland festival, but miracles can happen with a little love, family, and faith.

title: Say When
description: Megan (Keira Knightley) panics when her boyfriend proposes and hides out in the home of her new teenage friend Annika (Chloë Grace Moretz).

title: Scales: Mermaids are Real
description: Mermaids Are Real! Siren Phillips has lived her whole life thinking she's an ordinary girl, but on the eve of her twelfth birthday she learns that she is far from ordinary.

title: Scalps
description: A group of Southern soldiers attacks an Indian tribe, killing everyone. Only one squaw manages to escape and is saved by a gunfighter who falls in love with her. Together they will seek revenge by fighting the soldiers and her cruel captain.

title: Scarlet Winter
description: A married man wakes with a bloody knife in his hand and his dead mistress in his bed. At first convinced of his guilt, he buries the body, but as he pieces together the events of the night before, he believes he is being framed and there is a murderer among the people closest to him.

title: Scenes of a Sexual Nature
description: This British comedy stars an incredible home-grown cast including Tom Hardy, Ewan McGregor, Catherine Tate, Mark Strong, Hugh Bonneville, Andrew Lincoln and Adrian Lester. On the lush green lawns of London's Hampstead Heath, a variety of couples sort through their romantic dilemmas.

title: Scoop
description: An American journalism student in London scoops a big story, and begins an affair with an aristocrat as the incident unfurls.

title: Sea Level
description: Pup, a bamboo shark, discovers egg sacs while playing around the ocean with his friends. When he sees human poachers stealing the eggs from his reef, Pup makes it his mission to save his family.

title: Season of the Witch
description: Fourteenth century knights transport a suspected witch to a monastery, where monks deduce her powers could be the source of the Black Plague.

title: Second Coming
description: Jackie, husband Mark  and their son JJ are a close family navigating their way through life in present day London. The humour is part of their everyday lives. Jackie discovers she is pregnant and is perplexed.

title: Second Samuel
description: It’s 1949,  Second Samuel town and the whole community is turned upside down when the death of their beloved Miss Gertrude leaves them all questioning just who was- and is- their neighbor.

title: Seduced and Abandoned
description: A "meta-documentary" from James Toback and Alec Baldwin, about their attempts to raise money for another film—one with no title or script, just a star.

title: See for Me
description: See For Me is an original, edge-of-your-seat home invasion thriller with a killer twist.

title: See You Then
description: Set over one night, two exes reconnect in this acclaimed and captivating LGBTQ story.

title: Seize the Night
description: Over the course of one night, a whirlwind romance between a drug dealer and a mysterious singer takes them on a collision course with a dangerous mind-control drug through the Los Angeles underground scene.

title: Senior Moment
description: Stripped of his driver's license, a retired NASA pilot must not only battle with the DMV, he must find new ways to navigate love and life without his beloved vintage Porsche.

title: Senior Year: Love Never Fails
description: CJ & Marcella struggle to protect their relationship against pressure from family, faith and friends when a devastating discovery upends their lives.

title: Septembers of Shiraz
description: At once a moving human drama and a timely suspense thriller, Septembers of Shiraz is the story of a family thrust into an unimaginably surreal experience in post-Revolutionary Iran.

title: Settlers
description: Following ecological disaster, a family from Earth do what they must to survive on a desolate Mars homestead.

title: SEVE - Artist, Fighter, Legend
description: Seve Ballesteros was an artist, a golfing Picasso. He was a fighter; against back injury, rivals on the golf course, a disintegrating swing, and finally cancer.

title: Seven Cemeteries
description: A recent parolee (Danny Trejo) gets a Mexican witch to resurrect his old posse so that they can help him save a woman's ranch from a ruthless drug lord.

title: Seven Pistols for a Massacre
description: A man is arrested, tried and convicted for a robbery that was actually committed by someone else.

title: Severance
description: Working nine to five is a real killer, but team-building holidays can be even worse. Seven colleagues find themselves faced with the chop when their corporate weekend in the wilds of Eastern Europe descends into a deadly nightmare.

title: Seymour: An Introduction
description: Ethan Hawke’s directorial debut shines a light on pianist, Seymour Bernstein. The former performer and now teacher discusses his passion for music, the tribulations of fame, and his philosophy on life in this intimate portrayal of a gifted artist.

title: Shade
description: In the shadowy criminal underbelly of illegal gambling, top-notch con men Vernon (Stuart Townsend), Miller (Gabriel Byrne) and Tiffany (Thandiwe Newton) join forces with fellow player Jennings (Jamie Foxx) to take down some big scores.

title: Shadow
description: When a young soldier leaves for a mountain biking excursion, he meets the girl of his dreams as well as a group of violent locals who want to see them dead at any cost.

title: Shadow Fighter
description: A homeless ex-boxer and an inner-city kid's unlikely bond helps them face their future, while fighting the tragedy from their past.

title: Shaolin Wooden Men
description: A young Little Mute witnesses his father being murdered by an unidentified assassin. Filled with rage, he vows to avenge his death by mastering various martial arts techniques.

title: Shark Attack 3: Megalodon
description: When two researchers discover a colossal shark's tooth off the Mexican coast their worst fears surface - the most menacing beast to ever rule the waters is still alive and mercilessly feeding on anything that crosses its path.

title: Shark Killer
description: A shark exterminator must retrieve a rare diamond from the stomach of a massive black-finned white shark; however, the powerful local crime lord has, too, set his sights on the gem. Will the fearless shark killer live up to his reputation?

title: Shark Lake
description: A black market animal trafficker releases one of his most treasured exotic species into serene Lake Tahoe for ‘safe-keeping’ while he serves a prison sentence. However this isn’t so safe for the locals, who begin to become part of the food chain at an unbelievable rate.

title: Shark Season
description: Three kayakers fight for their lives when a great white shark traps them on a small, sinking island.

title: Shark Side of the Moon
description: Decades ago, the USSR developed unkillable sharks and launched them to the moon. Today, a team of American astronauts will endure the fight of their lives.

title: Shark!
description: A gunrunner loses his cargo near a small coastal Sudanese town so he's stuck there. When a woman hires him to raid a sunken ship in the shark-infested waters, he sees a chance to compensate for his losses. He's not the only one.

title: Sharkenstein
description: In the final days of World War II, a secret experiment to weaponize sharks is shut down and destroyed by the Third Reich. But now, 60 years later, a small ocean town is plagued by a bloodthirsty, mysterious creature.

title: Sharknado
description: When a freak tornado swamps Los Angeles, thousands of man-eating sharks are sucked into the swirling vortex, terrorizing the waterlogged populace and flooding the city with shark-infested seawater.

title: Sharknado 2: The Second One
description: Fin Shepard and his ex-wife April are flying to New York City when their plane enters the most unnatural of storms and is battered by airborne sharks.

title: Sharknado 3: Oh Hell No!
description: When Fin and April head to Florida, they are quickly warned of trouble ahead as the Sunshine State is overcome with strong winds and a dangerous tumult of rain....

title: Sharknado 4: The Fourth Awakens
description: After a blissful few years Sharknado free,  Fin (Ian Ziering, Sharknado 1, 2 & 3, 90210) and April (Tara Reid, Sharknado 1, 2 & 3, American Pie) have to face their bloodiest Sharknado attack yet!

title: Sharknado 5: Global Swarming
description: With much of America lying in ruins, the rest of the world braces for a global sharknado, and Fin and his family must travel around the world to stop them.

title: Sharknado: Feeding Frenzy
description: What began as another Syfy creature feature has now become an important piece of pop culture - poised to take over the entire world.

title: Sharknado: Heart of Sharkness
description: A 'mockumentary' about David Moore, the filmmaker who first dreamed of "sharks in a tornado" and brought on disaster by using real sharks. The first SHARKNADO was to be a movie never seen, a crime never reported, a tale never told. Until now.

title: Shattered Earth. Cloudy Mountain
description: A peaceful town turns into a living hell when a devastating earthquake is triggered, causing buildings to tumble and sinkholes to open. A retired railway soldier and his son, an explosives engineer, travel deep into a cave to rescue trapped survivors.

title: She Dies Tomorrow
description: In this dark apocalyptic thriller, Amy's carefully mended life begins to unravel as her delusions of certain death become contagious to those around her. As the fear spreads, Amy and her friends' lives spiral out of control in a tantalising descent into madness.

title: She Will
description: An aging film star retreats to rural Scotland to recuperate. While there, mysterious forces of revenge emerge from the land where witches were burned.

title: She's A Criminal
description: Sue, a young bartender, desperate to make quick money to save her family bar, partners up with a cunning thief to pull a dangerous heist. When their scheme goes awry, Sue must resort to more criminal activities before she loses everything.

title: She's Funny That Way
description: Isabella, a young Hollywood starlet, recalls how the actions of charming Broadway director, Arnold, changed her life forever.

title: Shih
description: Shih captures the return of Paola Shih to Taiwan to meet with her father after twenty years of separation.

title: Shock Wave: Hong Kong Destruction
description: A disgruntled former bomb disposal officer Poon (Andy Lau, Infernal Affairs, House of Flying Daggers) , who awakes from a coma with amnesia, becomes a fugitive when the police suspect him of being involved in bomb attacks.

title: ShockWave: Countdown to Disaster
description: A stolen seismic weapon is activated in Yemen. A hostage freed there tries in vain to warn against its global effect. It starts seismic activity at the Californian fault line where her daughter and ex are monitoring it. Can they stop it?

title: Shoot first, die later
description: Domenico Malacarne, despite being a police commissioner, is in collusion with the underworld that takes advantage of his corrupt relations to obtain large profits. Gradually, however, he realizes the exaggeration of the mafia and begins to hinder its operations.

title: Shoplifters
description: On the margins of Tokyo, a dysfunctional band of outsiders are united by loyalty, a penchant for petty theft and playful grifting. When the young son is arrested, secrets are exposed that upend their tenuous, below-the-radar existence.

title: Short Term 12
description: Short Term 12 is told through the eyes of Grace (Brie Larson), a twenty-something supervisor at a foster-care facility for at-risk teenagers. Passionate and tough, Grace is a formidable caretaker of the kids in her charge, and in love with her long-term boyfriend, Mason (John Gallagher Jr.).

title: Shortcut to Happiness
description: A down-and-out writer sells his soul to the devil in exchange for fame and fortune. Starring Anthony Hopkins, Alec Baldwin and Jennifer Love Hewitt.

title: Shoshana
description: Inspired by real events, Shoshana is a political thriller set in the 1930s in Tel Aviv, a brand new European, Jewish city being built on the shores of the Mediterranean.

title: Shrapnel
description: A former Marine and his old war buddy face off against the Mexican cartel behind the disappearance of his daughter.

title: Shutter
description: A newly married couple discovers disturbing, ghostly images in photographs they develop after an eerie accident in which they believe they may have hit a young girl with their car.

title: Shuttlecock: Directors Cut
description: During a memorial for his father, WW II hero Major James Prentis confesses a dark family secret to his son, something he has harbored for more than 20 years.

title: Siberia
description: John Wick meets John Le Carre with Keanu Reeves as a gun- toting diamond dealer going up against the Russian mob, in this chilly, action-packed thriller...

title: Siberian Education
description: A violent crime drama starring John Malkovich and Peter Stormare. In a forgotten corner of Siberia run by a community of criminals, two boys are taught to live by a ruthless moral code.

title: Silent Night
description: Recently released from prison and struggling to find work, Mark meets Alan, his former cell-mate, who encourages him to return to a life of crime.

title: Silicon Cowboys
description: In this historical documentary, three friends dream up the Compaq portable computer at a Texas diner in 1981 and soon find themselves battling mighty IBM for PC supremacy.

title: Silk Road
description: The creator of Silk Road, the dark web’s first criminal marketplace, becomes the target for an erratic DEA agent who is determined to take him down.

title: Silk Stalkings
description: Best friends Rita and Chris are a pair of homicide detectives who battle crime in glitzy Palm Beach, Fla. Starring Mitzi Kapture and Rob Estes.

title: Simply Irresistible
description: Beautiful restaurant owner Amanda Shelton (Sarah Michelle Gellar) is falling head over heels for handsome, hard-driving executive Tom Bartlett (Sean Patrick Flanery). Unfortunately, Tom is too busy to recognize that he's met the girl of his dreams--until Amanda puts him under her tantalizing spell!

title: Sin City 2: A Dame to Kill For
description: In a town where justice doesn't prevail, the desperate want vengeance and ruthless murderers find themselves with vigilantes on their heels. Their paths cross in Sin City’s famous Kadie's Club Pecos.

title: Sinbad and The Fifth Voyage
description: When an evil sorcerer, known as the White Thief, kidnaps Firoozeh and holds her hostage in the Black Desert, Sinbad has 40 days and 40 nights to rescue her.

title: Sins of My Father
description: Sins of My Father. Pablo Escobar told by his son. The role of the son in the history of mafia bears a responsibility that very few people would be willing to assume. From the beginning the descendent is doomed, against his own will, to the consequences of the actions of his ancestors.

title: SinÉl
description: Due to the situation derived from the health crisis, when Inma's partner dies suddenly, she is forced to live for 48 hours with the corpse - of her abuser.

title: Six Feet
description: A lone front desk attendant in an isolated motel must battle his anxiety disorder, cleaning obsession and possible motel contamination while serving quarantined guests in the middle of a deadly global pandemic.

title: Skateistan
description: Inspired by Skateistan, Afghanistan's first skateboarding school, this emotional feature-length documentary is a journey deep into the lives of Afghanistan's urban youth. It chronicles the efforts of a grass-roots organization to build the first skate hall in Kabul.

title: Skin
description: A black child born to white parents is cast out of white society in 1950s South Africa. The film follows her thirty-year journey to acceptance.

title: Skye Hoshi - Anime Girl
description: Anime character Skye Hoshi mysteriously becomes real and falls out of her poster, it's up to slacker comic store employee Atom to help her get back home before her anime is destroyed.

title: Skyfire
description: A brand-new resort opens to the public, owned by Jack Harris, next to a stunning mountain range & a dormant volcano. It’s the most idyllic place on earth, until the mountain decides to wake up!

title: Sleepless
description: When Las Vegas cop Vincent Downs (Jamie Foxx) and his partner Sean (Tip “T.I.” Harris) rob a cocaine shipment bound for a drug-dealing casino boss (Dermot Mulroney), the desperate businessman retaliates by kidnapping Vincent’s son (Octavius J. Johnson

title: SlingShot
description: An intimate and inspirational portrait of Segway inventor, Dean Kamen, his fascinating life, and his 15-year quest to solve the world's safe water crisis. Iconoclast, Kamen, is a modern hero.

title: Slow West
description: Michael Fassbender (Xmen: Days of Future Past, Twelve Years A Slave) stars in Slow West, the story of a 17 year old boy named Jay (Kodi Smit-mcPhee; Dawn of the Planet of the Apes) who travels from Scotland to Colorado in pursuit of the woman he loves.

title: Smart Home Nation
description: Showcasing the incredible technologies that are transforming the way we live, Smart Home Nation offers a VIP tour of the most amazing automated homes on the planet. It’s an infinitely customizable fantasy world—with great tips for making any home just a little bit smarter

title: Smart People
description: A widowed professor (Dennis Quaid) experiences a new love and an unexpected visit from his adopted brother.

title: Smother
description: After being fired from his job, an everyday guy faces pressure from his wife about having a baby, while having to deal with his suffocating mother, who has decided to move in with the couple.

title: Sniper Special Ops
description: A special ops military force, led by expert sniper Jake Chandler (Steven Seagal), is sent to a remote village to extract an American congressman being held by terrorists.

title: Snitch
description: In the fast-paced action thriller SNITCH, Dwayne Johnson stars as a father whose teenage son is wrongly accused of a drug distribution crime and is looking at a mandatory minimum prison sentence of 10 years.

title: Snow Angel
description: In the aftermath of a fatal accident in a snowy village at the Eastern tip of Quebec, a screwed-up ex-pro snowboarder decides to pack up her cabin and leave town for good, but someone, or something - seems intent on stopping her.

title: Snow To Sand
description: Through a stunning cinematography, in this documentary we follow two explores that embark on an unprecedented winter expedition of the Pacific Crest Trail from Canada to Mexico.

title: Snow White & The Red Shoes
description: A magic curse turns seven boastful princes into dwarfs until they can find a princess who would restore their appearance with a kiss. At the same time, nearby Snow White finds a pair of magic shoes that can transform her appearance at will. Based on the fairytale by the Brothers Grimm.

title: Snow White and the Seven Samurai
description: Left for dead by her rich and powerful stepmother, Snow White is taken in by a team of assassins - The Seven Samurai, who train her in their ways of fighting.

title: Snowden
description: In 2013 Edward Snowden quietly leaves his job at the NSA and flies to Hong Kong to meet with journalists Glenn Greenwald and Ewen MacAskill and filmmaker Laura Poitras to reveal U.S. government cyber surveillance programs of epic proportions.

title: So I Married the Anti-Fan
description: Superstar celebrity Hoo Joon (Choi Tae Joon) meets his match in spunky magazine reporter Lee Geun Young (Choi Sooyoung) at the opening ceremony of a new nightclub.

title: Socorro Evolution
description: A team of marine wildlife ambassadors prepare themselves for a great adventure around Mexico’s Revillagigedo Archipelago, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Internationally renowned free divers show us the beauty of how man can explore marine wildlife while still conserving it.

title: Solitary Man
description: When his perfect world crashes down around him, Ben Kalmen (Michael Douglas) is forced to pick up the pieces and start his quest for success all over again.

title: Sommersby
description: A man presumed dead shows up after six years, but he may be an imposter, and could choose to hang for murder rather than reveal the truth.

title: Son of a Gun
description: JR busts out of prison with Brendan Lynch, Australia's most notorious criminal, and joins Lynch's gang for a gold heist that soon pits the two men against one another.

title: Songs for a Sloth
description: Maxwell is shocked to find he's inherited a sloth sanctuary from his father. When a talking sloth then visits his dreams, he becomes obsessed with saving the animal's habitat in his waking life by returning to his first passion, music.

title: Sons of Summer
description: Four surfing sons plan a tribute 'surfari' to a small beach town for one of their fathers murdered three decades earlier. But some road trips are to die for.

title: SOS Survive or Sacrifice
description: A hot air balloon joyride in Cyprus takes a dangerous turn when it becomes untethered and the passengers ascend without a pilot. As they are pushed far out over the ocean, it’s a desperate fight for their lives where every choice they make could be the difference in their survival.

title: Sound of Freedom
description: In this global box office sensation, an ex-federal agent embarks on a dangerous journey to rescue a victim of child trafficking from a terrible fate.

title: Southern Fury
description: A Southern mobster attempts to rescue his kidnapped brother.

title: Soy médico - I'm a doctor
description: "I am a doctor" aims to highlight the Medical Profession, emphasizing its values that help generate vocations based on the pride of being a doctor.

title: Spanish Lake
description: Spanish Lake is a bold and unflinching documentary on 'white flight' in the area of Spanish Lake, Missouri, a post WW2 suburb.

title: Speed Kills
description: Based on the true story of one of Miami’s most notorious businessmen and gangster's, SPEED KILLS is a high-octane thriller, described as “The Wolf of Wall Street on Water.”

title: Spider
description: After a long period in a mental institution - the result of a traumatic childhood - he returns to the streets of the East End of London where he grew up. The sights, sounds and the smells of those streets begin to awaken the deeply buried memories.

title: Spinning Gold
description: The incredible true story of Casablanca Records, and the madness behind the music that became the soundtrack of our lives.

title: Spiritual Kung Fu
description: Yi-Lang, a martial arts student, is made to guard the school after a book is stolen. Consequently, he discovers ghosts who teach him a lost martial arts style to help him defeat the thief.

title: Split Second
description: In a futuristic London where rising sea levels have placed large areas of the city under water, a burned out cop is assigned to investigate a series of bizarre murders which point to a non-human killer.

title: Spooks: The Greater Good
description: When charismatic terrorist Adem Qasim escapes from MI5 custody during a high profile handover, legendary operative Harry Pearce, Head of Counter-terrorism, is blamed. Disgraced and forced to resign, Harry disappears without a trace.

title: Spree
description: Meet Kurt Kunkle, a 23-year-old rideshare driver so desperate for social media attention, he'll stop at nothing to go viral. Kurt comes up with a plan to broadcast a killing spree as a shortcut to infamy.

title: Spring
description: A young man in a personal tailspin flees the US to Italy, where he sparks up a romance with a girl hiding a dark secret.

title: Sputnik
description: At the height of the Cold War, a Soviet spacecraft crash lands after a mission gone awry, leaving only one survivor. After a renowned psychologist is brought in to evaluate the cosmonaut's mental state, it becomes clear that something alien has come back to Earth with him.

title: Spy Game
description: From the Director of Top Gun and Enemy of the State comes an unbelievable action-thriller set against a world of global intrigue, starring Academy Award winners Robert Redford and Brad Pitt.

title: Spy Intervention
description: When a top-secret super spy suddenly meets the woman of his dreams, he abandons his adventurous existence and settles for the security of suburbia, revelling in the quaint existence he's never known. One year later, he is completely bored, though he refuses to admit it.

title: Sri Asih
description: Alana was separated from her parents and adopted by a rich woman. As she reaches adulthood, she discovers the truth about her origin: she is not an ordinary human being.

title: St. Agatha
description: St Agatha is a twisted horror thriller which pushes the boundaries of the “nunsploitation” genre from Darren Lynn Bousman, the director of SAW II, III and IV.

title: Stage Fright
description: As a starry-eyed teenager follows her mother's footsteps into musical theatre, her latest production is terrorised by a masked killer.

title: Standing on the Shoulders of Kitties
description: Bubbles' band lands a European tour but gets kicked off, forcing them to busk. Randy is their roadie. Can Ricky and Julian save them from the streets of Prague?

title: Standing Up for Sunny
description: An isolated guy with cerebral palsy is railroaded into helping an unassertive comedienne, and finds love and acceptance through stand up comedy.

title: Stardog and Turbocat
description: Launched into space by his scientist owner in 1969, loyal dog Buddy crash lands in the present-day in a small town where pets are ruthlessly rounded up by animal-hating cop Peck.

title: Stardust
description: Chronicles the young David Bowie's first visit to the US in 1971 - a trip that inspired the invention of his iconic alter ego, Ziggy Stardust.

title: Starting Up Love
description: Workaholic Jillian inherits a beautiful mountainside cabin after her long-lost, wealthy uncle dies.

title: Stash House
description: A couple love their new house, bought for a steal out of a foreclosure. During their first visit they find illegal drugs stashed in the walls and realize this is not their dream house. As they are about to leave, suddenly their exit is blocked by a gun-wielding neighbor Spector and his accomplice…

title: Stay
description: A thriller about a psychologist whose suicidal client makes bizarre predictions that--to the psychologist's mounting terror-- begin to come true. The shrink must race against time to save everything he loves before it disappears.

title: Stealing Cars
description: A confident yet rebellious teen goes spiralling  downward into the grim injustice of the juvenile penal system, where he encounters brutal conflicts as he struggles to confront the tragedy that set him on his course. Ultimately, he finds renewed hope, life‐affirming friendships and self-forgiveness.

title: Stealing Sinatra
description: In 1963, three enterprising, middle-class friends from southern California planned the impossible: the kidnapping of Frank Sinatra, Jr. Minute by minute, misstep by misstep.

title: Stem Cell
description: A brilliant neurosurgeon is found murdered in his own operating room. The picture is gruesome. Who killed him used the same tools of his specialty. Who is the murderer? A psychopath? Someone inside the institution? Commissioner Lorenzo Aliprandi and his homicide squad will meet again.

title: Still Alice
description: Alice Howland, happily married with three grown children, is a renowned linguistics professor who starts to forget words. When she receives a devastating diagnosis, Alice and her family find their bonds tested.

title: Still Today
description: After being left at the altar, Pete’s groomsman give him a wedding gift he’ll never forget. An escort. Maybe it’s the Lunar Eclipse, maybe it’s fate, but after a magical night in the city maybe this girl is what Pete needed all along.

title: Stir of Echoes
description: A man with the gift of prescience becomes obsessed with the ghost of a young woman who was raped, murdered and buried in his basement by two high school football jocks.

title: Stir of Echoes: The Homecoming
description: A soldier returns home from the Iraq war only to be haunted by visions of the dead.

title: Stolen
description: Director Simon West and Nicolas Cage team-up for the first time since the 1997 blockbuster CON AIR for STOLEN, a unique fast paced action thriller that takes place during 10 frantic hours on Mardi Gras day in New Orleans.

title: Stone
description: Academy-Award winner Robert De Niro and Academy-Award nominee Edward Norton deliver powerful performances as a seasoned corrections official and a scheming inmate whose lives become dangerously intertwined in this thought-provoking drama.

title: Stone Creek Killer
description: A small-town police chief pursues a serial killer with help from a psychic, while fighting to prove his own innocence and facing his demons both past and present.

title: Stonewall
description: As Danny and his friends experience discrimination, endure atrocities and are repeatedly harassed by the police, we see a rage begin to build.

title: Stork of Hope
description: Two Jewish brothers parents are killed in WWII and their only possession is a family photo that they tear in half, each keeping a piece. They become separated and older brother Ilya never gives up hope of being reunited with his brother - decades later he receives a phone call that changes his life.

title: Stowaway
description: A tenacious party girl fights to survive after three thieves commandeer her luxury yacht.

title: Straight Up
description: A gay OCD twentysomething finds his intellectual soul mate in a struggling actress.

title: Strange Weather
description: A poignant, lyrical drama about a mother who, in an effort to deal with the death of her son, travels the back roads of the Deep South to settle a score.

title: Stratton
description: Stratton (Dominic Cooper) is a determined and dedicated SBS operative working alongside MI5. After losing his American counterpart on a mission, Stratton meets Sumner (Connie Nielsen) from MI6, who happens to have a past with Barovski, the terrorist he was targetting.

title: Strawberry Mansion
description: In the near future an unassuming dream tax auditor gets swept up in a cosmic journey through the life and dreams of an ageing eccentric.

title: Stray
description: An orphaned teenager teams up with a detective to investigate her mother's murder and uncovers the supernatural forces plaguing her and her family's past. STRAY begins as a seemingly standard homicide investigation, bringing Detective Murphy to discover a family with secret supernatural powers.

title: Street Kings
description: When evidence implicates a veteran LAPD cop in the execution of a fellow officer, he is forced to go up against the cop culture he's been a part of his entire career.

title: Strong Enough
description: A cross-training athlete on the path to become a pro tests her limits one afternoon by pursuing several world-records just as conflict from her dissolving marriage collides, threatening to derail her.

title: Studio One Forever
description: Experience the untold story of America's first gay disco, a kaleidoscopic excursion into LGBTQ+ history through the lens of the groundbreaking club.

title: Stunt Squad
description: The merchants of Bologna are victims of a cruel gang of racketeers. Commissioner Grifi organizes a special team.

title: Submerged
description: A young woman and her friends, who've been targeted by kidnappers, must do everything they can to survive after their limo is forced off the road and plunged into a canal.

title: Submerged
description: The launch of the world's first anti-missile satellite takes a disastrous turn when it is sabotaged by terrorists (starring Coolio as their leader), who plunge the jet carrying the control computer into the ocean.

title: Submission
description: A cynical college professor, bored with his life and struggling with his second novel, takes a keen interest in a talented young female student. Before long, boundaries are crossed but who is the transgressor?

title: Suburbicon
description: Directed by George Clooney, SUBURBICON is a cold-blooded thriller set in the peaceful streets of suburbia. Here, the picket-fenced homes and manicured lawns look like the perfect place to raise a family...

title: Suitable Flesh
description: After murdering her young patient, a once-esteemed psychiatrist helplessly watches her life spiral into a nightmarish maelstrom of supernatural hysteria and gruesome deaths, all linked to a seemingly unstoppable ancient curse.

title: Suite Francaise
description: France 1940. As Hitler’s armies take control of Paris and bring total occupation to France, Lucile (Michelle Williams) awaits news from her husband who is being held a prisoner of war.

title: Sukiyaki Western Django
description: Acclaimed director Takashi Miike (13 Assassins) redefines the spaghetti western with SUKIYAKI WESTERN DJANGO starring Quentin Tarantino.

title: Sunrise
description: When a former cop named Fallon returns to the scene of a horrific crime, the residents of a rural town discover the dark visitor is really a vampire who feeds on blood and fear. Befriended by a kind immigrant family, the instinctive killer soon faces a choice of revenge or redemption.

title: Sunshine Cleaning
description: Once the high school cheerleading captain who dated the quarterback, Rose Lorkowski (Amy Adams) now finds herself a 30-something single mother working as a maid.

title: Super
description: Mild-mannered Frank D'Arbo decides to enter the world of crime fighting superheroes when his wife, Sarah, leaves him for local drug dealer Jacques.

title: Super Fuzz
description: Stricken by radiation, an agent acquires superpowers with which he breaks up a gang of counterfeiters who print bills on a fishing boat that he disposes of along with frozen fish. Among the superpowers are bullets stopped with his teeth.

title: Super Seniors
description: Super Seniors tells the story of four "Super Senior" tennis players - Leonid (95), Etty (82), King (85) and John (87) - as they descend on the latest International Tennis Federation Senior World Championship.

title: Supercell
description: Aspiring storm-chaser William is determined to continue his father's legacy by chasing the most dangerous supercell tornado ever seen.

title: Supremacy
description: A murderous white supremacist on parole takes an African American family hostage during a chaotic night of terror, and the police are forced to call in a dangerous prisoner to negotiate with the kidnapper …

title: Surprised by Oxford
description: Caro, a brilliant but emotionally guarded American student, arrives at the prestigious Oxford University with the sole focus of attaining her PhD.

title: Surrounded
description: In search of a gold mine, ex-soldier Mo Washington heads west. When an ambush forces her to take an outlaw captive, a battle ensues in the harsh wilderness. Directed by Anthony Mandler, starring Letitia Wright, Jamie Bell, and Michael K. Williams.

title: Surrounded
description: The Shallows meets Jaws in this gripping, pulse-pounding shark thriller. To boost viewership of their popular travel vlog, a group of millennial friends document their illegal snorkelling trip to a beautiful cove.

title: Survive
description: When their plane crashes on a remote snow-covered mountain, Jane and Paul have to fight for their lives as the only remaining survivors. Together they embark on a harrowing journey out of the wilderness.

title: Survivor
description: SURVIVOR is a gripping thriller about State Department employee Kate Abbott, newly posted in the American embassy in London. Kate is charged with stopping terrorists from getting into the U.S. which puts her directly in the line of fire.

title: Swallow
description: A provocative and acclaimed psychological thriller, 'Swallow' follows one woman’s unravelling as she struggles to reclaim independence in the face of an oppressive system by whatever means possible.

title: Swap Me Baby
description: While on a nature getaway at a remote cabin, an expectant couple stumble upon a magic box that swaps out their souls.

title: Sweetland
description: Sweetland is the story of an isolated community at the outermost edge of the world, and the struggles of one man determined to resist its extinction.

title: Switched
description: Tired of being bullied, Cassandra Evans prays that her nemesis, Katie Sharp, the queen bee of social media, would know what it's like to walk a day in her shoes. Her prayer is answered in an unexpected way when they get "Switched."

title: Sword of the Assassin
description: After the Le Chi Vien massacre, only five-year-old boy, grandchild of Nguyen Trai, in Nguyen Trai Family survives. A family servant takes the boy to run away from the hunt of Queen Mother Tuyen Tu Hoang.

title: Sword of Trust
description: An acclaimed comedy from revered director Lynn Shelton (Say When, Your Sister’s Sister), starring Marc Maron (Glow), Jillian Bell (Brittany Runs a Marathon), Jonathan Bass (Baywatch) and Michaela Watkins (Transparent).

title: Tainted
description: An ex-con, Lance, with ties to the Russian mob and Aryan brotherhood, attempts to live a quiet life after spending fifteen years in prison.

title: Take Down
description: Take Down focuses on the wayward offspring of international billionaires, sent by their parents to a tough-love school on a remote British island. When the school is taken hostage by a group of sophisticated kidnappers, the kids take the situation into their own hands.

title: Tale of Tales
description: SIMULTANEOUS RELEASE. IN CINEMAS AND WUAKI TV! From the bitter quest of the Queen of Longtrellis, to two mysterious sisters who provoke the passion of a king, to the King of Highhills obsessed with a giant Flea, these tales are inspired by the fairytales by Giambattista Basile.

title: Tangent Room
description: Trapped in a mysterious room with no escape, four brilliant minds race against time to prevent a cosmic collapse of the universe. They must learn to work together and solve the puzzle before it's too late.

title: Team Hot Wheels: Origin of Awesome
description: Meet Gage, Wyatt, Brandon and Rhett.  Kids born to ride.  Separately, they are seriously skilled racers, but together they become TEAM HOT WHEELS!

title: Team Khan
description: Fly-on-the-wall documentary about professional boxer Amir Khan. Filmed over two years, it follows Amir and his team in their quest to fight the best boxer on the planet, the unbeaten Floyd Mayweather Jr.

title: Ted Bundy American Boogeyman
description: Ted Bundy stalks the highways of gritty 70s America. FBI agents lead the largest manhunt in history to apprehend America's most infamous serial killer.

title: Teen Spirit
description: From the producer and musical team that brought you award-winning sensation LA LA LAND, comes TEEN SPIRIT. Fuel-injected with chart-topping pop anthems, ELLE FANNING takes centre stage in this uplifting Cinderella story about growing up, dreaming big, and finding your voice.

title: Tell It Like a Woman
description: Academy Award nominated Tell It Like A Woman tells the empowering stories of women, both in front of and behind the camera.

title: Tell It to the Bees
description: When mill worker Lydia is abandoned by her philandering husband, she struggles to look after herself and her son Charlie. Local doctor Jean is one of the few to help and a friendship develops that blossoms into a romance that will scandalise the town.

title: Tell Me I Love You
description: Three musicians pull off a scam to pay for their first album. However their past affairs, sexuality, and concept of "family" disrupt societal conventions. With a hit album on the way and stardom right at their fingertips, they must decide what true love is, and what they each mean to each other.

title: Tell no one
description: After his critically-acclaimed directorial debut, Mon Idole (Whatever You Say), French actor Guillaume Canet now brings us Tell No One, based on American writer Harlan Coben's bestselling thriller.

title: Telmo and Tula, Arts & Crafts
description: In this new session of Telmo and Tula, our little friends will teach us, easily and with materials available to everyone, how to make crafts and toys in the most fun and simple way possible.

title: Telmo And Tula, Little Cooks
description: Telmo & Tula is a very fun animated series in which children learn to cook the best breakfasts, sandwiches, salads and desserts in a safe and entertaining way. Telmo and Tula will teach children how fun it is to prepare delicious meals step by step.

title: Tennessee Williams' The Roman Spring of Mrs. Stone
description: After moving to Rome, a lonely widow finds herself consumed by a destructive love for a young Italian man in this adaptation of Tennessee Williams’ haunting novella.

title: Terezin
description: Antonio, an Italian clarinetist, and Martina, a Czech violinist, fall in love during the Second World War in Prague. The two are deported to the Terezin concentration camp, where their history is intertwined with that of many Jews.

title: Terminus
description: Following a near-fatal accident, David Chamberlain makes an unprecedented discovery that will not only determine the fate of his family, but of mankind.

title: That Awkward Moment
description: When Mikey is dumped by his girlfriend, his best friends Jason and Daniel make a pact to remain single with him until he gets back into the whirlwind of the New York dating game.

title: That Click
description: A man at the cutting edge of fashion, photojournalism and portraiture, photographer to the stars Douglas Kirkland has, with his camera, portrayed over sixty years of pop culture.

title: The 4th
description: It’s the 4th of July in Los Angeles, when Jamie, an illustrator who can barely pay his rent, tries to throw a party while his bully roommate is out of town. But everything seems to go wrong.

title: The 4th Floor
description: In this mystery thriller, a woman inherits a rent-controlled apartment and is terrorized by a neighbor. Starring Juliette Lewis, William Hurt and Shelley Duvall.

title: The 6th Friend
description: Six college best friends throw their own private graduation party that goes terribly wrong when an uninvited guest arrives.

title: The Affair
description: Liesel Landauer and her friend Hana are linked by a lifelong relationship and an exceptional house built by the architect Von Abt for Liesel and her husband Viktor in Czechoslovakia in the early 1930s.

title: The Air I Breathe
description: A drama based on an ancient Chinese proverb that breaks life down into four emotional cornerstones: happiness, pleasure, sorrow and love.

title: The Arrival
description: Radio astronomer Zane Zaminsky (Charlie Sheen) believes he's picked up a cosmic noise that signals extraterrestrial intelligence. His desperate search for answers leads him to Mexico and a mysterious power plant, where is arrested for the murder of a scientist.

title: The Art Beat
description: The series focuses on the life and work of leading contemporary Chinese artists.

title: The Asian Connection
description: Two Americans, Jack and Sam, unwittingly steal a drug lord’s money when they rob a series of banks in Southeast Asia, quickly becoming the target of the gang's vengeance. When Sam is killed, Jack takes the fight to the gang.

title: The Assassination
description: There is something, or someone, rotten at St Donavan's High School, and Bobby is determined to uncover the dirty truth.

title: The Assistant
description: An assistant to a powerful movie mogul grows increasingly aware of the questionable behaviour of her boss toward her female peers.

title: The Babadook
description: Six years after the violent death of her husband, Amelia (Essie Davis) is at a loss. She struggles to discipline her ‘out of control’ 6 year-old, Samuel (Noah Wiseman), a son she finds impossible to love. Samuel’s dreams are plagued by a monster he believes is coming to kill them both.

title: The Baby Proposal
description: Ambitious Layla Bennet co-hosts morning show Wake Up Chicago! with her handsome colleague Derek Dray. They don’t always see eye to eye, so when they suddenly must care for a baby together, it’s their worst nightmare!

title: The Baby Snatcher
description: Best friends become pregnant at the same time. However, when one of them suffers a miscarriage, jealousy turns her into a murderous baby snatcher.

title: The Babymakers
